/*
 * DSMIL Thunderbolt Compatibility Mode Controller
 * Direct manipulation of Thunderbolt CM modes via GNVS fields
 * 
 * Build: gcc -o thunderbolt_cm_control thunderbolt_cm_control.c
 * Usage: sudo ./thunderbolt_cm_control [options]
 */

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <getopt.h>
#include <sys/io.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <stdarg.h>

#define PAGE_SIZE 4096

// GNVS region addresses (from previous analysis)
#define GNVS_BASE 0x51CB3000
#define GNVS_SIZE 0x0DA3

// GNVS field offsets (found dynamically)
static int u4se_offset = -1;  // USB4 Support Enable
static int u4cm_offset = -1;  // USB4 Compatibility Mode
static int cmsk_offset = -1;  // CM Mode Mask

// ACPI method calls via /sys/firmware/acpi/tables
static char acpi_method_path[256];

struct cm_mode_info {
    const char *name;
    uint8_t value;
    const char *description;
};

static struct cm_mode_info cm_modes[] = {
    {"disabled", 0, "USB4/Thunderbolt disabled"},
    {"sw", 1, "Software compatibility mode"},
    {"hw", 2, "Hardware compatibility mode"},
    {"mixed", 3, "Mixed compatibility mode"},
    {NULL, 0, NULL}
};

static int mem_fd = -1;
static void *mem_map = NULL;

static void log_msg(const char *level, const char *msg, ...) {
    time_t now = time(NULL);
    struct tm *tm_info = localtime(&now);
    
    va_list args;
    va_start(args, msg);
    
    printf("[%02d:%02d:%02d] [%s] ", 
           tm_info->tm_hour, tm_info->tm_min, tm_info->tm_sec, level);
    vprintf(msg, args);
    printf("\n");
    
    va_end(args);
}

static int init_memory_access(void) {
    mem_fd = open("/dev/mem", O_RDWR);
    if (mem_fd < 0) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "Failed to open /dev/mem");
        return -1;
    }
    
    mem_map = mmap(NULL, GNVS_SIZE, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, mem_fd, GNVS_BASE);
    if (mem_map == MAP_FAILED) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "Failed to mmap GNVS region");
        close(mem_fd);
        return -1;
    }
    
    log_msg("INFO", "Mapped GNVS region");
    return 0;
}

static void cleanup_memory_access(void) {
    if (mem_map != NULL && mem_map != MAP_FAILED) {
        munmap(mem_map, GNVS_SIZE);
    }
    if (mem_fd >= 0) {
        close(mem_fd);
    }
}

static uint8_t read_gnvs_byte(int offset) {
    if (!mem_map || offset < 0 || offset >= GNVS_SIZE) {
        return 0xFF;
    }
    
    uint8_t *addr = (uint8_t *)mem_map + offset;
    return *addr;
}

static int write_gnvs_byte(int offset, uint8_t value) {
    if (!mem_map || offset < 0 || offset >= GNVS_SIZE) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    uint8_t *addr = (uint8_t *)mem_map + offset;
    *addr = value;
    return 0;
}

static int find_usb4_fields(void) {
    log_msg("INFO", "Searching for USB4 fields in GNVS region...");
    
    // Search for USB4 field patterns
    // U4SE, U4CM, CMSK are typically consecutive
    for (int i = 0; i < GNVS_SIZE - 3; i++) {
        uint8_t v0 = read_gnvs_byte(i);
        uint8_t v1 = read_gnvs_byte(i + 1);
        uint8_t v2 = read_gnvs_byte(i + 2);
        
        // Look for plausible USB4 field values
        if (v0 <= 1 && v1 <= 3 && v2 <= 3) {
            // Check if this looks like USB4 fields
            u4se_offset = i;
            u4cm_offset = i + 1;
            cmsk_offset = i + 2;
            
            log_msg("INFO", "Found USB4 fields:");
            log_msg("INFO", "  U4SE offset: 0x%04X = %d", u4se_offset, v0);
            log_msg("INFO", "  U4CM offset: 0x%04X = %d", u4cm_offset, v1);
            log_msg("INFO", "  CMSK offset: 0x%04X = %d", cmsk_offset, v2);
            
            return 1;
        }
    }
    
    log_msg("WARN", "USB4 fields not found in expected pattern");
    return 0;
}

static void show_current_state(void) {
    printf("\n=== Current Thunderbolt State ===\n");
    
    if (u4se_offset < 0 || u4cm_offset < 0 || cmsk_offset < 0) {
        printf("USB4 fields not found\n");
        return;
    }
    
    uint8_t u4se = read_gnvs_byte(u4se_offset);
    uint8_t u4cm = read_gnvs_byte(u4cm_offset);
    uint8_t cmsk = read_gnvs_byte(cmsk_offset);
    
    printf("USB4 Support Enable (U4SE): %d\n", u4se);
    printf("USB4 Compatibility Mode (U4CM): %d", u4cm);
    
    // Find mode name
    for (int i = 0; cm_modes[i].name; i++) {
        if (cm_modes[i].value == u4cm) {
            printf(" (%s)\n", cm_modes[i].name);
            break;
        }
    }
    
    printf("CM Mode Mask (CMSK): %d\n", cmsk);
    
    // Check which domains are enabled
    printf("\nDomain Enable Status:\n");
    if (cmsk & 0x01) {
        printf("  ✓ Domain 0 (iTBT0) enabled\n");
    } else {
        printf("  ✗ Domain 0 (iTBT0) disabled\n");
    }
    
    if (cmsk & 0x02) {
        printf("  ✓ Domain 1 (iTBT1) enabled\n");
    } else {
        printf("  ✗ Domain 1 (iTBT1) disabled\n");
    }
}

static int set_cm_mode(const char *mode_name) {
    uint8_t mode_value = 0xFF;
    
    // Find mode value
    for (int i = 0; cm_modes[i].name; i++) {
        if (strcmp(cm_modes[i].name, mode_name) == 0) {
            mode_value = cm_modes[i].value;
            break;
        }
    }
    
    if (mode_value == 0xFF) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "Invalid mode. Available modes:");
        for (int i = 0; cm_modes[i].name; i++) {
            printf("  %s - %s\n", cm_modes[i].name, cm_modes[i].description);
        }
        return -1;
    }
    
    if (u4cm_offset < 0) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "U4CM field not found");
        return -1;
    }
    
    uint8_t original = read_gnvs_byte(u4cm_offset);
    
    if (write_gnvs_byte(u4cm_offset, mode_value) < 0) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "Failed to write U4CM field");
        return -1;
    }
    
    uint8_t new_value = read_gnvs_byte(u4cm_offset);
    
    log_msg("INFO", "CM mode changed: %d -> %d", original, new_value);
    log_msg("INFO", "Mode: %s", mode_name);
    
    return 0;
}

static int enable_usb4_support(void) {
    if (u4se_offset < 0) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "U4SE field not found");
        return -1;
    }
    
    uint8_t original = read_gnvs_byte(u4se_offset);
    
    if (original == 1) {
        log_msg("INFO", "USB4 support already enabled");
        return 0;
    }
    
    if (write_gnvs_byte(u4se_offset, 1) < 0) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "Failed to write U4SE field");
        return -1;
    }
    
    uint8_t new_value = read_gnvs_byte(u4se_offset);
    
    log_msg("INFO", "USB4 support enabled: %d -> %d", original, new_value);
    return 0;
}

static int disable_usb4_support(void) {
    if (u4se_offset < 0) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "U4SE field not found");
        return -1;
    }
    
    uint8_t original = read_gnvs_byte(u4se_offset);
    
    if (original == 0) {
        log_msg("INFO", "USB4 support already disabled");
        return 0;
    }
    
    if (write_gnvs_byte(u4se_offset, 0) < 0) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "Failed to write U4SE field");
        return -1;
    }
    
    uint8_t new_value = read_gnvs_byte(u4se_offset);
    
    log_msg("INFO", "USB4 support disabled: %d -> %d", original, new_value);
    return 0;
}

static int set_domain_mask(uint8_t mask) {
    if (cmsk_offset < 0) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "CMSK field not found");
        return -1;
    }
    
    uint8_t original = read_gnvs_byte(cmsk_offset);
    
    if (write_gnvs_byte(cmsk_offset, mask) < 0) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "Failed to write CMSK field");
        return -1;
    }
    
    uint8_t new_value = read_gnvs_byte(cmsk_offset);
    
    log_msg("INFO", "Domain mask changed: 0x%02X -> 0x%02X", original, new_value);
    
    printf("Domain configuration:\n");
    if (mask & 0x01) {
        printf("  ✓ Domain 0 (iTBT0) enabled\n");
    }
    if (mask & 0x02) {
        printf("  ✓ Domain 1 (iTBT1) enabled\n");
    }
    
    return 0;
}

static int call_acpi_method(const char *method, const char *arg) {
    char cmd[512];
    
    // Try to call ACPI method via acpi_call if available
    snprintf(cmd, sizeof(cmd), "acpi_call -e %s %s 2>/dev/null", method, arg);
    int result = system(cmd);
    if (result == 0) {
        log_msg("INFO", "ACPI method %s called via acpi_call: %s", method, arg);
        return 0;
    }
    
    log_msg("WARN", "Failed to call ACPI method %s (acpi_call not available)", method);
    return -1;
}

static int trigger_docm_method(void) {
    log_msg("INFO", "Triggering DOCM method...");
    
    // Try to call DOCM method
    return call_acpi_method("\\_SB.DOCM", "");
}

static void show_thunderbolt_devices(void) {
    printf("\n=== Thunderbolt Devices ===\n");
    
    // Use lspci to find Thunderbolt devices
    system("lspci -nn | grep -i thunderbolt");
    system("lspci -nn | grep -i '0x15.*0x'");
    
    // Check for USB4 devices
    printf("\n=== USB4 Devices ===\n");
    system("lsusb | grep -i thunderbolt");
    system("lsusb | grep -i usb4");
}

static void print_usage(const char *prog_name) {
    printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", prog_name);
    printf("\nOptions:\n");
    printf("  -s, --status          Show current Thunderbolt state\n");
    printf("  -m, --mode <mode>     Set CM mode (disabled|sw|hw|mixed)\n");
    printf("  -e, --enable          Enable USB4 support\n");
    printf("  -d, --disable         Disable USB4 support\n");
    printf("  -M, --mask <mask>     Set domain mask (hex, e.g., 0x03)\n");
    printf("  -t, --trigger         Trigger DOCM ACPI method\n");
    printf("  -D, --devices         Show Thunderbolt/USB4 devices\n");
    printf("  -h, --help           Show this help\n");
    printf("\nExamples:\n");
    printf("  %s -s                 # Show current state\n", prog_name);
    printf("  %s -m sw              # Force software CM mode\n", prog_name);
    printf("  %s -e                 # Enable USB4 support\n", prog_name);
    printf("  %s -M 0x03             # Enable both domains\n", prog_name);
    printf("  %s -t                 # Trigger DOCM method\n", prog_name);
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
    int opt;
    int action = 0;  // 0=status, 1=set_mode, 2=enable, 3=disable, 4=mask, 5=trigger, 6=devices
    
    char *mode_value = NULL;
    uint8_t mask_value = 0;
    
    static struct option long_opts[] = {
        {"status", no_argument, 0, 's'},
        {"mode", required_argument, 0, 'm'},
        {"enable", no_argument, 0, 'e'},
        {"disable", no_argument, 0, 'd'},
        {"mask", required_argument, 0, 'M'},
        {"trigger", no_argument, 0, 't'},
        {"devices", no_argument, 0, 'D'},
        {"help", no_argument, 0, 'h'},
        {0, 0, 0, 0}
    };
    
    if (geteuid() != 0) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "This program requires root privileges");
        printf("Run with: sudo %s\n", argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }
    
    while ((opt = getopt_long(argc, argv, "sm:edM:tDh", long_opts, NULL)) != -1) {
        switch (opt) {
            case 's':
                action = 0;
                break;
            case 'm':
                action = 1;
                mode_value = optarg;
                break;
            case 'e':
                action = 2;
                break;
            case 'd':
                action = 3;
                break;
            case 'M':
                action = 4;
                mask_value = (uint8_t)strtol(optarg, NULL, 0);
                break;
            case 't':
                action = 5;
                break;
            case 'D':
                action = 6;
                break;
            case 'h':
                print_usage(argv[0]);
                return 0;
            default:
                print_usage(argv[0]);
                return 1;
        }
    }
    
    // Initialize memory access
    if (init_memory_access() < 0) {
        return 1;
    }
    
    // Find USB4 fields
    if (!find_usb4_fields()) {
        log_msg("WARN", "Proceeding without USB4 field detection");
    }
    
    // Execute requested action
    int result = 0;
    
    switch (action) {
        case 0:  // status
            show_current_state();
            break;
        case 1:  // set mode
            result = set_cm_mode(mode_value);
            break;
        case 2:  // enable
            result = enable_usb4_support();
            break;
        case 3:  // disable
            result = disable_usb4_support();
            break;
        case 4:  // mask
            result = set_domain_mask(mask_value);
            break;
        case 5:  // trigger
            result = trigger_docm_method();
            break;
        case 6:  // devices
            show_thunderbolt_devices();
            break;
        default:
            show_current_state();
            break;
    }
    
    // Show final state if we made changes
    if (action >= 1 && action <= 4) {
        printf("\n");
        show_current_state();
    }
    
    // Cleanup
    cleanup_memory_access();
    
    return result;
}



## SOURCE: intel-bug-bounty-report/ACPI DDST SSDT Firmware/acpi_tables/06_tools_and_scripts/nc3_vault_analyzer.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
DSMIL NC3 Vault Analyzer and NVM Restoration Tool
Analyzes NC3 vault structure and provides Ethernet NVM restoration capabilities
"""

import os
import sys
import time
import struct
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any, Tuple

class NC3VaultAnalyzer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.base_path = Path("/run/media/john/593d876a-4036-4255-bd45-33baba503068/DSMILSystem")
        self.results = {}
        
        # Hardware addresses from memory context
        self.addresses = {
            'i219_bar': 0x7C100000,
            'sram_tunnel': 0x50192D8000,
            'gna_fabric': 0x50192E3000,
            'csme_base': 0x50192DD000,
        }
        
        # NC3 vault structure
        self.vault_magic = 0x4E433300  # "NC3\0"
        self.vault_version = 0x0001
        
    def log(self, msg: str, level: str = "INFO"):
        """Log message with timestamp"""
        timestamp = time.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
        print(f"[{timestamp}] [{level}] {msg}")
        
    def check_root(self) -> bool:
        """Check if running as root"""
        return os.geteuid() == 0
        
    def read_memory_region(self, base: int, size: int) -> Optional[bytes]:
        """Read memory region via /dev/mem"""
        try:
            with open("/dev/mem", "rb") as mem:
                mem.seek(base)
                return mem.read(size)
        except Exception as e:
            self.log(f"Error reading memory region 0x{base:X}: {e}", "ERROR")
            return None
            
    def write_memory_region(self, base: int, data: bytes) -> bool:
        """Write memory region via /dev/mem"""
        try:
            with open("/dev/mem", "r+b") as mem:
                mem.seek(base)
                mem.write(data)
                return True
        except Exception as e:
            self.log(f"Error writing memory region 0x{base:X}: {e}", "ERROR")
            return False
            
    def analyze_sram_tunnel(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Analyze SRAM tunnel for NC3 vault"""
        self.log("Analyzing SRAM tunnel for NC3 vault...")
        
        results = {
            'tunnel_active': False,
            'vault_found': False,
            'vault_offset': 0,
            'vault_size': 0,
            'route_descriptors': []
        }
        
        # Read SRAM tunnel feature register
        tunnel_data = self.read_memory_region(self.addresses['sram_tunnel'], 0x1000)
        if not tunnel_data:
            return results
            
        # Check tunnel feature
        feature_reg = struct.unpack("<I", tunnel_data[0x0000:0x0004])[0]
        results['tunnel_active'] = (feature_reg & 0x20002000) != 0
        
        self.log(f"SRAM Tunnel Feature: 0x{feature_reg:08X}")
        self.log(f"Tunnel Active: {results['tunnel_active']}")
        
        if not results['tunnel_active']:
            return results
            
        # Parse route descriptors
        for i in range(4):
            desc_offset = 0x024 + i * 8
            ctrl_offset = 0x028 + i * 8
            
            if desc_offset + 4 <= len(tunnel_data) and ctrl_offset + 4 <= len(tunnel_data):
                route_desc = struct.unpack("<I", tunnel_data[desc_offset:desc_offset+4])[0]
                route_ctrl = struct.unpack("<I", tunnel_data[ctrl_offset:ctrl_offset+4])[0]
                
                port = route_desc & 0xFF
                base = route_ctrl & 0xFFFFF000
                
                route_info = {
                    'index': i,
                    'port': port,
                    'base': base,
                    'desc': route_desc,
                    'ctrl': route_ctrl
                }
                
                results['route_descriptors'].append(route_info)
                
                self.log(f"Route {i}: Port 0x{port:02X}, Base 0x{base:08X}")
                
                # Look for NC3 vault (port 0x99)
                if port == 0x99:
                    results['vault_found'] = True
                    results['vault_offset'] = base
                    results['vault_size'] = 0x10000  # 64KB
                    
                    self.log(f"Found NC3 vault at offset 0x{base:08X}")
                    
        return results
        
    def dump_nc3_vault(self, output_file: str) -> bool:
        """Dump NC3 vault to file"""
        self.log(f"Dumping NC3 vault to {output_file}...")
        
        tunnel_results = self.analyze_sram_tunnel()
        
        if not tunnel_results['vault_found']:
            self.log("NC3 vault not found", "ERROR")
            return False
            
        # Calculate vault base address
        vault_base = self.addresses['sram_tunnel'] + tunnel_results['vault_offset']
        vault_size = tunnel_results['vault_size']
        
        self.log(f"Reading NC3 vault from 0x{vault_base:X} ({vault_size} bytes)")
        
        # Read vault data
        vault_data = self.read_memory_region(vault_base, vault_size)
        if not vault_data:
            return False
            
        # Verify vault header
        if len(vault_data) >= 16:
            magic = struct.unpack("<I", vault_data[0:4])[0]
            version = struct.unpack("<H", vault_data[4:6])[0]
            size = struct.unpack("<H", vault_data[6:8])[0]
            
            self.log(f"Vault Header: Magic=0x{magic:08X}, Version={version}, Size={size}")
            
            if magic != self.vault_magic:
                self.log(f"Vault magic mismatch: expected 0x{self.vault_magic:08X}", "WARN")
            else:
                self.log("NC3 vault header verified")
                
        # Save to file
        try:
            with open(output_file, "wb") as f:
                f.write(vault_data)
            self.log(f"NC3 vault dumped to {output_file} ({len(vault_data)} bytes)")
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            self.log(f"Error saving vault: {e}", "ERROR")
            return False
            
    def analyze_vault_structure(self, vault_file: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Analyze NC3 vault structure"""
        self.log(f"Analyzing vault structure from {vault_file}...")
        
        results = {
            'valid_header': False,
            'entries': [],
            'total_size': 0
        }
        
        try:
            with open(vault_file, "rb") as f:
                data = f.read()
                
            results['total_size'] = len(data)
            
            if len(data) < 16:
                self.log("Vault file too small", "ERROR")
                return results
                
            # Parse header
            magic = struct.unpack("<I", data[0:4])[0]
            version = struct.unpack("<H", data[4:6])[0]
            size = struct.unpack("<H", data[6:8])[0]
            checksum = struct.unpack("<I", data[8:12])[0]
            timestamp = struct.unpack("<I", data[12:16])[0]
            
            results['valid_header'] = (magic == self.vault_magic)
            
            if results['valid_header']:
                self.log(f"Valid NC3 Vault v{version}")
                self.log(f"Size: {size} bytes, Checksum: 0x{checksum:08X}")
                self.log(f"Timestamp: {timestamp}")
                
                # Parse entries
                offset = 16
                entry_count = 0
                
                while offset < len(data) - 16 and entry_count < 100:  # Limit entries
                    if offset + 48 > len(data):
                        break
                        
                    entry_type = struct.unpack("<I", data[offset:offset+4])[0]
                    entry_offset = struct.unpack("<I", data[offset+4:offset+8])[0]
                    entry_size = struct.unpack("<I", data[offset+8:offset+12])[0]
                    entry_flags = struct.unpack("<I", data[offset+12:offset+16])[0]
                    entry_name = data[offset+16:offset+48].rstrip(b'\x00').decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
                    
                    if entry_type == 0 and entry_offset == 0 and entry_size == 0:
                        break  # End of entries
                        
                    entry = {
                        'type': entry_type,
                        'offset': entry_offset,
                        'size': entry_size,
                        'flags': entry_flags,
                        'name': entry_name
                    }
                    
                    results['entries'].append(entry)
                    
                    self.log(f"Entry {entry_count}: {entry_name} (type={entry_type}, size={entry_size})")
                    
                    offset += 48
                    entry_count += 1
                    
                self.log(f"Found {entry_count} vault entries")
                
            else:
                self.log(f"Invalid vault magic: 0x{magic:08X}", "ERROR")
                
        except Exception as e:
            self.log(f"Error analyzing vault: {e}", "ERROR")
            
        return results
        
    def backup_ethernet_nvm(self, backup_file: str) -> bool:
        """Backup Ethernet NVM"""
        self.log(f"Backing up Ethernet NVM to {backup_file}...")
        
        # Check I219-V device
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(
                ["lspci", "-xxx", "-s", "00:1f.6"],
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=5
            )
            
            if result.returncode != 0:
                self.log("I219-V device not found", "ERROR")
                return False
                
        except Exception as e:
            self.log(f"Error checking I219-V: {e}", "ERROR")
            return False
            
        # Map I219-V registers
        i219_data = self.read_memory_region(self.addresses['i219_bar'], 0x1000)
        if not i219_data:
            return False
            
        # Read NVM using EEPROM read method
        nvm_data = bytearray()
        
        for i in range(0, 0x100, 4):  # 4KB NVM
            # Set EEPROM address
            addr_value = (i << 2) | 0x1  # Read command
            if self.write_memory_region(self.addresses['i219_bar'] + 0x14, struct.pack("<I", addr_value)):
                time.sleep(0.001)  # Wait for read
                
                # Read data
                data = self.read_memory_region(self.addresses['i219_bar'] + 0x14, 4)
                if data:
                    nvm_data.extend(data)
                    
        if len(nvm_data) == 0:
            self.log("Failed to read NVM data", "ERROR")
            return False
            
        # Save backup
        try:
            with open(backup_file, "wb") as f:
                f.write(nvm_data)
            self.log(f"NVM backup saved to {backup_file} ({len(nvm_data)} bytes)")
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            self.log(f"Error saving backup: {e}", "ERROR")
            return False
            
    def restore_ethernet_nvm(self, nvm_file: str) -> bool:
        """Restore Ethernet NVM from file"""
        self.log(f"Restoring Ethernet NVM from {nvm_file}...")
        
        # Read NVM file
        try:
            with open(nvm_file, "rb") as f:
                nvm_data = f.read()
        except Exception as e:
            self.log(f"Error reading NVM file: {e}", "ERROR")
            return False
            
        if len(nvm_data) > 0x1000:
            self.log(f"NVM file too large: {len(nvm_data)} bytes (max 4KB)", "ERROR")
            return False
            
        # Check I219-V device
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(
                ["lspci", "-xxx", "-s", "00:1f.6"],
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=5
            )
            
            if result.returncode != 0:
                self.log("I219-V device not found", "ERROR")
                return False
                
        except Exception as e:
            self.log(f"Error checking I219-V: {e}", "ERROR")
            return False
            
        # Map I219-V registers
        i219_data = self.read_memory_region(self.addresses['i219_bar'], 0x1000)
        if not i219_data:
            return False
            
        # Enable flash write access
        self.log("Enabling flash write access...")
        
        # Get semaphore
        swsm = struct.unpack("<I", i219_data[0x58:0x5C])[0]
        self.write_memory_region(self.addresses['i219_bar'] + 0x58, struct.pack("<I", swsm | 0x1))
        
        # Enable flash writes
        eecd = struct.unpack("<I", i219_data[0x10:0x14])[0]
        self.write_memory_region(self.addresses['i219_bar'] + 0x10, struct.pack("<I", eecd | 0x2))
        
        time.sleep(0.001)
        
        # Write NVM data
        self.log(f"Writing {len(nvm_data)} bytes to NVM...")
        
        for i in range(0, len(nvm_data), 4):
            if i + 4 <= len(nvm_data):
                word = struct.unpack("<I", nvm_data[i:i+4])[0]
            else:
                # Handle partial word at end
                word = 0
                for j in range(len(nvm_data) - i):
                    word |= nvm_data[i + j] << (j * 8)
                    
            # Write word to NVM
            addr_value = (i << 2) | word
            self.write_memory_region(self.addresses['i219_bar'] + 0x14, struct.pack("<I", addr_value))
            
            # Wait for write completion
            timeout = 100
            while timeout > 0:
                eecd_data = self.read_memory_region(self.addresses['i219_bar'] + 0x10, 4)
                if eecd_data and not (struct.unpack("<I", eecd_data)[0] & 0x1):
                    break
                time.sleep(0.0001)
                timeout -= 1
                
            if timeout == 0:
                self.log(f"Flash write timeout at offset 0x{i:04X}", "WARN")
                
            if (i % 256) == 0:
                self.log(f"Written {i}/{len(nvm_data)} bytes")
                
        # Disable flash writes
        eecd = struct.unpack("<I", self.read_memory_region(self.addresses['i219_bar'] + 0x10, 4))[0]
        self.write_memory_region(self.addresses['i219_bar'] + 0x10, struct.pack("<I", eecd & ~0x2))
        
        # Release semaphore
        swsm = struct.unpack("<I", self.read_memory_region(self.addresses['i219_bar'] + 0x58, 4))[0]
        self.write_memory_region(self.addresses['i219_bar'] + 0x58, struct.pack("<I", swsm & ~0x1))
        
        self.log("NVM restoration completed")
        
        # Reset Ethernet controller
        self.log("Resetting Ethernet controller...")
        
        # Reset via PCI command register
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(
                ["setpci", "-s", "00:1f.6", "COMMAND.L", "0x0000"],
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=5
            )
            time.sleep(0.1)
            
            result = subprocess.run(
                ["setpci", "-s", "00:1f.6", "COMMAND.L", "0x0007"],
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=5
            )
            
            self.log("Ethernet controller reset complete")
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.log(f"Error resetting controller: {e}", "WARN")
            
        return True
        
    def run_complete_analysis(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Run complete NC3 vault and Ethernet analysis"""
        self.log("Starting complete NC3 vault and Ethernet analysis...")
        self.log("=" * 50)
        
        results = {
            'timestamp': time.time(),
            'sram_tunnel': self.analyze_sram_tunnel(),
            'vault_dumped': False,
            'vault_analysis': {},
            'nvm_backup': False,
            'nvm_restored': False
        }
        
        # Dump NC3 vault
        vault_file = "nc3_vault_dump.bin"
        if results['sram_tunnel']['vault_found']:
            results['vault_dumped'] = self.dump_nc3_vault(vault_file)
            
            if results['vault_dumped']:
                results['vault_analysis'] = self.analyze_vault_structure(vault_file)
                
        # Backup NVM
        nvm_backup_file = "ethernet_nvm_backup.bin"
        results['nvm_backup'] = self.backup_ethernet_nvm(nvm_backup_file)
        
        # Generate summary
        self.generate_summary(results)
        
        return results
        
    def generate_summary(self, results: Dict[str, Any]):
        """Generate analysis summary"""
        self.log("=" * 50)
        self.log("NC3 VAULT AND ETHERNET ANALYSIS SUMMARY")
        self.log("=" * 50)
        
        # SRAM Tunnel Status
        tunnel = results['sram_tunnel']
        self.log(f"SRAM Tunnel: {'ACTIVE' if tunnel['tunnel_active'] else 'INACTIVE'}")
        self.log(f"NC3 Vault: {'FOUND' if tunnel['vault_found'] else 'NOT FOUND'}")
        
        if tunnel['vault_found']:
            self.log(f"Vault Offset: 0x{tunnel['vault_offset']:08X}")
            self.log(f"Vault Size: {tunnel['vault_size']} bytes")
            
        # Vault Dump Status
        self.log(f"Vault Dump: {'SUCCESS' if results['vault_dumped'] else 'FAILED'}")
        
        if results['vault_analysis']:
            analysis = results['vault_analysis']
            self.log(f"Vault Header: {'VALID' if analysis['valid_header'] else 'INVALID'}")
            self.log(f"Vault Entries: {len(analysis['entries'])}")
            
        # NVM Status
        self.log(f"NVM Backup: {'SUCCESS' if results['nvm_backup'] else 'FAILED'}")
        
        # Overall Assessment
        success_count = sum([
            tunnel['tunnel_active'],
            tunnel['vault_found'],
            results['vault_dumped'],
            results['nvm_backup']
        ])
        
        if success_count >= 3:
            self.log("OVERALL: HIGH SUCCESS - Full access achieved", "SUCCESS")
        elif success_count >= 2:
            self.log("OVERALL: PARTIAL SUCCESS - Some access achieved", "WARN")
        else:
            self.log("OVERALL: LIMITED SUCCESS - Minimal access", "ERROR")
            
        # Save results
        self.save_results(results)
        
    def save_results(self, results: Dict[str, Any]):
        """Save results to JSON file"""
        import json
        
        output_file = Path(__file__).parent / "nc3_analysis_results.json"
        
        try:
            with open(output_file, 'w') as f:
                json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
            self.log(f"Results saved to: {output_file}")
        except Exception as e:
            self.log(f"Error saving results: {e}", "ERROR")


def main():
    analyzer = NC3VaultAnalyzer()
    
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        command = sys.argv[1]
        
        if command == "analyze":
            analyzer.run_complete_analysis()
        elif command == "dump":
            analyzer.dump_nc3_vault("nc3_vault_dump.bin")
        elif command == "backup":
            analyzer.backup_ethernet_nvm("ethernet_nvm_backup.bin")
        elif command == "restore":
            if len(sys.argv) > 2:
                analyzer.restore_ethernet_nvm(sys.argv[2])
            else:
                print("Usage: python3 nc3_vault_analyzer.py restore <nvm_file>")
        else:
            print("Usage: python3 nc3_vault_analyzer.py [analyze|dump|backup|restore <file>]")
    else:
        # Default to complete analysis
        analyzer.run_complete_analysis()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if not os.geteuid() == 0:
        print("This script requires root privileges")
        print("Run with: sudo python3 nc3_vault_analyzer.py")
        sys.exit(1)
        
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
DSMIL ODD MMIO Security Analysis Tool
Investigates critical MMIO regions and security implications

Author: DSMIL Security Analysis Team
Version: 1.0.0
"""

import mmap
import struct
import sys
import os
import json
import subprocess
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum

class SecurityLevel(Enum):
    CRITICAL = "CRITICAL"
    HIGH = "HIGH"
    MEDIUM = "MEDIUM"
    LOW = "LOW"

@dataclass
class MMIORegion:
    name: str
    base_address: int
    size: int
    description: str
    security_level: SecurityLevel
    access_pattern: str
    vulnerabilities: List[str]

@dataclass
class RegisterField:
    name: str
    offset: int
    bit_width: int
    description: str
    security_impact: str

class ODDMMIOAnalyzer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.mmio_regions = self._initialize_regions()
        self.findings = []
        
    def _initialize_regions(self) -> Dict[str, MMIORegion]:
        """Initialize known MMIO regions from ACPI analysis"""
        regions = {
            "DPTF": MMIORegion(
                name="DPTF Configuration",
                base_address=0x51CA1000,
                size=0x0021,
                description="Dynamic Power and Thermal Framework configuration",
                security_level=SecurityLevel.CRITICAL,
                access_pattern="AnyAcc, Lock, Preserve",
                vulnerabilities=[
                    "Direct thermal management disable",
                    "Sleep state manipulation (S1DE-S5DE)",
                    "Power policy override",
                    "Battery status tampering"
                ]
            ),
            "TPM": MMIORegion(
                name="TPM 2.0 MMIO",
                base_address=0xFED40000,
                size=0x5000,
                description="TPM 2.0 direct memory-mapped I/O",
                security_level=SecurityLevel.CRITICAL,
                access_pattern="AnyAcc, NoLock, Preserve",
                vulnerabilities=[
                    "Bypass OS TPM driver",
                    "Direct TPM register access",
                    "Potential firmware-level TPM compromise"
                ]
            ),
            "CPU_PWR": MMIORegion(
                name="CPU Power Management",
                base_address=0x51CBD000,
                size=0x0126,
                description="CPU power management interface",
                security_level=SecurityLevel.HIGH,
                access_pattern="SystemMemory",
                vulnerabilities=[
                    "Performance manipulation",
                    "CPU frequency scaling bypass",
                    "Power state override"
                ]
            ),
            "DYNAMIC_CPWR": MMIORegion(
                name="Dynamic Power Control",
                base_address=0x0,  # Calculated from MHBR
                size=0x1000,
                description="Runtime calculated power management window",
                security_level=SecurityLevel.HIGH,
                access_pattern="ByteAcc, NoLock, Preserve",
                vulnerabilities=[
                    "MHBR register manipulation",
                    "Memory remapping potential",
                    "No base address validation"
                ]
            ),
            "THUNDERBOLT": MMIORegion(
                name="Thunderbolt/Type-C Control",
                base_address=0x0,  # Calculated from GMHB()
                size=0x08,
                description="Thunderbolt security and base control",
                security_level=SecurityLevel.HIGH,
                access_pattern="DWordAcc, NoLock, Preserve",
                vulnerabilities=[
                    "GMHB() method dependency",
                    "Thunderbolt security bypass (PSCM)",
                    "No integrity checks on base address"
                ]
            )
        }
        return regions
    
    def analyze_mhbr_register(self) -> Dict:
        """Analyze MHBR (Memory Host Base Register) structure"""
        print("🔍 Analyzing MHBR Register...")
        
        analysis = {
            "register_name": "MHBR - Memory Host Base Register",
            "location": "_SB.PC00.MC.MHBR",
            "usage_pattern": "((MHBR << 0x0F) + 0x5000)",
            "security_concerns": [
                "No validation of MHBR value before use",
                "Left shift by 15 bits creates large address space",
                "Potential for memory controller remapping"
            ],
            "attack_vectors": [
                "Manipulate MHBR to point to arbitrary memory",
                "Shift overflow attacks",
                "Power management register hijacking"
            ]
        }
        
        # Calculate potential address ranges
        for mhbr_val in [0x0, 0x80000000, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0x12345678]:
            calculated_addr = (mhbr_val << 0x0F) + 0x5000
            analysis[f"mhbr_{mhbr_val:08X}_result"] = f"0x{calculated_addr:016X}"
        
        self.findings.append({
            "type": "MHBR_ANALYSIS",
            "severity": SecurityLevel.HIGH,
            "data": analysis
        })
        
        return analysis
    
    def analyze_gmhb_method(self) -> Dict:
        """Analyze GMHB() method for Thunderbolt base calculation"""
        print("⚡ Analyzing GMHB() Method...")
        
        analysis = {
            "method_name": "GMHB() - Get Memory Host Base",
            "location": "_SB.PC00.GMHB()",
            "usage_patterns": [
                "GMHB() + REGO (for MBAR region)",
                "GMHB() + 0x5DA0 (for PBAR region)"
            ],
            "security_concerns": [
                "Unknown return value validation",
                "Method could be manipulated to return malicious base",
                "Thunderbolt security depends on this calculation"
            ],
            "controlled_fields": {
                "PMBD": "Base data (32 bits)",
                "PMBC": "Base control (8 bits)",
                "PSCM": "Security mode (8 bits) - CRITICAL",
                "PMBR": "Base ready (1 bit)"
            },
            "attack_vectors": [
                "GMHB() return value manipulation",
                "PSCM field modification to bypass security",
                "Base address corruption"
            ]
        }
        
        self.findings.append({
            "type": "GMHB_ANALYSIS",
            "severity": SecurityLevel.HIGH,
            "data": analysis
        })
        
        return analysis
    
    def analyze_dptf_fields(self) -> Dict:
        """Analyze DPTF configuration fields for bypass potential"""
        print("🌡️ Analyzing DPTF Fields...")
        
        fields = {
            "DPTF": {"offset": 0, "size": 8, "impact": "DPTF enable/disable - CRITICAL"},
            "DCFE": {"offset": 1, "size": 32, "impact": "DCFE configuration"},
            "SADE": {"offset": 5, "size": 8, "impact": "SADE flag"},
            "FND1-3": {"offset": 6, "size": 24, "impact": "Fan control data"},
            "CHGE": {"offset": 9, "size": 8, "impact": "Charging enable"},
            "BATR": {"offset": 10, "size": 8, "impact": "Battery status"},
            "S1DE-S5DE": {"offset": 11, "size": 40, "impact": "Sleep state enables - CRITICAL"},
            "PCHE": {"offset": 16, "size": 8, "impact": "Platform control"},
            "PPSZ": {"offset": 17, "size": 32, "impact": "Power package size"},
            "PWRE": {"offset": 21, "size": 8, "impact": "Power enable"},
            "PPPR": {"offset": 22, "size": 16, "impact": "Power policy"},
            "ODV0-5": {"offset": 24, "size": 48, "impact": "Override data"}
        }
        
        analysis = {
            "region_name": "DPTF Configuration",
            "base_address": "0x51CA1000",
            "total_size": "0x0021 (33 bytes)",
            "access_pattern": "AnyAcc, Lock, Preserve",
            "fields": fields,
            "critical_fields": ["DPTF", "S1DE-S5DE", "CHGE", "PWRE"],
            "attack_vectors": [
                "Set DPTF=0 to disable thermal management",
                "Manipulate S1DE-S5DE for sleep state attacks",
                "Override CHGE to bypass charging safety",
                "Modify PWRE for power management bypass"
            ],
            "mitigation_strategies": [
                "Add range validation for all field writes",
                "Implement thermal safety interlocks",
                "Require EC validation for power state changes",
                "Add audit logging for DPTF modifications"
            ]
        }
        
        self.findings.append({
            "type": "DPTF_ANALYSIS",
            "severity": SecurityLevel.CRITICAL,
            "data": analysis
        })
        
        return analysis
    
    def analyze_tpm_mmio(self) -> Dict:
        """Analyze TPM MMIO access patterns"""
        print("🔐 Analyzing TPM MMIO Access...")
        
        tpm_fields = {
            "ACC0": {"offset": 0, "size": 8, "description": "Access register 0"},
            "INTE": {"offset": 8, "size": 32, "description": "Interrupt enable"},
            "INTV": {"offset": 12, "size": 8, "description": "Interrupt vector"},
            "INTS": {"offset": 16, "size": 32, "description": "Interrupt status"},
            "INTF": {"offset": 20, "size": 32, "description": "Interrupt flags"},
            "STS0": {"offset": 32, "size": 32, "description": "Status register 0"},
            "FIFO": {"offset": 36, "size": 32, "description": "FIFO register"},
            "TID0": {"offset": 48, "size": 32, "description": "TPM ID register 0"}
        }
        
        analysis = {
            "region_name": "TPM 2.0 MMIO",
            "base_address": "0xFED40000",
            "total_size": "0x5000 (20KB)",
            "access_pattern": "AnyAcc, NoLock, Preserve",
            "fields": tpm_fields,
            "security_concerns": [
                "Direct bypass of OS TPM driver",
                "Full TPM register access (20KB window)",
                "Potential firmware-level TPM compromise",
                "No access control validation"
            ],
            "attack_vectors": [
                "Direct TPM command injection",
                "TPM state manipulation",
                "Attestation bypass",
                "Key extraction attacks"
            ],
            "mitigation_strategies": [
                "Restrict MMIO access to firmware only",
                "Add TPM access validation in EC",
                "Implement secure boot for TPM firmware",
                "Add TPM access audit logging"
            ]
        }
        
        self.findings.append({
            "type": "TPM_MMIO_ANALYSIS",
            "severity": SecurityLevel.CRITICAL,
            "data": analysis
        })
        
        return analysis
    
    def audit_adbg_usage(self) -> Dict:
        """Audit ADBG debug interface usage"""
        print("🐛 Auditing ADBG Usage...")
        
        adbg_patterns = {
            "bluetooth": [
                "BT PR _STA", "BT PR _ON", "BT PR _OFF", "BT PR _RST",
                "BT CNMT Mutex:Acquired Try Done", "BT RF Kill ON/OFF",
                "Set BTIE Disable/Enable"
            ],
            "graphics": [
                "iGFX Empty Dongle SKU supported",
                "Display Mux Supported", "Set Disp Mux to iGfx/dGfx",
                "IGD eDP _DSM", "Get/Set Current Disp Mux Status"
            ],
            "dptf": [
                "[Dptf DptfTabl SSDT][AcpiTableEntry/Exit]",
                "SPUR, Arg0=", "AR: GLAI method"
            ],
            "system": [
                "Set RDLY ", "Tile Activation "
            ]
        }
        
        analysis = {
            "interface_name": "ADBG - Universal Debug Interface",
            "usage_count": len(adbg_patterns["bluetooth"]) + len(adbg_patterns["graphics"]) + len(adbg_patterns["dptf"]) + len(adbg_patterns["system"]),
            "subsystems": adbg_patterns,
            "security_concerns": [
                "Universal debug access across all subsystems",
                "State information leakage",
                "Potential backdoor if enabled in production",
                "No documented access control"
            ],
            "production_risk": "Medium - Depends on build configuration",
            "mitigation_strategies": [
                "Remove ADBG in production builds",
                "Add compile-time debug guards",
                "Implement access control checks",
                "Add debug access audit logging"
            ]
        }
        
        self.findings.append({
            "type": "ADBG_AUDIT",
            "severity": SecurityLevel.MEDIUM,
            "data": analysis
        })
        
        return analysis
    
    def test_memory_access(self, address: int, size: int) -> Dict:
        """Test memory access safely"""
        try:
            # Try to read memory using /dev/mem
            with open('/dev/mem', 'r+b') as f:
                try:
                    mmap_region = mmap.mmap(f.fileno(), size, offset=address)
                    data = mmap_region.read(min(size, 256))  # Read first 256 bytes max
                    mmap_region.close()
                    
                    return {
                        "status": "SUCCESS",
                        "address": f"0x{address:X}",
                        "size": size,
                        "data_preview": data[:32].hex(),
                        "accessible": True
                    }
                except (OSError, PermissionError) as e:
                    return {
                        "status": "ACCESS_DENIED",
                        "address": f"0x{address:X}",
                        "size": size,
                        "error": str(e),
                        "accessible": False
                    }
        except Exception as e:
            return {
                "status": "ERROR",
                "address": f"0x{address:X}",
                "size": size,
                "error": str(e),
                "accessible": False
            }
    
    def generate_report(self) -> str:
        """Generate comprehensive security analysis report"""
        report = []
        report.append("# DSMIL ODD MMIO Security Analysis Report")
        report.append(f"Generated: {subprocess.check_output(['date']).decode().strip()}")
        report.append("")
        
        # Summary
        report.append("## Executive Summary")
        critical_count = len([f for f in self.findings if f["severity"] == SecurityLevel.CRITICAL])
        high_count = len([f for f in self.findings if f["severity"] == SecurityLevel.HIGH])
        report.append(f"- Critical Issues: {critical_count}")
        report.append(f"- High Risk Issues: {high_count}")
        report.append(f"- Total Findings: {len(self.findings)}")
        report.append("")
        
        # Detailed findings
        for finding in self.findings:
            report.append(f"## {finding['type'].replace('_', ' ')}")
            report.append(f"**Severity:** {finding['severity'].value}")
            report.append("")
            
            data = finding['data']
            if isinstance(data, dict):
                for key, value in data.items():
                    if isinstance(value, list):
                        report.append(f"**{key}:**")
                        for item in value:
                            report.append(f"  - {item}")
                    else:
                        report.append(f"**{key}:** {value}")
            report.append("")
        
        # Recommendations
        report.append("## Security Recommendations")
        report.append("1. **Immediate Actions**")
        report.append("   - Add validation for all dynamic MMIO base calculations")
        report.append("   - Restrict TPM MMIO access to firmware only")
        report.append("   - Implement thermal safety interlocks for DPTF")
        report.append("")
        report.append("2. **Hardening Strategies**")
        report.append("   - Remove ADBG interface in production builds")
        report.append("   - Add range validation for all MMIO operations")
        report.append("   - Implement secure boot for critical firmware components")
        report.append("")
        report.append("3. **Monitoring & Detection**")
        report.append("   - Add audit logging for MMIO access patterns")
        report.append("   - Implement runtime integrity checks")
        report.append("   - Monitor for suspicious power state changes")
        
        return "\n".join(report)
    
    def run_full_analysis(self) -> str:
        """Run complete analysis pipeline"""
        print("🚀 Starting DSMIL ODD MMIO Security Analysis...")
        print("=" * 60)
        
        # Run all analyses
        self.analyze_mhbr_register()
        self.analyze_gmhb_method()
        self.analyze_dptf_fields()
        self.analyze_tpm_mmio()
        self.audit_adbg_usage()
        
        # Test memory access (safe mode)
        print("\n🧪 Testing Memory Access (Safe Mode)...")
        for region_name, region in self.mmio_regions.items():
            if region.base_address > 0:
                result = self.test_memory_access(region.base_address, min(region.size, 256))
                print(f"  {region_name}: {result['status']}")
        
        print("\n📊 Generating Report...")
        report = self.generate_report()
        
        print("✅ Analysis Complete!")
        return report

def main():
    analyzer = ODDMMIOAnalyzer()
    
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        command = sys.argv[1].lower()
        
        if command == "mhbr":
            analyzer.analyze_mhbr_register()
        elif command == "gmhb":
            analyzer.analyze_gmhb_method()
        elif command == "dptf":
            analyzer.analyze_dptf_fields()
        elif command == "tpm":
            analyzer.analyze_tpm_mmio()
        elif command == "adbg":
            analyzer.audit_adbg_usage()
        elif command == "full":
            report = analyzer.run_full_analysis()
            print(report)
            
            # Save report
            with open('/run/media/john/593d876a-4036-4255-bd45-33baba503068/DSMILSystem/firmware/acpi_tables/ODD_MMIO_ANALYSIS_REPORT.md', 'w') as f:
                f.write(report)
            print(f"\n📄 Report saved to: ODD_MMIO_ANALYSIS_REPORT.md")
        else:
            print("Usage: python3 ODD_MMIO_ANALYSIS_TOOL.py [mhbr|gmhb|dptf|tpm|adbg|full]")
    else:
        # Run full analysis by default
        report = analyzer.run_full_analysis()
        print(report)
        
        # Save report
        with open('/run/media/john/593d876a-4036-4255-bd45-33baba503068/DSMILSystem/firmware/acpi_tables/ODD_MMIO_ANALYSIS_REPORT.md', 'w') as f:
            f.write(report)
        print(f"\n📄 Report saved to: ODD_MMIO_ANALYSIS_REPORT.md")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()



## SOURCE: intel-bug-bounty-report/ACPI DDST SSDT Firmware/acpi_tables/06_tools_and_scripts/MCM_INTEGRATION_SUITE.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
MCM-1000 Firmware Integration Suite
Complete firmware integration with ACPI tables, kernel driver, and telemetry bridge
"""

import os
import sys
import time
import json
import logging
from typing import Dict, Any, Optional, List
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

# Import integration components
from ENHANCED_MCM_TELEMETRY_BRIDGE import EnhancedMCMTelemetryBridge
from MCM1000_DRIVER_BRIDGE import MCM1000DriverBridge
from MCM_ACPI_GENERATOR import MCMACPIGenerator

class MCMIntegrationSuite:
    """Complete MCM-1000 firmware integration suite"""
    
    def __init__(self, config_file: Optional[str] = None):
        self.logger = self._setup_logging()
        self.config = self._load_config(config_file)
        
        # Initialize components
        self.telemetry_bridge = EnhancedMCMTelemetryBridge(config_file)
        self.driver_bridge = MCM1000DriverBridge()
        self.acpi_generator = MCMACPIGenerator(self.config.get('acpi_output_dir', '/tmp/acpi_tables'))
        
        # Integration state
        self.initialized = False
        self.active_components = set()
        self.integration_history = []
        
    def _setup_logging(self) -> logging.Logger:
        """Setup comprehensive logging"""
        logger = logging.getLogger('MCMIntegrationSuite')
        logger.setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
        
        # Console handler
        console = logging.StreamHandler()
        console.setLevel(logging.INFO)
        formatter = logging.Formatter(
            '%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s'
        )
        console.setFormatter(formatter)
        logger.addHandler(console)
        
        # File handler
        try:
            file_handler = logging.FileHandler(
                '/var/log/mcm_integration_suite.log'
            )
            file_handler.setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
            file_formatter = logging.Formatter(
                '%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(funcName)s:%(lineno)d - %(message)s'
            )
            file_handler.setFormatter(file_formatter)
            logger.addHandler(file_handler)
        except PermissionError:
            logger.warning("Cannot create log file, using console only")
        
        return logger
    
    def _load_config(self, config_file: Optional[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Load configuration"""
        default_config = {
            'acpi_output_dir': '/tmp/acpi_tables',
            'telemetry_interval': 1.0,
            'auto_activate': False,
            'activation_method': 'standard',
            'security_level': 'high',
            'enable_driver': True,
            'enable_acpi': True,
            'enable_monitoring': True,
            'monitoring_duration': 60,
            'save_telemetry': True,
            'telemetry_file': '/tmp/mcm_telemetry.json'
        }
        
        if config_file and Path(config_file).exists():
            try:
                with open(config_file, 'r') as f:
                    user_config = json.load(f)
                default_config.update(user_config)
            except Exception as e:
                self.logger.warning(f"Failed to load config: {e}")
        
        return default_config
    
    def initialize(self) -> bool:
        """Initialize all integration components"""
        try:
            self.logger.info("Initializing MCM-1000 Integration Suite...")
            
            # Initialize telemetry bridge
            if not self._init_telemetry_bridge():
                return False
            
            # Initialize driver bridge
            if self.config.get('enable_driver', True):
                if not self._init_driver_bridge():
                    self.logger.warning("Driver bridge initialization failed, continuing without driver")
            
            # Generate ACPI tables
            if self.config.get('enable_acpi', True):
                if not self._generate_acpi_tables():
                    self.logger.warning("ACPI table generation failed, continuing without ACPI")
            
            self.initialized = True
            self.logger.info("MCM-1000 Integration Suite initialized successfully")
            
            return True
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"Integration suite initialization failed: {e}")
            return False
    
    def _init_telemetry_bridge(self) -> bool:
        """Initialize telemetry bridge"""
        try:
            # Telemetry bridge is already initialized in __init__
            self.active_components.add('telemetry')
            self.logger.info("Telemetry bridge initialized")
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"Telemetry bridge initialization failed: {e}")
            return False
    
    def _init_driver_bridge(self) -> bool:
        """Initialize driver bridge"""
        try:
            if self.driver_bridge.initialize():
                self.active_components.add('driver')
                self.logger.info("Driver bridge initialized")
                return True
            else:
                return False
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"Driver bridge initialization failed: {e}")
            return False
    
    def _generate_acpi_tables(self) -> bool:
        """Generate ACPI tables"""
        try:
            saved_files = self.acpi_generator.save_tables()
            if saved_files:
                self.active_components.add('acpi')
                self.logger.info(f"ACPI tables generated: {len(saved_files)} files")
                return True
            else:
                return False
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"ACPI table generation failed: {e}")
            return False
    
    def activate_flex_fabric(self, method: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Activate Flex Fabric with optimal method selection"""
        method = method or self.config.get('activation_method', 'standard')
        
        self.logger.info(f"Activating Flex Fabric using {method} method")
        
        activation_record = {
            'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'method': method,
            'components_used': list(self.active_components),
            'success': False,
            'error': None,
            'duration': 0,
            'results': {}
        }
        
        start_time = time.time()
        
        try:
            # Try driver activation first if available
            if 'driver' in self.active_components:
                self.logger.info("Attempting driver-based activation...")
                driver_result = self.driver_bridge.activate_fabric_through_driver(method)
                activation_record['results']['driver'] = driver_result
                
                if driver_result['success']:
                    activation_record['success'] = True
                    self.logger.info("Driver-based activation successful")
                else:
                    self.logger.warning("Driver-based activation failed, falling back to bridge")
            
            # Fallback to telemetry bridge activation
            if not activation_record['success']:
                self.logger.info("Attempting bridge-based activation...")
                bridge_result = self.telemetry_bridge.activate_flex_fabric(method)
                activation_record['results']['bridge'] = bridge_result
                
                if bridge_result['success']:
                    activation_record['success'] = True
                    self.logger.info("Bridge-based activation successful")
                else:
                    activation_record['error'] = "Both driver and bridge activation failed"
                    self.logger.error("All activation methods failed")
            
        except Exception as e:
            activation_record['error'] = str(e)
            self.logger.error(f"Flex Fabric activation error: {e}")
        
        activation_record['duration'] = time.time() - start_time
        
        # Add to history
        self.integration_history.append(activation_record)
        
        return activation_record
    
    def start_monitoring(self, duration: Optional[int] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Start comprehensive monitoring"""
        duration = duration or self.config.get('monitoring_duration', 60)
        
        self.logger.info(f"Starting comprehensive monitoring for {duration} seconds")
        
        monitoring_record = {
            'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'duration': duration,
            'components_monitored': list(self.active_components),
            'telemetry_data': [],
            'status_snapshots': [],
            'success': False,
            'error': None
        }
        
        try:
            # Start telemetry monitoring
            if 'telemetry' in self.active_components:
                telemetry_thread = self.telemetry_bridge.start_telemetry_collection(duration)
            
            # Collect status snapshots
            start_time = time.time()
            while time.time() - start_time < duration:
                try:
                    snapshot = self._collect_status_snapshot()
                    monitoring_record['status_snapshots'].append(snapshot)
                    time.sleep(self.config.get('telemetry_interval', 1.0))
                except Exception as e:
                    self.logger.error(f"Status snapshot error: {e}")
            
            # Collect final telemetry
            if 'telemetry' in self.active_components:
                latest_telemetry = self.telemetry_bridge.get_latest_telemetry()
                if latest_telemetry:
                    monitoring_record['telemetry_data'].append(latest_telemetry)
            
            monitoring_record['success'] = True
            self.logger.info("Monitoring completed successfully")
            
        except Exception as e:
            monitoring_record['error'] = str(e)
            self.logger.error(f"Monitoring error: {e}")
        
        return monitoring_record
    
    def _collect_status_snapshot(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Collect comprehensive status snapshot"""
        snapshot = {
            'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'components': {}
        }
        
        # Telemetry bridge status
        if 'telemetry' in self.active_components:
            snapshot['components']['telemetry'] = {
                'available': True,
                'regions': len(self.telemetry_bridge.regions),
                'acpi_objects': len(self.telemetry_bridge.acpi_objects),
                'activation_history': len(self.telemetry_bridge.activation_history)
            }
        
        # Driver bridge status
        if 'driver' in self.active_components:
            snapshot['components']['driver'] = self.driver_bridge.get_comprehensive_status()
        
        # ACPI status
        if 'acpi' in self.active_components:
            snapshot['components']['acpi'] = {
                'available': True,
                'regions': len(self.acpi_generator.regions),
                'objects': len(self.acpi_generator.objects),
                'methods': len(self.acpi_generator.methods)
            }
        
        return snapshot
    
    def get_comprehensive_status(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get comprehensive integration status"""
        return {
            'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'initialized': self.initialized,
            'active_components': list(self.active_components),
            'config': self.config,
            'integration_history': self.integration_history[-10:],  # Last 10 records
            'component_status': {
                'telemetry': 'telemetry' in self.active_components,
                'driver': 'driver' in self.active_components,
                'acpi': 'acpi' in self.active_components
            }
        }
    
    def save_integration_data(self, filename: Optional[str] = None) -> bool:
        """Save integration data to file"""
        filename = filename or self.config.get('telemetry_file', '/tmp/mcm_telemetry.json')
        
        try:
            integration_data = {
                'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(),
                'status': self.get_comprehensive_status(),
                'latest_telemetry': None,
                'activation_report': None
            }
            
            # Add latest telemetry if available
            if 'telemetry' in self.active_components:
                latest = self.telemetry_bridge.get_latest_telemetry()
                if latest:
                    integration_data['latest_telemetry'] = latest.__dict__
            
            # Add activation report if available
            if self.telemetry_bridge.activation_history:
                integration_data['activation_report'] = self.telemetry_bridge.generate_activation_report()
            
            # Save to file
            with open(filename, 'w') as f:
                json.dump(integration_data, f, indent=2, default=str)
            
            self.logger.info(f"Integration data saved to {filename}")
            return True
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"Failed to save integration data: {e}")
            return False
    
    def generate_integration_report(self) -> str:
        """Generate comprehensive integration report"""
        report = f"""
# MCM-1000 Integration Suite Report
**Generated**: {datetime.now().isoformat()}

## Integration Status
- **Initialized**: {'✅' if self.initialized else '❌'}
- **Active Components**: {len(self.active_components)}
- **Components**: {', '.join(self.active_components)}

## Component Details
"""
        
        # Telemetry component
        if 'telemetry' in self.active_components:
            report += f"""
### Telemetry Bridge
- **Regions Configured**: {len(self.telemetry_bridge.regions)}
- **ACPI Objects**: {len(self.telemetry_bridge.acpi_objects)}
- **Activation History**: {len(self.telemetry_bridge.activation_history)} records
"""
        
        # Driver component
        if 'driver' in self.active_components:
            driver_status = self.driver_bridge.get_comprehensive_status()
            report += f"""
### Driver Bridge
- **Device Present**: {'✅' if driver_status['device_fd'] else '❌'}
- **Driver Module Loaded**: {'✅' if driver_status['driver_status']['module_loaded'] else '❌'}
- **Firmware Version**: {driver_status['driver_status']['firmware_version']}
- **Hardware Revision**: {driver_status['driver_status']['hardware_revision']}
"""
        
        # ACPI component
        if 'acpi' in self.active_components:
            report += f"""
### ACPI Generator
- **Regions Defined**: {len(self.acpi_generator.regions)}
- **Objects Defined**: {len(self.acpi_generator.objects)}
- **Methods Defined**: {len(self.acpi_generator.methods)}
"""
        
        # Recent activations
        if self.integration_history:
            report += """
## Recent Activations
"""
            for i, activation in enumerate(self.integration_history[-3:], 1):
                status_icon = "✅" if activation['success'] else "❌"
                report += f"{i}. {status_icon} {activation['method']}: {activation['duration']:.2f}s\n"
                if activation.get('error'):
                    report += f"   Error: {activation['error']}\n"
        
        return report
    
    def cleanup(self):
        """Cleanup integration suite"""
        try:
            self.logger.info("Cleaning up MCM-1000 Integration Suite...")
            
            # Cleanup driver bridge
            if 'driver' in self.active_components:
                self.driver_bridge.cleanup()
            
            self.active_components.clear()
            self.initialized = False
            
            self.logger.info("Integration suite cleanup completed")
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"Cleanup error: {e}")


def main():
    """Main function for CLI usage"""
    import argparse
    
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='MCM-1000 Firmware Integration Suite')
    parser.add_argument('--config', type=str, help='Configuration file path')
    parser.add_argument('--activate', choices=['standard', 'stealth', 'aggressive', 'acpi_informed'],
                       help='Activate Flex Fabric')
    parser.add_argument('--monitor', type=int, help='Monitor for specified seconds')
    parser.add_argument('--status', action='store_true', help='Show integration status')
    parser.add_argument('--report', action='store_true', help='Generate integration report')
    parser.add_argument('--save', type=str, help='Save integration data to file')
    
    args = parser.parse_args()
    
    # Initialize integration suite
    suite = MCMIntegrationSuite(args.config)
    
    if not suite.initialize():
        print("Failed to initialize MCM-1000 Integration Suite")
        return 1
    
    try:
        if args.activate:
            print(f"Activating Flex Fabric using {args.activate} method...")
            result = suite.activate_flex_fabric(args.activate)
            print(f"Result: {'SUCCESS' if result['success'] else 'FAILED'}")
            print(f"Duration: {result['duration']:.2f}s")
            print(f"Components used: {', '.join(result['components_used'])}")
        
        elif args.monitor:
            print(f"Starting monitoring for {args.monitor} seconds...")
            result = suite.start_monitoring(args.monitor)
            print(f"Monitoring completed: {'SUCCESS' if result['success'] else 'FAILED'}")
            print(f"Status snapshots: {len(result['status_snapshots'])}")
            print(f"Telemetry records: {len(result['telemetry_data'])}")
        
        elif args.status:
            print("Integration Status:")
            status = suite.get_comprehensive_status()
            print(json.dumps(status, indent=2))
        
        elif args.report:
            print("Integration Report:")
            print(suite.generate_integration_report())
        
        elif args.save:
            print(f"Saving integration data to {args.save}...")
            if suite.save_integration_data(args.save):
                print("Integration data saved successfully")
            else:
                print("Failed to save integration data")
        
        else:
            print("No action specified. Use --help for usage information.")
        
        return 0
        
    finally:
        suite.cleanup()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
