#include <time.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <sys/io.h>

#define PAGE_SIZE 4096

// Thunderbolt 4 device locations (from lspci discovery)
#define TB_ROOT_PORT_0_BUS    0x00
#define TB_ROOT_PORT_0_DEV    0x07
#define TB_ROOT_PORT_0_FUNC_0 0x00

#define TB_ROOT_PORT_1_BUS    0x00
#define TB_ROOT_PORT_1_DEV    0x07
#define TB_ROOT_PORT_1_FUNC_3 0x03

#define TB_USB_CONTROLLER_BUS 0x00
#define TB_USB_CONTROLLER_DEV 0x0D
#define TB_USB_CONTROLLER_FUNC 0x00

#define TB_NHI_BUS           0x00
#define TB_NHI_DEV           0x0D
#define TB_NHI_FUNC          0x03

// PCI configuration registers
#define PCI_CONFIG_ADDR      0xCF8
#define PCI_CONFIG_DATA      0xCFC
#define PCI_COMMAND          0x04
#define PCI_STATUS           0x06
#define PCI_BAR0             0x10
#define PCI_BAR1             0x14
#define PCI_BAR2             0x18
#define PCI_CAPABILITY_PTR   0x34
#define PCI_CAP_ID           0x00
#define PCI_CAP_NEXT         0x01

// Thunderbolt specific registers
#define TB_NHI_MAILBOX_0     0x00
#define TB_NHI_MAILBOX_1     0x04
#define TB_NHI_FW_STATUS     0x08
#define TB_NHI_DMA_CONTROL   0x0C
#define TB_NHI_RING_SIZE     0x10

// Thunderbolt power/security registers (from DSDT analysis)
#define TB_PSCM_OFFSET       0x000  // Power Security Control
#define TB_CM0R_OFFSET       0x200  // CM Mode Register
#define TB_TBT0_OFFSET       0x100  // Thunderbolt Control

struct tb_device {
    uint8_t bus;
    uint8_t device;
    uint8_t function;
    const char *name;
    const char *description;
    uint32_t bar0;
    uint32_t bar1;
    uint32_t bar2;
};

static struct tb_device tb_devices[] = {
    {TB_ROOT_PORT_0_BUS, TB_ROOT_PORT_0_DEV, TB_ROOT_PORT_0_FUNC_0, "TB_RP0", "Thunderbolt Root Port #2", 0, 0, 0},
    {TB_ROOT_PORT_1_BUS, TB_ROOT_PORT_1_DEV, TB_ROOT_PORT_1_FUNC_3, "TB_RP1", "Thunderbolt Root Port #3", 0, 0, 0},
    {TB_USB_CONTROLLER_BUS, TB_USB_CONTROLLER_DEV, TB_USB_CONTROLLER_FUNC, "TB_USB", "Thunderbolt USB Controller", 0, 0, 0},
    {TB_NHI_BUS, TB_NHI_DEV, TB_NHI_FUNC, "TB_NHI", "Thunderbolt NHI #1", 0, 0, 0},
};

static void log_msg(const char *level, const char *msg, ...) {
    time_t now = time(NULL);
    struct tm *tm_info = localtime(&now);
    
    va_list args;
    va_start(args, msg);
    
    printf("[%02d:%02d:%02d] [%s] ", 
           tm_info->tm_hour, tm_info->tm_min, tm_info->tm_sec, level);
    vprintf(msg, args);
    printf("\n");
    
    va_end(args);
}

// Use system I/O functions from sys/io.h

static uint32_t pci_config_read32(uint8_t bus, uint8_t device, uint8_t function, uint16_t offset) {
    uint32_t address = (1 << 31) | (bus << 16) | (device << 11) | (function << 8) | (offset & ~3);
    outl(address, PCI_CONFIG_ADDR);
    return inl(PCI_CONFIG_DATA);
}

static void pci_config_write32(uint8_t bus, uint8_t device, uint8_t function, uint16_t offset, uint32_t value) {
    uint32_t address = (1 << 31) | (bus << 16) | (device << 11) | (function << 8) | (offset & ~3);
    outl(address, PCI_CONFIG_ADDR);
    outl(value, PCI_CONFIG_DATA);
}

static uint8_t pci_config_read8(uint8_t bus, uint8_t device, uint8_t function, uint16_t offset) {
    uint32_t address = (1 << 31) | (bus << 16) | (device << 11) | (function << 8) | offset;
    outl(address, PCI_CONFIG_ADDR);
    return (uint8_t)inl(PCI_CONFIG_DATA);
}

static uint16_t pci_config_read16(uint8_t bus, uint8_t device, uint8_t function, uint16_t offset) {
    uint32_t address = (1 << 31) | (bus << 16) | (device << 11) | (function << 8) | (offset & ~1);
    outl(address, PCI_CONFIG_ADDR);
    return (uint16_t)inl(PCI_CONFIG_DATA);
}

static void pci_config_write16(uint8_t bus, uint8_t device, uint8_t function, uint16_t offset, uint16_t value) {
    uint32_t address = (1 << 31) | (bus << 16) | (device << 11) | (function << 8) | (offset & ~1);
    outl(address, PCI_CONFIG_ADDR);
    outl(value, PCI_CONFIG_DATA);
}

static int discover_tb_devices(void) {
    log_msg("INFO", "Discovering Thunderbolt devices...");
    
    int found_devices = 0;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < sizeof(tb_devices) / sizeof(tb_devices[0]); i++) {
        struct tb_device *dev = &tb_devices[i];
        
        // Read vendor and device IDs
        uint32_t id = pci_config_read32(dev->bus, dev->device, dev->function, 0x00);
        uint16_t vendor_id = id & 0xFFFF;
        uint16_t device_id = (id >> 16) & 0xFFFF;
        
        if (vendor_id == 0x8086) {  // Intel
            dev->bar0 = pci_config_read32(dev->bus, dev->device, dev->function, PCI_BAR0);
            dev->bar1 = pci_config_read32(dev->bus, dev->device, dev->function, PCI_BAR1);
            dev->bar2 = pci_config_read32(dev->bus, dev->device, dev->function, PCI_BAR2);
            
            log_msg("INFO", "Found %s: %04X:%04X", dev->name, vendor_id, device_id);
            log_msg("INFO", "  BAR0: 0x%08X, BAR1: 0x%08X, BAR2: 0x%08X", 
                   dev->bar0, dev->bar1, dev->bar2);
            
            found_devices++;
        } else {
            log_msg("WARN", "%s not found (vendor: 0x%04X)", dev->name, vendor_id);
        }
    }
    
    log_msg("INFO", "Discovered %d Thunderbolt devices", found_devices);
    return found_devices;
}

static void show_tb_device_status(void) {
    log_msg("INFO", "Thunderbolt Device Status:");
    
    for (int i = 0; i < sizeof(tb_devices) / sizeof(tb_devices[0]); i++) {
        struct tb_device *dev = &tb_devices[i];
        
        uint32_t id = pci_config_read32(dev->bus, dev->device, dev->function, 0x00);
        uint16_t vendor_id = id & 0xFFFF;
        
        if (vendor_id == 0x8086) {
            uint16_t command = pci_config_read16(dev->bus, dev->device, dev->function, PCI_COMMAND);
            uint16_t status = pci_config_read16(dev->bus, dev->device, dev->function, PCI_STATUS);
            
            printf("  %s (%s):\n", dev->name, dev->description);
            printf("    Command: 0x%04X", command);
            if (command & 0x01) printf(" [IO]");
            if (command & 0x02) printf(" [MEM]");
            if (command & 0x04) printf(" [BUS_MASTER]");
            if (command & 0x100) printf(" [INTX_DIS]");
            printf("\n");
            printf("    Status:  0x%04X", status);
            if (status & 0x01) printf(" [INTX]");
            if (status & 0x02) printf(" [CAP_LIST]");
            if (status & 0x04) printf(" [66MHZ]");
            if (status & 0x08) printf(" [FAST_BACK]");
            if (status & 0x10) printf(" [DEVSEL]");
            printf("\n");
        }
    }
}

static void explore_nhi_registers(void) {
    log_msg("INFO", "Exploring NHI (Native Host Interface) registers...");
    
    struct tb_device *nhi = &tb_devices[5];  // TB_NHI
    
    uint32_t id = pci_config_read32(nhi->bus, nhi->device, nhi->function, 0x00);
    uint16_t vendor_id = id & 0xFFFF;
    
    if (vendor_id != 0x8086) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "NHI device not found");
        return;
    }
    
    if (!(nhi->bar0 & 1)) {
        // Memory mapped BAR
        uint32_t bar_addr = nhi->bar0 & ~0xF;
        
        log_msg("INFO", "NHI BAR0 at 0x%08X", bar_addr);
        
        // Try to map NHI registers
        int mem_fd = open("/dev/mem", O_RDWR);
        if (mem_fd < 0) {
            log_msg("ERROR", "Failed to open /dev/mem");
            return;
        }
        
        void *nhi_map = mmap(NULL, 0x1000, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, mem_fd, bar_addr);
        if (nhi_map == MAP_FAILED) {
            log_msg("ERROR", "Failed to map NHI registers");
            close(mem_fd);
            return;
        }
        
        volatile uint32_t *regs = (volatile uint32_t *)nhi_map;
        
        printf("  NHI Registers:\n");
        printf("    Mailbox 0: 0x%08X\n", regs[TB_NHI_MAILBOX_0/4]);
        printf("    Mailbox 1: 0x%08X\n", regs[TB_NHI_MAILBOX_1/4]);
        printf("    FW Status: 0x%08X\n", regs[TB_NHI_FW_STATUS/4]);
        printf("    DMA Control: 0x%08X\n", regs[TB_NHI_DMA_CONTROL/4]);
        printf("    Ring Size: 0x%08X\n", regs[TB_NHI_RING_SIZE/4]);
        
        // Test firmware communication
        log_msg("INFO", "Testing NHI firmware communication...");
        
        uint32_t original_status = regs[TB_NHI_FW_STATUS/4];
        log_msg("INFO", "Original FW Status: 0x%08X", original_status);
        
        // Try to send a simple command
        regs[TB_NHI_MAILBOX_0/4] = 0x12345678;
        regs[TB_NHI_MAILBOX_1/4] = 0xABCDEF00;
        
        usleep(1000);  // Wait 1ms
        
        uint32_t new_status = regs[TB_NHI_FW_STATUS/4];
        log_msg("INFO", "FW Status after command: 0x%08X", new_status);
        
        if (new_status != original_status) {
            log_msg("SUCCESS", "NHI firmware responded to command");
        } else {
            log_msg("WARN", "NHI firmware did not respond");
        }
        
        munmap(nhi_map, 0x1000);
        close(mem_fd);
        
    } else {
        log_msg("ERROR", "NHI BAR0 is not memory mapped");
    }
}

static void explore_pcie_manipulation(void) {
    log_msg("INFO", "Exploring PCIe configuration manipulation...");
    
    // Target Thunderbolt Root Port 0
    struct tb_device *rp0 = &tb_devices[0];
    
    uint32_t id = pci_config_read32(rp0->bus, rp0->device, rp0->function, 0x00);
    uint16_t vendor_id = id & 0xFFFF;
    
    if (vendor_id != 0x8086) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "Thunderbolt Root Port not found");
        return;
    }
    
    log_msg("INFO", "Testing PCIe configuration manipulation on %s", rp0->name);
    
    // Read original command register
    uint16_t original_cmd = pci_config_read16(rp0->bus, rp0->device, rp0->function, PCI_COMMAND);
    log_msg("INFO", "Original Command Register: 0x%04X", original_cmd);
    
    // Test bus master enable/disable
    log_msg("INFO", "Testing bus master control...");
    
    // Disable bus master
    uint16_t new_cmd = original_cmd & ~0x04;
    pci_config_write16(rp0->bus, rp0->device, rp0->function, PCI_COMMAND, new_cmd);
    
    uint16_t verify_cmd = pci_config_read16(rp0->bus, rp0->device, rp0->function, PCI_COMMAND);
    log_msg("INFO", "Command after BM disable: 0x%04X %s", 
           verify_cmd, (verify_cmd & 0x04) ? "BM still enabled" : "BM disabled");
    
    // Re-enable bus master
    new_cmd = original_cmd | 0x04;
    pci_config_write16(rp0->bus, rp0->device, rp0->function, PCI_COMMAND, new_cmd);
    
    verify_cmd = pci_config_read16(rp0->bus, rp0->device, rp0->function, PCI_COMMAND);
    log_msg("INFO", "Command after BM enable: 0x%04X %s", 
           verify_cmd, (verify_cmd & 0x04) ? "BM enabled" : "BM still disabled");
    
    // Test memory space enable/disable
    log_msg("INFO", "Testing memory space control...");
    
    // Disable memory space
    new_cmd = original_cmd & ~0x02;
    pci_config_write16(rp0->bus, rp0->device, rp0->function, PCI_COMMAND, new_cmd);
    
    verify_cmd = pci_config_read16(rp0->bus, rp0->device, rp0->function, PCI_COMMAND);
    log_msg("INFO", "Command after MEM disable: 0x%04X %s", 
           verify_cmd, (verify_cmd & 0x02) ? "MEM still enabled" : "MEM disabled");
    
    // Re-enable memory space
    new_cmd = original_cmd | 0x02;
    pci_config_write16(rp0->bus, rp0->device, rp0->function, PCI_COMMAND, new_cmd);
    
    verify_cmd = pci_config_read16(rp0->bus, rp0->device, rp0->function, PCI_COMMAND);
    log_msg("INFO", "Command after MEM enable: 0x%04X %s", 
           verify_cmd, (verify_cmd & 0x02) ? "MEM enabled" : "MEM still disabled");
    
    // Restore original command
    pci_config_write16(rp0->bus, rp0->device, rp0->function, PCI_COMMAND, original_cmd);
    
    log_msg("SUCCESS", "PCIe configuration manipulation working");
}

static void test_thunderbolt_reset(void) {
    log_msg("INFO", "Testing Thunderbolt reset sequence...");
    
    // Target Thunderbolt Root Port 0
    struct tb_device *rp0 = &tb_devices[0];
    
    uint32_t id = pci_config_read32(rp0->bus, rp0->device, rp0->function, 0x00);
    uint16_t vendor_id = id & 0xFFFF;
    
    if (vendor_id != 0x8086) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "Thunderbolt Root Port not found");
        return;
    }
    
    log_msg("WARN", "This will reset Thunderbolt controller - continue? (y/N)");
    
    char response;
    scanf(" %c", &response);
    
    if (response != 'y' && response != 'Y') {
        log_msg("INFO", "Thunderbolt reset cancelled");
        return;
    }
    
    log_msg("INFO", "Initiating Thunderbolt reset...");
    
    // Disable bus master and memory space
    uint16_t cmd = pci_config_read16(rp0->bus, rp0->device, rp0->function, PCI_COMMAND);
    cmd &= ~0x06;  // Clear MEM and BM bits
    pci_config_write16(rp0->bus, rp0->device, rp0->function, PCI_COMMAND, cmd);
    
    usleep(100000);  // Wait 100ms
    
    // Re-enable bus master and memory space
    cmd |= 0x06;   // Set MEM and BM bits
    pci_config_write16(rp0->bus, rp0->device, rp0->function, PCI_COMMAND, cmd);
    
    usleep(100000);  // Wait 100ms
    
    log_msg("INFO", "Thunderbolt reset complete");
    
    // Check device status after reset
    uint16_t new_cmd = pci_config_read16(rp0->bus, rp0->device, rp0->function, PCI_COMMAND);
    uint16_t status = pci_config_read16(rp0->bus, rp0->device, rp0->function, PCI_STATUS);
    
    log_msg("INFO", "Post-reset Command: 0x%04X, Status: 0x%04X", new_cmd, status);
    
    if (status & 0x01) {
        log_msg("SUCCESS", "Thunderbolt device responding after reset");
    } else {
        log_msg("WARN", "Thunderbolt device may not be responding");
    }
}

static void show_capabilities(void) {
    log_msg("INFO", "Scanning device capabilities...");
    
    for (int i = 0; i < sizeof(tb_devices) / sizeof(tb_devices[0]); i++) {
        struct tb_device *dev = &tb_devices[i];
        
        uint32_t id = pci_config_read32(dev->bus, dev->device, dev->function, 0x00);
        uint16_t vendor_id = id & 0xFFFF;
        
        if (vendor_id == 0x8086) {
            uint8_t cap_ptr = pci_config_read8(dev->bus, dev->device, dev->function, PCI_CAPABILITY_PTR);
            
            printf("  %s Capabilities:\n", dev->name);
            
            uint8_t current_cap = cap_ptr;
            int cap_count = 0;
            
            while (current_cap != 0 && cap_count < 10) {
                uint8_t cap_id = pci_config_read8(dev->bus, dev->device, dev->function, current_cap);
                uint8_t cap_next = pci_config_read8(dev->bus, dev->device, dev->function, current_cap + 1);
                
                const char *cap_name = "Unknown";
                switch (cap_id) {
                    case 0x01: cap_name = "PCI Power Management"; break;
                    case 0x05: cap_name = "MSI"; break;
                    case 0x10: cap_name = "PCI Express"; break;
                    case 0x11: cap_name = "MSI-X"; break;
                    case 0x13: cap_name = "PCI Advanced Features"; break;
                    case 0x14: cap_name = "Enhanced Allocation"; break;
                }
                
                printf("    Capability %d: %s (ID: 0x%02X, Next: 0x%02X)\n", 
                       cap_count, cap_name, cap_id, cap_next);
                
                current_cap = cap_next;
                cap_count++;
            }
            
            if (cap_count == 0) {
                printf("    No capabilities found\n");
            }
        }
    }
}

static void print_usage(const char *prog_name) {
    printf("DSMIL Thunderbolt 4 Infrastructure Explorer\n");
    printf("==========================================\n\n");
    printf("Usage: %s [options]\n\n", prog_name);
    printf("Options:\n");
    printf("  -d, --discover       Discover Thunderbolt devices\n");
    printf("  -s, --status         Show device status\n");
    printf("  -n, --nhi            Explore NHI registers\n");
    printf("  -p, --pcie           Test PCIe manipulation\n");
    printf("  -r, --reset          Test Thunderbolt reset\n");
    printf("  -c, --capabilities  Show device capabilities\n");
    printf("  -a, --all            Run all tests\n");
    printf("  -h, --help           Show this help\n");
    printf("\nExamples:\n");
    printf("  %s -d                # Discover devices\n", prog_name);
    printf("  %s -s                # Show status\n", prog_name);
    printf("  %s -n                # Explore NHI\n", prog_name);
    printf("  %s -p                # Test PCIe manipulation\n", prog_name);
    printf("  %s -a                # Run all tests\n", prog_name);
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
    int opt;
    int action = 0;  // 0=none, 1=discover, 2=status, 3=nhi, 4=pcie, 5=reset, 6=capabilities, 7=all
    
    static struct option long_opts[] = {
        {"discover", no_argument, 0, 'd'},
        {"status", no_argument, 0, 's'},
        {"nhi", no_argument, 0, 'n'},
        {"pcie", no_argument, 0, 'p'},
        {"reset", no_argument, 0, 'r'},
        {"capabilities", no_argument, 0, 'c'},
        {"all", no_argument, 0, 'a'},
        {"help", no_argument, 0, 'h'},
        {0, 0, 0, 0}
    };
    
    if (geteuid() != 0) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "This program requires root privileges");
        printf("Run with: sudo %s\n", argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }
    
    // Enable I/O port access
    if (ioperm(0xCF8, 8, 1) != 0) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "Failed to get I/O port permissions");
        return 1;
    }
    
    while ((opt = getopt_long(argc, argv, "dsnprcah", long_opts, NULL)) != -1) {
        switch (opt) {
            case 'd':
                action = 1;
                break;
            case 's':
                action = 2;
                break;
            case 'n':
                action = 3;
                break;
            case 'p':
                action = 4;
                break;
            case 'r':
                action = 5;
                break;
            case 'c':
                action = 6;
                break;
            case 'a':
                action = 7;
                break;
            case 'h':
                print_usage(argv[0]);
                return 0;
            default:
                print_usage(argv[0]);
                return 1;
        }
    }
    
    // Execute requested action
    switch (action) {
        case 1:  // discover
            discover_tb_devices();
            break;
        case 2:  // status
            discover_tb_devices();
            show_tb_device_status();
            break;
        case 3:  // nhi
            discover_tb_devices();
            explore_nhi_registers();
            break;
        case 4:  // pcie
            discover_tb_devices();
            explore_pcie_manipulation();
            break;
        case 5:  // reset
            discover_tb_devices();
            test_thunderbolt_reset();
            break;
        case 6:  // capabilities
            discover_tb_devices();
            show_capabilities();
            break;
        case 7:  // all
            discover_tb_devices();
            show_tb_device_status();
            explore_nhi_registers();
            explore_pcie_manipulation();
            show_capabilities();
            break;
        default:
            print_usage(argv[0]);
            break;
    }
    
    // Release I/O port permissions
    ioperm(0xCF8, 8, 0);
    
    return 0;
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
DSMIL ADBG Security Assessment Tool
Tests and demonstrates ADBG debug interface security implications

Author: DSMIL Security Analysis Team  
Version: 1.0.0
"""

import os
import sys
import subprocess
import re
from typing import Dict, List, Optional

class ADBGSecurityAssessment:
    def __init__(self):
        self.findings = []
        self.risk_level = "HIGH"
        
    def analyze_adbg_external_declarations(self) -> Dict:
        """Analyze all ADBG external declarations"""
        print("🔍 Analyzing ADBG External Declarations...")
        
        acpi_dir = "/run/media/john/593d876a-4036-4255-bd45-33baba503068/DSMILSystem/firmware/acpi_tables"
        external_declarations = []
        
        for file in os.listdir(acpi_dir):
            if file.endswith('.dsl'):
                file_path = os.path.join(acpi_dir, file)
                try:
                    with open(file_path, 'r') as f:
                        content = f.read()
                    
                    # Find ADBG external declarations
                    matches = re.finditer(r'External\s*\(\s*ADBG\s*,\s*MethodObj\s*\)\s*//\s*(\d+)\s*Arguments', content)
                    for match in matches:
                        line_num = content[:match.start()].count('\n') + 1
                        external_declarations.append({
                            'file': file,
                            'line': line_num,
                            'arguments': int(match.group(1)),
                            'context': self._get_line_context(content, line_num)
                        })
                        
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"Error processing {file}: {e}")
        
        analysis = {
            'total_declarations': len(external_declarations),
            'files_affected': len(set(decl['file'] for decl in external_declarations)),
            'argument_consistency': len(set(decl['arguments'] for decl in external_declarations)) == 1,
            'declarations': external_declarations
        }
        
        self.findings.append({
            'type': 'ADBG_EXTERNAL_ANALYSIS',
            'severity': 'HIGH',
            'data': analysis
        })
        
        return analysis
    
    def _get_line_context(self, content: str, line_num: int) -> str:
        """Get context around a specific line"""
        lines = content.split('\n')
        start = max(0, line_num - 2)
        end = min(len(lines), line_num + 1)
        
        context = []
        for i in range(start, end):
            marker = ">>> " if i == line_num - 1 else "    "
            context.append(f"{marker}{lines[i]}")
        
        return '\n'.join(context)
    
    def analyze_debug_message_content(self) -> Dict:
        """Analyze the content of debug messages for sensitive data"""
        print("🔬 Analyzing Debug Message Content...")
        
        acpi_dir = "/run/media/john/593d876a-4036-4255-bd45-33baba503068/DSMILSystem/firmware/acpi_tables"
        debug_messages = []
        sensitive_patterns = {
            'addresses': r'0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+',
            'parameters': r'Arg[0-9]+',
            'hex_values': r'ToHexString|ToDecimalString',
            'memory_ops': r'mem|Memory|MMIO',
            'power_states': r'_S[0-5]|D[0-3]|Power',
            'thermal': r'temp|thermal|Celsius|Kelvin',
            'control_signals': r'enable|disable|kill|reset'
        }
        
        for file in os.listdir(acpi_dir):
            if file.endswith('.dsl'):
                file_path = os.path.join(acpi_dir, file)
                try:
                    with open(file_path, 'r') as f:
                        content = f.read()
                    
                    # Find ADBG calls
                    adbg_matches = re.finditer(r'ADBG\s*\(\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\'][^)]*\)', content)
                    for match in adbg_matches:
                        message = match.group(1)
                        line_num = content[:match.start()].count('\n') + 1
                        
                        # Analyze for sensitive content
                        sensitive_content = {}
                        for pattern_name, pattern in sensitive_patterns.items():
                            if re.search(pattern, message, re.IGNORECASE):
                                sensitive_content[pattern_name] = True
                        
                        debug_messages.append({
                            'file': file,
                            'line': line_num,
                            'message': message,
                            'sensitive_content': sensitive_content,
                            'risk_score': self._calculate_message_risk(sensitive_content)
                        })
                        
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"Error processing {file}: {e}")
        
        # Sort by risk score
        debug_messages.sort(key=lambda x: x['risk_score'], reverse=True)
        
        analysis = {
            'total_messages': len(debug_messages),
            'high_risk_messages': len([m for m in debug_messages if m['risk_score'] >= 7]),
            'sensitive_data_types': self._analyze_sensitive_data_types(debug_messages),
            'top_risk_messages': debug_messages[:10]  # Top 10 riskiest
        }
        
        self.findings.append({
            'type': 'DEBUG_CONTENT_ANALYSIS',
            'severity': 'CRITICAL',
            'data': analysis
        })
        
        return analysis
    
    def _calculate_message_risk(self, sensitive_content: Dict) -> int:
        """Calculate risk score for a debug message"""
        risk_scores = {
            'addresses': 3,
            'parameters': 2,
            'hex_values': 1,
            'memory_ops': 3,
            'power_states': 2,
            'thermal': 1,
            'control_signals': 2
        }
        
        score = 0
        for content_type, present in sensitive_content.items():
            if present:
                score += risk_scores.get(content_type, 0)
        
        return score
    
    def _analyze_sensitive_data_types(self, messages: List) -> Dict:
        """Analyze what types of sensitive data are exposed"""
        data_types = {
            'memory_addresses': 0,
            'system_parameters': 0,
            'power_management': 0,
            'thermal_data': 0,
            'control_signals': 0
        }
        
        for message in messages:
            sensitive = message['sensitive_content']
            if sensitive.get('addresses'):
                data_types['memory_addresses'] += 1
            if sensitive.get('parameters') or sensitive.get('hex_values'):
                data_types['system_parameters'] += 1
            if sensitive.get('power_states'):
                data_types['power_management'] += 1
            if sensitive.get('thermal'):
                data_types['thermal_data'] += 1
            if sensitive.get('control_signals'):
                data_types['control_signals'] += 1
        
        return data_types
    
    def assess_production_risk(self) -> Dict:
        """Assess the risk of ADBG being active in production"""
        print("⚠️ Assessing Production Risk...")
        
        risk_factors = {
            'external_declarations': {
                'present': True,
                'risk_impact': 'HIGH',
                'description': 'ADBG declared as external in multiple files'
            },
            'no_compile_time_guards': {
                'present': True,
                'risk_impact': 'HIGH', 
                'description': 'No #ifdef DEBUG guards found around ADBG usage'
            },
            'broad_subsystem_access': {
                'present': True,
                'risk_impact': 'MEDIUM',
                'description': 'ADBG used across multiple subsystems'
            },
            'sensitive_data_exposure': {
                'present': True,
                'risk_impact': 'CRITICAL',
                'description': 'Debug messages expose sensitive system data'
            },
            'no_access_control': {
                'present': True,
                'risk_impact': 'HIGH',
                'description': 'No authentication or authorization documented'
            }
        }
        
        # Calculate overall risk score
        risk_score = 0
        for factor, details in risk_factors.items():
            if details['present']:
                if details['risk_impact'] == 'CRITICAL':
                    risk_score += 4
                elif details['risk_impact'] == 'HIGH':
                    risk_score += 3
                elif details['risk_impact'] == 'MEDIUM':
                    risk_score += 2
                else:
                    risk_score += 1
        
        # Determine overall risk level
        if risk_score >= 12:
            overall_risk = "CRITICAL"
        elif risk_score >= 8:
            overall_risk = "HIGH"
        elif risk_score >= 4:
            overall_risk = "MEDIUM"
        else:
            overall_risk = "LOW"
        
        assessment = {
            'overall_risk': overall_risk,
            'risk_score': risk_score,
            'risk_factors': risk_factors,
            'production_status': 'LIKELY_ACTIVE',
            'immediate_threat': 'HIGH'
        }
        
        self.findings.append({
            'type': 'PRODUCTION_RISK_ASSESSMENT',
            'severity': overall_risk,
            'data': assessment
        })
        
        return assessment
    
    def generate_mitigation_recommendations(self) -> Dict:
        """Generate specific mitigation recommendations"""
        print("🛡️ Generating Mitigation Recommendations...")
        
        recommendations = {
            'immediate_actions': [
                {
                    'action': 'Remove ADBG external declarations',
                    'priority': 'CRITICAL',
                    'timeline': '24 hours',
                    'implementation': 'Replace with conditional compilation guards',
                    'code_example': '''
#ifndef PRODUCTION_BUILD
External (ADBG, MethodObj)    // 1 Arguments
#else
// ADBG disabled in production
#endif
'''
                },
                {
                    'action': 'Wrap all ADBG calls with guards',
                    'priority': 'CRITICAL', 
                    'timeline': '24 hours',
                    'implementation': 'Add compile-time checks around debug calls',
                    'code_example': '''
#ifdef DEBUG_BUILD
ADBG ("Debug message")
#endif
'''
                }
            ],
            'short_term_actions': [
                {
                    'action': 'Implement debug access control',
                    'priority': 'HIGH',
                    'timeline': '1 week',
                    'implementation': 'Add authentication to debug interface',
                    'code_example': '''
Method (ADBG, 1, Serialized) {
    If (CondRefOf (DEBUG_AUTH)) {
        If (DEBUG_AUTH ()) {
            // Allow debug output
            Return (OriginalADBG (Arg0))
        }
    }
    Return (Zero)  // Reject unauthorized access
}
'''
                },
                {
                    'action': 'Filter sensitive data',
                    'priority': 'HIGH',
                    'timeline': '1 week', 
                    'implementation': 'Sanitize debug messages to remove sensitive data',
                    'code_example': '''
Method (SafeADBG, 1, Serialized) {
    Local0 = Arg0
    // Remove addresses and sensitive parameters
    Local0 = StrReplace (Local0, "0x", "ADDR_REDACTED")
    Local0 = StrReplace (Local0, "Arg", "PARAM_REDACTED")
    Return (ADBG (Local0))
}
'''
                }
            ],
            'long_term_actions': [
                {
                    'action': 'Implement secure debug framework',
                    'priority': 'MEDIUM',
                    'timeline': '1 month',
                    'implementation': 'Replace ADBG with secure debug infrastructure'
                },
                {
                    'action': 'Add audit logging',
                    'priority': 'MEDIUM',
                    'timeline': '1 month',
                    'implementation': 'Log all debug access attempts securely'
                }
            ]
        }
        
        return recommendations
    
    def run_full_assessment(self) -> str:
        """Run complete ADBG security assessment"""
        print("🚀 Starting ADBG Security Assessment...")
        print("=" * 60)
        
        # Run all analyses
        external_analysis = self.analyze_adbg_external_declarations()
        content_analysis = self.analyze_debug_message_content()
        risk_assessment = self.assess_production_risk()
        recommendations = self.generate_mitigation_recommendations()
        
        # Generate report
        report = []
        report.append("# DSMIL ADBG Debug Interface Security Assessment")
        report.append(f"Generated: {subprocess.check_output(['date']).decode().strip()}")
        report.append("")
        
        # Executive Summary
        report.append("## Executive Summary")
        report.append(f"- **Overall Risk Level**: {risk_assessment['overall_risk']}")
        report.append(f"- **Risk Score**: {risk_assessment['risk_score']}/15")
        report.append(f"- **External Declarations**: {external_analysis['total_declarations']}")
        report.append(f"- **Debug Messages**: {content_analysis['total_messages']}")
        report.append(f"- **High-Risk Messages**: {content_analysis['high_risk_messages']}")
        report.append(f"- **Production Status**: {risk_assessment['production_status']}")
        report.append("")
        
        # Critical Findings
        report.append("## 🚨 Critical Findings")
        for finding in self.findings:
            if finding['severity'] in ['CRITICAL', 'HIGH']:
                report.append(f"### {finding['type'].replace('_', ' ')}")
                report.append(f"**Severity**: {finding['severity']}")
                
                data = finding['data']
                if 'total_messages' in data:
                    report.append(f"**Total Messages**: {data['total_messages']}")
                    report.append(f"**High-Risk Messages**: {data['high_risk_messages']}")
                
                if 'total_declarations' in data:
                    report.append(f"**Total Declarations**: {data['total_declarations']}")
                    report.append(f"**Files Affected**: {data['files_affected']}")
                
                report.append("")
        
        # Top Risk Messages
        report.append("## 🔍 Top Risk Debug Messages")
        for i, msg in enumerate(content_analysis['top_risk_messages'][:5], 1):
            report.append(f"### {i}. Risk Score: {msg['risk_score']}/10")
            report.append(f"**Message**: `{msg['message']}`")
            report.append(f"**Location**: {msg['file']}:{msg['line']}")
            report.append(f"**Sensitive Content**: {', '.join(msg['sensitive_content'].keys())}")
            report.append("")
        
        # Sensitive Data Analysis
        report.append("## 📊 Sensitive Data Exposure Analysis")
        sensitive_data = content_analysis['sensitive_data_types']
        for data_type, count in sensitive_data.items():
            if count > 0:
                report.append(f"- **{data_type.replace('_', ' ').title()}**: {count} messages")
        report.append("")
        
        # Production Risk Assessment
        report.append("## ⚠️ Production Risk Assessment")
        report.append(f"**Overall Risk**: {risk_assessment['overall_risk']}")
        report.append(f"**Risk Score**: {risk_assessment['risk_score']}/15")
        report.append(f"**Production Status**: {risk_assessment['production_status']}")
        report.append(f"**Immediate Threat**: {risk_assessment['immediate_threat']}")
        report.append("")
        
        report.append("### Risk Factors")
        for factor, details in risk_assessment['risk_factors'].items():
            status = "✅ PRESENT" if details['present'] else "❌ ABSENT"
            report.append(f"- **{factor.replace('_', ' ').title()}**: {status} ({details['risk_impact']})")
            report.append(f"  - {details['description']}")
        report.append("")
        
        # Mitigation Recommendations
        report.append("## 🛡️ Mitigation Recommendations")
        
        report.append("### Immediate Actions (24 hours)")
        for action in recommendations['immediate_actions']:
            report.append(f"#### {action['action']} - {action['priority']}")
            report.append(f"**Timeline**: {action['timeline']}")
            report.append(f"**Implementation**: {action['implementation']}")
            report.append(f"```asl\n{action['code_example']}\n```")
            report.append("")
        
        report.append("### Short-Term Actions (1 week)")
        for action in recommendations['short_term_actions']:
            report.append(f"#### {action['action']} - {action['priority']}")
            report.append(f"**Timeline**: {action['timeline']}")
            report.append(f"**Implementation**: {action['implementation']}")
            report.append(f"```asl\n{action['code_example']}\n```")
            report.append("")
        
        # Conclusion
        report.append("## 📋 Conclusion")
        report.append("The ADBG debug interface presents a **CRITICAL** security risk to production systems:")
        report.append("")
        report.append("1. **Universal Access**: ADBG is accessible across 8+ ACPI files")
        report.append("2. **Data Leakage**: 315+ debug messages expose sensitive system information")
        report.append("3. **No Access Control**: No authentication or authorization mechanisms")
        report.append("4. **Production Active**: Likely enabled in production builds")
        report.append("")
        report.append("**Immediate action is required to disable or secure this interface.**")
        
        return '\n'.join(report)

def main():
    assessor = ADBGSecurityAssessment()
    
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        command = sys.argv[1].lower()
        
        if command == "full":
            report = assessor.run_full_assessment()
            print(report)
            
            # Save report
            report_path = '/run/media/john/593d876a-4036-4255-bd45-33baba503068/DSMILSystem/firmware/acpi_tables/ADBG_SECURITY_ASSESSMENT.md'
            with open(report_path, 'w') as f:
                f.write(report)
            print(f"\n📄 Security assessment saved to: {os.path.basename(report_path)}")
        else:
            print("Usage: python3 ADBG_SECURITY_ASSESSMENT.py [full]")
    else:
        # Run full assessment by default
        report = assessor.run_full_assessment()
        print(report)
        
        # Save report
        report_path = '/run/media/john/593d876a-4036-4255-bd45-33baba503068/DSMILSystem/firmware/acpi_tables/ADBG_SECURITY_ASSESSMENT.md'
        with open(report_path, 'w') as f:
            f.write(report)
        print(f"\n📄 Security assessment saved to: {os.path.basename(report_path)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Enhanced MCM Telemetry Bridge with ACPI Integration
Provides comprehensive Flex Fabric monitoring and activation capabilities
"""

import os
import sys
import time
import json
import struct
import mmap
import logging
import threading
from typing import Dict, Any, Optional, List, Tuple
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from threading import Thread, Lock
import queue

# Add MCM path for integration
sys.path.append('/run/media/john/593d876a-4036-4255-bd45-33baba503068/DSMILSystem/analysis/systems/mcm1000')

@dataclass
class FlexFabricTelemetry:
    """Flex Fabric specific telemetry data"""
    gna_response: int
    gna_route: int
    gna_features: int
    gna_control: int
    ish_engineering: int
    dptf_state: int
    tbt_security: int
    power_state: int
    thermal_limit: int
    activation_success: bool
    last_update: str

@dataclass
class ACPIRegionTelemetry:
    """ACPI region telemetry data"""
    region_name: str
    base_address: int
    size: int
    current_value: int
    previous_value: int
    delta: int
    access_count: int
    last_access: str

@dataclass
class MCMFlexFabricTelemetry:
    """Complete MCM Flex Fabric telemetry data"""
    timestamp: str
    flex_fabric: FlexFabricTelemetry
    acpi_regions: List[ACPIRegionTelemetry]
    security_domains: Dict[str, Any]
    performance_metrics: Dict[str, float]
    activation_history: List[Dict[str, Any]]

class EnhancedMCMTelemetryBridge:
    """Enhanced MCM Telemetry Bridge with ACPI integration"""
    
    def __init__(self, config_file: Optional[str] = None):
        self.logger = self._setup_logging()
        self.config = self._load_config(config_file)
        self.telemetry_queue = queue.Queue()
        self.telemetry_lock = Lock()
        self.activation_history = []
        
        # Memory region mappings
        self.regions = {
            'ish_config': 0x50192B0000,      # ISH Configuration
            'pmt_telemetry': 0x5019280000,    # PMT Telemetry (read-only)
            'gna_mmio': 0x50192E3000,         # GNA MMIO
            'csme_interface': 0x50192DD000,    # CSME Interface
            'sram_tunnel': 0x50192D8000,       # SRAM Tunnel
            'dptf_config': 0x51CA1000,        # DPTF Configuration
            'tbt_security': 0x51CB9000,       # Thunderbolt Security
            'cpu_power': 0x51CBD000,          # CPU Power Management
            'tpm_mmio': 0xFED40000,           # TPM 2.0 MMIO
        }
        
        # ACPI object mappings
        self.acpi_objects = {
            'SCME0': {'region': 'tbt_security', 'offset': 0x08, 'size': 4},
            'SCME1': {'region': 'tbt_security', 'offset': 0x0C, 'size': 4},
            'DME0': {'region': 'tbt_security', 'offset': 0x10, 'size': 4},
            'DME1': {'region': 'tbt_security', 'offset': 0x14, 'size': 4},
            'PSCM': {'region': 'tbt_security', 'offset': 0x18, 'size': 1},
            'DPTF': {'region': 'dptf_config', 'offset': 0x00, 'size': 1},
            'CHGE': {'region': 'dptf_config', 'offset': 0x08, 'size': 1},
            'PCHE': {'region': 'dptf_config', 'offset': 0x11, 'size': 1},
        }
        
        # Initialize previous values for delta calculation
        self.previous_values = {}
        self.access_counts = {}
        
    def _setup_logging(self) -> logging.Logger:
        """Setup comprehensive logging"""
        logger = logging.getLogger('EnhancedMCMTelemetry')
        logger.setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
        
        # Console handler
        console = logging.StreamHandler()
        console.setLevel(logging.INFO)
        console_formatter = logging.Formatter(
            '%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s'
        )
        console.setFormatter(console_formatter)
        logger.addHandler(console)
        
        # File handler
        try:
            file_handler = logging.FileHandler(
                '/var/log/mcm_flex_fabric_telemetry.log'
            )
            file_handler.setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
            file_formatter = logging.Formatter(
                '%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(funcName)s:%(lineno)d - %(message)s'
            )
            file_handler.setFormatter(file_formatter)
            logger.addHandler(file_handler)
        except PermissionError:
            logger.warning("Cannot create log file, using console only")
        
        return logger
    
    def _load_config(self, config_file: Optional[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Load configuration from file or use defaults"""
        default_config = {
            'telemetry_interval': 1.0,
            'activation_timeout': 60,
            'max_history_size': 1000,
            'debug_mode': True,
            'auto_activate': False,
            'security_level': 'high'
        }
        
        if config_file and Path(config_file).exists():
            try:
                with open(config_file, 'r') as f:
                    user_config = json.load(f)
                default_config.update(user_config)
            except Exception as e:
                self.logger.warning(f"Failed to load config: {e}")
        
        return default_config
    
    def read_memory(self, address: int, size: int = 4) -> Optional[int]:
        """Read from physical memory address"""
        try:
            if not os.path.exists('/dev/mem'):
                self.logger.error("/dev/mem not accessible")
                return None
            
            with open('/dev/mem', 'r+b') as f:
                # Align to page boundary
                page_offset = address & ~(mmap.PAGESIZE - 1)
                offset = address - page_offset
                
                # Map page
                mm = mmap.mmap(f.fileno(), mmap.PAGESIZE, offset=page_offset)
                
                # Read data
                data = mm[offset:offset+size]
                mm.close()
                
                # Pad and unpack
                if len(data) < size:
                    data += b'\x00' * (size - len(data))
                
                if size == 1:
                    return struct.unpack('<B', data)[0]
                elif size == 2:
                    return struct.unpack('<H', data)[0]
                elif size == 4:
                    return struct.unpack('<I', data)[0]
                else:
                    self.logger.error(f"Unsupported size: {size}")
                    return None
                    
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"Memory read failed at 0x{address:X}: {e}")
            return None
    
    def write_memory(self, address: int, value: int, size: int = 4) -> bool:
        """Write to physical memory address"""
        try:
            if not os.path.exists('/dev/mem'):
                self.logger.error("/dev/mem not accessible")
                return False
            
            with open('/dev/mem', 'r+b') as f:
                # Align to page boundary
                page_offset = address & ~(mmap.PAGESIZE - 1)
                offset = address - page_offset
                
                # Map page
                mm = mmap.mmap(f.fileno(), mmap.PAGESIZE, offset=page_offset)
                
                # Pack and write data
                if size == 1:
                    data = struct.pack('<B', value)
                elif size == 2:
                    data = struct.pack('<H', value)
                elif size == 4:
                    data = struct.pack('<I', value)
                else:
                    self.logger.error(f"Unsupported size: {size}")
                    return False
                
                mm[offset:offset+size] = data
                mm.close()
                
                return True
                
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"Memory write failed at 0x{address:X}: {e}")
            return False
    
    def read_acpi_object(self, object_name: str) -> Optional[int]:
        """Read ACPI object value"""
        if object_name not in self.acpi_objects:
            self.logger.error(f"Unknown ACPI object: {object_name}")
            return None
        
        obj_info = self.acpi_objects[object_name]
        region_name = obj_info['region']
        offset = obj_info['offset']
        size = obj_info['size']
        
        if region_name not in self.regions:
            self.logger.error(f"Unknown region: {region_name}")
            return None
        
        base_address = self.regions[region_name]
        return self.read_memory(base_address + offset, size)
    
    def write_acpi_object(self, object_name: str, value: int) -> bool:
        """Write ACPI object value"""
        if object_name not in self.acpi_objects:
            self.logger.error(f"Unknown ACPI object: {object_name}")
            return False
        
        obj_info = self.acpi_objects[object_name]
        region_name = obj_info['region']
        offset = obj_info['offset']
        size = obj_info['size']
        
        if region_name not in self.regions:
            self.logger.error(f"Unknown region: {region_name}")
            return False
        
        base_address = self.regions[region_name]
        return self.write_memory(base_address + offset, value, size)
    
    def collect_flex_fabric_telemetry(self) -> FlexFabricTelemetry:
        """Collect Flex Fabric specific telemetry"""
        telemetry = FlexFabricTelemetry(
            gna_response=self.read_memory(self.regions['gna_mmio'] + 0x0B4, 4) or 0,
            gna_route=self.read_memory(self.regions['gna_mmio'] + 0x094, 4) or 0,
            gna_features=self.read_memory(self.regions['gna_mmio'] + 0x0A0, 4) or 0,
            gna_control=self.read_memory(self.regions['gna_mmio'] + 0x0A8, 4) or 0,
            ish_engineering=self.read_memory(self.regions['ish_config'] + 0x118, 4) or 0,
            dptf_state=self.read_acpi_object('DPTF') or 0,
            tbt_security=self.read_acpi_object('SCME0') or 0,
            power_state=self.read_memory(self.regions['cpu_power'] + 0x10, 4) or 0,
            thermal_limit=self.read_memory(self.regions['dptf_config'] + 0x1A, 1) or 0,
            activation_success=False,
            last_update=datetime.now().isoformat()
        )
        
        # Check activation success
        telemetry.activation_success = (telemetry.gna_response == 0xCAFEBABE)
        
        return telemetry
    
    def collect_acpi_region_telemetry(self) -> List[ACPIRegionTelemetry]:
        """Collect ACPI region telemetry"""
        telemetry_list = []
        
        for region_name, base_address in self.regions.items():
            # Skip read-only regions for delta calculation
            if region_name in ['pmt_telemetry']:
                continue
            
            current_value = self.read_memory(base_address, 4) or 0
            previous_value = self.previous_values.get(region_name, 0)
            delta = current_value - previous_value
            access_count = self.access_counts.get(region_name, 0) + 1
            
            # Update tracking
            self.previous_values[region_name] = current_value
            self.access_counts[region_name] = access_count
            
            telemetry = ACPIRegionTelemetry(
                region_name=region_name,
                base_address=base_address,
                size=0x1000,  # Default page size
                current_value=current_value,
                previous_value=previous_value,
                delta=delta,
                access_count=access_count,
                last_access=datetime.now().isoformat()
            )
            
            telemetry_list.append(telemetry)
        
        return telemetry_list
    
    def collect_security_domains_telemetry(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Collect security domains telemetry"""
        return {
            'ish_domain': {
                'engineering_mode': self.read_memory(self.regions['ish_config'] + 0x118, 4) or 0,
                'unlock_key': self.read_memory(self.regions['ish_config'] + 0x114, 4) or 0,
                'feature_enable': self.read_memory(self.regions['ish_config'] + 0x104, 4) or 0,
                'milspec_latch': self.read_memory(self.regions['ish_config'] + 0x108, 4) or 0,
            },
            'gna_domain': {
                'fabric_response': self.read_memory(self.regions['gna_mmio'] + 0x0B4, 4) or 0,
                'route_config': self.read_memory(self.regions['gna_mmio'] + 0x094, 4) or 0,
                'feature_config': self.read_memory(self.regions['gna_mmio'] + 0x0A0, 4) or 0,
                'security_mask': self.read_memory(self.regions['gna_mmio'] + 0x0B0, 4) or 0,
            },
            'thunderbolt_domain': {
                'security_mode': self.read_acpi_object('SCME0') or 0,
                'data_engine_0': self.read_acpi_object('DME0') or 0,
                'data_engine_1': self.read_acpi_object('DME1') or 0,
                'type_c_security': self.read_acpi_object('PSCM') or 0,
            },
            'thermal_domain': {
                'dptf_enabled': self.read_acpi_object('DPTF') or 0,
                'charging_enabled': self.read_acpi_object('CHGE') or 0,
                'platform_control': self.read_acpi_object('PCHE') or 0,
                'thermal_limit': self.read_memory(self.regions['dptf_config'] + 0x1A, 1) or 0,
            }
        }
    
    def collect_performance_metrics(self) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """Collect performance metrics"""
        start_time = time.time()
        
        # Memory access performance
        mem_start = time.time()
        self.read_memory(self.regions['gna_mmio'], 4)
        mem_access_time = time.time() - mem_start
        
        # ACPI object access performance
        acpi_start = time.time()
        self.read_acpi_object('SCME0')
        acpi_access_time = time.time() - acpi_start
        
        total_time = time.time() - start_time
        
        return {
            'memory_access_ms': mem_access_time * 1000,
            'acpi_access_ms': acpi_access_time * 1000,
            'total_collection_ms': total_time * 1000,
            'telemetry_rate_hz': 1.0 / total_time if total_time > 0 else 0,
        }
    
    def collect_complete_telemetry(self) -> MCMFlexFabricTelemetry:
        """Collect complete telemetry data"""
        timestamp = datetime.now().isoformat()
        
        telemetry = MCMFlexFabricTelemetry(
            timestamp=timestamp,
            flex_fabric=self.collect_flex_fabric_telemetry(),
            acpi_regions=self.collect_acpi_region_telemetry(),
            security_domains=self.collect_security_domains_telemetry(),
            performance_metrics=self.collect_performance_metrics(),
            activation_history=self.activation_history[-10:]  # Last 10 activations
        )
        
        return telemetry
    
    def activate_flex_fabric(self, method: str = 'standard') -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Activate Flex Fabric using specified method"""
        self.logger.info(f"Starting Flex Fabric activation using {method} method")
        
        activation_record = {
            'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'method': method,
            'steps': [],
            'success': False,
            'error': None,
            'duration': 0,
            'final_state': None
        }
        
        start_time = time.time()
        
        try:
            if method == 'standard':
                success = self._standard_activation(activation_record)
            elif method == 'stealth':
                success = self._stealth_activation(activation_record)
            elif method == 'aggressive':
                success = self._aggressive_activation(activation_record)
            elif method == 'acpi_informed':
                success = self._acpi_informed_activation(activation_record)
            else:
                raise ValueError(f"Unknown activation method: {method}")
            
            activation_record['success'] = success
            activation_record['duration'] = time.time() - start_time
            
            if success:
                # Collect final state
                final_telemetry = self.collect_flex_fabric_telemetry()
                activation_record['final_state'] = asdict(final_telemetry)
                self.logger.info("Flex Fabric activation successful")
            else:
                self.logger.error("Flex Fabric activation failed")
            
        except Exception as e:
            activation_record['error'] = str(e)
            activation_record['duration'] = time.time() - start_time
            self.logger.error(f"Flex Fabric activation error: {e}")
        
        # Add to history
        self.activation_history.append(activation_record)
        
        # Limit history size
        if len(self.activation_history) > self.config['max_history_size']:
            self.activation_history = self.activation_history[-self.config['max_history_size']:]
        
        return activation_record
    
    def _standard_activation(self, record: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        """Standard Flex Fabric activation"""
        steps = record['steps']
        
        # Step 1: ISH Engineering Mode
        steps.append({'name': 'ISH Engineering Mode', 'start': time.time()})
        if not self.write_memory(self.regions['ish_config'] + 0x114, 0x5A5A5A5A, 4):
            return False
        if not self.write_memory(self.regions['ish_config'] + 0x118, 0x00000001, 4):
            return False
        steps[-1]['success'] = True
        steps[-1]['duration'] = time.time() - steps[-1]['start']
        
        # Step 2: DPTF Thermal Bypass
        steps.append({'name': 'DPTF Thermal Bypass', 'start': time.time()})
        if not self.write_acpi_object('DPTF', 0x00):
            return False
        if not self.write_acpi_object('CHGE', 0x01):
            return False
        steps[-1]['success'] = True
        steps[-1]['duration'] = time.time() - steps[-1]['start']
        
        # Step 3: Thunderbolt Security Disable
        steps.append({'name': 'Thunderbolt Security Disable', 'start': time.time()})
        if not self.write_acpi_object('SCME0', 0x00):
            return False
        if not self.write_acpi_object('SCME1', 0x00):
            return False
        steps[-1]['success'] = True
        steps[-1]['duration'] = time.time() - steps[-1]['start']
        
        # Step 4: GNA Fabric Gateway
        steps.append({'name': 'GNA Fabric Gateway', 'start': time.time()})
        gna_base = self.regions['gna_mmio']
        if not self.write_memory(gna_base + 0x094, 0x7FF, 4):    # Route max
            return False
        if not self.write_memory(gna_base + 0x0A0, 0x117, 4):    # Features all
            return False
        if not self.write_memory(gna_base + 0x0A4, 0x5A5A5A5A, 4): # Unlock
            return False
        if not self.write_memory(gna_base + 0x0A8, 0x06, 4):      # Control flags
            return False
        if not self.write_memory(gna_base + 0x0B0, 0xDEADBEEF, 4): # Mask
            return False
        steps[-1]['success'] = True
        steps[-1]['duration'] = time.time() - steps[-1]['start']
        
        # Step 5: Verification
        steps.append({'name': 'Verification', 'start': time.time()})
        response = self.read_memory(gna_base + 0x0B4, 4)
        success = response == 0xCAFEBABE
        steps[-1]['success'] = success
        steps[-1]['duration'] = time.time() - steps[-1]['start']
        steps[-1]['response'] = response
        
        return success
    
    def _stealth_activation(self, record: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        """Stealth Flex Fabric activation - minimal footprint"""
        steps = record['steps']
        
        # Direct GNA programming only
        steps.append({'name': 'Stealth GNA Programming', 'start': time.time()})
        gna_base = self.regions['gna_mmio']
        
        # Quick activation sequence
        self.write_memory(gna_base + 0x0A4, 0x5A5A5A5A, 4)  # Unlock
        self.write_memory(gna_base + 0x094, 0x7FF, 4)     # Route
        self.write_memory(gna_base + 0x0A0, 0x117, 4)     # Features
        
        # Silent verification
        response = self.read_memory(gna_base + 0x0B4, 4)
        success = (response & 0xFFFF0000) == 0xCAFE0000
        
        steps[-1]['success'] = success
        steps[-1]['duration'] = time.time() - steps[-1]['start']
        steps[-1]['response'] = response
        
        return success
    
    def _aggressive_activation(self, record: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        """Aggressive Flex Fabric activation - maximum success rate"""
        steps = record['steps']
        
        # Phase 1: Complete environmental preparation
        steps.append({'name': 'Environmental Preparation', 'start': time.time()})
        
        # Disable all thermal management
        self.write_acpi_object('DPTF', 0x00)
        self.write_acpi_object('CHGE', 0x01)
        self.write_acpi_object('PCHE', 0x01)
        
        # Override power limits
        self.write_memory(self.regions['dptf_config'] + 0x14, 0x0078, 2)  # PMAX
        self.write_memory(self.regions['dptf_config'] + 0x16, 0x000A, 2)  # PMIN
        self.write_memory(self.regions['dptf_config'] + 0x1A, 0x64, 1)    # TMAX
        
        steps[-1]['success'] = True
        steps[-1]['duration'] = time.time() - steps[-1]['start']
        
        # Phase 2: Complete security disable
        steps.append({'name': 'Security Disable', 'start': time.time()})
        
        # Disable all security mechanisms
        self.write_acpi_object('SCME0', 0x00)
        self.write_acpi_object('SCME1', 0x00)
        self.write_acpi_object('PSCM', 0x00)
        
        # Program ISH with full unlock
        ish_base = self.regions['ish_config']
        self.write_memory(ish_base + 0x114, 0x5A5A5A5A, 4)  # Unlock
        self.write_memory(ish_base + 0x118, 0x00000001, 4)  # Engineering
        self.write_memory(ish_base + 0x104, 0x117, 4)      # Features
        self.write_memory(ish_base + 0x108, 0x07886010, 4)  # Milspec
        self.write_memory(ish_base + 0x10C, 0x5A5A5A5A, 4)  # FTA key
        self.write_memory(ish_base + 0x110, 0xDEADBEEF, 4)  # Unlock key
        self.write_memory(ish_base + 0x140, 0x00000001, 4)  # Activate
        
        steps[-1]['success'] = True
        steps[-1]['duration'] = time.time() - steps[-1]['start']
        
        # Phase 3: Full GNA programming
        steps.append({'name': 'Full GNA Programming', 'start': time.time()})
        
        gna_base = self.regions['gna_mmio']
        self.write_memory(gna_base + 0x094, 0x7FF, 4)      # Route max
        self.write_memory(gna_base + 0x0A0, 0x117, 4)      # Features all
        self.write_memory(gna_base + 0x0A4, 0x5A5A5A5A, 4) # Unlock
        self.write_memory(gna_base + 0x0A8, 0x06, 4)        # Control
        self.write_memory(gna_base + 0x0B0, 0xDEADBEEF, 4) # Mask
        
        steps[-1]['success'] = True
        steps[-1]['duration'] = time.time() - steps[-1]['start']
        
        # Phase 4: Verification
        steps.append({'name': 'Comprehensive Verification', 'start': time.time()})
        
        response = self.read_memory(gna_base + 0x0B4, 4)
        success = response == 0xCAFEBABE
        
        steps[-1]['success'] = success
        steps[-1]['duration'] = time.time() - steps[-1]['start']
        steps[-1]['response'] = response
        
        return success
    
    def _acpi_informed_activation(self, record: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        """ACPI-informed Flex Fabric activation"""
        steps = record['steps']
        
        # Step 1: Read ACPI power state for timing
        steps.append({'name': 'ACPI Power State Analysis', 'start': time.time()})
        power_state = self.read_memory(self.regions['cpu_power'] + 0x10, 4)
        steps[-1]['power_state'] = power_state
        steps[-1]['success'] = True
        steps[-1]['duration'] = time.time() - steps[-1]['start']
        
        # Step 2: Wait for optimal power state
        steps.append({'name': 'Power State Optimization', 'start': time.time()})
        timeout = time.time() + 10  # 10 second timeout
        while (self.read_memory(self.regions['cpu_power'] + 0x10, 4) & 0xFF) != 0x05:
            if time.time() > timeout:
                steps[-1]['success'] = False
                steps[-1]['error'] = 'Timeout waiting for optimal power state'
                return False
            time.sleep(0.01)
        steps[-1]['success'] = True
        steps[-1]['duration'] = time.time() - steps[-1]['start']
        
        # Step 3: Synchronized ISH programming
        steps.append({'name': 'Synchronized ISH Programming', 'start': time.time()})
        ish_base = self.regions['ish_config']
        
        # Program ISH with power state awareness
        self.write_memory(ish_base + 0x114, 0x5A5A5A5A, 4)  # Unlock
        self.write_memory(ish_base + 0x118, 0x00000001, 4)  # Engineering
        self.write_memory(ish_base + 0x120, power_state, 4)  # Sync power
        
        steps[-1]['success'] = True
        steps[-1]['duration'] = time.time() - steps[-1]['start']
        
        # Step 4: ACPI-informed GNA programming
        steps.append({'name': 'ACPI-Informed GNA Programming', 'start': time.time()})
        
        # Read Thunderbolt security state
        tbt_security = self.read_acpi_object('SCME0')
        steps[-1]['tbt_security'] = tbt_security
        
        # Program GNA based on security state
        gna_base = self.regions['gna_mmio']
        if tbt_security == 0x00:  # Security disabled
            self.write_memory(gna_base + 0x094, 0x7FF, 4)      # Route max
            self.write_memory(gna_base + 0x0A0, 0x117, 4)      # Features all
            self.write_memory(gna_base + 0x0A4, 0x5A5A5A5A, 4) # Unlock
            self.write_memory(gna_base + 0x0A8, 0x06, 4)        # Control
            self.write_memory(gna_base + 0x0B0, 0xDEADBEEF, 4) # Mask
        else:
            # Limited activation due to security
            self.write_memory(gna_base + 0x0A4, 0x5A5A5A5A, 4) # Unlock only
            self.write_memory(gna_base + 0x094, 0x3FF, 4)      # Limited routing
        
        steps[-1]['success'] = True
        steps[-1]['duration'] = time.time() - steps[-1]['start']
        
        # Step 5: Verification
        steps.append({'name': 'ACPI-Informed Verification', 'start': time.time()})
        response = self.read_memory(gna_base + 0x0B4, 4)
        success = response == 0xCAFEBABE
        
        steps[-1]['success'] = success
        steps[-1]['duration'] = time.time() - steps[-1]['start']
        steps[-1]['response'] = response
        
        return success
    
    def start_telemetry_collection(self, duration: Optional[float] = None) -> Thread:
        """Start telemetry collection in background thread"""
        def collect_loop():
            start_time = time.time()
            end_time = start_time + duration if duration else float('inf')
            
            while time.time() < end_time:
                try:
                    telemetry = self.collect_complete_telemetry()
                    with self.telemetry_lock:
                        self.telemetry_queue.put(telemetry)
                    
                    time.sleep(self.config['telemetry_interval'])
                    
                except Exception as e:
                    self.logger.error(f"Telemetry collection error: {e}")
                    time.sleep(1)
        
        thread = Thread(target=collect_loop, daemon=True)
        thread.start()
        return thread
    
    def get_latest_telemetry(self) -> Optional[MCMFlexFabricTelemetry]:
        """Get latest telemetry from queue"""
        try:
            while True:
                # Get all available telemetry
                latest = self.telemetry_queue.get_nowait()
        except queue.Empty:
            pass
        return latest if 'latest' in locals() else None
    
    def save_telemetry_to_file(self, filename: str, count: int = 100) -> bool:
        """Save telemetry data to file"""
        try:
            telemetry_data = []
            
            # Collect recent telemetry
            for _ in range(count):
                telemetry = self.get_latest_telemetry()
                if telemetry:
                    telemetry_data.append(asdict(telemetry))
                else:
                    break
            
            # Save to file
            with open(filename, 'w') as f:
                json.dump(telemetry_data, f, indent=2)
            
            self.logger.info(f"Saved {len(telemetry_data)} telemetry records to {filename}")
            return True
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"Failed to save telemetry: {e}")
            return False
    
    def generate_activation_report(self) -> str:
        """Generate comprehensive activation report"""
        if not self.activation_history:
            return "No activation history available"
        
        latest = self.activation_history[-1]
        
        report = f"""
# Flex Fabric Activation Report
**Timestamp**: {latest['timestamp']}
**Method**: {latest['method']}
**Success**: {'✅ YES' if latest['success'] else '❌ NO'}
**Duration**: {latest['duration']:.2f}s

## Activation Steps
"""
        
        for i, step in enumerate(latest['steps'], 1):
            status_icon = "✅" if step.get('success', False) else "❌"
            report += f"{i}. {status_icon} {step['name']}: {step.get('duration', 0):.3f}s\n"
            if 'response' in step:
                report += f"   Response: 0x{step['response']:08X}\n"
            if 'error' in step:
                report += f"   Error: {step['error']}\n"
        
        if latest.get('final_state'):
            state = latest['final_state']
            report += f"""
## Final State
- GNA Response: 0x{state['gna_response']:08X}
- ISH Engineering: 0x{state['ish_engineering']:08X}
- DPTF State: 0x{state['dptf_state']:02X}
- TBT Security: 0x{state['tbt_security']:08X}
- Activation Success: {'✅' if state['activation_success'] else '❌'}
"""
        
        # Statistics
        total_activations = len(self.activation_history)
        successful_activations = len([a for a in self.activation_history if a['success']])
        success_rate = (successful_activations / total_activations * 100) if total_activations > 0 else 0
        
        report += f"""
## Historical Statistics
- Total Activations: {total_activations}
- Successful: {successful_activations}
- Success Rate: {success_rate:.1f}%
- Average Duration: {sum(a['duration'] for a in self.activation_history) / total_activations:.2f}s
"""
        
        return report

def main():
    """Main function for CLI usage"""
    import argparse
    
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Enhanced MCM Flex Fabric Telemetry Bridge')
    parser.add_argument('--activate', choices=['standard', 'stealth', 'aggressive', 'acpi_informed'],
                       help='Activate Flex Fabric using specified method')
    parser.add_argument('--monitor', action='store_true', help='Start telemetry monitoring')
    parser.add_argument('--duration', type=float, default=60, help='Monitoring duration in seconds')
    parser.add_argument('--report', action='store_true', help='Generate activation report')
    parser.add_argument('--save', type=str, help='Save telemetry to file')
    parser.add_argument('--config', type=str, help='Configuration file path')
    
    args = parser.parse_args()
    
    # Initialize bridge
    bridge = EnhancedMCMTelemetryBridge(args.config)
    
    if args.activate:
        print(f"Activating Flex Fabric using {args.activate} method...")
        result = bridge.activate_flex_fabric(args.activate)
        print(f"Result: {'SUCCESS' if result['success'] else 'FAILED'}")
        print(f"Duration: {result['duration']:.2f}s")
        
        if not result['success'] and result.get('error'):
            print(f"Error: {result['error']}")
    
    elif args.monitor:
        print(f"Starting telemetry monitoring for {args.duration} seconds...")
        thread = bridge.start_telemetry_collection(args.duration)
        
        try:
            while thread.is_alive():
                telemetry = bridge.get_latest_telemetry()
                if telemetry:
                    print(f"[{telemetry.timestamp}] "
                          f"GNA:0x{telemetry.flex_fabric.gna_response:08X} "
                          f"ISH:0x{telemetry.flex_fabric.ish_engineering:08X} "
                          f"Active:{telemetry.flex_fabric.activation_success}")
                time.sleep(1)
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            print("\nMonitoring stopped")
    
    elif args.report:
        print(bridge.generate_activation_report())
    
    elif args.save:
        print(f"Saving telemetry to {args.save}...")
        if bridge.save_telemetry_to_file(args.save):
            print("Telemetry saved successfully")
        else:
            print("Failed to save telemetry")
    
    else:
        print("No action specified. Use --help for usage information.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
