/*
 * DSMIL Flash NVM Access Tool for I219-V 0x15FC
 * Direct flash controller access for modern I219-V variants
 * 
 * Build: gcc -o flash_nvm_tool flash_nvm_tool.c
 * Usage: sudo ./flash_nvm_tool [options]
 */

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <getopt.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <sys/io.h>

#define PAGE_SIZE 4096

// I219-V Flash controller registers
#define I219_FLASH_CTRL      0x0010  // Flash Control Register
#define I219_FLASH_DATA      0x0014  // Flash Data Register
#define I219_FLASH_STATUS    0x0018  // Flash Status Register
#define I219_FLASH_ADDR      0x001C  // Flash Address Register
#define I219_FLASH_CFG       0x0020  // Flash Configuration Register

// Flash commands
#define FLASH_CMD_READ        0x01
#define FLASH_CMD_WRITE       0x02
#define FLASH_CMD_ERASE       0x03
#define FLASH_CMD_READ_ID     0x04
#define FLASH_CMD_WRITE_ENABLE 0x05
#define FLASH_CMD_WRITE_DISABLE 0x06
#define FLASH_CMD_READ_STATUS 0x07

// Flash status bits
#define FLASH_STATUS_BUSY     0x01
#define FLASH_STATUS_READY    0x02
#define FLASH_STATUS_ERROR    0x04
#define FLASH_STATUS_PROTECT  0x08

// Flash configuration bits
#define FLASH_CFG_ENABLE     0x01
#define FLASH_CFG_FAST_READ  0x02
#define FLASH_CFG_QUAD_READ  0x04
#define FLASH_CFG_PROTECT    0x08

// I219-V PCI config
#define I219V_PCI_BUS        0x00
#define I219V_PCI_DEV        0x1F
#define I219V_PCI_FUNC       0x06
#define I219V_BAR            0x7C100000

// Flash memory layout for 0x15FC
#define FLASH_BASE_OFFSET    0x0000
#define FLASH_SIZE           0x10000  // 64KB flash
#define FLASH_SECTOR_SIZE    0x1000   // 4KB sectors
#define FLASH_PAGE_SIZE      0x100    // 256-byte pages

static void log_msg(const char *level, const char *msg, ...) {
    time_t now = time(NULL);
    struct tm *tm_info = localtime(&now);
    
    va_list args;
    va_start(args, msg);
    
    printf("[%02d:%02d:%02d] [%s] ", 
           tm_info->tm_hour, tm_info->tm_min, tm_info->tm_sec, level);
    vprintf(msg, args);
    printf("\n");
    
    va_end(args);
}

// Use system I/O functions from sys/io.h

static uint32_t pci_config_read32(uint8_t bus, uint8_t device, uint8_t function, uint16_t offset) {
    uint32_t address = (1 << 31) | (bus << 16) | (device << 11) | (function << 8) | (offset & ~3);
    outl(address, 0xCF8);
    return inl(0xCFC);
}

static void pci_config_write32(uint8_t bus, uint8_t device, uint8_t function, uint16_t offset, uint32_t value) {
    uint32_t address = (1 << 31) | (bus << 16) | (device << 11) | (function << 8) | (offset & ~3);
    outl(address, 0xCF8);
    outl(value, 0xCFC);
}

static uint16_t pci_config_read16(uint8_t bus, uint8_t device, uint8_t function, uint16_t offset) {
    uint32_t address = (1 << 31) | (bus << 16) | (device << 11) | (function << 8) | (offset & ~1);
    outl(address, 0xCF8);
    return (uint16_t)inl(0xCFC);
}

static void pci_config_write16(uint8_t bus, uint8_t device, uint8_t function, uint16_t offset, uint16_t value) {
    uint32_t address = (1 << 31) | (bus << 16) | (device << 11) | (function << 8) | (offset & ~1);
    outl(address, 0xCF8);
    outl(value, 0xCFC);
}

static void* map_memory_region(uint64_t base, size_t size) {
    int mem_fd = open("/dev/mem", O_RDWR);
    if (mem_fd < 0) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "Failed to open /dev/mem");
        return NULL;
    }
    
    // Align to page boundary
    uint64_t aligned_base = base & ~(PAGE_SIZE - 1);
    size_t offset = base - aligned_base;
    size_t mapped_size = size + offset;
    
    void *mapped = mmap(NULL, mapped_size, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, mem_fd, aligned_base);
    close(mem_fd);
    
    if (mapped == MAP_FAILED) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "Failed to map memory region 0x%lX", base);
        return NULL;
    }
    
    return (void*)((uint8_t*)mapped + offset);
}

static void unmap_memory_region(void *ptr, size_t size) {
    // Find the actual mapped base
    uintptr_t aligned_ptr = (uintptr_t)ptr & ~(PAGE_SIZE - 1);
    size_t offset = (uintptr_t)ptr - aligned_ptr;
    size_t mapped_size = size + offset;
    munmap((void*)aligned_ptr, mapped_size);
}

static int check_i219_device(void) {
    log_msg("INFO", "Checking I219-V Ethernet controller...");
    
    uint32_t device_id = pci_config_read32(I219V_PCI_BUS, I219V_PCI_DEV, I219V_PCI_FUNC, 0x00);
    uint16_t vendor_id = device_id & 0xFFFF;
    uint16_t device = (device_id >> 16) & 0xFFFF;
    
    if (vendor_id != 0x8086) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "Not an Intel device (VID: 0x%04X)", vendor_id);
        return -1;
    }
    
    log_msg("INFO", "Found I219-V Ethernet controller (VID:0x%04X DID:0x%04X)", vendor_id, device);
    
    // Check for flash-based variant
    if (device == 0x15FC) {
        log_msg("INFO", "Detected flash-based I219-V variant (0x15FC)");
        log_msg("INFO", "This variant uses internal flash storage, not external EEPROM");
        return 1;  // Flash-based
    } else {
        log_msg("WARN", "Unknown I219 variant (DID: 0x%04X)", device);
        return 0;  // Unknown/EEPROM-based
    }
}

static int flash_wait_ready(volatile uint32_t *i219_regs, int timeout_ms) {
    int timeout = timeout_ms * 1000;  // Convert to microseconds
    
    while (timeout-- > 0) {
        uint32_t status = i219_regs[I219_FLASH_STATUS/4];
        
        if (status & FLASH_STATUS_ERROR) {
            log_msg("ERROR", "Flash operation failed (status: 0x%08X)", status);
            return -1;
        }
        
        if (status & FLASH_STATUS_READY) {
            return 0;  // Ready
        }
        
        if (!(status & FLASH_STATUS_BUSY)) {
            return 0;  // Not busy
        }
        
        usleep(1);
    }
    
    log_msg("ERROR", "Flash operation timeout");
    return -1;
}

static int flash_command(volatile uint32_t *i219_regs, uint8_t cmd) {
    // Wait for flash to be ready
    if (flash_wait_ready(i219_regs, 100) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    // Send command
    i219_regs[I219_FLASH_CTRL/4] = cmd;
    
    // Wait for command completion
    return flash_wait_ready(i219_regs, 1000);
}

static int flash_read_id(volatile uint32_t *i219_regs, uint32_t *flash_id) {
    log_msg("INFO", "Reading flash ID...");
    
    // Send read ID command
    if (flash_command(i219_regs, FLASH_CMD_READ_ID) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    // Read ID from data register
    *flash_id = i219_regs[I219_FLASH_DATA/4];
    
    log_msg("INFO", "Flash ID: 0x%08X", *flash_id);
    
    return 0;
}

static int flash_enable_write(volatile uint32_t *i219_regs) {
    log_msg("DEBUG", "Enabling flash write...");
    
    // Send write enable command
    return flash_command(i219_regs, FLASH_CMD_WRITE_ENABLE);
}

static int flash_read_bytes(volatile uint32_t *i219_regs, uint32_t offset, uint8_t *buffer, size_t size) {
    log_msg("DEBUG", "Reading %zu bytes from flash offset 0x%04X", size, offset);
    
    // Set flash address
    i219_regs[I219_FLASH_ADDR/4] = offset;
    
    // Send read command
    if (flash_command(i219_regs, FLASH_CMD_READ) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    // Read data
    for (size_t i = 0; i < size; i += 4) {
        uint32_t data = i219_regs[I219_FLASH_DATA/4];
        
        // Copy bytes (handle partial reads)
        for (int j = 0; j < 4 && (i + j) < size; j++) {
            buffer[i + j] = (data >> (j * 8)) & 0xFF;
        }
    }
    
    return 0;
}

static int flash_write_bytes(volatile uint32_t *i219_regs, uint32_t offset, const uint8_t *buffer, size_t size) {
    log_msg("DEBUG", "Writing %zu bytes to flash offset 0x%04X", size, offset);
    
    // Enable write
    if (flash_enable_write(i219_regs) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    // Set flash address
    i219_regs[I219_FLASH_ADDR/4] = offset;
    
    // Send write command
    if (flash_command(i219_regs, FLASH_CMD_WRITE) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    // Write data
    for (size_t i = 0; i < size; i += 4) {
        uint32_t data = 0;
        
        // Pack bytes into word
        for (int j = 0; j < 4 && (i + j) < size; j++) {
            data |= buffer[i + j] << (j * 8);
        }
        
        i219_regs[I219_FLASH_DATA/4] = data;
        
        // Wait for write completion
        if (flash_wait_ready(i219_regs, 100) < 0) {
            return -1;
        }
    }
    
    return 0;
}

static int flash_erase_sector(volatile uint32_t *i219_regs, uint32_t sector_offset) {
    log_msg("DEBUG", "Erasing flash sector at offset 0x%04X", sector_offset);
    
    // Enable write
    if (flash_enable_write(i219_regs) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    // Set sector address
    i219_regs[I219_FLASH_ADDR/4] = sector_offset;
    
    // Send erase command
    if (flash_command(i219_regs, FLASH_CMD_ERASE) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    // Wait for erase completion (longer timeout)
    return flash_wait_ready(i219_regs, 5000);
}

static int backup_flash_nvm(const char *backup_file) {
    log_msg("INFO", "Backing up flash NVM to %s...", backup_file);
    
    volatile uint32_t *i219_regs = (volatile uint32_t*)map_memory_region(I219V_BAR, 0x1000);
    if (!i219_regs) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    // Check flash controller status
    uint32_t flash_cfg = i219_regs[I219_FLASH_CFG/4];
    log_msg("INFO", "Flash Configuration: 0x%08X", flash_cfg);
    
    if (!(flash_cfg & FLASH_CFG_ENABLE)) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "Flash controller not enabled");
        unmap_memory_region((void*)i219_regs, 0x1000);
        return -1;
    }
    
    // Read flash ID
    uint32_t flash_id;
    if (flash_read_id(i219_regs, &flash_id) < 0) {
        unmap_memory_region((void*)i219_regs, 0x1000);
        return -1;
    }
    
    // Allocate buffer
    uint8_t *flash_data = malloc(FLASH_SIZE);
    if (!flash_data) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "Failed to allocate memory for flash data");
        unmap_memory_region((void*)i219_regs, 0x1000);
        return -1;
    }
    
    // Read flash in chunks
    int success = 1;
    for (uint32_t offset = 0; offset < FLASH_SIZE; offset += FLASH_PAGE_SIZE) {
        if (flash_read_bytes(i219_regs, offset, flash_data + offset, FLASH_PAGE_SIZE) < 0) {
            log_msg("ERROR", "Failed to read flash at offset 0x%04X", offset);
            success = 0;
            break;
        }
        
        if ((offset % 0x1000) == 0) {
            log_msg("INFO", "Read %d/%d KB", offset / 1024, FLASH_SIZE / 1024);
        }
    }
    
    unmap_memory_region((void*)i219_regs, 0x1000);
    
    if (!success) {
        free(flash_data);
        return -1;
    }
    
    // Save backup
    FILE *fp = fopen(backup_file, "wb");
    if (!fp) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "Failed to create backup file: %s", backup_file);
        free(flash_data);
        return -1;
    }
    
    size_t written = fwrite(flash_data, 1, FLASH_SIZE, fp);
    fclose(fp);
    free(flash_data);
    
    if (written == FLASH_SIZE) {
        log_msg("SUCCESS", "Flash NVM backup completed (%zu bytes)", written);
        return 0;
    } else {
        log_msg("ERROR", "Incomplete backup: %zu/%d bytes", written, FLASH_SIZE);
        return -1;
    }
}

static int restore_flash_nvm(const char *nvm_file) {
    log_msg("INFO", "Restoring flash NVM from %s...", nvm_file);
    
    // Read NVM file
    FILE *fp = fopen(nvm_file, "rb");
    if (!fp) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "Failed to open NVM file: %s", nvm_file);
        return -1;
    }
    
    fseek(fp, 0, SEEK_END);
    long file_size = ftell(fp);
    fseek(fp, 0, SEEK_SET);
    
    if (file_size > FLASH_SIZE) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "NVM file too large: %ld bytes (max %d)", file_size, FLASH_SIZE);
        fclose(fp);
        return -1;
    }
    
    uint8_t *flash_data = malloc(FLASH_SIZE);
    if (!flash_data) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "Failed to allocate memory");
        fclose(fp);
        return -1;
    }
    
    memset(flash_data, 0xFF, FLASH_SIZE);  // Default to 0xFF
    size_t bytes_read = fread(flash_data, 1, file_size, fp);
    fclose(fp);
    
    log_msg("INFO", "Read %zu bytes from NVM file", bytes_read);
    
    volatile uint32_t *i219_regs = (volatile uint32_t*)map_memory_region(I219V_BAR, 0x1000);
    if (!i219_regs) {
        free(flash_data);
        return -1;
    }
    
    // Check flash controller
    uint32_t flash_cfg = i219_regs[I219_FLASH_CFG/4];
    if (!(flash_cfg & FLASH_CFG_ENABLE)) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "Flash controller not enabled");
        unmap_memory_region((void*)i219_regs, 0x1000);
        free(flash_data);
        return -1;
    }
    
    // Erase and write flash sector by sector
    int success = 1;
    
    for (uint32_t sector = 0; sector < FLASH_SIZE; sector += FLASH_SECTOR_SIZE) {
        // Check if this sector needs updating
        int needs_update = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < FLASH_SECTOR_SIZE; i++) {
            if (flash_data[sector + i] != 0xFF) {
                needs_update = 1;
                break;
            }
        }
        
        if (!needs_update) {
            continue;  // Skip empty sectors
        }
        
        log_msg("INFO", "Processing sector %d/%d", sector / FLASH_SECTOR_SIZE, FLASH_SIZE / FLASH_SECTOR_SIZE);
        
        // Erase sector
        if (flash_erase_sector(i219_regs, sector) < 0) {
            log_msg("ERROR", "Failed to erase sector 0x%04X", sector);
            success = 0;
            break;
        }
        
        // Write sector in pages
        for (uint32_t page = 0; page < FLASH_SECTOR_SIZE; page += FLASH_PAGE_SIZE) {
            uint32_t offset = sector + page;
            
            if (flash_write_bytes(i219_regs, offset, flash_data + offset, FLASH_PAGE_SIZE) < 0) {
                log_msg("ERROR", "Failed to write page at 0x%04X", offset);
                success = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
        
        if (!success) {
            break;
        }
    }
    
    unmap_memory_region((void*)i219_regs, 0x1000);
    free(flash_data);
    
    if (!success) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    log_msg("SUCCESS", "Flash NVM restoration completed");
    
    // Reset Ethernet controller
    log_msg("INFO", "Resetting Ethernet controller...");
    
    uint16_t cmd = pci_config_read16(I219V_PCI_BUS, I219V_PCI_DEV, I219V_PCI_FUNC, 0x04);
    pci_config_write16(I219V_PCI_BUS, I219V_PCI_DEV, I219V_PCI_FUNC, 0x04, cmd & ~0x3);
    usleep(100000);
    pci_config_write16(I219V_PCI_BUS, I219V_PCI_DEV, I219V_PCI_FUNC, 0x04, cmd);
    
    log_msg("INFO", "Ethernet controller reset complete");
    
    return 0;
}

static int show_flash_info(void) {
    log_msg("INFO", "Displaying flash NVM information...");
    
    volatile uint32_t *i219_regs = (volatile uint32_t*)map_memory_region(I219V_BAR, 0x1000);
    if (!i219_regs) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    // Show flash controller registers
    uint32_t flash_ctrl = i219_regs[I219_FLASH_CTRL/4];
    uint32_t flash_status = i219_regs[I219_FLASH_STATUS/4];
    uint32_t flash_cfg = i219_regs[I219_FLASH_CFG/4];
    
    printf("I219-V Flash Controller Status:\n");
    printf("  Flash Ctrl:    0x%08X\n", flash_ctrl);
    printf("  Flash Status:  0x%08X", flash_status);
    if (flash_status & FLASH_STATUS_BUSY) printf(" [BUSY]");
    if (flash_status & FLASH_STATUS_READY) printf(" [READY]");
    if (flash_status & FLASH_STATUS_ERROR) printf(" [ERROR]");
    if (flash_status & FLASH_STATUS_PROTECT) printf(" [PROTECTED]");
    printf("\n");
    printf("  Flash Config:  0x%08X", flash_cfg);
    if (flash_cfg & FLASH_CFG_ENABLE) printf(" [ENABLED]");
    if (flash_cfg & FLASH_CFG_FAST_READ) printf(" [FAST_READ]");
    if (flash_cfg & FLASH_CFG_QUAD_READ) printf(" [QUAD_READ]");
    if (flash_cfg & FLASH_CFG_PROTECT) printf(" [PROTECTED]");
    printf("\n");
    
    // Read flash ID
    uint32_t flash_id;
    if (flash_read_id(i219_regs, &flash_id) == 0) {
        printf("  Flash ID:      0x%08X\n", flash_id);
        
        // Decode flash ID (manufacturer + device)
        uint16_t manufacturer = flash_id & 0xFFFF;
        uint16_t device = (flash_id >> 16) & 0xFFFF;
        
        printf("  Manufacturer:  0x%04X", manufacturer);
        if (manufacturer == 0x20) printf(" [STMicroelectronics]");
        if (manufacturer == 0xEF) printf(" [Winbond]");
        if (manufacturer == 0x1C) printf(" [EON]");
        printf("\n");
        
        printf("  Device:        0x%04X", device);
        printf("\n");
    }
    
    // Read first few bytes of flash
    uint8_t header[16];
    if (flash_read_bytes(i219_regs, 0, header, 16) == 0) {
        printf("\nFlash Header (first 16 bytes):\n");
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
            if ((i % 8) == 0) printf("  ");
            printf("%02X ", header[i]);
            if ((i % 8) == 7) printf("\n");
        }
    }
    
    unmap_memory_region((void*)i219_regs, 0x1000);
    
    return 0;
}

static void print_usage(const char *prog_name) {
    printf("DSMIL Flash NVM Access Tool for I219-V 0x15FC\n");
    printf("==========================================\n\n");
    printf("Usage: %s [options]\n\n", prog_name);
    printf("Options:\n");
    printf("  -b, --backup <file>   Backup flash NVM to file\n");
    printf("  -r, --restore <file>  Restore flash NVM from file\n");
    printf("  -i, --info            Show flash NVM information\n");
    printf("  -h, --help            Show this help\n");
    printf("\nNotes:\n");
    printf("  This tool is specifically for I219-V variant 0x15FC\n");
    printf("  which uses internal flash storage instead of EEPROM.\n");
    printf("  Flash operations are slower than EEPROM operations.\n");
    printf("\nExamples:\n");
    printf("  %s -b flash_nvm.bin   # Backup flash NVM\n", prog_name);
    printf("  %s -r flash_nvm.bin   # Restore flash NVM\n", prog_name);
    printf("  %s -i                  # Show flash info\n", prog_name);
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
    int opt;
    int action = 0;  // 0=none, 1=backup, 2=restore, 3=info
    char *file_arg = NULL;
    
    static struct option long_opts[] = {
        {"backup", required_argument, 0, 'b'},
        {"restore", required_argument, 0, 'r'},
        {"info", no_argument, 0, 'i'},
        {"help", no_argument, 0, 'h'},
        {0, 0, 0, 0}
    };
    
    if (geteuid() != 0) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "This program requires root privileges");
        printf("Run with: sudo %s\n", argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }
    
    // Enable I/O port access
    if (ioperm(0xCF8, 8, 1) != 0) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "Failed to get I/O port permissions");
        return 1;
    }
    
    while ((opt = getopt_long(argc, argv, "b:r:ih", long_opts, NULL)) != -1) {
        switch (opt) {
            case 'b':
                action = 1;
                file_arg = optarg;
                break;
            case 'r':
                action = 2;
                file_arg = optarg;
                break;
            case 'i':
                action = 3;
                break;
            case 'h':
                print_usage(argv[0]);
                return 0;
            default:
                print_usage(argv[0]);
                return 1;
        }
    }
    
    // Check I219-V device
    int device_type = check_i219_device();
    if (device_type < 0) {
        return 1;
    }
    
    if (device_type != 1) {
        log_msg("ERROR", "This tool is for flash-based I219-V variant (0x15FC) only");
        log_msg("INFO", "For EEPROM-based variants, use ethernet_nvm_tool instead");
        return 1;
    }
    
    // Execute requested action
    switch (action) {
        case 1:  // backup
            if (!file_arg) {
                log_msg("ERROR", "Backup requires output file");
                break;
            }
            backup_flash_nvm(file_arg);
            break;
        case 2:  // restore
            if (!file_arg) {
                log_msg("ERROR", "Restore requires input file");
                break;
            }
            restore_flash_nvm(file_arg);
            break;
        case 3:  // info
            show_flash_info();
            break;
        default:
            print_usage(argv[0]);
            break;
    }
    
    // Release I/O port permissions
    ioperm(0xCF8, 8, 0);
    
    return 0;
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
DSMIL Unexplored DSDT Functions Explorer
Tests and analyzes hidden/undocumented DSDT functions for exploitation potential
"""

import os
import sys
import time
import struct
import mmap
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple, Optional, Any

class DSDTExplorer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.base_path = Path("/run/media/john/593d876a-4036-4255-bd45-33baba503068/DSMILSystem")
        self.results = {}
        
        # Hardware addresses from previous analysis
        self.addresses = {
            'gnvs_base': 0x51CB3000,
            'gnvs_size': 0x0DA3,
            'mchbar': 0xFEDC0000,
            'cpwr': 0xFEDC5000,
            'pbar': 0xFEDC5DA0,
            'ish_config': 0x50192B0000,
            'gna_mmio': 0x50192E3000,
            'csme': 0x50192DD000,
            'sram_tunnel': 0x50192D8000,
        }
        
        # Critical GNVS offsets
        self.gnvs_offsets = {
            'iadg': 0xC8E,  # Debug Master Enable
            'srld': 0xC8F,  # Serial Debug Enable
            'u4se': None,   # USB4 Support Enable (find dynamically)
            'u4cm': None,   # USB4 Compatibility Mode (find dynamically)
            'cmsk': None,   # CM Mode Mask (find dynamically)
        }
        
    def log(self, msg: str, level: str = "INFO"):
        """Log message with timestamp"""
        timestamp = time.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
        print(f"[{timestamp}] [{level}] {msg}")
        
    def check_root(self) -> bool:
        """Check if running as root"""
        return os.geteuid() == 0
        
    def find_gnvs_usb4_fields(self) -> bool:
        """Find USB4-related fields in GNVS region"""
        self.log("Searching for USB4 fields in GNVS region...")
        
        try:
            with open("/dev/mem", "rb") as mem:
                # Map GNVS region
                offset = self.addresses['gnvs_base']
                size = self.addresses['gnvs_size']
                
                mem.seek(offset)
                gnvs_data = mem.read(size)
                
                # Search for U4SE, U4CM, CMSK patterns
                # These are typically sequential bytes
                for i in range(len(gnvs_data) - 3):
                    # Look for plausible USB4 field values
                    if (gnvs_data[i] in [0, 1] and 
                        gnvs_data[i+1] in [0, 1, 2, 3] and
                        gnvs_data[i+2] in [0, 1, 2, 3]):
                        
                        # Check if this matches USB4 field pattern
                        self.gnvs_offsets['u4se'] = i
                        self.gnvs_offsets['u4cm'] = i + 1
                        self.gnvs_offsets['cmsk'] = i + 2
                        
                        self.log(f"Found USB4 fields at GNVS offset 0x{i:04X}")
                        self.log(f"  U4SE: 0x{i:04X} = {gnvs_data[i]}")
                        self.log(f"  U4CM: 0x{i+1:04X} = {gnvs_data[i+1]}")
                        self.log(f"  CMSK: 0x{i+2:04X} = {gnvs_data[i+2]}")
                        return True
                        
        except PermissionError:
            self.log("Need root access to read /dev/mem", "ERROR")
            return False
        except Exception as e:
            self.log(f"Error reading GNVS: {e}", "ERROR")
            return False
            
        self.log("USB4 fields not found in expected pattern", "WARN")
        return False
        
    def read_gnvs_field(self, offset: int) -> Optional[int]:
        """Read a byte from GNVS region"""
        try:
            with open("/dev/mem", "rb") as mem:
                mem.seek(self.addresses['gnvs_base'] + offset)
                return mem.read(1)[0]
        except:
            return None
            
    def write_gnvs_field(self, offset: int, value: int) -> bool:
        """Write a byte to GNVS region"""
        try:
            with open("/dev/mem", "r+b") as mem:
                mem.seek(self.addresses['gnvs_base'] + offset)
                mem.write(bytes([value]))
                return True
        except:
            return False
            
    def test_gnvs_debug_control(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Test GNVS debug enable/disable"""
        self.log("Testing GNVS debug control...")
        
        results = {
            'iadg_original': None,
            'srld_original': None,
            'iadg_test': False,
            'srld_test': False,
            'debug_active': False
        }
        
        # Read original values
        results['iadg_original'] = self.read_gnvs_field(self.gnvs_offsets['iadg'])
        results['srld_original'] = self.read_gnvs_field(self.gnvs_offsets['srld'])
        
        self.log(f"Original IADG: {results['iadg_original']}")
        self.log(f"Original SRLD: {results['srld_original']}")
        
        # Test enabling debug
        if self.write_gnvs_field(self.gnvs_offsets['iadg'], 1):
            results['iadg_test'] = True
            self.log("Successfully set IADG = 1")
            
        if self.write_gnvs_field(self.gnvs_offsets['srld'], 1):
            results['srld_test'] = True
            self.log("Successfully set SRLD = 1")
            
        # Check if debug is active
        if results['iadg_test'] and results['srld_test']:
            results['debug_active'] = True
            self.log("Debug interface should now be active", "SUCCESS")
            
            # Test ADBG method
            self.test_adbg_method()
            
        return results
        
    def test_adbg_method(self):
        """Test ADBG method output"""
        self.log("Testing ADBG method output...")
        
        try:
            # Check for serial output
            result = subprocess.run(
                ["dmesg | tail -20 | grep ADBG"],
                shell=True,
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=5
            )
            
            if result.stdout:
                self.log("ADBG output found in dmesg:")
                for line in result.stdout.strip().split('\n')[-5:]:
                    self.log(f"  {line}")
            else:
                self.log("No recent ADBG output found")
                
        except Exception as e:
            self.log(f"Error checking ADBG output: {e}")
            
    def test_p2sb_access(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Test P2SB sideband register access"""
        self.log("Testing P2SB sideband access...")
        
        results = {
            'sbreg_bar': None,
            'port_access': {},
            'critical_registers': {}
        }
        
        # Try to read P2SB BAR
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(
                ["lspci", "-xxx", "-s", "00:1f.1"],
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=5
            )
            
            if result.returncode == 0:
                lines = result.stdout.split('\n')
                for line in lines:
                    if '10:' in line and len(line.split()) >= 2:
                        bar_hex = line.split()[1]
                        results['sbreg_bar'] = int(bar_hex, 16)
                        self.log(f"P2SB SBREG_BAR: 0x{results['sbreg_bar']:08X}")
                        break
                        
        except Exception as e:
            self.log(f"Error reading P2SB BAR: {e}")
            
        # Test critical registers if BAR found
        if results['sbreg_bar']:
            self.test_critical_pcrs(results)
            
        return results
        
    def test_critical_pcrs(self, results: Dict[str, Any]):
        """Test critical Platform Configuration Registers"""
        self.log("Testing critical PCR registers...")
        
        critical_ports = {
            0xA0: "PCH GPIO",
            0xA2: "PCH RST",
            0xA8: "PCH SPI",
            0xD0: "PCH PMC",
            0xD2: "PCH PMC_2",
            0xE0: "PCH CSME",
            0xE2: "PCH CSME_2",
            0xE4: "PCH CSME_3",
            0xE8: "PCH CSME_4",
            0xEA: "PCH CSME_5",
            0xF0: "PCH FUSE",
            0xF2: "PCH FUSE_2",
        }
        
        for port, desc in critical_ports.items():
            try:
                # Calculate PCR address
                pcr_addr = results['sbreg_bar'] + (port << 16)
                
                # Try to read first DWORD
                with open("/dev/mem", "rb") as mem:
                    mem.seek(pcr_addr)
                    value = struct.unpack("<I", mem.read(4))[0]
                    
                    results['critical_registers'][port] = {
                        'description': desc,
                        'address': f"0x{pcr_addr:08X}",
                        'value': f"0x{value:08X}",
                        'accessible': True
                    }
                    
                    self.log(f"PCR {port:02X} ({desc}): 0x{value:08X}")
                    
            except Exception as e:
                results['critical_registers'][port] = {
                    'description': desc,
                    'address': f"0x{pcr_addr:08X}" if 'pcr_addr' in locals() else "N/A",
                    'value': "N/A",
                    'accessible': False,
                    'error': str(e)
                }
                
    def test_thunderbolt_cm_control(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Test Thunderbolt Compatibility Mode control"""
        self.log("Testing Thunderbolt CM control...")
        
        results = {
            'u4se_found': False,
            'u4cm_found': False,
            'cmsk_found': False,
            'original_values': {},
            'cm_mode_test': False
        }
        
        # Find USB4 fields first
        if not self.find_gnvs_usb4_fields():
            return results
            
        # Read original values
        for field in ['u4se', 'u4cm', 'cmsk']:
            if self.gnvs_offsets[field] is not None:
                value = self.read_gnvs_field(self.gnvs_offsets[field])
                if value is not None:
                    results['original_values'][field] = value
                    results[f'{field}_found'] = True
                    
        self.log(f"USB4 Support Enable (U4SE): {results['original_values'].get('u4se', 'N/A')}")
        self.log(f"USB4 Compatibility Mode (U4CM): {results['original_values'].get('u4cm', 'N/A')}")
        self.log(f"CM Mode Mask (CMSK): {results['original_values'].get('cmsk', 'N/A')}")
        
        # Test forcing software CM mode
        if results['u4se_found'] and results['u4cm_found']:
            if self.write_gnvs_field(self.gnvs_offsets['u4cm'], 1):
                self.log("Successfully forced software CM mode", "SUCCESS")
                results['cm_mode_test'] = True
                
                # Check if Thunderbolt domains respond
                self.check_thunderbolt_domains()
                
        return results
        
    def check_thunderbolt_domains(self):
        """Check Thunderbolt domain status"""
        self.log("Checking Thunderbolt domain status...")
        
        try:
            # Check for Thunderbolt devices
            result = subprocess.run(
                ["lspci", "-nn", "-d", "*:*:*"],
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=10
            )
            
            tb_devices = []
            for line in result.stdout.split('\n'):
                if 'Thunderbolt' in line or '0x15' in line:  # Intel Thunderbolt vendor
                    tb_devices.append(line.strip())
                    
            if tb_devices:
                self.log(f"Found {len(tb_devices)} Thunderbolt-related devices:")
                for device in tb_devices[:5]:  # Show first 5
                    self.log(f"  {device}")
            else:
                self.log("No Thunderbolt devices detected")
                
        except Exception as e:
            self.log(f"Error checking Thunderbolt devices: {e}")
            
    def test_xdci_debug_control(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Test XDCI debug interface control"""
        self.log("Testing XDCI debug control...")
        
        results = {
            'xdci_base': None,
            'power_state': {},
            'debug_accessible': False
        }
        
        # Find XDCI device
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(
                ["lspci", "-xxx", "-s", "00:15.0"],
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=5
            )
            
            if result.returncode == 0:
                lines = result.stdout.split('\n')
                for line in lines:
                    if '10:' in line and len(line.split()) >= 2:
                        bar_hex = line.split()[1]
                        results['xdci_base'] = int(bar_hex, 16)
                        self.log(f"XDCI Base: 0x{results['xdci_base']:08X}")
                        break
                        
        except Exception as e:
            self.log(f"Error reading XDCI BAR: {e}")
            
        if results['xdci_base']:
            # Test XDCI debug registers
            self.test_xdci_registers(results)
            
        return results
        
    def test_xdci_registers(self, results: Dict[str, Any]):
        """Test XDCI debug interface registers"""
        self.log("Testing XDCI debug registers...")
        
        # XDCI debug register offsets (from SPPS analysis)
        debug_offsets = {
            0x10F810: "USB2/USB3 Power Control",
            0x10F818: "Power Up State",
            0x10F81A: "XDCI Power Enable",
        }
        
        for offset, desc in debug_offsets.items():
            try:
                addr = results['xdci_base'] + offset
                with open("/dev/mem", "rb") as mem:
                    mem.seek(addr)
                    value = struct.unpack("<I", mem.read(4))[0]
                    
                    results['power_state'][offset] = {
                        'description': desc,
                        'address': f"0x{addr:08X}",
                        'value': f"0x{value:08X}",
                        'accessible': True
                    }
                    
                    self.log(f"XDCI {desc}: 0x{value:08X}")
                    
                    # Mark as accessible if we can read it
                    results['debug_accessible'] = True
                    
            except Exception as e:
                results['power_state'][offset] = {
                    'description': desc,
                    'address': f"0x{addr:08X}" if 'addr' in locals() else "N/A",
                    'value': "N/A",
                    'accessible': False,
                    'error': str(e)
                }
                
    def test_gpio_control(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Test GPIO control via GGOV/SGOV"""
        self.log("Testing GPIO control...")
        
        results = {
            'gpio_communities': {},
            'test_gpio': None,
            'writable': False
        }
        
        # Try to access GPIO communities
        communities = [
            {"name": "PCH GPIO", "base": 0xFD5D0000, "size": 0x10000},
            {"name": "CPU GPIO", "base": 0xFD5A0000, "size": 0x10000},
        ]
        
        for comm in communities:
            try:
                with open("/dev/mem", "rb") as mem:
                    mem.seek(comm['base'])
                    pad_cfg = mem.read(8)  # Read PADCFG register
                    
                    results['gpio_communities'][comm['name']] = {
                        'base': f"0x{comm['base']:08X}",
                        'accessible': True,
                        'pad_cfg_sample': f"0x{pad_cfg.hex()}"
                    }
                    
                    self.log(f"{comm['name']}: PADCFG sample = 0x{pad_cfg.hex()}")
                    
            except Exception as e:
                results['gpio_communities'][comm['name']] = {
                    'base': f"0x{comm['base']:08X}",
                    'accessible': False,
                    'error': str(e)
                }
                
        return results
        
    def test_wifi_reset_control(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Test WiFi reset control"""
        self.log("Testing WiFi reset control...")
        
        results = {
            'wifi_device': None,
            'cnvi_detected': False,
            'reset_accessible': False
        }
        
        # Find WiFi device
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(
                ["lspci", "-nn", "-d", "*:*:*"],
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                timeout=10
            )
            
            wifi_devices = []
            for line in result.stdout.split('\n'):
                if 'Wireless' in line or 'Wi-Fi' in line or '0x4b' in line:  # Intel WiFi vendor
                    wifi_devices.append(line.strip())
                    
            if wifi_devices:
                results['wifi_device'] = wifi_devices[0]
                self.log(f"WiFi device: {results['wifi_device']}")
                
                # Check if CNVi is detected
                if 'CNVi' in result.stdout:
                    results['cnvi_detected'] = True
                    self.log("CNVi WiFi detected")
                    
        except Exception as e:
            self.log(f"Error checking WiFi device: {e}")
            
        return results
        
    def run_all_tests(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Run all exploration tests"""
        self.log("Starting DSDT Unexplored Functions Exploration")
        self.log("=" * 50)
        
        if not self.check_root():
            self.log("This script requires root privileges", "ERROR")
            self.log("Run with: sudo python3 explore_unexplored.py")
            return {}
            
        all_results = {}
        
        # Test 1: GNVS Debug Control
        self.log("\n[TEST 1] GNVS Debug Control")
        all_results['gnvs_debug'] = self.test_gnvs_debug_control()
        
        # Test 2: P2SB Sideband Access
        self.log("\n[TEST 2] P2SB Sideband Access")
        all_results['p2sb_access'] = self.test_p2sb_access()
        
        # Test 3: Thunderbolt CM Control
        self.log("\n[TEST 3] Thunderbolt CM Control")
        all_results['thunderbolt_cm'] = self.test_thunderbolt_cm_control()
        
        # Test 4: XDCI Debug Control
        self.log("\n[TEST 4] XDCI Debug Control")
        all_results['xdci_debug'] = self.test_xdci_debug_control()
        
        # Test 5: GPIO Control
        self.log("\n[TEST 5] GPIO Control")
        all_results['gpio_control'] = self.test_gpio_control()
        
        # Test 6: WiFi Reset Control
        self.log("\n[TEST 6] WiFi Reset Control")
        all_results['wifi_reset'] = self.test_wifi_reset_control()
        
        # Generate summary
        self.generate_summary(all_results)
        
        return all_results
        
    def generate_summary(self, results: Dict[str, Any]):
        """Generate exploration summary"""
        self.log("\n" + "=" * 50)
        self.log("EXPLORATION SUMMARY")
        self.log("=" * 50)
        
        summary = {
            'gnvs_debug_accessible': results.get('gnvs_debug', {}).get('debug_active', False),
            'p2sb_accessible': len([r for r in results.get('p2sb_access', {}).get('critical_registers', {}).values() if r.get('accessible', False)]) > 0,
            'thunderbolt_cm_accessible': results.get('thunderbolt_cm', {}).get('cm_mode_test', False),
            'xdci_debug_accessible': results.get('xdci_debug', {}).get('debug_accessible', False),
            'gpio_accessible': len([r for r in results.get('gpio_control', {}).get('gpio_communities', {}).values() if r.get('accessible', False)]) > 0,
            'wifi_detected': results.get('wifi_reset', {}).get('wifi_device') is not None,
        }
        
        self.log(f"GNVS Debug Control:     {'✓' if summary['gnvs_debug_accessible'] else '✗'}")
        self.log(f"P2SB Sideband Access:     {'✓' if summary['p2sb_accessible'] else '✗'}")
        self.log(f"Thunderbolt CM Control:   {'✓' if summary['thunderbolt_cm_accessible'] else '✗'}")
        self.log(f"XDCI Debug Control:       {'✓' if summary['xdci_debug_accessible'] else '✗'}")
        self.log(f"GPIO Control:            {'✓' if summary['gpio_accessible'] else '✗'}")
        self.log(f"WiFi Reset Control:      {'✓' if summary['wifi_detected'] else '✗'}")
        
        # Count successful tests
        successful = sum(summary.values())
        self.log(f"\nSuccessful tests: {successful}/6")
        
        if successful >= 4:
            self.log("HIGH EXPLOITATION POTENTIAL", "SUCCESS")
        elif successful >= 2:
            self.log("MEDIUM EXPLOITATION POTENTIAL", "WARN")
        else:
            self.log("LOW EXPLOITATION POTENTIAL", "ERROR")
            
        # Save results
        self.save_results(results)
        
    def save_results(self, results: Dict[str, Any]):
        """Save exploration results to file"""
        import json
        
        output_file = self.base_path / "firmware/acpi_tables/06_tools_and_scripts/exploration_results.json"
        
        try:
            with open(output_file, 'w') as f:
                json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
            self.log(f"Results saved to: {output_file}")
        except Exception as e:
            self.log(f"Error saving results: {e}", "ERROR")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    explorer = DSDTExplorer()
    results = explorer.run_all_tests()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
DSMIL Debug Interface Access Investigation Tool
Deep analysis of ADBG universal debug interface and security implications

Author: DSMIL Security Analysis Team
Version: 1.0.0
"""

import re
import json
import sys
import os
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum

class DebugLevel(Enum):
    CRITICAL = "CRITICAL"
    HIGH = "HIGH"
    MEDIUM = "MEDIUM"
    LOW = "LOW"
    INFO = "INFO"

@dataclass
class DebugCall:
    method: str
    file: str
    line: int
    context: str
    subsystem: str
    data_exposed: str
    security_impact: DebugLevel

@dataclass
class DebugInterface:
    name: str
    type: str
    arguments: int
    access_pattern: str
    security_level: DebugLevel
    total_calls: int
    subsystems: Dict[str, List[DebugCall]]

class DebugInterfaceAnalyzer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.debug_calls = []
        self.interfaces = {}
        self.subsystems = {}
        
    def parse_acpi_files(self, directory: str) -> Dict:
        """Parse all ACPI files for debug interface usage"""
        print("🔍 Scanning ACPI files for debug interfaces...")
        
        acpi_files = []
        for file in os.listdir(directory):
            if file.endswith('.dsl'):
                acpi_files.append(os.path.join(directory, file))
        
        debug_data = {
            'adbg_calls': [],
            'external_declarations': [],
            'debug_methods': [],
            'security_implications': []
        }
        
        for file_path in acpi_files:
            try:
                with open(file_path, 'r') as f:
                    content = f.read()
                    
                # Extract ADBG external declarations
                external_matches = re.findall(r'External\s*\(\s*ADBG\s*,\s*MethodObj\s*\)\s*//\s*(\d+)\s*Arguments', content)
                for match in external_matches:
                    debug_data['external_declarations'].append({
                        'file': os.path.basename(file_path),
                        'arguments': int(match[0]),
                        'type': 'MethodObj'
                    })
                
                # Extract ADBG calls
                adbg_matches = re.findall(r'ADBG\s*\(\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']\s*(?:,\s*[^)]+)?\s*\)', content)
                for i, match in enumerate(adbg_matches):
                    # Find line number
                    lines = content.split('\n')
                    line_num = 0
                    for j, line in enumerate(lines):
                        if 'ADBG' in line and match in line:
                            line_num = j + 1
                            break
                    
                    debug_data['adbg_calls'].append({
                        'file': os.path.basename(file_path),
                        'line': line_num,
                        'message': match,
                        'context': self._extract_context(content, line_num)
                    })
                
                # Extract other debug methods
                other_debug_matches = re.findall(r'(?:Debug|DBG|debug)\s*=\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']', content)
                for match in other_debug_matches:
                    debug_data['debug_methods'].append({
                        'file': os.path.basename(file_path),
                        'message': match
                    })
                    
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Error parsing {file_path}: {e}")
        
        return debug_data
    
    def _extract_context(self, content: str, line_num: int) -> str:
        """Extract context around a debug call"""
        lines = content.split('\n')
        start = max(0, line_num - 3)
        end = min(len(lines), line_num + 2)
        
        context_lines = []
        for i in range(start, end):
            prefix = ">>> " if i == line_num - 1 else "    "
            context_lines.append(f"{prefix}{lines[i]}")
        
        return '\n'.join(context_lines)
    
    def analyze_subsystems(self, debug_data: Dict) -> Dict:
        """Analyze debug calls by subsystem"""
        subsystem_analysis = {
            'bluetooth': {'calls': [], 'risk': 'MEDIUM', 'data_types': []},
            'graphics': {'calls': [], 'risk': 'MEDIUM', 'data_types': []},
            'dptf': {'calls': [], 'risk': 'HIGH', 'data_types': []},
            'power': {'calls': [], 'risk': 'HIGH', 'data_types': []},
            'system': {'calls': [], 'risk': 'LOW', 'data_types': []},
            'unknown': {'calls': [], 'risk': 'LOW', 'data_types': []}
        }
        
        for call in debug_data['adbg_calls']:
            message = call['message'].lower()
            file = call['file']
            
            # Classify by subsystem
            if 'bt' in message or 'bluetooth' in message:
                subsystem = 'bluetooth'
            elif 'gfx' in message or 'display' in message or 'mux' in message:
                subsystem = 'graphics'
            elif 'dptf' in message or 'thermal' in message:
                subsystem = 'dptf'
            elif 'power' in message or 'pwr' in message or 'sleep' in message:
                subsystem = 'power'
            elif 'tile' in message or 'rdly' in message:
                subsystem = 'system'
            else:
                subsystem = 'unknown'
            
            # Analyze data exposure
            data_exposed = self._analyze_data_exposure(message)
            
            subsystem_analysis[subsystem]['calls'].append({
                'file': file,
                'line': call['line'],
                'message': call['message'],
                'data_exposed': data_exposed,
                'context': call['context']
            })
            
            if data_exposed not in subsystem_analysis[subsystem]['data_types']:
                subsystem_analysis[subsystem]['data_types'].append(data_exposed)
        
        return subsystem_analysis
    
    def _analyze_data_exposure(self, message: str) -> str:
        """Analyze what type of data is exposed by debug call"""
        message_lower = message.lower()
        
        if 'state' in message_lower or 'status' in message_lower:
            return 'STATE_INFORMATION'
        elif 'mutex' in message_lower or 'lock' in message_lower:
            return 'SYNCHRONIZATION_STATE'
        elif 'temp' in message_lower or 'thermal' in message_lower:
            return 'THERMAL_DATA'
        elif 'power' in message_lower or 'pwr' in message_lower:
            return 'POWER_STATE'
        elif 'addr' in message_lower or 'base' in message_lower:
            return 'MEMORY_ADDRESS'
        elif 'arg' in message_lower or 'val' in message_lower:
            return 'PARAMETER_VALUES'
        elif 'kill' in message_lower or 'enable' in message_lower or 'disable' in message_lower:
            return 'CONTROL_SIGNALS'
        else:
            return 'OPERATIONAL_STATUS'
    
    def assess_security_risks(self, debug_data: Dict, subsystem_analysis: Dict) -> Dict:

        security_assessment = {

        high_risk_data = []

        security_assessment['mitigation_strategies'] = [

                'description': 'Remove ADBG external declarations in production builds',

            },

        return security_assessment

        """Investigate ADBG method implementation details"""
        print("🔬 Investigating ADBG implementation...")
        
        investigation = {
            'method_signature': 'ADBG (1 Argument)',

            'likely_implementation': 'System debug output handler',

    def generate_investigation_report(self) -> str:
        """Generate comprehensive debug interface investigation report"""
        print("📊 Generating debug interface investigation report...")
        
        # Parse ACPI files
        debug_data = self.parse_acpi_files('/run/media/john/593d876a-4036-4255-bd45-33baba503068/DSMILSystem/firmware/acpi_tables')
        
        # Analyze subsystems
        subsystem_analysis = self.analyze_subsystems(debug_data)

        security_assessment = self.assess_security_risks(debug_data, subsystem_analysis)

        implementation_analysis = self.investigate_adbg_implementation()
        
        # Generate report
        report = []

        report.append("")
        
        # ADBG Interface Analysis
        report.append("## ADBG Interface Analysis")
        report.append(f"**Method Signature**: {implementation_analysis['method_signature']}")
        report.append(f"**Expected Location**: {implementation_analysis['expected_location']}")

        # Implementation Hypotheses

        for subsystem, data in subsystem_analysis.items():
            if data['calls']:

                report.append("")
                
                report.append("**Critical Calls**:")
                for call in data['calls'][:3]:  # Show first 3 calls
                    report.append(f"- `{call['message']}` ({call['file']}:{call['line']})")
                report.append("")
        
        # Security Assessment
        report.append("## Security Assessment")
        report.append(f"**Overall Risk**: {security_assessment['overall_risk']}")
        report.append("")
        
        report.append("### Critical Findings")

        report.append("### Attack Vectors")
        for vector in security_assessment['attack_vectors']:

            report.append(f"- {vector['description']}")
            report.append("")
        
        # Mitigation Strategies
        report.append("## Mitigation Strategies")
        for strategy in security_assessment['mitigation_strategies']:
            report.append(f"### {strategy['strategy']} - {strategy['priority']}")
            report.append(f"**Description**: {strategy['description']}")
            report.append(f"**Implementation**: {strategy['implementation']}")
            report.append("")
        
        # Recommendations
        report.append("## Immediate Recommendations")
        report.append("1. **CRITICAL**: Remove ADBG external declarations in production builds")
        report.append("2. **HIGH**: Implement compile-time debug guards")
        report.append("3. **HIGH**: Add debug access authentication")
        report.append("4. **MEDIUM**: Filter sensitive data from debug output")
