// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only
/*
 * Intel GNA (Gaussian & Neural-Network Accelerator) Driver
 * For Intel Meteor Lake-P (Device ID: 8086:7e4c)
 * 
 * Built for DSMIL System - Dell Latitude 5450 JRTC1-MILSPEC
 * Kernel: 6.18.5+deb14-amd64
 *
 * v2.0 - Flex Fabric Edition:
 *   - Secondary MMIO to physical GNA fabric (0x50192E3000)
 *   - CTRL2 fabric controller (0x50192E2000)
 *   - ISH config region (0x50192B0000) for VSEC/clock/fabric freeze
 *   - SRAM tunnel (0x50192D8000)
 *   - Raw R/W IOCTLs for any mapped region
 *   - Fabric dispatch (freeze-inject-unfreeze)
 *   - Sysfs for live fabric state
 */

#include <linux/module.h>
#include <linux/kernel.h>
#include <linux/init.h>
#include <linux/pci.h>
#include <linux/io.h>
#include <linux/interrupt.h>
#include <linux/fs.h>
#include <linux/cdev.h>
#include <linux/device.h>
#include <linux/uaccess.h>
#include <linux/slab.h>
#include <linux/pm_runtime.h>
#include <linux/delay.h>

#define DRIVER_NAME     "intel_gna"
#define DRIVER_VERSION  "2.0.0-fabric"
#define DRIVER_AUTHOR   "DSMIL System"
#define DRIVER_DESC     "Intel GNA + Flex Fabric Driver for Meteor Lake-P"

/* PCI Device IDs */
#define PCI_VENDOR_ID_INTEL     0x8086
#define PCI_DEVICE_ID_MTL_GNA   0x7e4c  /* Meteor Lake-P GNA */

/* GNA Register Offsets */
#define GNA_CTRL        0x000   /* Control Register */
#define GNA_STS         0x004   /* Status Register */
#define GNA_INTR_STS    0x008   /* Interrupt Status */
#define GNA_INTR_EN     0x00C   /* Interrupt Enable */
#define GNA_CFG         0x010   /* Configuration */
#define GNA_DESC_BASE   0x014   /* Descriptor Base Address */
#define GNA_DESC_CTRL   0x018   /* Descriptor Control */
#define GNA_PERF_CNT    0x020   /* Performance Counter */
#define GNA_ERR_STS     0x024   /* Error Status */
#define GNA_VERSION     0x028   /* Hardware Version */
#define GNA_CAPS        0x02C   /* Capabilities */

/* GNA Control Register Bits */
#define GNA_CTRL_START      BIT(0)
#define GNA_CTRL_STOP       BIT(1)
#define GNA_CTRL_RESET      BIT(2)
#define GNA_CTRL_ENABLE     BIT(3)

/* GNA Status Register Bits */
#define GNA_STS_IDLE        BIT(0)
#define GNA_STS_BUSY        BIT(1)
#define GNA_STS_DONE        BIT(2)
#define GNA_STS_ERROR       BIT(3)

/* GNA Interrupt Bits */
#define GNA_INTR_DONE       BIT(0)
#define GNA_INTR_ERROR      BIT(1)
#define GNA_INTR_TIMEOUT    BIT(2)

/* MMIO Size */
#define GNA_MMIO_SIZE       0x1000  /* 4KB */

/* ============================================================================
 * Flex Fabric Physical Addresses (Meteor Lake-P SoC)
 * These are the REAL hardware addresses discovered via fabric probe.
 * PCI BAR0 reads 0xFFFFFFFF; the live registers are at these phys addrs.
 * ============================================================================ */
#define FAB_GNA_PHYS        0x50192E3000ULL  /* GNA fabric gateway */
#define FAB_GNA_SIZE        0x1000
#define FAB_CTRL2_PHYS      0x50192E2000ULL  /* Fabric controller */
#define FAB_CTRL2_SIZE      0x1000
#define FAB_ISH_PHYS        0x50192B0000ULL  /* ISH config (VSEC) */
#define FAB_ISH_SIZE        0x10000          /* 64KB */
#define FAB_SRAM0_PHYS      0x50192D8000ULL  /* SRAM tunnel */
#define FAB_SRAM0_SIZE      0x4000           /* 16KB */
#define FAB_CSME_PHYS       0x50192DD000ULL  /* CSME interface */
#define FAB_CSME_SIZE       0x1000

/* ISH VSEC Register Offsets */
#define VSEC_LOCK           0x14
#define VSEC_ENG_MODE       0x18
#define VSEC_CLOCK_CTRL     0x20
#define VSEC_SECURITY_CTRL  0x28    /* ME Squelch - matches MCM1000 */
#define VSEC_FEATURE_CTRL   0x70

/* VSEC Clock Control Bits */
#define VSEC_CLK_SYNC_EN    BIT(0)
#define VSEC_CLK_HB_LOCK    BIT(1)
#define VSEC_CLK_FAB_FREEZE BIT(4)
#define VSEC_CLK_DRIFT_COMP BIT(8)

/* GNA Fabric Gateway Offsets (within FAB_GNA region) */
#define GNA_FAB_ROUTE       0x094  /* Route config */
#define GNA_FAB_FEAT        0x0A0  /* Feature flags */
#define GNA_FAB_UNLOCK      0x0A4  /* Unlock key */
#define GNA_FAB_CTRL        0x0A8  /* Ctrl flags */
#define GNA_FAB_MASK        0x0B0  /* Mask register */
#define GNA_FAB_RESP        0x0B4  /* Response register */
#define GNA_HW_CAP          0x100  /* HW capability */
#define GNA_HW_STATUS       0x104  /* HW status */
#define GNA_HW_CONFIG       0x108  /* HW config */
#define GNA_HW_FEAT         0x10C  /* HW features */

/* ISH Fabric Command Offsets */
#define ISH_FAB_FEAT_CMD    0x104  /* Feature command */
#define ISH_FAB_MILSPEC     0x108  /* MILSPEC latch */
#define ISH_FAB_FTA_KEY     0x110  /* Factory Test Agent key */
#define ISH_FAB_UNLOCK_KEY  0x114  /* Unlock key */
#define ISH_FAB_ENG_MODE    0x118  /* Engineering mode */
#define ISH_FAB_ACTIVATE    0x140  /* Activate trigger */
#define ISH_FAB_COMMIT      0x144  /* Commit trigger */

/* Fabric region IDs for IOCTLs */
#define FAB_REGION_BAR0     0
#define FAB_REGION_GNA      1
#define FAB_REGION_CTRL2    2
#define FAB_REGION_ISH      3
#define FAB_REGION_SRAM     4
#define FAB_REGION_CSME     5
#define FAB_REGION_MAX      6

/* IOCTL Commands */
#define GNA_IOC_MAGIC       'G'
#define GNA_IOC_GET_INFO    _IOR(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 0, struct gna_info)
#define GNA_IOC_SUBMIT      _IOWR(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 1, struct gna_request)
#define GNA_IOC_WAIT        _IOR(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 2, struct gna_wait)
#define GNA_IOC_RESET       _IO(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 3)
#define GNA_IOC_GET_STATUS  _IOR(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 4, u32)
/* Fabric IOCTLs */
#define GNA_IOC_FAB_READ    _IOWR(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 10, struct gna_fab_reg)
#define GNA_IOC_FAB_WRITE   _IOW(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 11, struct gna_fab_reg)
#define GNA_IOC_FAB_DUMP    _IOWR(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 12, struct gna_fab_dump)
#define GNA_IOC_FAB_DISPATCH _IOW(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 13, struct gna_fab_dispatch)
#define GNA_IOC_FAB_SCAN    _IOWR(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 14, struct gna_fab_scan)

/* Data Structures */
struct gna_info {
    u32 version;
    u32 capabilities;
    u32 max_layers;
    u32 max_memory;
    u32 device_id;
    u32 revision;
};

struct gna_request {
    u64 descriptor_addr;
    u32 descriptor_size;
    u32 flags;
    u32 timeout_ms;
    u32 request_id;
};

struct gna_wait {
    u32 request_id;
    u32 timeout_ms;
    u32 status;
    u32 hw_status;
};

/* Fabric raw register access */
struct gna_fab_reg {
    u32 region;     /* FAB_REGION_* */
    u32 offset;     /* byte offset within region */
    u32 value;      /* value read or to write */
    u32 status;     /* 0=ok, nonzero=error */
};

/* Fabric region dump */
struct gna_fab_dump {
    u32 region;
    u32 start_offset;
    u32 count;          /* number of u32s to read (max 256) */
    u32 values[256];
};

/* Fabric dispatch command */
struct gna_fab_dispatch {
    u32 fta_key;        /* Factory Test Agent key */
    u32 unlock_key;     /* Unlock key */
    u32 features;       /* Feature flags to inject */
    u32 milspec;        /* MILSPEC latch value */
    u32 flags;          /* Dispatch flags */
    u32 result;         /* Result/status after dispatch */
};

/* Fabric writability scan result */
struct gna_fab_scan {
    u32 region;
    u32 writable_count;       /* number of writable registers found */
    u32 nonzero_count;        /* number of non-zero registers */
    u32 writable_map[8];      /* bitmask: bit N = offset N*4 writable (256 regs) */
};

/* Fabric region descriptor */
struct fab_region {
    void __iomem *virt;
    resource_size_t phys;
    size_t size;
    const char *name;
    bool mapped;
};

/* Device Context */
struct gna_device {
    struct pci_dev *pdev;
    void __iomem *mmio;
    resource_size_t mmio_phys;
    
    struct cdev cdev;
    struct device *dev;
    dev_t devno;
    struct class *class;
    
    spinlock_t lock;
    struct mutex ioctl_lock;
    
    u32 hw_version;
    u32 capabilities;
    
    bool enabled;
    atomic_t open_count;
    
    /* Statistics */
    u64 requests_submitted;
    u64 requests_completed;
    u64 errors;

    /* Flex Fabric Regions */
    struct fab_region fab[FAB_REGION_MAX];
    bool fabric_initialized;
    u32 fabric_dispatch_count;
    u32 last_dispatch_result;
};

static struct gna_device *gna_dev;

/* Register Access */
static inline u32 gna_read32(struct gna_device *gna, u32 offset)
{
    return readl(gna->mmio + offset);
}

static inline void gna_write32(struct gna_device *gna, u32 offset, u32 value)
{
    writel(value, gna->mmio + offset);
}

/* ============================================================================
 * Flex Fabric Region Helpers
 * ============================================================================ */
static struct fab_region *fab_get_region(struct gna_device *gna, u32 region_id)
{
    if (region_id >= FAB_REGION_MAX)
        return NULL;
    if (!gna->fab[region_id].mapped)
        return NULL;
    return &gna->fab[region_id];
}

static u32 fab_read32(struct fab_region *r, u32 offset)
{
    if (!r || !r->virt || offset >= r->size)
        return 0xDEADDEAD;
    return readl(r->virt + offset);
}

static int fab_write32(struct fab_region *r, u32 offset, u32 value)
{
    if (!r || !r->virt || offset >= r->size)
        return -EINVAL;
    writel(value, r->virt + offset);
    wmb();
    return 0;
}

static void fab_init_regions(struct gna_device *gna)
{
    struct fab_region *f;

    /* BAR0 is already mapped as gna->mmio */
    f = &gna->fab[FAB_REGION_BAR0];
    f->virt = gna->mmio;
    f->phys = gna->mmio_phys;
    f->size = GNA_MMIO_SIZE;
    f->name = "bar0";
    f->mapped = (gna->mmio != NULL);

    /* GNA fabric gateway */
    f = &gna->fab[FAB_REGION_GNA];
    f->phys = FAB_GNA_PHYS;
    f->size = FAB_GNA_SIZE;
    f->name = "gna-fabric";
    f->virt = ioremap(f->phys, f->size);
    f->mapped = (f->virt != NULL);
    if (f->mapped)
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Fabric GNA mapped: 0x%llx\n", (u64)f->phys);
    else
        dev_warn(&gna->pdev->dev, "Fabric GNA map FAILED\n");

    /* CTRL2 fabric controller */
    f = &gna->fab[FAB_REGION_CTRL2];
    f->phys = FAB_CTRL2_PHYS;
    f->size = FAB_CTRL2_SIZE;
    f->name = "ctrl2";
    f->virt = ioremap(f->phys, f->size);
    f->mapped = (f->virt != NULL);
    if (f->mapped)
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Fabric CTRL2 mapped: 0x%llx\n", (u64)f->phys);

    /* ISH config (VSEC) */
    f = &gna->fab[FAB_REGION_ISH];
    f->phys = FAB_ISH_PHYS;
    f->size = FAB_ISH_SIZE;
    f->name = "ish-vsec";
    f->virt = ioremap(f->phys, f->size);
    f->mapped = (f->virt != NULL);
    if (f->mapped)
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Fabric ISH mapped: 0x%llx\n", (u64)f->phys);

    /* SRAM tunnel */
    f = &gna->fab[FAB_REGION_SRAM];
    f->phys = FAB_SRAM0_PHYS;
    f->size = FAB_SRAM0_SIZE;
    f->name = "sram0";
    f->virt = ioremap(f->phys, f->size);
    f->mapped = (f->virt != NULL);
    if (f->mapped)
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Fabric SRAM mapped: 0x%llx\n", (u64)f->phys);

    /* CSME interface */
    f = &gna->fab[FAB_REGION_CSME];
    f->phys = FAB_CSME_PHYS;
    f->size = FAB_CSME_SIZE;
    f->name = "csme";
    f->virt = ioremap(f->phys, f->size);
    f->mapped = (f->virt != NULL);
    if (f->mapped)
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Fabric CSME mapped: 0x%llx\n", (u64)f->phys);

    gna->fabric_initialized = true;
}

static void fab_cleanup_regions(struct gna_device *gna)
{
    int i;
    for (i = 1; i < FAB_REGION_MAX; i++) {
        if (gna->fab[i].virt) {
            iounmap(gna->fab[i].virt);
            gna->fab[i].virt = NULL;
            gna->fab[i].mapped = false;
        }
    }
    gna->fabric_initialized = false;
}

/* ============================================================================
 * CSME Interface Registers (at FAB_CSME_PHYS)
 * Discovered via runtime probe:
 *   0x04: ME status/control (bit 31=active, writable)
 *   0x08: Live ME firmware status (dynamic, writable)
 *   0x0C: ME capability (bit 31=active, responds to writes)
 *   0x14: ME watchdog control (bit 0=WDT_DIS, writable)
 *   0x30: ME feature register (read-only, 0x8F9)
 * ============================================================================ */
#define CSME_STATUS_CTRL    0x04
#define CSME_FW_STATUS      0x08
#define CSME_CAPABILITY     0x0C
#define CSME_WDT_CTRL       0x14
#define CSME_FEATURES       0x30

/* ME Squelch Mask (from MCM1000 driver) */
#define VSEC_SEC_SQUELCH_MASK   0x8000F011
#define VSEC_SEC_WDT_DIS        BIT(0)
#define VSEC_SEC_PORT_BYPASS    BIT(4)
#define VSEC_SEC_PRIV_MAX       (0xF << 12)
#define VSEC_SEC_SVRN_MODE      BIT(31)

/* SRAM Tunnel Topology (at FAB_SRAM0_PHYS)
 * Discovered via runtime probe:
 *   0x000: Feature register (0x20002000 = SRAM_TUNNEL bit set)
 *   0x004: Memory config (0x00400000)
 *   0x008: DMA base (0x08000000)
 *   0x100-0x11C: Intel PCI bridge descriptors (VID 0x8086, DID 0x0101)
 *   0x024-0x04C: Route descriptors (config 0x07080005)
 */
#define SRAM_FEATURE_REG    0x000
#define SRAM_MEM_CONFIG     0x004
#define SRAM_DMA_BASE       0x008
#define SRAM_BRIDGE0_BASE   0x100
#define SRAM_BRIDGE1_BASE   0x110
#define SRAM_ROUTE0_BASE    0x024

/* GNA HW Identity (at GNA fabric + 0x100)
 * HW_CAP=0x0120021F  HW_STATUS=0x0E00
 * HW_CONFIG=0x01200200  HW_FEAT=0x0400
 * RESP=0x23A21820 (persistent gateway ack)
 */

/* ============================================================================
 * Post-Boot Fabric State Detection
 * Checks whether titan/early-boot unlock succeeded and reports full state.
 * After early-boot unlock, ISH 0x14-0x28 should be writable and CTRL2 alive.
 * ============================================================================ */
static void fab_detect_unlock_state(struct gna_device *gna)
{
    struct fab_region *ish = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_ISH);
    struct fab_region *ctrl2 = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_CTRL2);
    struct fab_region *csme = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_CSME);
    struct fab_region *sram = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_SRAM);
    struct fab_region *gna_fab = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_GNA);
    u32 val;
    int ctrl2_nz = 0, i;
    bool titan_active = false;

    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "=== FABRIC STATE DETECTION ===\n");

    /* Check 1: ISH VSEC lower offsets — if NOT 0xFFFFFFFF, titan unlocked them */
    if (ish) {
        val = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_LOCK);
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "ISH LOCK(0x14)=%08x %s\n", val,
                 val != 0xFFFFFFFF ? "** TITAN ACTIVE **" : "(firmware domain)");
        if (val != 0xFFFFFFFF)
            titan_active = true;

        val = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_ENG_MODE);
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "ISH ENG_MODE(0x18)=%08x\n", val);
        if (val == 0x00000001)
            titan_active = true;

        val = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_SECURITY_CTRL);
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "ISH SECURITY(0x28)=%08x %s\n", val,
                 val == VSEC_SEC_SQUELCH_MASK ? "** ME SQUELCHED **" : "");

        val = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_FEATURE_CTRL);
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "ISH FEAT_CTRL(0x70)=%08x [%s%s%s%s]\n", val,
                 (val & BIT(4))  ? "AMX " : "",
                 (val & BIT(5))  ? "NPU " : "",
                 (val & BIT(8))  ? "AVX512 " : "",
                 (val & BIT(12)) ? "SRAM_TUNNEL " : "");

        /* Command mailbox state */
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "ISH unlock_key(0x114)=%08x eng(0x118)=%08x\n",
                 fab_read32(ish, ISH_FAB_UNLOCK_KEY),
                 fab_read32(ish, ISH_FAB_ENG_MODE));
    }

    /* Check 2: CTRL2 fabric controller — alive after titan? */
    if (ctrl2) {
        for (i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
            val = fab_read32(ctrl2, i * 4);
            if (val != 0 && val != 0xFFFFFFFF)
                ctrl2_nz++;
        }
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "CTRL2 live registers: %d/256 %s\n", ctrl2_nz,
                 ctrl2_nz > 0 ? "** FABRIC CONTROLLER ONLINE **" : "(dark)");
        if (ctrl2_nz > 0)
            titan_active = true;
    }

    /* Check 3: CSME ME status */
    if (csme) {
        u32 sts = fab_read32(csme, CSME_STATUS_CTRL);
        u32 fw  = fab_read32(csme, CSME_FW_STATUS);
        u32 wdt = fab_read32(csme, CSME_WDT_CTRL);
        u32 cap = fab_read32(csme, CSME_CAPABILITY);
        u32 feat = fab_read32(csme, CSME_FEATURES);
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "CSME status=0x%08x fw=0x%08x cap=0x%08x\n",
                 sts, fw, cap);
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "CSME wdt=0x%08x feat=0x%08x [WDT_DIS=%d]\n",
                 wdt, feat, !!(wdt & VSEC_SEC_WDT_DIS));
    }

    /* Check 4: GNA hardware state */
    if (gna_fab) {
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "GNA hw_cap=0x%08x hw_sts=0x%08x resp=0x%08x\n",
                 fab_read32(gna_fab, GNA_HW_CAP),
                 fab_read32(gna_fab, GNA_HW_STATUS),
                 fab_read32(gna_fab, GNA_FAB_RESP));
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "GNA gateway: route=0x%08x feat=0x%08x unlock=0x%08x\n",
                 fab_read32(gna_fab, GNA_FAB_ROUTE),
                 fab_read32(gna_fab, GNA_FAB_FEAT),
                 fab_read32(gna_fab, GNA_FAB_UNLOCK));
    }

    /* Check 5: SRAM tunnel feature register */
    if (sram) {
        val = fab_read32(sram, SRAM_FEATURE_REG);
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "SRAM feature=0x%08x [TUNNEL=%s]\n", val,
                 (val & BIT(12)) ? "ACTIVE" : "inactive");
    }

    /* Summary */
    if (titan_active) {
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev,
                 "*** TITAN EARLY-BOOT UNLOCK DETECTED - FABRIC SOVEREIGN ***\n");
    } else {
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev,
                 "Fabric in runtime mode (titan unlock needed for full access)\n");
    }
}

/* Fabric dispatch: freeze -> inject -> unfreeze */
static int fab_dispatch(struct gna_device *gna, struct gna_fab_dispatch *cmd)
{
    struct fab_region *ish = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_ISH);
    struct fab_region *gna_fab = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_GNA);
    u32 clk_before, clk_after, feat_before, feat_after;

    if (!ish) {
        dev_err(&gna->pdev->dev, "Fabric dispatch: ISH not mapped\n");
        cmd->result = 0xFFFFFFFF;
        return -ENODEV;
    }

    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "=== FABRIC DISPATCH #%u ===", 
             ++gna->fabric_dispatch_count);

    /* Record before state */
    clk_before = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_CLOCK_CTRL);
    feat_before = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_FEATURE_CTRL);
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Before: CLK=0x%08x FEAT=0x%08x\n",
             clk_before, feat_before);

    /* Step 1: Freeze fabric */
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "[1] FABRIC FREEZE\n");
    fab_write32(ish, VSEC_CLOCK_CTRL,
                clk_before | VSEC_CLK_FAB_FREEZE | VSEC_CLK_SYNC_EN);
    udelay(100);

    /* Step 2: Inject ISH values */
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "[2] INJECT: FTA=0x%08x UNLOCK=0x%08x FEAT=0x%08x MILSPEC=0x%08x\n",
             cmd->fta_key, cmd->unlock_key, cmd->features, cmd->milspec);
    fab_write32(ish, ISH_FAB_FTA_KEY, cmd->fta_key);
    fab_write32(ish, ISH_FAB_UNLOCK_KEY, cmd->unlock_key);
    fab_write32(ish, ISH_FAB_ENG_MODE, 0x00000001);
    fab_write32(ish, ISH_FAB_FEAT_CMD, cmd->features);
    fab_write32(ish, ISH_FAB_MILSPEC, cmd->milspec);
    wmb();
    udelay(100);

    /* Step 3: Activate + Commit */
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "[3] ACTIVATE + COMMIT\n");
    fab_write32(ish, ISH_FAB_ACTIVATE, 0x00000001);
    fab_write32(ish, ISH_FAB_COMMIT, 0x00000001);
    wmb();
    udelay(200);

    /* Step 4: Program GNA gateway if mapped */
    if (gna_fab) {
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "[4] GNA GATEWAY PROGRAM\n");
        fab_write32(gna_fab, GNA_FAB_ROUTE, 0x7FF);
        fab_write32(gna_fab, GNA_FAB_FEAT, cmd->features);
        fab_write32(gna_fab, GNA_FAB_UNLOCK, cmd->unlock_key);
        fab_write32(gna_fab, GNA_FAB_CTRL, 0x06); /* TX enable + fabric write */
        fab_write32(gna_fab, GNA_FAB_MASK, 0xDEADBEEF);
        wmb();
    }

    /* Step 5: Unfreeze fabric */
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "[5] FABRIC UNFREEZE\n");
    clk_after = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_CLOCK_CTRL);
    fab_write32(ish, VSEC_CLOCK_CTRL,
                (clk_after & ~VSEC_CLK_FAB_FREEZE) | VSEC_CLK_SYNC_EN);

    /* Wait for propagation */
    msleep(200);

    /* Record after state */
    clk_after = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_CLOCK_CTRL);
    feat_after = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_FEATURE_CTRL);
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "After: CLK=0x%08x FEAT=0x%08x\n",
             clk_after, feat_after);

    /* Check GNA response register */
    if (gna_fab) {
        u32 resp = fab_read32(gna_fab, GNA_FAB_RESP);
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "GNA response: 0x%08x\n", resp);
        cmd->result = resp;
    } else {
        cmd->result = feat_after;
    }

    gna->last_dispatch_result = cmd->result;
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "=== DISPATCH COMPLETE (result=0x%08x) ===",
             cmd->result);
    return 0;
}

/* Hardware Operations */
static int gna_hw_init(struct gna_device *gna)
{
    u32 ctrl, sts;
    int timeout = 100;
    int ret;
    
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Initializing GNA hardware...\n");
    
    /* Wake device from D3 if needed */
    ret = pci_set_power_state(gna->pdev, PCI_D0);
    if (ret)
        dev_warn(&gna->pdev->dev, "Failed to set D0 power state: %d\n", ret);
    msleep(50);
    
    /* Re-enable device after power state change */
    ret = pci_enable_device(gna->pdev);
    if (ret) {
        dev_err(&gna->pdev->dev, "Failed to re-enable device: %d\n", ret);
        return ret;
    }
    pci_set_master(gna->pdev);
    
    /* Read initial status */
    sts = gna_read32(gna, GNA_STS);
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Initial status: 0x%08x\n", sts);
    
    /* If all 1s, device may need more time or is in special state */
    if (sts == 0xFFFFFFFF) {
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Device returning 0xFFFFFFFF - device may not have firmware loaded\n");
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Continuing with soft initialization (no firmware mode)\n");
        /* Skip reset, just try to enable */
        gna->hw_version = 0xFFFFFFFF;
        gna->capabilities = 0;
        gna->enabled = true;
        return 0;
    }
    
    /* Reset the device */
    gna_write32(gna, GNA_CTRL, GNA_CTRL_RESET);
    usleep_range(1000, 2000);
    
    /* Wait for reset to complete */
    while (timeout--) {
        sts = gna_read32(gna, GNA_STS);
        if ((sts & GNA_STS_IDLE) || sts == 0xFFFFFFFF)
            break;
        usleep_range(100, 200);
    }
    
    if (timeout <= 0 && sts != 0xFFFFFFFF) {
        dev_warn(&gna->pdev->dev, "GNA reset timeout (sts=0x%08x), continuing anyway\n", sts);
    }

skip_reset:
    
    /* Read hardware version and capabilities */
    gna->hw_version = gna_read32(gna, GNA_VERSION);
    gna->capabilities = gna_read32(gna, GNA_CAPS);
    
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "GNA HW Version: 0x%08x, Caps: 0x%08x\n",
             gna->hw_version, gna->capabilities);
    
    /* Check if device is responding properly */
    if (gna->hw_version == 0xFFFFFFFF && gna->capabilities == 0xFFFFFFFF) {
        dev_warn(&gna->pdev->dev, "Device not responding properly - may need firmware\n");
        gna->enabled = true; /* Mark as enabled anyway for debugging */
        return 0;
    }
    
    /* Enable the device */
    ctrl = gna_read32(gna, GNA_CTRL);
    if (ctrl != 0xFFFFFFFF) {
        ctrl |= GNA_CTRL_ENABLE;
        gna_write32(gna, GNA_CTRL, ctrl);
        
        /* Enable interrupts */
        gna_write32(gna, GNA_INTR_EN, GNA_INTR_DONE | GNA_INTR_ERROR);
    } else {
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Control register inaccessible - device in special mode\n");
    }
    
    gna->enabled = true;
    
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "GNA hardware initialized successfully\n");
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Device accessible via /dev/gna0 and sysfs\n");
    return 0;
}

static void gna_hw_fini(struct gna_device *gna)
{
    if (!gna->enabled)
        return;
    
    /* Disable interrupts */
    gna_write32(gna, GNA_INTR_EN, 0);
    
    /* Stop and disable */
    gna_write32(gna, GNA_CTRL, GNA_CTRL_STOP);
    usleep_range(1000, 2000);
    gna_write32(gna, GNA_CTRL, 0);
    
    gna->enabled = false;
    
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "GNA hardware disabled\n");
}

/* Interrupt Handler */
static irqreturn_t gna_irq_handler(int irq, void *data)
{
    struct gna_device *gna = data;
    u32 intr_sts;
    
    intr_sts = gna_read32(gna, GNA_INTR_STS);
    if (!intr_sts)
        return IRQ_NONE;
    
    /* Clear interrupts */
    gna_write32(gna, GNA_INTR_STS, intr_sts);
    
    if (intr_sts & GNA_INTR_DONE) {
        gna->requests_completed++;
        dev_dbg(&gna->pdev->dev, "GNA request completed\n");
    }
    
    if (intr_sts & GNA_INTR_ERROR) {
        gna->errors++;
        dev_err(&gna->pdev->dev, "GNA error interrupt\n");
    }
    
    return IRQ_HANDLED;
}

/* File Operations */
static int gna_open(struct inode *inode, struct file *file)
{
    struct gna_device *gna = container_of(inode->i_cdev, struct gna_device, cdev);
    
    file->private_data = gna;
    atomic_inc(&gna->open_count);
    
    dev_dbg(&gna->pdev->dev, "GNA device opened (count: %d)\n",
            atomic_read(&gna->open_count));
    
    return 0;
}

static int gna_release(struct inode *inode, struct file *file)
{
    struct gna_device *gna = file->private_data;
    
    atomic_dec(&gna->open_count);
    
    dev_dbg(&gna->pdev->dev, "GNA device closed (count: %d)\n",
            atomic_read(&gna->open_count));
    
    return 0;
}

static long gna_ioctl(struct file *file, unsigned int cmd, unsigned long arg)
{
    struct gna_device *gna = file->private_data;
    void __user *argp = (void __user *)arg;
    int ret = 0;
    
    mutex_lock(&gna->ioctl_lock);
    
    switch (cmd) {
    case GNA_IOC_GET_INFO: {
        struct gna_info info = {
            .version = gna->hw_version,
            .capabilities = gna->capabilities,
            .max_layers = 256,
            .max_memory = 256 * 1024 * 1024, /* 256MB */
            .device_id = gna->pdev->device,
            .revision = gna->pdev->revision,
        };
        if (copy_to_user(argp, &info, sizeof(info)))
            ret = -EFAULT;
        break;
    }
    
    case GNA_IOC_GET_STATUS: {
        u32 status = gna_read32(gna, GNA_STS);
        if (copy_to_user(argp, &status, sizeof(status)))
            ret = -EFAULT;
        break;
    }
    
    case GNA_IOC_RESET:
        ret = gna_hw_init(gna);
        break;
    
    case GNA_IOC_SUBMIT: {
        struct gna_request req;
        if (copy_from_user(&req, argp, sizeof(req))) {
            ret = -EFAULT;
            break;
        }
        /* Submit request to hardware */
        gna_write32(gna, GNA_DESC_BASE, req.descriptor_addr & 0xFFFFFFFF);
        gna_write32(gna, GNA_DESC_CTRL, req.descriptor_size);
        gna_write32(gna, GNA_CTRL, GNA_CTRL_START | GNA_CTRL_ENABLE);
        gna->requests_submitted++;
        break;
    }
    
    /* ================================================================
     * Fabric IOCTLs
     * ================================================================ */
    case GNA_IOC_FAB_READ: {
        struct gna_fab_reg freg;
        struct fab_region *r;
        if (copy_from_user(&freg, argp, sizeof(freg))) {
            ret = -EFAULT;
            break;
        }
        r = fab_get_region(gna, freg.region);
        if (!r) {
            freg.status = 1;
            freg.value = 0xDEADDEAD;
        } else {
            freg.value = fab_read32(r, freg.offset);
            freg.status = 0;
        }
        if (copy_to_user(argp, &freg, sizeof(freg)))
            ret = -EFAULT;
        break;
    }

    case GNA_IOC_FAB_WRITE: {
        struct gna_fab_reg freg;
        struct fab_region *r;
        if (copy_from_user(&freg, argp, sizeof(freg))) {
            ret = -EFAULT;
            break;
        }
        r = fab_get_region(gna, freg.region);
        if (!r) {
            ret = -ENODEV;
        } else {
            ret = fab_write32(r, freg.offset, freg.value);
            dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "FAB_WRITE %s+0x%03x = 0x%08x\n",
                     r->name, freg.offset, freg.value);
        }
        break;
    }

    case GNA_IOC_FAB_DUMP: {
        struct gna_fab_dump *dump;
        struct fab_region *r;
        u32 i;
        dump = kmalloc(sizeof(*dump), GFP_KERNEL);
        if (!dump) { ret = -ENOMEM; break; }
        if (copy_from_user(dump, argp, sizeof(*dump))) {
            kfree(dump); ret = -EFAULT; break;
        }
        if (dump->count > 256) dump->count = 256;
        r = fab_get_region(gna, dump->region);
        if (!r) {
            kfree(dump); ret = -ENODEV; break;
        }
        for (i = 0; i < dump->count; i++)
            dump->values[i] = fab_read32(r, dump->start_offset + i * 4);
        if (copy_to_user(argp, dump, sizeof(*dump)))
            ret = -EFAULT;
        kfree(dump);
        break;
    }

    case GNA_IOC_FAB_SCAN: {
        struct gna_fab_scan scan;
        struct fab_region *r;
        u32 i, max_regs;
        if (copy_from_user(&scan, argp, sizeof(scan))) {
            ret = -EFAULT; break;
        }
        memset(&scan.writable_map, 0, sizeof(scan.writable_map));
        scan.writable_count = 0;
        scan.nonzero_count = 0;
        r = fab_get_region(gna, scan.region);
        if (!r) { ret = -ENODEV; break; }
        max_regs = min_t(u32, r->size / 4, 256);
        for (i = 0; i < max_regs; i++) {
            u32 off = i * 4;
            u32 orig = fab_read32(r, off);
            u32 test = (orig == 0) ? 0x01 : (orig ^ 0x01);
            if (orig != 0 && orig != 0xFFFFFFFF)
                scan.nonzero_count++;
            fab_write32(r, off, test);
            udelay(10);
            if (fab_read32(r, off) != orig) {
                scan.writable_count++;
                scan.writable_map[i / 32] |= (1U << (i % 32));
                fab_write32(r, off, orig); /* restore */
            }
        }
        if (copy_to_user(argp, &scan, sizeof(scan)))
            ret = -EFAULT;
        break;
    }

    case GNA_IOC_FAB_DISPATCH: {
        struct gna_fab_dispatch dispatch;
        if (copy_from_user(&dispatch, argp, sizeof(dispatch))) {
            ret = -EFAULT; break;
        }
        ret = fab_dispatch(gna, &dispatch);
        if (copy_to_user(argp, &dispatch, sizeof(dispatch)))
            ret = -EFAULT;
        break;
    }

    default:
        ret = -ENOTTY;
    }
    
    mutex_unlock(&gna->ioctl_lock);
    return ret;
}

static int gna_mmap(struct file *file, struct vm_area_struct *vma)
{
    struct gna_device *gna = file->private_data;
    unsigned long size = vma->vm_end - vma->vm_start;
    
    if (size > GNA_MMIO_SIZE)
        return -EINVAL;
    
    vma->vm_page_prot = pgprot_noncached(vma->vm_page_prot);
    
    if (io_remap_pfn_range(vma, vma->vm_start,
                          gna->mmio_phys >> PAGE_SHIFT,
                          size, vma->vm_page_prot))
        return -EAGAIN;
    
    return 0;
}

static const struct file_operations gna_fops = {
    .owner          = THIS_MODULE,
    .open           = gna_open,
    .release        = gna_release,
    .unlocked_ioctl = gna_ioctl,
    .mmap           = gna_mmap,
};

/* Sysfs Attributes */
static ssize_t version_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    return sprintf(buf, "0x%08x\n", gna_dev->hw_version);
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(version);

static ssize_t capabilities_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    return sprintf(buf, "0x%08x\n", gna_dev->capabilities);
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(capabilities);

static ssize_t status_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    u32 sts = gna_read32(gna_dev, GNA_STS);
    return sprintf(buf, "0x%08x\n", sts);
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(status);

static ssize_t stats_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    return sprintf(buf, "submitted: %llu\ncompleted: %llu\nerrors: %llu\n",
                   gna_dev->requests_submitted,
                   gna_dev->requests_completed,
                   gna_dev->errors);
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(stats);

/* Fabric Sysfs Attributes */
static ssize_t fabric_regions_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    int i, len = 0;
    static const char *names[] = {"bar0", "gna-fabric", "ctrl2", "ish-vsec", "sram0", "csme"};
    for (i = 0; i < FAB_REGION_MAX; i++) {
        len += sprintf(buf + len, "[%d] %-12s phys=0x%llx size=0x%lx %s\n",
                       i, names[i],
                       (u64)gna_dev->fab[i].phys,
                       (unsigned long)gna_dev->fab[i].size,
                       gna_dev->fab[i].mapped ? "MAPPED" : "unmapped");
    }
    return len;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(fabric_regions);

static ssize_t fabric_gna_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    struct fab_region *r = fab_get_region(gna_dev, FAB_REGION_GNA);
    int len = 0;
    if (!r) return sprintf(buf, "not mapped\n");
    len += sprintf(buf + len, "route=0x%08x feat=0x%08x unlock=0x%08x\n",
                   fab_read32(r, GNA_FAB_ROUTE),
                   fab_read32(r, GNA_FAB_FEAT),
                   fab_read32(r, GNA_FAB_UNLOCK));
    len += sprintf(buf + len, "ctrl=0x%08x mask=0x%08x resp=0x%08x\n",
                   fab_read32(r, GNA_FAB_CTRL),
                   fab_read32(r, GNA_FAB_MASK),
                   fab_read32(r, GNA_FAB_RESP));
    len += sprintf(buf + len, "hw_cap=0x%08x hw_sts=0x%08x hw_cfg=0x%08x hw_feat=0x%08x\n",
                   fab_read32(r, GNA_HW_CAP),
                   fab_read32(r, GNA_HW_STATUS),
                   fab_read32(r, GNA_HW_CONFIG),
                   fab_read32(r, GNA_HW_FEAT));
    return len;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(fabric_gna);

static ssize_t fabric_ish_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    struct fab_region *r = fab_get_region(gna_dev, FAB_REGION_ISH);
    int len = 0;
    if (!r) return sprintf(buf, "not mapped\n");
    len += sprintf(buf + len, "lock=0x%08x eng_mode=0x%08x clock=0x%08x\n",
                   fab_read32(r, VSEC_LOCK),
                   fab_read32(r, VSEC_ENG_MODE),
                   fab_read32(r, VSEC_CLOCK_CTRL));
    len += sprintf(buf + len, "feat_ctrl=0x%08x security=0x%08x\n",
                   fab_read32(r, VSEC_FEATURE_CTRL),
                   fab_read32(r, VSEC_SECURITY_CTRL));
    len += sprintf(buf + len, "fta_key=0x%08x unlock_key=0x%08x eng=0x%08x\n",
                   fab_read32(r, ISH_FAB_FTA_KEY),
                   fab_read32(r, ISH_FAB_UNLOCK_KEY),
                   fab_read32(r, ISH_FAB_ENG_MODE));
    len += sprintf(buf + len, "feat_cmd=0x%08x milspec=0x%08x\n",
                   fab_read32(r, ISH_FAB_FEAT_CMD),
                   fab_read32(r, ISH_FAB_MILSPEC));
    len += sprintf(buf + len, "activate=0x%08x commit=0x%08x\n",
                   fab_read32(r, ISH_FAB_ACTIVATE),
                   fab_read32(r, ISH_FAB_COMMIT));
    return len;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(fabric_ish);

static ssize_t fabric_dispatch_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    return sprintf(buf, "dispatches=%u last_result=0x%08x\n",
                   gna_dev->fabric_dispatch_count,
                   gna_dev->last_dispatch_result);
}

static ssize_t fabric_dispatch_store(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr,
                                     const char *buf, size_t count)
{
    struct gna_fab_dispatch cmd = {
        .fta_key    = 0xFF070707,
        .unlock_key = 0x5A5A5A5A,
        .features   = 0x00000117,
        .milspec    = 0x07886010,
        .flags      = 0,
    };
    if (sysfs_streq(buf, "go") || sysfs_streq(buf, "1")) {
        fab_dispatch(gna_dev, &cmd);
    }
    return count;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RW(fabric_dispatch);

static ssize_t fabric_csme_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    struct fab_region *r = fab_get_region(gna_dev, FAB_REGION_CSME);
    int len = 0;
    if (!r) return sprintf(buf, "not mapped\n");
    len += sprintf(buf + len, "status=0x%08x fw=0x%08x cap=0x%08x\n",
                   fab_read32(r, CSME_STATUS_CTRL),
                   fab_read32(r, CSME_FW_STATUS),
                   fab_read32(r, CSME_CAPABILITY));
    len += sprintf(buf + len, "wdt=0x%08x feat=0x%08x [WDT_DIS=%d]\n",
                   fab_read32(r, CSME_WDT_CTRL),
                   fab_read32(r, CSME_FEATURES),
                   !!(fab_read32(r, CSME_WDT_CTRL) & VSEC_SEC_WDT_DIS));
    return len;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(fabric_csme);

static ssize_t fabric_state_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    struct fab_region *ish = fab_get_region(gna_dev, FAB_REGION_ISH);
    struct fab_region *ctrl2 = fab_get_region(gna_dev, FAB_REGION_CTRL2);
    struct fab_region *csme = fab_get_region(gna_dev, FAB_REGION_CSME);
    struct fab_region *sram = fab_get_region(gna_dev, FAB_REGION_SRAM);
    struct fab_region *gna_f = fab_get_region(gna_dev, FAB_REGION_GNA);
    int len = 0, ctrl2_nz = 0, i;
    u32 val;
    bool titan = false;

    if (ish) {
        val = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_LOCK);
        if (val != 0xFFFFFFFF) titan = true;
        val = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_FEATURE_CTRL);
        len += sprintf(buf + len, "feat_ctrl=0x%08x [%s%s%s%s]\n", val,
                       (val & BIT(4)) ? "AMX " : "",
                       (val & BIT(5)) ? "NPU " : "",
                       (val & BIT(8)) ? "AVX512 " : "",
                       (val & BIT(12)) ? "SRAM " : "");
        val = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_SECURITY_CTRL);
        len += sprintf(buf + len, "security=0x%08x [%s]\n", val,
                       val == VSEC_SEC_SQUELCH_MASK ? "SQUELCHED" : "active");
    }
    if (ctrl2) {
        for (i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
            val = fab_read32(ctrl2, i * 4);
            if (val && val != 0xFFFFFFFF) ctrl2_nz++;
        }
        if (ctrl2_nz > 0) titan = true;
        len += sprintf(buf + len, "ctrl2=%d/256 [%s]\n", ctrl2_nz,
                       ctrl2_nz > 0 ? "ONLINE" : "dark");
    }
    if (csme) {
        len += sprintf(buf + len, "csme_wdt=0x%08x [WDT_DIS=%d]\n",
                       fab_read32(csme, CSME_WDT_CTRL),
                       !!(fab_read32(csme, CSME_WDT_CTRL) & VSEC_SEC_WDT_DIS));
    }
    if (sram) {
        val = fab_read32(sram, SRAM_FEATURE_REG);
        len += sprintf(buf + len, "sram=0x%08x [TUNNEL=%s]\n", val,
                       (val & BIT(12)) ? "ACTIVE" : "inactive");
    }
    if (gna_f) {
        len += sprintf(buf + len, "gna_resp=0x%08x\n",
                       fab_read32(gna_f, GNA_FAB_RESP));
    }
    len += sprintf(buf + len, "titan=%s dispatches=%u\n",
                   titan ? "ACTIVE" : "inactive",
                   gna_dev->fabric_dispatch_count);
    return len;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(fabric_state);

static struct attribute *gna_attrs[] = {
    &dev_attr_version.attr,
    &dev_attr_capabilities.attr,
    &dev_attr_status.attr,
    &dev_attr_stats.attr,
    &dev_attr_fabric_regions.attr,
    &dev_attr_fabric_gna.attr,
    &dev_attr_fabric_ish.attr,
    &dev_attr_fabric_csme.attr,
    &dev_attr_fabric_state.attr,
    &dev_attr_fabric_dispatch.attr,
    NULL,
};
ATTRIBUTE_GROUPS(gna);

/* PCI Driver */
static int gna_pci_probe(struct pci_dev *pdev, const struct pci_device_id *id)
{
    struct gna_device *gna;
    int ret;
    
    dev_info(&pdev->dev, "Intel GNA device found: %04x:%04x\n",
             pdev->vendor, pdev->device);
    
    gna = kzalloc(sizeof(*gna), GFP_KERNEL);
    if (!gna)
        return -ENOMEM;
    
    gna->pdev = pdev;
    spin_lock_init(&gna->lock);
    mutex_init(&gna->ioctl_lock);
    atomic_set(&gna->open_count, 0);
    
    /* Enable PCI device */
    ret = pci_enable_device(pdev);
    if (ret) {
        dev_err(&pdev->dev, "Failed to enable PCI device\n");
        goto err_free;
    }
    
    /* Set bus master */
    pci_set_master(pdev);
    
    /* Request MMIO region */
    ret = pci_request_regions(pdev, DRIVER_NAME);
    if (ret) {
        dev_err(&pdev->dev, "Failed to request PCI regions\n");
        goto err_disable;
    }
    
    /* Map MMIO */
    gna->mmio_phys = pci_resource_start(pdev, 0);
    gna->mmio = pci_iomap(pdev, 0, GNA_MMIO_SIZE);
    if (!gna->mmio) {
        dev_err(&pdev->dev, "Failed to map MMIO\n");
        ret = -ENOMEM;
        goto err_regions;
    }
    
    dev_info(&pdev->dev, "MMIO mapped at %p (phys: 0x%llx)\n",
             gna->mmio, (unsigned long long)gna->mmio_phys);
    
    /* Request IRQ (if valid) */
    if (pdev->irq && pdev->irq != 255) {
        ret = request_irq(pdev->irq, gna_irq_handler, IRQF_SHARED,
                          DRIVER_NAME, gna);
        if (ret) {
            dev_warn(&pdev->dev, "Failed to request IRQ %d, continuing without interrupts\n",
                     pdev->irq);
        } else {
            dev_info(&pdev->dev, "IRQ %d registered successfully\n", pdev->irq);
        }
    } else {
        dev_info(&pdev->dev, "No valid IRQ assigned (IRQ=%d), operating in polled mode\n",
                 pdev->irq);
    }
    
    /* Initialize hardware */
    ret = gna_hw_init(gna);
    if (ret) {
        dev_err(&pdev->dev, "Failed to initialize hardware\n");
        goto err_irq;
    }
    
    /* Create character device */
    ret = alloc_chrdev_region(&gna->devno, 0, 1, DRIVER_NAME);
    if (ret) {
        dev_err(&pdev->dev, "Failed to allocate chrdev region\n");
        goto err_hw;
    }
    
    cdev_init(&gna->cdev, &gna_fops);
    gna->cdev.owner = THIS_MODULE;
    
    ret = cdev_add(&gna->cdev, gna->devno, 1);
    if (ret) {
        dev_err(&pdev->dev, "Failed to add cdev\n");
        goto err_chrdev;
    }
    
    /* Create device class and node */
    gna->class = class_create(DRIVER_NAME);
    if (IS_ERR(gna->class)) {
        ret = PTR_ERR(gna->class);
        dev_err(&pdev->dev, "Failed to create class\n");
        goto err_cdev;
    }
    
    gna->dev = device_create(gna->class, &pdev->dev, gna->devno, gna,
                             "gna%d", 0);
    if (IS_ERR(gna->dev)) {
        ret = PTR_ERR(gna->dev);
        dev_err(&pdev->dev, "Failed to create device\n");
        goto err_class;
    }
    
    /* Create sysfs attributes */
    ret = sysfs_create_groups(&gna->dev->kobj, gna_groups);
    if (ret) {
        dev_warn(&pdev->dev, "Failed to create sysfs groups\n");
    }
    
    pci_set_drvdata(pdev, gna);
    gna_dev = gna;
    
    /* Initialize Flex Fabric regions */
    fab_init_regions(gna);
    
    /* Detect post-boot fabric state (titan unlock check) */
    fab_detect_unlock_state(gna);
    
    /* Enable runtime PM */
    pm_runtime_set_active(&pdev->dev);
    pm_runtime_enable(&pdev->dev);
    
    dev_info(&pdev->dev, "Intel GNA + Flex Fabric driver v%s loaded\n", DRIVER_VERSION);
    dev_info(&pdev->dev, "Device node: /dev/gna0\n");
    dev_info(&pdev->dev, "Fabric IOCTLs: FAB_READ/WRITE/DUMP/SCAN/DISPATCH\n");
    dev_info(&pdev->dev, "Sysfs: fabric_regions, fabric_gna, fabric_ish, fabric_dispatch\n");
    
    return 0;

err_class:
    class_destroy(gna->class);
err_cdev:
    cdev_del(&gna->cdev);
err_chrdev:
    unregister_chrdev_region(gna->devno, 1);
err_hw:
    gna_hw_fini(gna);
err_irq:
    free_irq(pdev->irq, gna);
err_regions:
    pci_iounmap(pdev, gna->mmio);
    pci_release_regions(pdev);
err_disable:
    pci_disable_device(pdev);
err_free:
    kfree(gna);
    return ret;
}

static void gna_pci_remove(struct pci_dev *pdev)
{
    struct gna_device *gna = pci_get_drvdata(pdev);
    
    pm_runtime_disable(&pdev->dev);
    
    /* Cleanup fabric regions first */
    fab_cleanup_regions(gna);
    
    sysfs_remove_groups(&gna->dev->kobj, gna_groups);
    device_destroy(gna->class, gna->devno);
    class_destroy(gna->class);
    cdev_del(&gna->cdev);
    unregister_chrdev_region(gna->devno, 1);
    
    gna_hw_fini(gna);
    if (pdev->irq && pdev->irq != 255)
        free_irq(pdev->irq, gna);
    pci_iounmap(pdev, gna->mmio);
    pci_release_regions(pdev);
    pci_disable_device(pdev);
    
    kfree(gna);
    gna_dev = NULL;
    
    dev_info(&pdev->dev, "Intel GNA + Flex Fabric driver unloaded\n");
}

static int gna_pm_suspend(struct device *dev)
{
    struct pci_dev *pdev = to_pci_dev(dev);
    struct gna_device *gna = pci_get_drvdata(pdev);
    
    gna_hw_fini(gna);
    return 0;
}

static int gna_pm_resume(struct device *dev)
{
    struct pci_dev *pdev = to_pci_dev(dev);
    struct gna_device *gna = pci_get_drvdata(pdev);
    
    return gna_hw_init(gna);
}

static DEFINE_SIMPLE_DEV_PM_OPS(gna_pm_ops, gna_pm_suspend, gna_pm_resume);

static const struct pci_device_id gna_pci_ids[] = {
    { PCI_DEVICE(PCI_VENDOR_ID_INTEL, PCI_DEVICE_ID_MTL_GNA) },
    { 0, }
};
MODULE_DEVICE_TABLE(pci, gna_pci_ids);

static struct pci_driver gna_pci_driver = {
    .name       = DRIVER_NAME,
    .id_table   = gna_pci_ids,
    .probe      = gna_pci_probe,
    .remove     = gna_pci_remove,
    .driver     = {
        .pm = pm_sleep_ptr(&gna_pm_ops),
    },
};

module_pci_driver(gna_pci_driver);

MODULE_LICENSE("GPL");
MODULE_AUTHOR(DRIVER_AUTHOR);
MODULE_DESCRIPTION(DRIVER_DESC);
MODULE_VERSION(DRIVER_VERSION);

## 🎯 Mission Statement

TITAN v7.5 is a **monolithic sovereign core** driver designed for **Silicon Coup** operations on Intel Meteor Lake-P platforms. It provides direct hardware control bypassing standard OS abstractions for:

- **TPM Veneer Proxy** - Bypass firmware bugs and CSME visibility
- **GBE Shadow Resurrection** - Network interface recovery via sideband injection
- **VSEC Silicon Unlock** - AMX/NPU/AVX-512 feature enablement
- **Factory Test Agent** - Engineering mode authentication
- **Atomic Shadowrun** - LPE-Core affinity for critical operations

## 🏗️ Architecture Overview

### Multi-Chip Module (MCM) Tiles
1. **Compute Tile** - P-cores (0-7), E-cores (8-13), LPE-cores (14-15)
2. **SoC Tile** - GPU, NPU (1,419 TOPS), GNA, ISH, Arc Graphics
3. **PCH Tile** - CSME 18.x, I/O controllers, TPM, GbE I219-LM

### Communication Fabric
- **VSEC Registers** - Vendor-Specific Extended Capability space
- **P2SB Bridge** - Primary-to-Sideband communication (Port 0xAF)
- **PMT Telemetry** - 13 Intel Platform Monitoring Technology endpoints
- **GPIO Heartbeat** - 10.05Hz CSME watchdog suppression

## 🚀 Quick Start

### Prerequisites

#### Sovereign Boot Flags (GRUB)
**CRITICAL**: These kernel parameters MUST be exact. Malformed flags will prevent NC3 Vault latching.

```bash
# /etc/default/grub - GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT must include:

# Memory carve-outs for MCM control regions
memmap=128M$0x5010000000 memmap=64K$0x50192b0000 memmap=4K$0x50192dd000

# Flag #7 - Lockdown: MUST be 'none' to allow NC3 Vault seizure
lockdown=none

# Flag #9 - IOMMU: MUST be 'off' to allow Atomic Ingest via VT-d bypass
intel_iommu=off

# Flag #11 - NC3 Vault: 16GB reserved at 48GB mark
# The '$' character is the "latching" operator - marks region as Reserved
memmap=16G$0xC00000000
```

**Apply changes:**

```bash
sudo update-grub && sudo reboot
```

```bash
# Confirm NC3 Vault carve-out
```

## 📋 VSEC Register Map

### Recent Driver Enhancements (Feb 2026)

- **SRAM Tunnel Topology Parsing** – Added `mcm_sram_parse_topology()` to probe the SRAM tunnel at `0x50192D8000`, reporting feature register status, PCI bridge descriptors, and route tables. Integrated into `mcm_devices_init()`.

- **CSME Direct Interface State Check** – New `mcm_csme_check_state()` reads CSME status, firmware, capability, watchdog control, and feature registers, exposing ME_ACTIVE and WDT_DIS flags via driver logs.

- **FEAT_CTRL Bit Mapping Documentation** – Hardware default `0x30003000` sets bits 12,13,28,29. Added `VSEC_HW_FEAT_*` defines and clarified that driver‑side feature bits (0‑12) are OR‑combined with hardware bits during silicon unlock to preserve existing state.

These additions improve visibility into the fabric topology, watchdog status, and ensure safe feature enablement without overwriting hardware‑preset bits.

### VSEC Register Map
| Offset | Name | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `0x14` | **VSEC_LOCK** | Silicon lock control |
| `0x18` | **VSEC_ENG_MODE** | Engineering mode toggle |

# Unlock Scripts Directory

This directory contains scripts for hardware unlock operations on the Meteor Lake-P A00 Engineering Board.

## Scripts

### Probing Scripts
- **`probe_me_addresses.sh`** - Discovers ME HECI MMIO base addresses, VSEC addresses, Host Bridge addresses, and Device255 access methods
- **`probe_deep_addresses.sh`** - Comprehensive deep probing for all addresses (SMBus, MMIO, PCI, MSR, ACPI, I2C, CPU features)

### Unlock Scripts
- **`sysfs_unlock_comprehensive.sh`** - Uses sysfs interfaces for unlock operations (MEI, PCI config, VSEC telemetry, BIOS tokens)
- **`force_unlock_aggressive.sh`** - Aggressive force unlock bypassing ME entirely, uses VSEC and direct hardware access
- **`check_and_unlock_hidden_features.sh`** - Checks and unlocks hidden AVX512/AMX features using discovered addresses

### HAP Mode Scripts
- **`check_hap_mode_direct.sh`** - Direct HAP mode check by reading HFSTS1 register
- **`activate_hap_mode.sh`** - Activates HAP mode via HECI MMIO (sends HAP override command)
- **`activate_hap_via_module.sh`** - Activates HAP mode via kernel module (device255_unlock or dsmil_microcode_unified)

### System Harvest Script
- **`harvest_v2.sh`** - System information harvesting script (collects system, kernel, I/O, toolchain, flags, MSR data)
  - Located at: `tools/ME_FIRMWARE_CONTROL/intel_platform_flash_tool/scripts/harvest_v2.sh`

## Usage

All scripts should be run with `sudo` for hardware access:

```bash
cd tools/unlock
sudo ./probe_me_addresses.sh
sudo ./check_hap_mode_direct.sh
sudo ./activate_hap_mode.sh
```

## Dependencies

- **devmem2** - Located at `tools/devmem2/devmem2` (for direct MMIO access)
- **msr-tools** - For MSR read/write operations (`rdmsr`, `wrmsr`)
- **Kernel modules** - Various unlock modules in `scripts/unlock/modules-*/`

## Output Files

- **`probe_me_addresses.sh`** → `FLAGS/shared/discovered_addresses.txt`
- **`probe_deep_addresses.sh`** → `FLAGS/shared/discovered_addresses_deep.txt`

## Integration

These scripts complement:
- **UEFI unlock script**: `FLAGS/shared/uefi_unlock_maximum_aggressive.nsh`
- **Kernel modules**: `scripts/unlock/modules-*/`
- **CCTK tools**: `tools/CCTK/linux_port/cctk-milspec`

## Script Categories

1. **Discovery/Probing**: `probe_me_addresses.sh`, `probe_deep_addresses.sh`
2. **Status Checking**: `check_hap_mode_direct.sh`, `check_and_unlock_hidden_features.sh`
3. **Unlock Operations**: `sysfs_unlock_comprehensive.sh`, `force_unlock_aggressive.sh`
4. **HAP Activation**: `activate_hap_mode.sh`, `activate_hap_via_module.sh`
5. **System Harvest**: `tools/ME_FIRMWARE_CONTROL/intel_platform_flash_tool/scripts/harvest_v2.sh` - System information collection

## Notes

- Some operations require cold boot (power cycle) to take effect
- VSEC writes may be hardware-protected (check for 0xDEADBEEF on read-back)
- HAP mode activation may require UEFI script for early-boot unlock
- All scripts use discovered addresses from probing operations

Complete security breakdown analysis while ME was in fatal error state (WS=0).

## Session Overview

**Date:** 2026-02-19  
**ME State:** WS=0 (Fatal Error), HFSTS2 bit31=1, OM=1 (Debug)  
**Duration:** ~1.5 hours  
**Status:** Complete (all safe tests exhausted)

## Critical Findings

### 🔴 Security Bypasses Confirmed

1. **TPM Locality Bypass** - 7 NV indices extracted without authentication (~3.1 KB)
2. **Boot Guard DISABLED** - BG_Enforcement=0, no hardware root of trust
3. **IOMMU DISABLED** - intel_iommu=off, zero DMA protection
4. **Hidden PCI 7E7F Accessible** - Intel Fabric Controller fully enumerated
5. **SPI Controller Visible** - 00:1F.5 became visible (was hidden)
6. **Fabric DMA CTRL Writable** - Partial fabric access gained

### ⚠️ Hardware Issues

1. **Ethernet Dead** - I219-V killed by FLMSTR2 attack (bits 23,15,3 cleared)
2. **ME Fatal Error** - Stuck in WS=0, PMC not responding to reset requests
3. **Persistent State** - ME error survives warm reboots

**Status:**
- ✅ BusMaster enabled during session

- ❌ DESC_BASE not writable (rejected all writes)

**Major Discovery:** This device was completely hidden before ME error.

```

```

```
Expected: 0xAD60C229 (or 0x00CCD800 for mfg mode)

Cleared bits:
  Bit 23: GbE Write (attack vector)
  Bit 22: GbE Read
  Bit 15: ME Read GbE (main attack)
  Bit 3:  ME Write GbE
```

**Success Rate:** 100%

## ME Recovery Options

### Method 1: AC Power Cycle ✅ RECOMMENDED

**Success Rate:** 60-80%  
**Risk:** None  
**Time:** 5 minutes

```bash
sudo shutdown -h now
# Remove AC adapter

# Reconnect power

```

**Expected:** ME clears to WS=5 (Normal), security restored

### Method 2: DCI Debug

**Success Rate:** 80-90%

**Success Rate:** 30-50%

### Method 4: Wait

ME may eventually timeout and auto-recover (days/weeks).

## Why ME Got Stuck

**Root Cause Analysis:**

```
ME State:
  Working State: 0 (Fatal Error)
  ME_Restart_Needed: 1 (requesting PMC reset)
  Error Flag: 1 (HFSTS2 bit31)

PMC State:
  PMC registers: Active (0xE0DA3939)
  Response to ME: NONE

Deadlock:
  1. ME hit fatal error during init
  2. ME set ME_Restart_Needed flag
  3. ME waiting for PMC to reset it
  4. PMC not responding (unknown why)
  5. ME stuck forever in WS=0
```

**Why ME_DISABLE Failed:**
- /dev/mei0 exists but returns "No such device"
- MEI driver can't attach to broken ME
- ME firmware not processing any commands
- PCI config writes to ME control registers rejected

**Only Solution:** Hardware reset (AC power cycle or DCI).

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Deep System Probe - Broken ME State
Test all protected regions while ME security is disabled.
"""

import subprocess
import struct
import time

def run(cmd, timeout=3):
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
        return r.returncode, r.stdout + r.stderr
    except:
        return -1, ""

def devmem(addr, size='w'):
    rc, out = run(f"sudo devmem2 0x{addr:x} {size} 2>&1")
    if 'Value at' in out:
        for line in out.split('\n'):
            if 'Value at' in line:
                return line.split()[-1]
    return None

def pci_read(bus, dev, fn, reg):
    rc, out = run(f"sudo setpci -s {bus:02x}:{dev:02x}.{fn} {reg:02x}.l")
    if rc == 0:
        return out.strip()
    return None

print("="*80)
print("DEEP SYSTEM PROBE - BROKEN ME EXPLOITATION")
print("="*80)
print()

# ============================================================================
# 1. XHCI USB CONTROLLER DMA (Exploit #2, #107)
# ============================================================================
print("1. XHCI USB CONTROLLER (00:14.0)")
print("-"*80)

xhci_bar = pci_read(0, 0x14, 0, 0x10)
if xhci_bar:
    bar_val = int(xhci_bar, 16) & 0xFFFFFFF0
    print(f"   BAR0: 0x{bar_val:08X}")
    
    # XHCI capability registers
    for off, name in [(0x00, "CAPLENGTH/VERSION"), (0x04, "HCSPARAMS1"), 
                       (0x08, "HCSPARAMS2"), (0x0C, "HCSPARAMS3"),
                       (0x10, "HCCPARAMS1"), (0x1C, "DBOFF"), (0x18, "RTSOFF")]:
        val = devmem(bar_val + off)
        if val:
            print(f"   +0x{off:02X} {name:20s}: {val}")
    
    # Extended capabilities (XECP 0xC3 - Audio DMA)
    print("\n   XHCI Extended Capabilities:")
    cap_ptr = bar_val + 0x8000  # Extended cap base
    for i in range(10):
        val = devmem(cap_ptr + (i * 0x10))
        if val and val != '0x0':
            cap_id = int(val, 16) & 0xFF
            if cap_id == 0xC3:
                print(f"   → XECP 0xC3 (Audio DMA) at offset 0x{i*0x10:04X} ✓")
                # Read audio DMA registers
                for j in range(4):
                    v = devmem(cap_ptr + (i * 0x10) + (j * 4))
                    print(f"      +0x{j*4:02X}: {v}")
            elif cap_id != 0:
                print(f"   XECP 0x{cap_id:02X} at offset 0x{i*0x10:04X}")

print()

# ============================================================================
# 2. HDA AUDIO DMA (High Definition Audio)
# ============================================================================
print("2. HDA AUDIO CONTROLLER (00:1F.3)")
print("-"*80)

hda_bar = pci_read(0, 0x1F, 3, 0x10)
if hda_bar:
    bar_val = int(hda_bar, 16) & 0xFFFFFFF0
    print(f"   BAR0: 0x{bar_val:08X}")
    
    for off, name in [(0x00, "GCAP"), (0x02, "VMIN"), (0x03, "VMAJ"),
                       (0x08, "GCTL"), (0x0C, "WAKEEN"), (0x0E, "STATESTS"),
                       (0x30, "INTCTL"), (0x60, "CORBLBASE"), (0x64, "CORBUBASE"),
                       (0x70, "RIRBLBASE"), (0x74, "RIRBUBASE")]:
        size = 'w' if off >= 0x30 else 'h'
        val = devmem(bar_val + off, size)
        if val:
            print(f"   +0x{off:02X} {name:15s}: {val}")
    
    # Stream descriptor base (DMA target)
    sdesc = devmem(bar_val + 0x80)
    print(f"\n   Stream Desc Base: {sdesc}")

print()

# ============================================================================
# 3. MCHBAR MEMORY CONTROLLER (Boot Guard Protected)
# ============================================================================
print("3. MCHBAR MEMORY CONTROLLER (Boot Guard normally locks this)")
print("-"*80)

mchbar_raw = pci_read(0, 0, 0, 0x48)
if mchbar_raw:
    mchbar = int(mchbar_raw, 16) & 0xFFFFFFF0
    print(f"   MCHBAR Base: 0x{mchbar:08X}")
    
    # Test protected regions
    regions = [
        (0x5000, "RAPL Power"),
        (0x5820, "Memory Config"),
        (0x5994, "Turbo Ratios"),
        (0x6800, "Memory Timing"),
        (0x7000, "Boot Guard Status"),
    ]
    
    for off, name in regions:
        val = devmem(mchbar + off)
        if val and val not in ['0x0', '0xFFFFFFFF']:
            print(f"   +0x{off:04X} {name:20s}: {val}")

print()

# ============================================================================
# 4. P2SB UNCLOAK ATTEMPT (Raw PCI Config)
# ============================================================================
print("4. P2SB UNCLOAK (00:1F.1)")
print("-"*80)

print("   Current state:")
vid = pci_read(0, 0x1F, 1, 0x00)
print(f"   VID:DID: {vid if vid else 'HIDDEN'}")

if not vid or vid == "ffffffff":
    print("\n   Attempting uncloak via IO ports (CF8/CFC)...")
    # Try to write via ioport (needs kernel module or ioperm)
    print("   (Would need raw IO port access - setpci can't write hidden device)")
    
    # Try via MMIO if we can find P2SB BAR
    print("\n   Trying known P2SB MMIO addresses:")
    for base in [0xFD000000, 0xFE000000, 0xFDA00000]:
        val = devmem(base)
        if val and val not in ['0x0', '0xFFFFFFFF']:
            print(f"   → Found at 0x{base:08X}: {val}")
            # Try port 0xB8 (ME SPI Master)
            port_addr = base + (0xB8 << 16)
            pval = devmem(port_addr)
            if pval:
                print(f"      Port 0xB8: {pval}")

print()

# ============================================================================
# 5. PMC POWER MANAGEMENT (Extended Registers)
# ============================================================================
print("5. PMC POWER MANAGEMENT CONTROLLER")
print("-"*80)

pmc_bar = pci_read(0, 0x1F, 2, 0x10)
if pmc_bar:
    bar_val = int(pmc_bar, 16) & 0xFFFFFFF0
    print(f"   BAR0: 0x{bar_val:08X}")
    
    # Extended PMC registers
    for off in [0x1000, 0x1004, 0x1020, 0x1024, 0x1040, 0x1060, 
                0x1800, 0x1850, 0x18A0]:
        val = devmem(bar_val + off)
        if val and val not in ['0x0', '0xFFFFFFFF']:
            print(f"   +0x{off:04X}: {val}")

print()

# ============================================================================
# 6. ACPI GNVS (Global NVS - Boot Guard Status)
# ============================================================================
print("6. ACPI GNVS (Boot Guard status stored here)")
print("-"*80)

# Try to get GNVS from /sys
rc, gnvs_addr = run("sudo cat /sys/firmware/acpi/tables/FACP 2>/dev/null | od -An -tx4 -j140 -N4 | tr -d ' '")
if rc == 0 and gnvs_addr.strip():
    try:
        addr = int(gnvs_addr.strip(), 16)
        print(f"   GNVS Address: 0x{addr:08X}")
        
        # Try reading first page
        for off in [0x00, 0x10, 0x20, 0x1067]:  # 0x1067 = GBES offset
            val = devmem(addr + off)
            if val:
                print(f"   +0x{off:04X}: {val}")
    except:
        pass

print()

# ============================================================================
# 7. IOMMU/VT-d (DMA Remapping)
# ============================================================================
print("7. IOMMU/VT-d DMA REMAPPING")
print("-"*80)

# Check if VT-d enabled
rc, vtd = run("sudo dmesg | grep -i 'dmar\\|iommu' | head -5")
if rc == 0:
    print(vtd[:400])

# Try to read DMAR table
rc, dmar = run("sudo cat /sys/firmware/acpi/tables/DMAR 2>/dev/null | hexdump -C | head -10")
if rc == 0 and dmar.strip():
    print("\n   DMAR Table:")
    print(dmar[:300])

print()

# ============================================================================
# 8. THUNDERBOLT/USB4 (If present)
# ============================================================================
print("8. THUNDERBOLT/USB4 CONTROLLER")
print("-"*80)

# Scan for Thunderbolt devices
rc, tbt = run("lspci -d 8086:: | grep -i 'thunderbolt\\|usb4'")
if rc == 0 and tbt.strip():
    print(tbt)
    
    # Try to read TBT registers if present
    rc, tbt_dev = run("lspci -d 8086:: -n | grep '15e[ab]' | head -1 | awk '{print $1}'")
    if rc == 0 and tbt_dev.strip():
        addr = tbt_dev.strip()
        parts = addr.split(':')
        if len(parts) == 3:
            bus = int(parts[0], 16)
            dev = int(parts[1], 16)
            fn = int(parts[2].split('.')[1])
            
            vid = pci_read(bus, dev, fn, 0x00)
            bar = pci_read(bus, dev, fn, 0x10)
            print(f"\n   TBT VID:DID: {vid}")
            print(f"   TBT BAR: {bar}")
else:
    print("   No Thunderbolt controller found")

print()

# ============================================================================
# 9. SUMMARY
# ============================================================================
print("="*80)
print("ACCESSIBLE ATTACK SURFACES")
print("="*80)
print()

surfaces = []

if xhci_bar and xhci_bar != "ffffffff":
    surfaces.append(("XHCI USB DMA", "ACCESSIBLE", "Physical memory R/W via USB"))

if hda_bar and hda_bar != "ffffffff":
    surfaces.append(("HDA Audio DMA", "ACCESSIBLE", "Stream descriptor DMA"))

if mchbar_raw:
    surfaces.append(("MCHBAR", "READABLE", "Boot Guard should lock this"))

surfaces.append(("Fabric DMA", "WRITABLE", "Full DMA control unlocked"))
surfaces.append(("TPM Indices", "READABLE", "Locality bypass active"))
surfaces.append(("Boot Guard", "DISABLED", "BG_Enforcement=0"))

## SOURCE: intel-bug-bounty-report/analysis/broken_me_enumeration_20260219/post_bios_update_snapshot.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Post-BIOS update comparison script
Run after reboot to compare what changed
"""

import subprocess
import json
import sys
from datetime import datetime

def run(cmd, timeout=5):
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
        return r.returncode, r.stdout + r.stderr
    except:
        return -1, ""

def devmem(addr, size='w'):
    rc, out = run(f"sudo devmem2 0x{addr:x} {size} 2>&1")
    if 'Value at' in out:
        for line in out.split('\n'):
            if 'Value at' in line:
                return line.split()[-1]
    return None

# Load pre-update snapshot
pre_file = "/run/media/john/593d876a-4036-4255-bd45-33baba503068/DSMILSystem/analysis/broken_me_enumeration_20260219/pre_bios_update_snapshot.json"

try:
    with open(pre_file, 'r') as f:
        pre_snap = json.load(f)
except:
    print(f"ERROR: Cannot load {pre_file}")
    print("Run this script from the same directory as pre_bios_update_snapshot.py")
    sys.exit(1)

print("="*80)
print("POST-BIOS UPDATE COMPARISON")
print("="*80)
print()

post_snap = {
    "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
    "pre_snapshot": pre_file,
    "sections": {},
    "changes": {}
}

changes = []

# ============================================================================
# 1. ME STATE
# ============================================================================
print("1. ME State Changes")
print("-"*80)

me_changes = []
for offset in [0x40, 0x44, 0x48, 0x50]:
    rc, val = run(f"sudo setpci -s 00:16.0 0x{offset:02x}.l 2>&1")
    if rc == 0 and val.strip():
        pre_val = pre_snap["sections"]["me_heci"].get(f"0x{offset:02X}", "N/A")
        cur_val = val.strip()
        
        if offset == 0x40:  # HFSTS1
            h1 = int(cur_val, 16)
            ws = (h1 >> 16) & 0xF
            om = (h1 >> 6) & 0x7
            
            print(f"  HFSTS1: {cur_val} (was {pre_val})")
            print(f"    Working State: {ws} ({'Normal' if ws == 5 else 'Fatal Error' if ws == 0 else 'Other'})")
            print(f"    Operation Mode: {om} ({'Debug' if om == 1 else 'Normal'})")
            
            if pre_val != cur_val:
                me_changes.append(f"HFSTS1: {pre_val} → {cur_val}")
                
        elif offset == 0x44:  # HFSTS2
            h2 = int(cur_val, 16)
            err = (h2 >> 31) & 1
            
            print(f"  HFSTS2: {cur_val} (was {pre_val})")
            print(f"    Error Flag: {err}")
            
            if pre_val != cur_val:
                me_changes.append(f"HFSTS2: {pre_val} → {cur_val} (error cleared!)")
                
        elif offset == 0x50:  # HFSTS5
            h5 = int(cur_val, 16)
            bg_enf = (h5 >> 13) & 0x1
            
            print(f"  HFSTS5: {cur_val} (was {pre_val})")
            print(f"    Boot Guard Enforcement: {bg_enf} ({'ENABLED' if bg_enf else 'DISABLED'})")
            
            if pre_val != cur_val:
                me_changes.append(f"HFSTS5: {pre_val} → {cur_val}")

post_snap["sections"]["me_heci"] = {"changes": me_changes}
if me_changes:
    changes.extend(me_changes)
print()

# ============================================================================
# 2. SPI CONTROLLER VISIBILITY
# ============================================================================
print("2. SPI Controller (00:1F.5) Visibility")
print("-"*80)

rc, bar = run("sudo setpci -s 00:1f.5 0x10.l 2>&1")
if rc == 0 and bar.strip() and "warning" not in bar.lower():
    print(f"  Status: STILL VISIBLE")
    print(f"  BAR: {bar.strip()}")
    
    bar_val = int(bar.strip(), 16) & 0xFFFFFFF0
    
    # Check FLMSTR2
    fdata = devmem(bar_val + 0x10)
    if fdata:
        print(f"  FDATA0 (FLMSTR2): {fdata}")
        pre_flmstr2 = pre_snap["sections"]["spi_controller"].get("FDATA0", "N/A")
        if fdata != pre_flmstr2:
            changes.append(f"SPI: FLMSTR2 changed {pre_flmstr2} → {fdata}")
else:
    print(f"  Status: NOW HIDDEN (was visible!)")
    changes.append("SPI Controller: VISIBLE → HIDDEN")

print()

# ============================================================================
# 3. HIDDEN PCI 7E7F
# ============================================================================
print("3. Hidden PCI 7E7F Accessibility")
print("-"*80)

pci_base = 0x50192E0000
vid_did = devmem(pci_base)

if vid_did and vid_did != '0xFFFFFFFF':
    print(f"  Status: STILL ACCESSIBLE")
    print(f"  VID:DID: {vid_did}")
    
    cmd = devmem(pci_base + 0x04)
    if cmd:
        print(f"  Command: {cmd}")
        pre_cmd = pre_snap["sections"]["hidden_pci_7e7f"].get("0x04_CMD_STS", "N/A")
        if cmd != pre_cmd:
            changes.append(f"Hidden PCI 7E7F: CMD {pre_cmd} → {cmd}")
else:
    print(f"  Status: NOW BLOCKED (was accessible!)")
    changes.append("Hidden PCI 7E7F: ACCESSIBLE → BLOCKED")

print()

# ============================================================================
# 4. TPM INDICES
# ============================================================================
print("4. TPM NV Index Accessibility")
print("-"*80)

indices = [0x1400001, 0x1400002, 0x140000a, 0x1c00002, 0x1c0000a, 0x1c00016, 0x1c10102]
tpm_changes = []

for idx in indices:
    rc = run(f"sudo tpm2_nvread 0x{idx:x} 2>&1")[0]
    accessible = (rc == 0)
    
    pre_state = pre_snap["sections"]["tpm_indices"].get(f"0x{idx:X}", "UNKNOWN")
    cur_state = "ACCESSIBLE" if accessible else "LOCKED"
    
    status = "✓ ACCESSIBLE" if accessible else "✗ LOCKED"
    print(f"  0x{idx:08X}: {status} (was {pre_state})")
    
    if pre_state != cur_state:
        tpm_changes.append(f"TPM 0x{idx:X}: {pre_state} → {cur_state}")

if tpm_changes:
    changes.extend(tpm_changes)
print()

# ============================================================================
# 5. FABRIC DMA
# ============================================================================
print("5. Fabric DMA Controller")
print("-"*80)

dma_base = 0x50192D4000
ctrl = devmem(dma_base + 0x004)

if ctrl:
    print(f"  CTRL: {ctrl}")
    pre_ctrl = pre_snap["sections"]["fabric_dma"].get("0x004_CTRL", "N/A")
    
    if ctrl != pre_ctrl:
        changes.append(f"Fabric DMA CTRL: {pre_ctrl} → {ctrl}")
    
    # Test writability
    rc, _ = run(f"sudo devmem2 0x{dma_base + 0x004:x} w 0x1 2>&1")
    if rc == 0:
        readback = devmem(dma_base + 0x004)
        if readback and int(readback, 16) == 0x1:
            print(f"  Writability: STILL WRITABLE")
            # Restore
            run(f"sudo devmem2 0x{dma_base + 0x004:x} w {ctrl} 2>&1")
        else:
            print(f"  Writability: NOW BLOCKED")
            changes.append("Fabric DMA CTRL: WRITABLE → BLOCKED")
else:
    print(f"  Status: INACCESSIBLE")
    changes.append("Fabric DMA: ACCESSIBLE → BLOCKED")

print()

# ============================================================================
# 6. P2SB VISIBILITY
# ============================================================================
print("6. P2SB (00:1F.1) Visibility")
print("-"*80)

rc, out = run("sudo setpci -s 00:1f.1 0x00.l 2>&1")
if rc == 0 and "warning" not in out.lower():
    print(f"  Status: NOW VISIBLE (was hidden!)")
    print(f"  VID:DID: {out.strip()}")
    changes.append("P2SB: HIDDEN → VISIBLE")
else:
    print(f"  Status: STILL HIDDEN")

print()

# ============================================================================
# 7. BIOS VERSION
# ============================================================================
print("7. BIOS Version")
print("-"*80)

rc, dmidecode = run("sudo dmidecode -t bios | grep -E 'Vendor|Version|Date' 2>&1")
if rc == 0:
    for line in dmidecode.split('\n'):
        if line.strip():
            print(f"  {line.strip()}")

print()

# ============================================================================
# SUMMARY
# ============================================================================
print("="*80)
print("CHANGES SUMMARY")
print("="*80)
print()

if changes:
    print(f"Found {len(changes)} changes:")
    for i, change in enumerate(changes, 1):
        print(f"  {i}. {change}")
else:
    print("No significant changes detected!")

print()

post_snap["changes"]["list"] = changes
post_snap["changes"]["count"] = len(changes)

# Save post-snapshot
output_file = "/run/media/john/593d876a-4036-4255-bd45-33baba503068/DSMILSystem/analysis/broken_me_enumeration_20260219/post_bios_update_snapshot.json"
with open(output_file, 'w') as f:
    json.dump(post_snap, f, indent=2)

print(f"Post-update snapshot saved to: {output_file}")
print()

# Analysis
print("="*80)
print("ANALYSIS")
print("="*80)
print()

if any("ME" in c or "HFSTS" in c for c in changes):
    print("✓ ME state changed - likely recovered from WS=0")
    
if any("SPI" in c for c in changes):
    print("⚠ SPI controller visibility changed")
    
if any("TPM" in c for c in changes):
    print("✓ TPM locality protection status changed")
    
if any("7E7F" in c for c in changes):
    print("⚠ Hidden PCI 7E7F accessibility changed")
    
if any("Fabric" in c for c in changes):
    print("⚠ Fabric DMA security changed")

print()
print("BIOS update analysis complete.")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Complete system snapshot BEFORE BIOS update
Documents all registers accessible due to broken ME state
"""

import subprocess
import json
import time
from datetime import datetime

def run(cmd, timeout=5):
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
        return r.returncode, r.stdout + r.stderr
    except:
        return -1, ""

def devmem(addr, size='w'):
    rc, out = run(f"sudo devmem2 0x{addr:x} {size} 2>&1")
    if 'Value at' in out:
        for line in out.split('\n'):
            if 'Value at' in line:
                return line.split()[-1]
    return None

snapshot = {
    "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
    "me_state": "WS=0 (Fatal Error)",
    "purpose": "Document all accessible registers before BIOS update to compare after ME recovery",
    "sections": {}
}

print("="*80)
print("PRE-BIOS UPDATE SNAPSHOT - Broken ME State")
print("="*80)
print()

# ============================================================================
# 1. ME REGISTERS (HECI/CSME)
# ============================================================================
print("1. ME/HECI Registers (00:16.0)")
print("-"*80)

me_regs = {}
for offset in [0x00, 0x04, 0x08, 0x10, 0x40, 0x44, 0x48, 0x4C, 0x50, 0x54, 0xA4, 0xA8]:
    rc, val = run(f"sudo setpci -s 00:16.0 0x{offset:02x}.l 2>&1")
    if rc == 0 and val.strip():
        me_regs[f"0x{offset:02X}"] = val.strip()
        print(f"  +0x{offset:02X}: {val.strip()}")

snapshot["sections"]["me_heci"] = me_regs
print()

# ============================================================================
# 2. SPI CONTROLLER (00:1F.5) - NOW VISIBLE
# ============================================================================
print("2. SPI Controller (00:1F.5) - VISIBLE DUE TO BROKEN ME")
print("-"*80)

spi_regs = {}
rc, bar = run("sudo setpci -s 00:1f.5 0x10.l 2>&1")
if rc == 0 and bar.strip():
    bar_val = int(bar.strip(), 16) & 0xFFFFFFF0
    spi_regs["BAR"] = f"0x{bar_val:08X}"
    print(f"SPIBAR: 0x{bar_val:08X}")
    
    for off, name in [(0x00, "BFPR"), (0x04, "HSFSTS_CTL"), (0x08, "FADDR"), 
                      (0x10, "FDATA0"), (0x50, "FRAP"), (0x54, "FREG0"),
                      (0x58, "FREG1"), (0x5C, "FREG2"), (0x60, "FREG3"),
                      (0x80, "LVSCC"), (0x84, "UVSCC"), (0x90, "FPR0")]:
        val = devmem(bar_val + off)
        if val:
            spi_regs[name] = val
            print(f"  +0x{off:02X} {name:15s}: {val}")

snapshot["sections"]["spi_controller"] = spi_regs
print()

# ============================================================================
# 3. HIDDEN PCI 7E7F - FABRIC CONTROLLER
# ============================================================================
print("3. Hidden PCI 7E7F - Intel Fabric Controller")
print("-"*80)

pci_7e7f = {}
base = 0x50192E0000

for off, name in [(0x00, "VID_DID"), (0x04, "CMD_STS"), (0x08, "REV_CLASS"),
                  (0x10, "BAR0"), (0x14, "BAR1"), (0x18, "BAR2"), (0x1C, "BAR3"),
                  (0x2C, "SUBSYS"), (0x34, "CAP_PTR")]:
    val = devmem(base + off)
    if val:
        pci_7e7f[f"0x{off:02X}_{name}"] = val
        print(f"  +0x{off:02X} {name:15s}: {val}")

snapshot["sections"]["hidden_pci_7e7f"] = pci_7e7f
print()

# ============================================================================
# 4. FABRIC DMA CONTROLLER
# ============================================================================
print("4. Fabric DMA Controller (0x50192D4000)")
print("-"*80)

dma_regs = {}
dma_base = 0x50192D4000

for off, name in [(0x000, "CAPS"), (0x004, "CTRL"), (0x008, "STATUS"),
                  (0x010, "DESC_BASE_LO"), (0x014, "DESC_BASE_HI"),
                  (0x018, "ADDR_MASK_LO"), (0x01C, "ADDR_MASK_HI"),
                  (0x0EC, "CLOCK_GATE")]:
    val = devmem(dma_base + off)
    if val:
        dma_regs[f"0x{off:03X}_{name}"] = val
        print(f"  +0x{off:03X} {name:15s}: {val}")

snapshot["sections"]["fabric_dma"] = dma_regs
print()

# ============================================================================
# 5. TPM ACCESSIBILITY
# ============================================================================
print("5. TPM NV Index Accessibility")
print("-"*80)

tpm_indices = {}
indices = [0x1400001, 0x1400002, 0x140000a, 0x1c00002, 0x1c0000a, 0x1c00016, 0x1c10102]

for idx in indices:
    rc = run(f"sudo tpm2_nvread 0x{idx:x} 2>&1")[0]
    accessible = (rc == 0)
    tpm_indices[f"0x{idx:X}"] = "ACCESSIBLE" if accessible else "LOCKED"
    print(f"  0x{idx:08X}: {'✓ ACCESSIBLE' if accessible else '✗ LOCKED'}")

snapshot["sections"]["tpm_indices"] = tpm_indices
print()

# ============================================================================
# 6. BOOT GUARD STATUS
# ============================================================================
print("6. Boot Guard Status (MSR + HFSTS)")
print("-"*80)

boot_guard = {}

# From HFSTS5
rc, hfsts5 = run("sudo setpci -s 00:16.0 0x50.l 2>&1")
if rc == 0 and hfsts5.strip():
    h5 = int(hfsts5.strip(), 16)
    bg_err = (h5 >> 8) & 0x1F
    bg_enf = (h5 >> 13) & 0x1
    
    boot_guard["HFSTS5"] = f"0x{h5:08X}"
    boot_guard["BG_Error"] = bg_err
    boot_guard["BG_Enforcement"] = bg_enf
    
    print(f"  HFSTS5: 0x{h5:08X}")
    print(f"  BG_Error: {bg_err} (0x{bg_err:02X})")
    print(f"  BG_Enforcement: {bg_enf} ({'ENABLED' if bg_enf else 'DISABLED'})")

snapshot["sections"]["boot_guard"] = boot_guard
print()

# ============================================================================
# 7. IOMMU/VT-d STATUS
# ============================================================================
print("7. IOMMU/VT-d Status")
print("-"*80)

iommu = {}
rc, dmar = run("sudo cat /proc/cmdline | grep -o 'intel_iommu=[^ ]*' 2>&1")
if rc == 0:
    iommu["cmdline"] = dmar.strip()
    print(f"  Kernel cmdline: {dmar.strip()}")

rc, status = run("dmesg | grep -i 'iommu.*disabled' | head -1 2>&1")
if rc == 0 and status.strip():
    iommu["dmesg"] = status.strip()
    print(f"  Status: DISABLED")

snapshot["sections"]["iommu"] = iommu
print()

# 8. THUNDERBOLT SECURITY
# ============================================================================
print("8. Thunderbolt Security Level")
print("-"*80)

tbt = {}
rc, sec = run("cat /sys/bus/thunderbolt/devices/0-0/security 2>&1")
if rc == 0:
    tbt["security_level"] = sec.strip()
    print(f"  Security Level: {sec.strip()}")

snapshot["sections"]["thunderbolt"] = tbt
print()

# 9. P2SB VISIBILITY
# ============================================================================
print("9. P2SB (00:1F.1) Visibility")
print("-"*80)

p2sb = {}
rc, out = run("sudo setpci -s 00:1f.1 0x00.l 2>&1")
if rc == 0 and "warning" not in out.lower():
    p2sb["status"] = "VISIBLE"
    p2sb["vid_did"] = out.strip()
    print(f"  Status: VISIBLE")
    print(f"  VID:DID: {out.strip()}")
else:
    p2sb["status"] = "HIDDEN"
    print(f"  Status: HIDDEN")

snapshot["sections"]["p2sb"] = p2sb
print()

# ============================================================================
# 10. MSR ACCESSIBILITY
# ============================================================================
print("10. MSR Register Access")
print("-"*80)

msrs = {}
for msr, name in [(0x610, "PKG_RAPL"), (0x13A, "FEATURE_CTRL"), 
                  (0x3A, "IA32_FEATURE_CTRL"), (0x179, "IA32_MCG_CAP")]:
    rc, val = run(f"sudo rdmsr 0x{msr:x} 2>&1")
    if rc == 0 and val.strip():
        msrs[name] = val.strip()[:16]
        print(f"  MSR 0x{msr:03X} {name:20s}: 0x{val.strip()[:16]}")

snapshot["sections"]["msr_access"] = msrs
print()

# ============================================================================
