/*
 * Minimal ME Microcode Force-Load for A00 Board
 * Directly writes to ME HECI to enable microcode 0x1C
 */

#include <linux/module.h>
#include <linux/kernel.h>
#include <linux/pci.h>
#include <linux/io.h>

MODULE_LICENSE("GPL");
MODULE_AUTHOR("DSMIL");
MODULE_DESCRIPTION("ME microcode force loader for A00 - Part of unified microcode system");

static u32 target_microcode = 0x1C;
module_param(target_microcode, uint, 0644);

static int __init me_force_init(void)
{
	struct pci_dev *me_pci;
	void __iomem *heci_mmio;
	u32 status;

	pr_info("=== ME Microcode Force Loader ===\n");
	pr_info("Target microcode: 0x%X\n", target_microcode);

	/* Find ME device - Try multiple IDs for Meteor Lake */
	me_pci = pci_get_device(PCI_VENDOR_ID_INTEL, 0x7E70, NULL); /* MTL HECI1 */
	if (!me_pci) {
		me_pci = pci_get_device(PCI_VENDOR_ID_INTEL, 0x7E75, NULL); /* MTL HECI2 */
	}
	if (!me_pci) {
		pr_err("ME: HECI device not found\n");
		return -ENODEV;
	}

	pr_info("ME: Found HECI at %04x:%02x:%02x.%d\n",
		pci_domain_nr(me_pci->bus),
		me_pci->bus->number,
		PCI_SLOT(me_pci->devfn),
		PCI_FUNC(me_pci->devfn));

	/* Enable PCI device */
	if (pci_enable_device(me_pci)) {
		pr_err("ME: Failed to enable PCI device\n");
		pci_dev_put(me_pci);
		return -EIO;
	}

	/* Map HECI MMIO (BAR0) */
	heci_mmio = pci_iomap(me_pci, 0, 0x1000);
	if (!heci_mmio) {
		pr_err("ME: Failed to map HECI MMIO\n");
		pci_disable_device(me_pci);
		pci_dev_put(me_pci);
		return -ENOMEM;
	}

	pr_info("ME: HECI MMIO mapped\n");

	/* Read ME status */
	status = ioread32(heci_mmio + 0x00); /* ME_CSR_HA */
	pr_info("ME: Status register: 0x%08X\n", status);

	/*
	 * HECI Microcode Command Sequence:
	 * 1. Write microcode version to control register
	 * 2. Set downgrade enable bit
	 * 3. Trigger ME command via doorbell
	 */

	/* Check if ME is ready */
	if (!(status & 0x80000000)) {
		pr_warn("ME: Not ready (status bit not set)\n");
	}

	/* Write microcode downgrade command */
	iowrite32(0x00000001, heci_mmio + 0x04); /* Enable downgrade policy */
	iowrite32(target_microcode, heci_mmio + 0x08); /* Target version */
	iowrite32(0x000A06A4, heci_mmio + 0x0C); /* CPU signature: 06-AA-04 */
	
	/* Trigger ME command */
	iowrite32(0x8505, heci_mmio + 0x10); /* Command: Microcode Update */
	iowrite32(0x00000001, heci_mmio + 0x14); /* Doorbell: Execute */

	msleep(500); /* Wait for ME processing */

	/* Check result */
	status = ioread32(heci_mmio + 0x18); /* ME_CSR_ME */
	pr_info("ME: Command result: 0x%08X\n", status);

	if (status & 0x8000) {
		pr_info("ME: ✓ Microcode 0x%X staged for next boot\n", target_microcode);
	} else {
		pr_warn("ME: Command may have failed (status: 0x%X)\n", status);
	}

	/* Cleanup */
	pci_iounmap(me_pci, heci_mmio);
	pci_disable_device(me_pci);
	pci_dev_put(me_pci);

	pr_info("ME: Force loader complete - reboot to apply\n");
	return 0;
}

static void __exit me_force_exit(void)
{
	pr_info("ME: Force loader unloaded\n");
}

module_init(me_force_init);
module_exit(me_force_exit);



## SOURCE: intel-bug-bounty-report/analysis/recovery/unlock/unlock/modules-6.12.63+deb13-amd64/unified_microcode/microcode_unified.c

/*
 * Unified Microcode Management Module
 * 
 * Complete microcode downgrade workflow:
 * 1. Device255 unlock (Master Crypto Controller) - REQUIRED FIRST
 * 2. ME HECI microcode staging
 * 3. Verification of staged microcode
 * 
 * This module performs all steps in sequence for microcode 0x1C downgrade.
 * 
 * CRITICAL: Device255 must be unlocked before microcode operations can succeed.
 * 
 * See individual modules for component functions:
 * - device255_unlock.c: Device255 SMBus unlock
 * - microcode_stage_heci.c: Direct HECI staging
 * - microcode_stage_mei.c: MEI client staging
 * - microcode_verify.c: Verification and diagnostics
 */

#include <linux/module.h>
#include <linux/kernel.h>
#include <linux/init.h>
#include <linux/pci.h>
#include <linux/io.h>
#include <linux/delay.h>
#include <linux/firmware.h>
#include <asm/msr.h>

MODULE_LICENSE("GPL");
MODULE_AUTHOR("DSMIL");
MODULE_DESCRIPTION("Unified microcode management - Device255 unlock + staging + verification");
MODULE_VERSION("1.0");

#define TARGET_MICROCODE_REV 0x1C

/* SMBus Device255 definitions */
#define SMBUS_VENDOR_ID      0x8086
#define SMBUS_DEVICE_ID      0x7E22
#define DEVICE255_ADDR       0xFF
#define SMBUS_HOST_STATUS    0x00
#define SMBUS_HOST_CONTROL   0x02
#define SMBUS_HOST_CMD       0x03
#define SMBUS_SLAVE_ADDR     0x04
#define SMBUS_DATA_0         0x05
#define SMBUS_DATA_1         0x06
#define SMBUS_HOST_CONTROL_START    (1 << 0)
#define SMBUS_HOST_CONTROL_QUICK    (1 << 4)
#define SMBUS_HOST_CONTROL_KILL     (1 << 1)
#define SMBUS_HOST_STATUS_DONE      (1 << 0)
#define SMBUS_HOST_STATUS_BUSY      (1 << 6)
#define SMBUS_MMIO_SIZE      0x100

/* ME HECI definitions */
#define ME_HECI1_VENDOR 0x8086
#define ME_HECI1_DEVICE 0x7E70
#define ME_HECI_HFSTS1          0x40
#define ME_HECI_HFSTS1_HAP_MODE (1 << 12)

/* Global state */
static struct pci_dev *smbus_pdev = NULL;
static void __iomem *smbus_mmio = NULL;
static struct pci_dev *me_pci = NULL;
static void __iomem *heci_mmio = NULL;

/* SMBus helper functions */
static u8 smbus_read8(void __iomem *base, u32 offset)
{
	if (base && offset < SMBUS_MMIO_SIZE)
		return ioread8(base + offset);
	return 0;
}

static void smbus_write8(void __iomem *base, u32 offset, u8 value)
{
	if (base && offset < SMBUS_MMIO_SIZE)
		iowrite8(value, base + offset);
}

static int smbus_wait_done(void __iomem *base, int timeout_ms)
{
	u8 status;
	int waited = 0;
	
	while (waited < timeout_ms) {
		status = smbus_read8(base, SMBUS_HOST_STATUS);
		if (status & SMBUS_HOST_STATUS_DONE) {
			return 0;
		}
		msleep(1);
		waited += 1;
	}
	return -ETIMEDOUT;
}

/* Phase 1: Device255 Unlock */
static int device255_unlock(void)
{
	u8 device_addr = DEVICE255_ADDR;
	u8 status;
	int ret = -EIO;
	resource_size_t smbus_start, smbus_len;
	
	pr_info("======================================================================\n");
	pr_info("PHASE 1: DEVICE255 (MASTER CRYPTO CONTROLLER) UNLOCK\n");
	pr_info("======================================================================\n");
	
	smbus_pdev = pci_get_device(SMBUS_VENDOR_ID, SMBUS_DEVICE_ID, NULL);
	if (!smbus_pdev) {
		pr_warn("[Device255] SMBus controller not found\n");
		return -ENODEV;
	}
	
	if (pci_enable_device(smbus_pdev)) {
		pr_warn("[Device255] Failed to enable SMBus\n");
		pci_dev_put(smbus_pdev);
		return -EBUSY;
	}
	
	smbus_start = pci_resource_start(smbus_pdev, 0);
	smbus_len = pci_resource_len(smbus_pdev, 0);
	
	if (pci_request_region(smbus_pdev, 0, "device255_smbus")) {
		pr_warn("[Device255] Failed to request MMIO region\n");
		goto err_smbus;
	}
	
	smbus_mmio = pci_iomap(smbus_pdev, 0, smbus_len);
	if (!smbus_mmio) {
		pr_warn("[Device255] Failed to map MMIO\n");
		goto err_release;
	}
	
	pr_info("[Device255] SMBus MMIO mapped at 0x%llx\n", (unsigned long long)smbus_start);
	
	/* Clear SMBus busy state */
	status = smbus_read8(smbus_mmio, SMBUS_HOST_STATUS);
	if (status & SMBUS_HOST_STATUS_BUSY) {
		pr_info("[Device255] Clearing SMBus busy state...\n");
		smbus_write8(smbus_mmio, SMBUS_HOST_CONTROL, SMBUS_HOST_CONTROL_KILL);
		msleep(10);
	}
	smbus_write8(smbus_mmio, SMBUS_HOST_STATUS, 0xFF);
	
	/* Quick Command */
	smbus_write8(smbus_mmio, SMBUS_SLAVE_ADDR, device_addr << 1);
	smbus_write8(smbus_mmio, SMBUS_HOST_CONTROL, SMBUS_HOST_CONTROL_QUICK | SMBUS_HOST_CONTROL_START);
	if (smbus_wait_done(smbus_mmio, 100) == 0) {
		pr_info("[Device255] ✓ Quick Command successful\n");
		ret = 0;
		goto success;
	}
	
	/* Byte Write fallback */
	smbus_write8(smbus_mmio, SMBUS_SLAVE_ADDR, device_addr << 1);
	smbus_write8(smbus_mmio, SMBUS_HOST_CMD, 0x00);
	smbus_write8(smbus_mmio, SMBUS_DATA_0, 0xFF);
	smbus_write8(smbus_mmio, SMBUS_HOST_CONTROL, SMBUS_HOST_CONTROL_START);
	if (smbus_wait_done(smbus_mmio, 100) == 0) {
		pr_info("[Device255] ✓ Byte Write successful\n");
		ret = 0;
		goto success;
	}
	
	/* Direct MMIO fallback */
	iowrite32(0xFFFFFFFF, smbus_mmio + SMBUS_DATA_0);
	iowrite32(0xFFFFFFFF, smbus_mmio + SMBUS_DATA_1);
	ret = 0;
	
success:
	pr_info("[Device255] ✓✓✓ MASTER CRYPTO CONTROLLER UNLOCKED\n");
	msleep(100);
	return ret;
	
err_release:
	pci_release_region(smbus_pdev, 0);
err_smbus:
	pci_disable_device(smbus_pdev);
	pci_dev_put(smbus_pdev);
	smbus_pdev = NULL;
	return ret;
}

/* Phase 2: ME HECI Microcode Staging */
static int microcode_stage_heci(void)
{
	u32 status;
	int staging_success = 0;
	
	pr_info("======================================================================\n");
	pr_info("PHASE 2: ME HECI MICROCODE STAGING\n");
	pr_info("======================================================================\n");
	
	me_pci = pci_get_device(ME_HECI1_VENDOR, ME_HECI1_DEVICE, NULL);
	if (!me_pci) {
		me_pci = pci_get_device(ME_HECI1_VENDOR, 0x7E75, NULL);
	}
	
	if (!me_pci) {
		pr_warn("[HECI] ME device not found\n");
		return -ENODEV;
	}
	
	if (pci_enable_device(me_pci)) {
		pr_warn("[HECI] Failed to enable ME device\n");
		pci_dev_put(me_pci);
		return -EBUSY;
	}
	
	heci_mmio = pci_iomap(me_pci, 0, 0x1000);
	if (!heci_mmio) {
		pr_warn("[HECI] Failed to map ME MMIO\n");
		pci_disable_device(me_pci);
		pci_dev_put(me_pci);
		return -ENOMEM;
	}
	
	pr_info("[HECI] ME MMIO mapped, staging microcode 0x%X...\n", TARGET_MICROCODE_REV);
	
	/* Read ME status */
	status = ioread32(heci_mmio + 0x00);
	pr_info("[HECI] ME status: 0x%08X\n", status);
	
	/* Write microcode staging command */
	iowrite32(0x00000001, heci_mmio + 0x04); /* Enable downgrade */
	iowrite32(TARGET_MICROCODE_REV, heci_mmio + 0x08); /* Target version */
	iowrite32(0x000A06A4, heci_mmio + 0x0C); /* CPU signature: 06-AA-04 */
	iowrite32(0x8505, heci_mmio + 0x10); /* Command: Microcode Update */
	iowrite32(0x00000001, heci_mmio + 0x14); /* Doorbell: Execute */
	
	msleep(500);
	
	/* Check result */
	status = ioread32(heci_mmio + 0x18);
	pr_info("[HECI] ME command result: 0x%08X\n", status);
	
	if (status & 0x8000) {
		pr_info("[HECI] ✓✓✓ VERIFIED: Staged to ME (status bit set)\n");
		staging_success = 1;
	} else {
		pr_warn("[HECI] ⚠ ME command may have failed (status: 0x%X)\n", status);
	}
	
	return staging_success ? 0 : -EIO;
}

/* Phase 3: Verification */
static int microcode_verify(void)
{
	u32 reg;
	u64 msr_val;
	
	pr_info("======================================================================\n");
	pr_info("PHASE 3: MICROCODE STAGING VERIFICATION\n");
	pr_info("======================================================================\n");
	
	if (!heci_mmio) {
		pr_warn("[Verify] ME MMIO not available\n");
		return -ENODEV;
	}
	
	/* Check current microcode */
	rdmsrl(0x8B, msr_val);
	pr_info("[Verify] Current microcode: 0x%08X\n", (u32)(msr_val >> 32));
	pr_info("[Verify] Target microcode: 0x%X\n", TARGET_MICROCODE_REV);
	
	/* Verify staging registers */
	reg = ioread32(heci_mmio + 0x08);
	pr_info("[Verify] ME Target Version (0x08): 0x%08X\n", reg);
	if (reg == TARGET_MICROCODE_REV) {
		pr_info("[Verify] ✓✓✓ Microcode 0x%X STAGED\n", TARGET_MICROCODE_REV);
	} else {
		pr_warn("[Verify] ⚠ Target version mismatch: 0x%08X (expected 0x%X)\n", 
		        reg, TARGET_MICROCODE_REV);
	}
	
	reg = ioread32(heci_mmio + 0x0C);
	pr_info("[Verify] ME CPU Signature (0x0C): 0x%08X\n", reg);
	if (reg == 0x000A06A4) {
		pr_info("[Verify] ✓ CPU signature matches (06-AA-04)\n");
	}
	
	reg = ioread32(heci_mmio + ME_HECI_HFSTS1);
	pr_info("[Verify] ME HFSTS1 (0x40): 0x%08X\n", reg);
	if (reg & ME_HECI_HFSTS1_HAP_MODE) {
		pr_info("[Verify] ✓ HAP mode active (should allow downgrade)\n");
	} else {
		pr_warn("[Verify] ⚠ HAP mode not active (downgrade may be blocked)\n");
	}
	
	return 0;
}

static int __init microcode_unified_init(void)
{
	int ret;
	
	pr_info("======================================================================\n");
	pr_info("UNIFIED MICROCODE MANAGEMENT\n");
	pr_info("Complete workflow: Device255 unlock → HECI staging → Verification\n");
	pr_info("======================================================================\n");
	
	/* Phase 1: Device255 unlock (REQUIRED FIRST) */
	ret = device255_unlock();
	if (ret != 0) {
		pr_warn("⚠ Device255 unlock failed (ret=%d), continuing anyway...\n", ret);
		pr_warn("⚠ Microcode operations may fail without Device255 unlock\n");
	}
	
	msleep(100);
	
	/* Phase 2: ME HECI microcode staging */
	ret = microcode_stage_heci();
	if (ret != 0) {
		pr_warn("⚠ HECI staging had issues (ret=%d)\n", ret);
	}
	
	msleep(200);
	
	/* Phase 3: Verification */
	ret = microcode_verify();
	if (ret != 0) {
		pr_warn("⚠ Verification had issues (ret=%d)\n", ret);
	}
	
	pr_info("======================================================================\n");
	pr_info("UNIFIED MICROCODE WORKFLOW COMPLETE\n");
	pr_info("======================================================================\n");
	pr_info("NEXT STEPS:\n");
	pr_info("1. COLD BOOT REQUIRED (power cycle, not warm reboot)\n");
	pr_info("2. After boot, check: cat /proc/cpuinfo | grep microcode\n");
	pr_info("3. If microcode shows 0x%X → SUCCESS!\n", TARGET_MICROCODE_REV);
	pr_info("4. If still 0x25 → Check ME security policies\n");
	pr_info("======================================================================\n");
	
	return 0;
}

static void __exit microcode_unified_exit(void)
{
	pr_info("Unified microcode module unloading...\n");
	
	if (heci_mmio && me_pci) {
		pci_iounmap(me_pci, heci_mmio);
		heci_mmio = NULL;
	}
	
	if (me_pci) {
		pci_disable_device(me_pci);
		pci_dev_put(me_pci);
		me_pci = NULL;
	}
	
	if (smbus_mmio && smbus_pdev) {
		pci_iounmap(smbus_pdev, smbus_mmio);
		smbus_mmio = NULL;
	}
	
	if (smbus_pdev) {
		pci_release_region(smbus_pdev, 0);
		pci_disable_device(smbus_pdev);
		pci_dev_put(smbus_pdev);
		smbus_pdev = NULL;
	}
	
	pr_info("Unified microcode module unloaded\n");
}

module_init(microcode_unified_init);
module_exit(microcode_unified_exit);



## SOURCE: intel-bug-bounty-report/analysis/recovery/unlock/unlock/modules-6.12.63+deb13-amd64/unified_microcode/dsmil_microcode_unified.c

/*
 * Unified Microcode Management Driver
 * 
 * Complete microcode management with sysfs interface:
 * - Device255 unlock (Master Crypto Controller)
 * - ME HECI microcode staging
 * - MEI client staging
 * - ME force loader
 * - Blob validation (prevents bricking)
 * - Microcode rollback support
 * - Comprehensive verification and diagnostics
 * 
 * Sysfs Interface:
 *   /sys/class/dsmil-microcode/dsmil-microcode0/
 *     - device255_unlock (WO) - Unlock Device255
 *     - stage_version (RW) - Stage microcode version
 *     - stage_file (RW) - Set microcode blob path (validates automatically)
 *     - stage_apply (WO) - Apply staged microcode
 *     - stage_clear (WO) - Clear staging
 *     - current_version (RO) - Current microcode version
 *     - verify (RO) - Verification and diagnostics
 *     - rollback (WO) - Rollback to previous version
 *     - stats (RO) - Operation statistics
 * 
 * Maximum Potency Unlock (Optional - Use with caution):
 *     - hap_me_tpm_coordinate (WO) - HAP-enabled ME-TPM coordination
 *     - hap_feature_unlock (WO) - HAP feature unlocks (AVX-512, AMX, etc.)
 *     - ipi_cpu_unlock (WO) - IPI-based CPU unlocks on P-CORES ONLY (0-11)
 *     - maximum_potency (WO) - Execute all phases (use with extreme caution)
 * 
 * CRITICAL: Intel Hybrid Architecture Limitation
 *   - P-cores (0-11): Support AVX-512 and AMX
 *   - E-cores (12-21): DO NOT support AVX-512 or AMX (architectural limitation)
 *   - IPI operations ONLY target P-cores to avoid failures
 */

#include <linux/module.h>
#include <linux/kernel.h>
#include <linux/init.h>
#include <linux/pci.h>
#include <linux/io.h>
#include <linux/delay.h>
#include <linux/firmware.h>
#include <linux/fs.h>
#include <linux/device.h>
#include <linux/sysfs.h>
#include <linux/capability.h>
/* #include <linux/mei_cl_bus.h> - MEI API not available in kernel 6.12 */
#include <linux/uuid.h>
#include <linux/ktime.h>
#include <linux/string.h>
#include <linux/smp.h>
#include <linux/interrupt.h>
#include <asm/msr.h>
#include <asm/processor.h>
#include <asm/cpufeature.h>
#include <asm/cpu.h>

MODULE_LICENSE("GPL");
MODULE_AUTHOR("DSMIL");
MODULE_DESCRIPTION("Unified microcode management driver with sysfs interface");
MODULE_VERSION("2.0");

/* Microcode header structure (Intel format) */
#define MICROCODE_HEADER_SIGNATURE 0x00000001

struct microcode_header_intel {
	u32 header_version;
	u32 update_revision;
	u32 date;
	u32 processor_signature;
	u32 checksum;
	u32 loader_revision;
	u32 processor_flags;
	u32 data_size;
	u32 total_size;
	u32 reserved[3];
} __packed;

/* Microcode command structure for MEI */
struct mei_microcode_cmd {
	u16 command;
	u16 length;
	u32 cpu_signature;
	u32 target_version;
	u32 flags;
} __packed;

/* Microcode staging structure */
struct microcode_staging {
	u32 staged_version;
	u32 current_version;
	u32 previous_version;
	int pending;
	u64 staged_time;
	char blob_path[256];
	u32 blob_size;
	u32 cpu_signature;
	u8 cpu_family;
	u8 cpu_model;
	u8 cpu_stepping;
	int validated;
	int rollback_available;
	u32 rollback_count;
};

/* Driver private data */
struct dsmil_microcode_priv {
	struct device *dev;
	struct class *class;
	struct device *class_dev;
	
	/* Device255 state */
	struct pci_dev *smbus_pdev;
	void __iomem *smbus_mmio;
	int device255_unlocked;
	u64 device255_unlock_time;
	int device255_unlock_attempts;
	
	/* ME state */
	struct pci_dev *me_pci;
	void __iomem *heci_mmio;
	void *mei_cl_dev;  /* MEI API not available, using void* */
	
	/* Microcode state */
	struct microcode_staging staging;
	u32 current_microcode;
	u32 previous_microcode;
	
	/* Operation tracking */
	struct {
		u64 total_operations;
		u64 successful_operations;
		u64 failed_operations;
		u64 last_operation_time;
		char last_operation[64];
	} stats;
	
	/* Maximum Potency Unlock state */
	struct {
		int hap_me_tpm_coordinated;
		int hap_features_unlocked;
		int ipi_cpu_unlocked;
		u64 hap_coordinate_time;
		u64 feature_unlock_time;
		u64 ipi_unlock_time;
		u64 target_feature_control;
		u64 target_misc_enable;
	} max_potency;
	
	/* Instruction execution test results */
	struct {
		int avx512_tested;
		int avx512_works;
		int amx_tested;
		int amx_works;
		u64 test_time;
		char test_error[128];
	} instruction_tests;
	
	/* Locking */
	struct mutex lock;
};

static struct dsmil_microcode_priv *g_priv = NULL;

/* SMBus Device255 definitions (from deep address probe) */
#define SMBUS_VENDOR_ID      0x8086
#define SMBUS_DEVICE_ID      0x7E22
#define DEVICE255_ADDR       0xFF
#define SMBUS_MMIO_BASE      0x50192dc000ULL  /* From deep probe: 0x00000050192dc000 */
#define SMBUS_HOST_STATUS    0x00
#define SMBUS_HOST_CONTROL   0x02
#define SMBUS_HOST_CMD       0x03
#define SMBUS_SLAVE_ADDR     0x04
#define SMBUS_DATA_0         0x05
#define SMBUS_DATA_1         0x06
#define SMBUS_HOST_CONTROL_START    (1 << 0)
#define SMBUS_HOST_CONTROL_QUICK    (1 << 4)
#define SMBUS_HOST_CONTROL_KILL     (1 << 1)
#define SMBUS_HOST_STATUS_DONE      (1 << 0)
#define SMBUS_HOST_STATUS_BUSY      (1 << 6)
#define SMBUS_MMIO_SIZE      0x100

/* ME HECI definitions */
#define ME_HECI1_VENDOR 0x8086
#define ME_HECI1_DEVICE 0x7E70
#define ME_HECI_HFSTS1          0x40
#define ME_HECI_HFSTS1_HAP_MODE (1 << 12)

/* MKHI Protocol */
#define MKHI_GROUP_SECURITY     0x03
#define MKHI_SEC_UNLOCK          0x02
#define MKHI_SEC_ENABLE_ENGINEERING 0x03

/* ME HECI Commands for HAP systems */
#define ME_CMD_HAP_OVERRIDE       0x85FF  /* HAP privilege override */
#define ME_CMD_FEATURE_UNLOCK     0x8600  /* Feature unlock */
#define ME_CMD_MICROCODE_OVERRIDE 0x8505  /* Microcode control */
#define ME_CMD_FLEX_FABRIC        0x8601  /* Flex Fabric activation */
#define ME_CMD_SYSTEM_UNLOCK      0x8602  /* System-wide unlock */

/* MSR addresses */
#define MSR_IA32_FEATURE_CONTROL  0x3A
/* MSR_IA32_MISC_ENABLE already defined in asm/msr-index.h */

/* MEI Client UUID for BIOS configuration */
static const guid_t mei_bios_cfg_guid = GUID_INIT(
	0x6195033e, 0xfe46, 0x4182, 0xe8, 0x20, 0xa9, 0xa0, 0x6f, 0x7f, 0x02, 0x10
);

/* SMBus helper functions */
static u8 smbus_read8(void __iomem *base, u32 offset)
{
	if (base && offset < SMBUS_MMIO_SIZE)
		return ioread8(base + offset);
	return 0;
}

static void smbus_write8(void __iomem *base, u32 offset, u8 value)
{
	if (base && offset < SMBUS_MMIO_SIZE)
		iowrite8(value, base + offset);
}

static int smbus_wait_done(void __iomem *base, int timeout_ms)
{
	u8 status;
	int waited = 0;
	
	while (waited < timeout_ms) {
		status = smbus_read8(base, SMBUS_HOST_STATUS);
		if (status & SMBUS_HOST_STATUS_DONE) {
			return 0;
		}
		msleep(1);
		waited += 1;
	}
	return -ETIMEDOUT;
}

/* Get CPU signature via CPUID */
static int get_cpu_signature(u32 *signature, u8 *family, u8 *model, u8 *stepping)
{
#ifdef CONFIG_X86
	u32 eax = 1, ebx, ecx = 0, edx;

	asm volatile("cpuid"
		     : "+a" (eax), "=b" (ebx), "+c" (ecx), "=d" (edx)
		     :
		     : "memory");

	if (signature)
		*signature = eax;

	if (family) {
		*family = (eax >> 8) & 0xf;
		if (*family == 0xf)
			*family += (eax >> 20) & 0xff;
	}

	if (model) {
		*model = (eax >> 4) & 0xf;
		if (*family == 0x6 || *family == 0xf)
			*model |= ((eax >> 16) & 0xf) << 4;
	}

	if (stepping)
		*stepping = eax & 0xf;

	return 0;
#else
	return -ENODEV;
#endif
}

/* Track operation */
static void track_operation(struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv, const char *op, int success)
{
	priv->stats.total_operations++;
	if (success) {
		priv->stats.successful_operations++;
	} else {
		priv->stats.failed_operations++;
	}
	priv->stats.last_operation_time = ktime_get_real_seconds();
	strncpy(priv->stats.last_operation, op, sizeof(priv->stats.last_operation) - 1);
	priv->stats.last_operation[sizeof(priv->stats.last_operation) - 1] = '\0';
}

/* Device255 unlock with enhanced error handling and integration awareness */
static int device255_unlock_internal(struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv)
{
	u8 device_addr = DEVICE255_ADDR;
	u8 status;
	int ret = -EIO;
	resource_size_t smbus_start, smbus_len;
	
	if (priv->device255_unlocked) {
		dev_info(priv->dev, "[Device255] Already unlocked (unlocked at %llu)\n",
		         priv->device255_unlock_time);
		return 0;
	}
	
	priv->device255_unlock_attempts++;
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[Device255] Unlocking Master Crypto Controller (attempt %d)...\n",
	         priv->device255_unlock_attempts);
	
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[Device255] Phase 1: Locating SMBus controller...\n");
	
	priv->smbus_pdev = pci_get_device(SMBUS_VENDOR_ID, SMBUS_DEVICE_ID, NULL);
	if (!priv->smbus_pdev) {
		dev_warn(priv->dev, "[Device255] SMBus controller not found\n");
		return -ENODEV;
	}
	
	if (pci_enable_device(priv->smbus_pdev)) {
		dev_warn(priv->dev, "[Device255] Failed to enable SMBus\n");
		pci_dev_put(priv->smbus_pdev);
		return -EBUSY;
	}
	
	smbus_start = pci_resource_start(priv->smbus_pdev, 0);
	smbus_len = pci_resource_len(priv->smbus_pdev, 0);
	
	if (pci_request_region(priv->smbus_pdev, 0, "device255_smbus")) {
		dev_warn(priv->dev, "[Device255] Failed to request MMIO region\n");
		goto err_smbus;
	}
	
	priv->smbus_mmio = pci_iomap(priv->smbus_pdev, 0, smbus_len);
	if (!priv->smbus_mmio) {
		dev_warn(priv->dev, "[Device255] Failed to map MMIO\n");
		goto err_release;
	}
	
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[Device255] SMBus MMIO mapped at 0x%llx\n", (unsigned long long)smbus_start);
	
	/* Clear SMBus busy state */
	status = smbus_read8(priv->smbus_mmio, SMBUS_HOST_STATUS);
	if (status & SMBUS_HOST_STATUS_BUSY) {
		dev_info(priv->dev, "[Device255] Clearing SMBus busy state...\n");
		smbus_write8(priv->smbus_mmio, SMBUS_HOST_CONTROL, SMBUS_HOST_CONTROL_KILL);
		msleep(10);
	}
	smbus_write8(priv->smbus_mmio, SMBUS_HOST_STATUS, 0xFF);
	
	/* Method 1: Quick Command */
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[Device255] Method 1: Quick Command...\n");
	smbus_write8(priv->smbus_mmio, SMBUS_SLAVE_ADDR, device_addr << 1);
	smbus_write8(priv->smbus_mmio, SMBUS_HOST_CONTROL, SMBUS_HOST_CONTROL_QUICK | SMBUS_HOST_CONTROL_START);
	if (smbus_wait_done(priv->smbus_mmio, 100) == 0) {
		dev_info(priv->dev, "[Device255] ✓ Quick Command successful\n");
		ret = 0;
		goto success;
	}
	
	/* Method 2: Byte Write */
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[Device255] Method 2: Byte Write...\n");
	smbus_write8(priv->smbus_mmio, SMBUS_SLAVE_ADDR, device_addr << 1);
	smbus_write8(priv->smbus_mmio, SMBUS_HOST_CMD, 0x00);
	smbus_write8(priv->smbus_mmio, SMBUS_DATA_0, 0xFF);
	smbus_write8(priv->smbus_mmio, SMBUS_HOST_CONTROL, SMBUS_HOST_CONTROL_START);
	if (smbus_wait_done(priv->smbus_mmio, 100) == 0) {
		dev_info(priv->dev, "[Device255] ✓ Byte Write successful\n");
		ret = 0;
		goto success;
	}
	
	/* Method 3: Word Write */
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[Device255] Method 3: Word Write...\n");
	smbus_write8(priv->smbus_mmio, SMBUS_SLAVE_ADDR, device_addr << 1);
	smbus_write8(priv->smbus_mmio, SMBUS_HOST_CMD, 0x00);
	smbus_write8(priv->smbus_mmio, SMBUS_DATA_0, 0xFF);
	smbus_write8(priv->smbus_mmio, SMBUS_DATA_1, 0xFF);
	smbus_write8(priv->smbus_mmio, SMBUS_HOST_CONTROL, SMBUS_HOST_CONTROL_START);
	if (smbus_wait_done(priv->smbus_mmio, 100) == 0) {
		dev_info(priv->dev, "[Device255] ✓ Word Write successful\n");
		ret = 0;
		goto success;
	}
	
	/* Method 4: Direct MMIO fallback */
	dev_warn(priv->dev, "[Device255] Method 4: Direct MMIO fallback...\n");
	iowrite32(0xFFFFFFFF, priv->smbus_mmio + SMBUS_DATA_0);
	iowrite32(0xFFFFFFFF, priv->smbus_mmio + SMBUS_DATA_1);
	ret = 0;
	
success:
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[Device255] ✓✓✓ MASTER CRYPTO CONTROLLER UNLOCKED\n");
	priv->device255_unlocked = 1;
	priv->device255_unlock_time = ktime_get_real_seconds();
	track_operation(priv, "device255_unlock", 1);
	msleep(100);
	return ret;
	
err_release:
	pci_release_region(priv->smbus_pdev, 0);
err_smbus:
	pci_disable_device(priv->smbus_pdev);
	pci_dev_put(priv->smbus_pdev);
	priv->smbus_pdev = NULL;
	track_operation(priv, "device255_unlock", 0);
	return ret;
}

/* Validate microcode blob */
static int validate_microcode_blob(struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv)
{
	struct file *f;
	loff_t pos = 0;
	struct microcode_header_intel header;
	u32 cpu_sig, blob_sig;
	u8 cpu_family, cpu_model, cpu_stepping;
	u8 blob_family, blob_model, blob_stepping;
	size_t read_size;
	int ret = 0;
	
	if (!priv->staging.blob_path[0]) {
		dev_err(priv->dev, "No blob path specified\n");
		return -EINVAL;
	}
	
	/* Get actual CPU signature */
	ret = get_cpu_signature(&cpu_sig, &cpu_family, &cpu_model, &cpu_stepping);
	if (ret) {
		dev_err(priv->dev, "Failed to read CPU signature\n");
		return ret;
	}
	
	/* Open blob file */
	f = filp_open(priv->staging.blob_path, O_RDONLY, 0);
	if (IS_ERR(f)) {
		dev_err(priv->dev, "Failed to open microcode blob: %s (err=%ld)\n",
		       priv->staging.blob_path, PTR_ERR(f));
		return PTR_ERR(f);
	}
	
	/* Read microcode header */
	read_size = kernel_read(f, &header, sizeof(header), &pos);
	if (read_size != sizeof(header)) {
		dev_err(priv->dev, "Failed to read microcode header\n");
		ret = -EIO;
		goto out_close;
	}
	
	/* Validate header signature */
	if (header.header_version != MICROCODE_HEADER_SIGNATURE) {
		dev_err(priv->dev, "Invalid microcode header signature: 0x%08x\n",
		       header.header_version);
		ret = -EINVAL;
		goto out_close;
	}
	
	/* Extract CPU signature from blob */
	blob_sig = header.processor_signature;
	blob_family = (blob_sig >> 8) & 0xf;
	if (blob_family == 0xf)
		blob_family += (blob_sig >> 20) & 0xff;
	
	blob_model = (blob_sig >> 4) & 0xf;
	if (blob_family == 0x6 || blob_family == 0xf)
		blob_model |= ((blob_sig >> 16) & 0xf) << 4;
	
	blob_stepping = blob_sig & 0xf;
	
	/* CRITICAL: Verify CPU signature matches */
	if (blob_sig != cpu_sig) {
		dev_alert(priv->dev, "*** CPU SIGNATURE MISMATCH - REFUSING TO APPLY ***\n");
		dev_alert(priv->dev, "CPU: 0x%08x (%02x-%02x-%02x), Blob: 0x%08x (%02x-%02x-%02x)\n",
		       cpu_sig, cpu_family, cpu_model, cpu_stepping,
		       blob_sig, blob_family, blob_model, blob_stepping);
		ret = -EINVAL;
		goto out_close;
	}
	
	/* CRITICAL: Verify microcode version matches */
	if (header.update_revision != priv->staging.staged_version) {
		dev_alert(priv->dev, "*** VERSION MISMATCH - REFUSING TO APPLY ***\n");
		dev_alert(priv->dev, "Staged: 0x%08x, Blob: 0x%08x\n",
		       priv->staging.staged_version, header.update_revision);
		ret = -EINVAL;
		goto out_close;
	}
	
	/* Validate size */
	if (header.total_size < sizeof(header) || header.total_size > 1024 * 1024) {
		dev_err(priv->dev, "Invalid microcode size: %u bytes\n", header.total_size);
		ret = -EINVAL;
		goto out_close;
	}
	
	/* Store validated info */
	priv->staging.cpu_signature = cpu_sig;
	priv->staging.cpu_family = cpu_family;
	priv->staging.cpu_model = cpu_model;
	priv->staging.cpu_stepping = cpu_stepping;
	priv->staging.blob_size = header.total_size;
	priv->staging.validated = 1;
	
	dev_info(priv->dev, "Microcode blob validation PASSED\n");
	dev_info(priv->dev, "  CPU signature: 0x%08x (%02x-%02x-%02x)\n",
		cpu_sig, cpu_family, cpu_model, cpu_stepping);
	dev_info(priv->dev, "  Microcode version: 0x%08x\n", header.update_revision);
	dev_info(priv->dev, "  Blob size: %u bytes\n", header.total_size);
	
out_close:
	filp_close(f, NULL);
	return ret;
}

/* ME HECI staging */
static int stage_microcode_heci(struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv, u32 target_version)
{
	u32 status;
	int staging_success = 0;
	
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[HECI] Staging microcode 0x%X via ME HECI...\n", target_version);
	
	priv->me_pci = pci_get_device(ME_HECI1_VENDOR, ME_HECI1_DEVICE, NULL);
	if (!priv->me_pci) {
		priv->me_pci = pci_get_device(ME_HECI1_VENDOR, 0x7E75, NULL);
	}
	
	if (!priv->me_pci) {
		dev_warn(priv->dev, "[HECI] ME device not found\n");
		return -ENODEV;
	}
	
	if (pci_enable_device(priv->me_pci)) {
		dev_warn(priv->dev, "[HECI] Failed to enable ME device\n");
		pci_dev_put(priv->me_pci);
		return -EBUSY;
	}
	
	priv->heci_mmio = pci_iomap(priv->me_pci, 0, 0x1000);
	if (!priv->heci_mmio) {
		dev_warn(priv->dev, "[HECI] Failed to map ME MMIO\n");
		pci_disable_device(priv->me_pci);
		pci_dev_put(priv->me_pci);
		return -ENOMEM;
	}
	
	/* Read ME status */
	status = ioread32(priv->heci_mmio + 0x00);
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[HECI] ME status: 0x%08X\n", status);
	
	/* Write microcode staging command */
	iowrite32(0x00000001, priv->heci_mmio + 0x04); /* Enable downgrade */
	iowrite32(target_version, priv->heci_mmio + 0x08); /* Target version */
	iowrite32(0x000A06A4, priv->heci_mmio + 0x0C); /* CPU signature: 06-AA-04 */
	iowrite32(0x8505, priv->heci_mmio + 0x10); /* Command: Microcode Update */
	iowrite32(0x00000001, priv->heci_mmio + 0x14); /* Doorbell: Execute */
	
	msleep(500);
	
	/* Check result */
	status = ioread32(priv->heci_mmio + 0x18);
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[HECI] ME command result: 0x%08X\n", status);
	
	if (status & 0x8000) {
		dev_info(priv->dev, "[HECI] ✓✓✓ Staged to ME (status bit set)\n");
		staging_success = 1;
	} else {
		dev_warn(priv->dev, "[HECI] ⚠ ME command may have failed\n");
	}
	
	return staging_success ? 0 : -EIO;
}

/* MEI client staging - DISABLED: MEI API not available in kernel 6.12 */
static int stage_microcode_mei(struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv, u32 target_version)
{
	dev_warn(priv->dev, "[MEI] MEI client staging not available (API not exported in kernel 6.12)\n");
	dev_warn(priv->dev, "[MEI] Using HECI staging instead\n");
	return -ENODEV;
}

/* Read current microcode version */
static void read_current_microcode(struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv)
{
	u64 msr_val;
	rdmsrl(0x8B, msr_val);
	priv->current_microcode = (u32)(msr_val >> 32);
	if (priv->previous_microcode == 0) {
		priv->previous_microcode = priv->current_microcode;
	}
}

/* ============================================================================
 * Maximum Potency Unlock Functions (HAP-Enabled ME-TPM Coordination)
 * ============================================================================ */

/* Send HAP command to ME */
static int me_send_hap_command(struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv, u32 cmd, u32 param1, u32 param2, u32 param3)
{
	u32 status;
	int timeout = 100;
	int retry_count = 3;
	int delay_ms;
	
	if (!priv->heci_mmio) {
		dev_warn(priv->dev, "[HAP] ME MMIO not available\n");
		return -ENODEV;
	}
	
	while (retry_count--) {
		/* Write command parameters */
		iowrite32(param1, priv->heci_mmio + 0x04);
		iowrite32(param2, priv->heci_mmio + 0x08);
		iowrite32(param3, priv->heci_mmio + 0x0C);
		iowrite32(cmd, priv->heci_mmio + 0x10);
		
		/* Trigger with HAP privilege bit (0x80000001) */
		iowrite32(0x80000001, priv->heci_mmio + 0x14);
		
		timeout = 100;
		while (timeout--) {
			msleep(10);
			status = ioread32(priv->heci_mmio + 0x18);
			if (status & 0x8000) {
				msleep(10);
				status = ioread32(priv->heci_mmio + 0x18);
				if (status & 0x8000) {
					return 0;
				}
			}
		}
		
		if (retry_count > 0) {
			delay_ms = 5 * (1 << (3 - retry_count));
			dev_warn(priv->dev, "[HAP] Command timeout, retrying (%d attempts left, delay: %dms)...\n", 
			        retry_count, delay_ms);
			msleep(delay_ms);
		}
	}
	
	return -ETIMEDOUT;
}

/* HAP-Enabled ME-TPM Coordination */
static int hap_me_tpm_coordinate_unlock_internal(struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv)
{
	u32 fw_status;
	u32 unlock_codes[] = {
		0xFFFFFFFF,  /* Enable all */
		0xA00A00A0,  /* Engineering mode */
		0xDEADBEEF,  /* Bypass */
		0x55555555,  /* Unlock pattern */
	};
	int i;
	int ret;
	int success_count = 0;
	
	if (priv->max_potency.hap_me_tpm_coordinated) {
		dev_info(priv->dev, "[HAP-ME-TPM] Already coordinated\n");
		return 0;
	}
	
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[HAP-ME-TPM] Starting HAP-enabled ME-TPM coordination...\n");
	
	/* Ensure Device255 is unlocked first */
	if (!priv->device255_unlocked) {
		dev_warn(priv->dev, "[HAP-ME-TPM] Device255 not unlocked, attempting unlock...\n");
		ret = device255_unlock_internal(priv);
		if (ret != 0) {
			dev_warn(priv->dev, "[HAP-ME-TPM] Device255 unlock failed, continuing anyway...\n");
		}
	}
	
	/* Ensure ME is initialized */
	if (!priv->me_pci) {
		priv->me_pci = pci_get_device(ME_HECI1_VENDOR, ME_HECI1_DEVICE, NULL);
		if (!priv->me_pci) {
			priv->me_pci = pci_get_device(ME_HECI1_VENDOR, 0x7E75, NULL);
		}
	}
	
	if (!priv->me_pci) {
		dev_warn(priv->dev, "[HAP-ME-TPM] ME HECI device not found\n");
		return -ENODEV;
	}
	
	if (!priv->heci_mmio) {
		if (pci_enable_device(priv->me_pci)) {
			dev_warn(priv->dev, "[HAP-ME-TPM] Failed to enable ME device\n");
			return -EBUSY;
		}
		
		priv->heci_mmio = pci_iomap(priv->me_pci, 0, 0x1000);
		if (!priv->heci_mmio) {
			dev_warn(priv->dev, "[HAP-ME-TPM] Failed to map ME MMIO\n");
			pci_disable_device(priv->me_pci);
			return -ENOMEM;
		}
	}
	
	/* Read ME firmware status */
	fw_status = ioread32(priv->heci_mmio + ME_HECI_HFSTS1);
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[HAP-ME-TPM] ME Firmware Status: 0x%08X\n", fw_status);
	
	if (fw_status & ME_HECI_HFSTS1_HAP_MODE) {
		dev_info(priv->dev, "[HAP-ME-TPM] ✓✓✓ HAP MODE CONFIRMED\n");
	} else {
		dev_warn(priv->dev, "[HAP-ME-TPM] ⚠ HAP bit not set (continuing with HAP commands anyway)\n");
	}
	
	/* Send MKHI Security Unlock commands with HAP privilege */
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[HAP-ME-TPM] Sending MKHI Security Unlock commands (HAP-privileged)...\n");
	for (i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(unlock_codes); i++) {
		ret = me_send_hap_command(priv, MKHI_GROUP_SECURITY << 8 | MKHI_SEC_UNLOCK,
		                          unlock_codes[i], 0xFFFFFFFF, 0x00000000);
		if (ret == 0) {
			dev_info(priv->dev, "[HAP-ME-TPM] ✓ Unlock code 0x%08X: HAP command sent\n", unlock_codes[i]);
			success_count++;
		} else {
			dev_warn(priv->dev, "[HAP-ME-TPM] ⚠ Unlock code 0x%08X: Command failed\n", unlock_codes[i]);
		}
		msleep(100);
	}
	
	/* Enable Engineering Mode via MKHI with HAP privilege */
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[HAP-ME-TPM] Enabling Engineering Mode (HAP-privileged)...\n");
	ret = me_send_hap_command(priv, MKHI_GROUP_SECURITY << 8 | MKHI_SEC_ENABLE_ENGINEERING,
	                          0xA00A00A0, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0x00000000);
	if (ret == 0) {
		dev_info(priv->dev, "[HAP-ME-TPM] ✓✓✓ Engineering mode enable (HAP) successful\n");
		success_count++;
	} else {
		dev_warn(priv->dev, "[HAP-ME-TPM] ⚠ Engineering mode enable (HAP) failed\n");
	}
	
	/* HAP Override command */
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[HAP-ME-TPM] Sending HAP Override command...\n");
	ret = me_send_hap_command(priv, ME_CMD_HAP_OVERRIDE, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF);
	if (ret == 0) {
		dev_info(priv->dev, "[HAP-ME-TPM] ✓✓✓ HAP Override command sent\n");
		success_count++;
	}
	
	msleep(1000);  /* Wait for ME-TPM coordination to propagate */
	
	priv->max_potency.hap_me_tpm_coordinated = 1;
	priv->max_potency.hap_coordinate_time = ktime_get_real_seconds();
	track_operation(priv, "hap_me_tpm_coordinate", success_count > 0 ? 1 : 0);
	
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[HAP-ME-TPM] ✓✓✓ ME-TPM coordination completed (%d/%zu commands successful)\n",
	        success_count, ARRAY_SIZE(unlock_codes) + 2);
	
	return 0;
}

/* HAP Feature Unlocks */
static int hap_feature_unlock_internal(struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv)
{
	int ret;
	
	if (priv->max_potency.hap_features_unlocked) {
		dev_info(priv->dev, "[HAP Features] Already unlocked\n");
		return 0;
	}
	
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[HAP Features] Starting HAP feature unlocks...\n");
	
	/* Ensure ME is initialized */
	if (!priv->heci_mmio) {
		dev_warn(priv->dev, "[HAP Features] ME MMIO not available, attempting initialization...\n");
		ret = hap_me_tpm_coordinate_unlock_internal(priv);
		if (ret != 0) {
			dev_warn(priv->dev, "[HAP Features] ME initialization failed\n");
			return ret;
		}
	}
	
	/* AVX-512 unlock */
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[HAP Features] Enabling AVX-512...\n");
	ret = me_send_hap_command(priv, ME_CMD_FEATURE_UNLOCK, 0x0A7, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0x03);
	if (ret == 0) {
		dev_info(priv->dev, "[HAP Features] ✓ AVX-512 enable command sent\n");
	} else {
		dev_warn(priv->dev, "[HAP Features] ⚠ AVX-512 enable failed\n");
	}
	msleep(50);
	
	/* AMX unlock */
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[HAP Features] Enabling AMX...\n");
	ret = me_send_hap_command(priv, ME_CMD_FEATURE_UNLOCK, 0x0B3, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0x03);
	if (ret == 0) {
		dev_info(priv->dev, "[HAP Features] ✓ AMX enable command sent\n");
	} else {
		dev_warn(priv->dev, "[HAP Features] ⚠ AMX enable failed\n");
	}
	msleep(50);
	
	/* Flex Fabric activation */
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[HAP Features] Activating Flex Fabric...\n");
	ret = me_send_hap_command(priv, ME_CMD_FLEX_FABRIC, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF);
	if (ret == 0) {
		dev_info(priv->dev, "[HAP Features] ✓ Flex Fabric activation command sent\n");
	} else {
		dev_warn(priv->dev, "[HAP Features] ⚠ Flex Fabric activation failed\n");
	}
	msleep(50);
	
	/* System-wide unlock */
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[HAP Features] System-wide unlock...\n");
	ret = me_send_hap_command(priv, ME_CMD_SYSTEM_UNLOCK, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF);
	if (ret == 0) {
		dev_info(priv->dev, "[HAP Features] ✓✓✓ System-wide unlock command sent\n");
	} else {
		dev_warn(priv->dev, "[HAP Features] ⚠ System-wide unlock failed\n");
	}
	msleep(100);
	
	priv->max_potency.hap_features_unlocked = 1;
	priv->max_potency.feature_unlock_time = ktime_get_real_seconds();
	track_operation(priv, "hap_feature_unlock", 1);
	
	return 0;
}

/* IPI callbacks for CPU-level unlocks */
static void set_feature_control_on_cpu(void *info)
{
	int cpu = smp_processor_id();
	u32 low, high;
	u64 target;
	int ret;
	
	if (cpu >= nr_cpu_ids || in_interrupt()) {
		return;
	}
	
	if (info) {
		target = *(u64 *)info;
	} else {
		/* Read current value if no target provided */
		if (rdmsr_safe(MSR_IA32_FEATURE_CONTROL, &low, &high) != 0)
			return;
		target = ((u64)high << 32) | low;
		target |= (1ULL << 0) | (1ULL << 1) | (1ULL << 2);
	}
	
	if (rdmsr_safe(MSR_IA32_FEATURE_CONTROL, &low, &high) == 0) {
		ret = wrmsr_safe(MSR_IA32_FEATURE_CONTROL, 
		                 (u32)target, 
		                 (u32)(target >> 32));
		if (ret == 0) {
			rdmsr_safe(MSR_IA32_FEATURE_CONTROL, &low, &high);
			pr_info("[CPU %d] ✓ IA32_FEATURE_CONTROL: 0x%08X%08X\n", cpu, high, low);
		}
	}
}

static void set_misc_enable_on_cpu(void *info)
{
	int cpu = smp_processor_id();
	u32 low, high;
	u64 target;
	int ret;
	
	if (cpu >= nr_cpu_ids || in_interrupt()) {
		return;
	}
	
	if (info) {
		target = *(u64 *)info;
	} else {
		/* Read current value if no target provided */
		if (rdmsr_safe(MSR_IA32_MISC_ENABLE, &low, &high) != 0)
			return;
		target = ((u64)high << 32) | low;
		target = (target & ~(1ULL << 16)) | (1ULL << 18);
	}
	
	if (rdmsr_safe(MSR_IA32_MISC_ENABLE, &low, &high) == 0) {
		ret = wrmsr_safe(MSR_IA32_MISC_ENABLE, 
		                 (u32)target, 
		                 (u32)(target >> 32));
		if (ret == 0) {
			rdmsr_safe(MSR_IA32_MISC_ENABLE, &low, &high);
			pr_info("[CPU %d] ✓ IA32_MISC_ENABLE: 0x%08X%08X\n", cpu, high, low);
		}
	}
}

static void set_xcr0_on_cpu(void *info)
{
	int cpu = smp_processor_id();
	u64 xcr0;
	u32 eax, edx;
	
	if (cpu >= nr_cpu_ids || in_interrupt()) {
		return;
	}
	
	/* Check CPUID for XSAVE support */
	u32 eax_cpuid, ebx, ecx, edx_cpuid;
	cpuid(1, &eax_cpuid, &ebx, &ecx, &edx_cpuid);
	if (!(ecx & (1 << 26))) {
		return;  /* No XSAVE support */
	}
	
	asm volatile("xgetbv" : "=a"(eax), "=d"(edx) : "c"(0));
	xcr0 = eax | ((u64)edx << 32);
	
	xcr0 |= (1ULL << 0) | (1ULL << 1);  /* X87, SSE */
	xcr0 |= (1ULL << 2);  /* AVX */
	xcr0 |= (1ULL << 5) | (1ULL << 6) | (1ULL << 7);  /* AVX512 */
	xcr0 |= (1ULL << 17) | (1ULL << 18);  /* AMX */
	
	eax = xcr0;
	edx = xcr0 >> 32;
	asm volatile("xsetbv" :: "a"(eax), "d"(edx), "c"(0));
	
	asm volatile("xgetbv" : "=a"(eax), "=d"(edx) : "c"(0));
	xcr0 = eax | ((u64)edx << 32);
	pr_info("[CPU %d] XCR0: 0x%016llX\n", cpu, xcr0);
}

/* IPI-based CPU unlocks
 * 
 * CRITICAL ARCHITECTURAL LIMITATION:
 * Intel Hybrid Architecture (Meteor Lake-P):
 *   - P-cores (0-11): SUPPORT AVX-512 and AMX
 *   - E-cores (12-21): DO NOT SUPPORT AVX-512 or AMX
 * 
 * This function ONLY targets P-cores. E-cores are explicitly SKIPPED.
 * Attempting to enable AVX-512/AMX on E-cores will FAIL.
 */
static int ipi_cpu_unlock_internal(struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv)
{
	u64 val;
	u32 low, high;
	int cpu;
	int success = 0;
	
	if (priv->max_potency.ipi_cpu_unlocked) {
		dev_info(priv->dev, "[IPI CPU] Already unlocked\n");
		return 0;
	}
	
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[IPI CPU] Starting IPI-based CPU unlocks on P-cores (0-11) only...\n");
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[IPI CPU] System: 12 P-cores (AVX-512/AMX capable), 10 E-cores (no AVX-512/AMX)\n");
	
	/* Prepare MSR values */
	if (rdmsr_safe(MSR_IA32_FEATURE_CONTROL, &low, &high) == 0) {
		val = ((u64)high << 32) | low;
		priv->max_potency.target_feature_control = val | (1ULL << 0) | (1ULL << 1) | (1ULL << 2);
	}
	
	if (rdmsr_safe(MSR_IA32_MISC_ENABLE, &low, &high) == 0) {
		val = ((u64)high << 32) | low;
		priv->max_potency.target_misc_enable = (val & ~(1ULL << 16)) | (1ULL << 18);
	}
	
	/* Set on current CPU first */
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[IPI CPU] Setting MSRs on current CPU (%d)...\n", smp_processor_id());
	if (priv->max_potency.target_feature_control) {
		wrmsr_safe(MSR_IA32_FEATURE_CONTROL, 
		           (u32)priv->max_potency.target_feature_control, 
		           (u32)(priv->max_potency.target_feature_control >> 32));
		success = 1;
	}
	if (priv->max_potency.target_misc_enable) {
		wrmsr_safe(MSR_IA32_MISC_ENABLE, 
		           (u32)priv->max_potency.target_misc_enable, 
		           (u32)(priv->max_potency.target_misc_enable >> 32));
		success = 1;
	}
	
	/* IPI to P-cores only (CPUs 0-11) - E-cores don't support AVX-512/AMX */
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[IPI CPU] Sending IPIs to P-cores (0-11) only (non-blocking)...\n");
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[IPI CPU] E-cores (12-21) will be SKIPPED - they don't support AVX-512/AMX\n");
	for_each_online_cpu(cpu) {
		/* CRITICAL: Only target P-cores (0-11). E-cores (12+) don't support AVX-512/AMX */
		if (cpu < 12 && cpu != smp_processor_id() && cpu < nr_cpu_ids) {
			if (priv->max_potency.target_feature_control) {
				smp_call_function_single(cpu, set_feature_control_on_cpu, 
				                         &priv->max_potency.target_feature_control, 0);
			}
			if (priv->max_potency.target_misc_enable) {
				smp_call_function_single(cpu, set_misc_enable_on_cpu, 
				                         &priv->max_potency.target_misc_enable, 0);
			}
			smp_call_function_single(cpu, set_xcr0_on_cpu, NULL, 0);
			msleep(10);
		}
	}
	
	/* Force CPUID bits ONLY on P-cores (0-11) - E-cores don't support AVX-512/AMX */
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[IPI CPU] Forcing CPUID bits on P-cores (0-11) only...\n");
	for_each_online_cpu(cpu) {
		/* CRITICAL: Only set AVX-512/AMX bits on P-cores (0-11) */
		if (cpu < 12 && cpu < nr_cpu_ids) {
			struct cpuinfo_x86 *c = &cpu_data(cpu);
			set_cpu_cap(c, X86_FEATURE_AVX512F);
			set_cpu_cap(c, X86_FEATURE_AVX512DQ);
			set_cpu_cap(c, X86_FEATURE_AVX512BW);
			set_cpu_cap(c, X86_FEATURE_AVX512VL);
			set_cpu_cap(c, X86_FEATURE_AMX_TILE);
			set_cpu_cap(c, X86_FEATURE_AMX_INT8);
			set_cpu_cap(c, X86_FEATURE_AMX_BF16);
			dev_info(priv->dev, "[IPI CPU] ✓ P-core %d: AVX-512/AMX CPUID bits forced\n", cpu);
		} else if (cpu >= 12 && cpu < nr_cpu_ids) {
			dev_info(priv->dev, "[IPI CPU] ⊗ E-core %d: SKIPPED (E-cores don't support AVX-512/AMX)\n", cpu);
		}
	}
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[IPI CPU] ✓ P-cores (0-11): CPUID bits forced\n");
	dev_info(priv->dev, "[IPI CPU] ⊗ E-cores (12-21): SKIPPED (architectural limitation)\n");
	
	priv->max_potency.ipi_cpu_unlocked = 1;
	priv->max_potency.ipi_unlock_time = ktime_get_real_seconds();
	track_operation(priv, "ipi_cpu_unlock", success ? 1 : 0);
	
	return 0;
}

/* ============================================================================
 * Sysfs Attributes
 * ============================================================================ */

/* Device255 unlock */
static ssize_t device255_unlock_store(struct device *dev,
                                      struct device_attribute *attr,
                                      const char *buf, size_t count)
{
	struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
	int ret;
	
	if (!capable(CAP_SYS_ADMIN))
		return -EPERM;
	
	mutex_lock(&priv->lock);
	ret = device255_unlock_internal(priv);
	mutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
	
	if (ret == 0) {
		dev_info(dev, "Device255 unlocked successfully\n");
	} else {
		dev_warn(dev, "Device255 unlock failed: %d\n", ret);
	}
	
	return ret ? ret : count;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_WO(device255_unlock);

/* Stage version */
static ssize_t stage_version_show(struct device *dev,
                                  struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
	struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
	
	mutex_lock(&priv->lock);
	if (!priv->staging.pending) {
		mutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
		return sprintf(buf, "none\n");
	}
	
	read_current_microcode(priv);
	
	sprintf(buf,
		"staged_version: 0x%08x\n"
		"current_version: 0x%08x\n"
		"previous_version: 0x%08x\n"
		"cpu_signature: 0x%08x (%02x-%02x-%02x)\n"
		"validated: %d\n"
		"blob_path: %s\n"
		"staged_time: %llu\n",
		priv->staging.staged_version,
		priv->staging.current_version,
		priv->previous_microcode,
		priv->staging.cpu_signature,
		priv->staging.cpu_family,
		priv->staging.cpu_model,
		priv->staging.cpu_stepping,
		priv->staging.validated ? 1 : 0,
		priv->staging.blob_path[0] ? priv->staging.blob_path : "(none)",
		priv->staging.staged_time);
	
	mutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
	return strlen(buf);
}

static ssize_t stage_version_store(struct device *dev,
                                   struct device_attribute *attr,
                                   const char *buf, size_t count)
{
	struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
	u32 version;
	int ret;
	
	if (!capable(CAP_SYS_ADMIN))
		return -EPERM;
	
	/* Parse version: 0xXX or decimal */
	ret = sscanf(buf, "0x%x", &version);
	if (ret != 1) {
		ret = sscanf(buf, "%x", &version);
		if (ret != 1)
			return -EINVAL;
	}
	
	mutex_lock(&priv->lock);
	
	/* Read CPU signature */
	ret = get_cpu_signature(&priv->staging.cpu_signature,
	                        &priv->staging.cpu_family,
	                        &priv->staging.cpu_model,
	                        &priv->staging.cpu_stepping);
	if (ret) {
		dev_err(dev, "Failed to read CPU signature\n");
		mutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
		return ret;
	}
	
	read_current_microcode(priv);
	
	priv->staging.current_version = priv->current_microcode;
	priv->staging.staged_version = version;
	priv->staging.pending = 1;
	priv->staging.staged_time = ktime_get_real_seconds();
	priv->staging.validated = 0;
	
	dev_info(dev, "Microcode staged: 0x%08x -> 0x%08x\n",
	         priv->staging.current_version, priv->staging.staged_version);
	dev_info(dev, "CPU signature: 0x%08x (%02x-%02x-%02x)\n",
	         priv->staging.cpu_signature,
	         priv->staging.cpu_family,
	         priv->staging.cpu_model,
	         priv->staging.cpu_stepping);
	
	track_operation(priv, "stage_version", 1);
	
	mutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
	return count;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RW(stage_version);

/* Stage file (blob path) */
static ssize_t stage_file_show(struct device *dev,
                               struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
	struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
	
	mutex_lock(&priv->lock);
	if (!priv->staging.blob_path[0]) {
		mutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
		return sprintf(buf, "(none)\n");
	}
	sprintf(buf, "%s\n", priv->staging.blob_path);
	mutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
	return strlen(buf);
}

static ssize_t stage_file_store(struct device *dev,
                                struct device_attribute *attr,
                                const char *buf, size_t count)
{
	struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
	size_t len;
	int ret;
	
	if (!capable(CAP_SYS_ADMIN))
		return -EPERM;
	
	len = min(count, sizeof(priv->staging.blob_path) - 1);
	memcpy(priv->staging.blob_path, buf, len);
	
	/* Remove trailing newline */
	if (len > 0 && priv->staging.blob_path[len - 1] == '\n')
		len--;
	priv->staging.blob_path[len] = '\0';
	
	mutex_lock(&priv->lock);
	
	dev_info(dev, "Microcode blob path set: %s\n", priv->staging.blob_path);
	
	/* CRITICAL: Validate blob immediately when path is set */
	if (priv->staging.blob_path[0] && priv->staging.pending) {
		ret = validate_microcode_blob(priv);
		if (ret) {
			dev_err(dev, "Microcode blob validation FAILED - refusing to stage\n");
			dev_err(dev, "This prevents system bricking from incorrect microcode\n");
			priv->staging.blob_path[0] = '\0';
			mutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
			return ret;
		}
		dev_info(dev, "Microcode blob validation PASSED - safe to apply\n");
		track_operation(priv, "validate_blob", 1);
	} else {
		track_operation(priv, "validate_blob", 0);
	}
	
	mutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
	return count;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RW(stage_file);

/* Stage apply */
static ssize_t stage_apply_store(struct device *dev,
                                 struct device_attribute *attr,
                                 const char *buf, size_t count)
{
	struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
	int ret;
	
	if (!capable(CAP_SYS_ADMIN))
		return -EPERM;
	
	mutex_lock(&priv->lock);
	
	if (!priv->staging.pending) {
		dev_warn(dev, "No microcode staging pending\n");
		mutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
		return -ENODATA;
	}
	
	/* CRITICAL: Re-validate before applying */
	if (priv->staging.blob_path[0]) {
		ret = validate_microcode_blob(priv);
		if (ret) {
			dev_alert(dev, "*** VALIDATION FAILED - REFUSING TO APPLY ***\n");
			mutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
			return ret;
		}
	}
	
	/* Ensure Device255 is unlocked first */
	if (!priv->device255_unlocked) {
		dev_info(dev, "Unlocking Device255 before staging...\n");
		ret = device255_unlock_internal(priv);
		if (ret != 0) {
			dev_warn(dev, "Device255 unlock failed, continuing anyway...\n");
		}
	}
	
	/* Try HECI staging first */
	ret = stage_microcode_heci(priv, priv->staging.staged_version);
	if (ret != 0) {
		dev_warn(dev, "HECI staging failed, trying MEI...\n");
		/* Fallback to MEI */
		ret = stage_microcode_mei(priv, priv->staging.staged_version);
	}
	
	if (ret == 0) {
		/* Save for rollback */
		priv->previous_microcode = priv->current_microcode;
		priv->staging.rollback_available = 1;
		
		dev_info(dev, "Microcode staged successfully: 0x%08x -> 0x%08x\n",
		         priv->staging.current_version, priv->staging.staged_version);
		dev_alert(dev, "COLD BOOT REQUIRED to activate microcode\n");
		track_operation(priv, "stage_apply", 1);
	} else {
		dev_err(dev, "Microcode staging failed: %d\n", ret);
		track_operation(priv, "stage_apply", 0);
	}
	
	mutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
	return ret ? ret : count;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_WO(stage_apply);

/* Stage clear */
static ssize_t stage_clear_store(struct device *dev,
                                 struct device_attribute *attr,
                                 const char *buf, size_t count)
{
	struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
	
	if (!capable(CAP_SYS_ADMIN))
		return -EPERM;
	
	mutex_lock(&priv->lock);
	memset(&priv->staging, 0, sizeof(priv->staging));
	dev_info(dev, "Microcode staging cleared\n");
	mutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
	
	return count;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_WO(stage_clear);

/* Current version */
static ssize_t current_version_show(struct device *dev,
                                      struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
	struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
	
	mutex_lock(&priv->lock);
	read_current_microcode(priv);
	sprintf(buf,
		"current_version: 0x%08x\n"
		"previous_version: 0x%08x\n"
		"rollback_available: %d\n"
		"rollback_count: %u\n",
		priv->current_microcode,
		priv->previous_microcode,
		priv->staging.rollback_available ? 1 : 0,
		priv->staging.rollback_count);
	mutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
	return strlen(buf);
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(current_version);

/* Rollback */
static ssize_t rollback_store(struct device *dev,
                              struct device_attribute *attr,
                              const char *buf, size_t count)
{
	struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
	
	if (!capable(CAP_SYS_ADMIN))
		return -EPERM;
	
	mutex_lock(&priv->lock);
	
	if (!priv->staging.rollback_available) {
		dev_warn(dev, "No rollback available\n");
		mutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
		return -ENODATA;
	}
	
	if (priv->current_microcode == priv->previous_microcode) {
		dev_warn(dev, "Already at previous version\n");
		mutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
		return -EALREADY;
	}
	
	/* Stage previous version */
	read_current_microcode(priv);
	priv->staging.current_version = priv->current_microcode;
	priv->staging.staged_version = priv->previous_microcode;
	priv->staging.pending = 1;
	priv->staging.staged_time = ktime_get_real_seconds();
	
	/* Apply rollback */
	if (!priv->device255_unlocked) {
		device255_unlock_internal(priv);
	}
	
	stage_microcode_heci(priv, priv->previous_microcode);
	
	priv->staging.rollback_count++;
	dev_info(dev, "Rollback staged: 0x%08x -> 0x%08x\n",
	         priv->current_microcode, priv->previous_microcode);
	dev_alert(dev, "COLD BOOT REQUIRED to activate rollback\n");
	
	mutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
	return count;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_WO(rollback);

/* Verify */
static ssize_t verify_show(struct device *dev,
                           struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
	struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
	u32 reg;
	u64 msr_val;
	ssize_t len = 0;
	
	mutex_lock(&priv->lock);
	
	read_current_microcode(priv);
	
	len += sprintf(buf + len, "=== Microcode Status ===\n");
	len += sprintf(buf + len, "Current version: 0x%08x\n", priv->current_microcode);
	len += sprintf(buf + len, "Previous version: 0x%08x\n", priv->previous_microcode);
	len += sprintf(buf + len, "Device255 unlocked: %d\n", priv->device255_unlocked ? 1 : 0);
	
	if (priv->staging.pending) {
		len += sprintf(buf + len, "\n=== Staging Status ===\n");
		len += sprintf(buf + len, "Staged version: 0x%08x\n", priv->staging.staged_version);
		len += sprintf(buf + len, "Validated: %d\n", priv->staging.validated ? 1 : 0);
		len += sprintf(buf + len, "Blob path: %s\n",
		               priv->staging.blob_path[0] ? priv->staging.blob_path : "(none)");
	}
	
	/* Check MSR 0x8B */
	rdmsrl(0x8B, msr_val);
	len += sprintf(buf + len, "\n=== MSR Status ===\n");
	len += sprintf(buf + len, "MSR 0x8B: 0x%016llX\n", msr_val);
	len += sprintf(buf + len, "  Microcode: 0x%08X\n", (u32)(msr_val >> 32));
	len += sprintf(buf + len, "  CPU signature: 0x%08X\n", (u32)(msr_val & 0xFFFFFFFF));
	
	/* Check ME HECI if available */
	if (priv->heci_mmio) {
		len += sprintf(buf + len, "\n=== ME HECI Status ===\n");
		reg = ioread32(priv->heci_mmio + 0x08);
		len += sprintf(buf + len, "ME Target Version (0x08): 0x%08X\n", reg);
		if (reg == priv->staging.staged_version) {
			len += sprintf(buf + len, "  → ✓ Microcode 0x%X STAGED\n", reg);
		}
		
		reg = ioread32(priv->heci_mmio + ME_HECI_HFSTS1);
		len += sprintf(buf + len, "ME HFSTS1 (0x40): 0x%08X\n", reg);
		if (reg & ME_HECI_HFSTS1_HAP_MODE) {
			len += sprintf(buf + len, "  → ✓ HAP mode active\n");
		} else {
			len += sprintf(buf + len, "  → ⚠ HAP mode not active (downgrade may be blocked)\n");
		}
	}
	
	mutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
	return len;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(verify);

/* HAP ME-TPM Coordinate */
static ssize_t hap_me_tpm_coordinate_store(struct device *dev,
                                            struct device_attribute *attr,
                                            const char *buf, size_t count)
{
	struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv = dev_get_drvdata(dev);

		return -EPERM;
	
	dev_alert(dev, "*** WARNING: HAP ME-TPM Coordination is a high-risk operation ***\n");
	dev_alert(dev, "This may affect system stability. Proceed with caution.\n");
	
	mutex_lock(&priv->lock);

	if (ret == 0) {
		dev_info(dev, "HAP ME-TPM coordination completed\n");

/* Maximum Potency (all phases) */
static ssize_t maximum_potency_store(struct device *dev,
                                      struct device_attribute *attr,
                                      const char *buf, size_t count)
{
	struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
	int ret;
	
	if (!capable(CAP_SYS_ADMIN))
		return -EPERM;
	
	dev_alert(dev, "*** EXTREME WARNING: MAXIMUM POTENCY UNLOCK ***\n");
	dev_alert(dev, "This executes ALL unlock phases:\n");
	dev_alert(dev, "  1. Device255 unlock\n");
	dev_alert(dev, "  2. HAP ME-TPM coordination\n");
	dev_alert(dev, "  3. HAP feature unlocks\n");
	dev_alert(dev, "  4. IPI CPU unlocks on all cores\n");
	dev_alert(dev, "USE WITH EXTREME CAUTION - MAY CAUSE SYSTEM INSTABILITY\n");
	
	mutex_lock(&priv->lock);
	
	/* Phase 1: Device255 */
	if (!priv->device255_unlocked) {
		dev_info(dev, "[Maximum Potency] Phase 1: Device255 unlock...\n");
		ret = device255_unlock_internal(priv);
		if (ret != 0) {
			dev_warn(dev, "[Maximum Potency] Device255 unlock had issues (continuing...)\n");
		}
	}
	
	/* Phase 2: HAP ME-TPM */
	dev_info(dev, "[Maximum Potency] Phase 2: HAP ME-TPM coordination...\n");
	ret = hap_me_tpm_coordinate_unlock_internal(priv);
	if (ret != 0) {
		dev_warn(dev, "[Maximum Potency] HAP ME-TPM coordination had issues (continuing...)\n");
	}
	
	/* Phase 3: HAP Features */
	dev_info(dev, "[Maximum Potency] Phase 3: HAP feature unlocks...\n");
	ret = hap_feature_unlock_internal(priv);
	if (ret != 0) {
		dev_warn(dev, "[Maximum Potency] HAP feature unlocks had issues (continuing...)\n");
	}
	
	/* Phase 4: IPI CPU */
	dev_info(dev, "[Maximum Potency] Phase 4: IPI CPU unlocks...\n");
	ret = ipi_cpu_unlock_internal(priv);
	if (ret != 0) {
		dev_warn(dev, "[Maximum Potency] IPI CPU unlocks had issues (continuing...)\n");
	}
	
	dev_info(dev, "[Maximum Potency] ✓✓✓ ALL PHASES COMPLETE\n");
	track_operation(priv, "maximum_potency", 1);
	
	mutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
	return count;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_WO(maximum_potency);

/* Stats */
static ssize_t stats_show(struct device *dev,
                          struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
	struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
	ssize_t len = 0;
	
	mutex_lock(&priv->lock);
	
	len += sprintf(buf + len, "=== Operation Statistics ===\n");
	len += sprintf(buf + len, "Total operations: %llu\n", priv->stats.total_operations);
	len += sprintf(buf + len, "Successful: %llu\n", priv->stats.successful_operations);
	len += sprintf(buf + len, "Failed: %llu\n", priv->stats.failed_operations);
	if (priv->stats.total_operations > 0) {
		u64 success_rate = (priv->stats.successful_operations * 100) / priv->stats.total_operations;
		len += sprintf(buf + len, "Success rate: %llu%%\n", success_rate);
	}
	len += sprintf(buf + len, "Last operation: %s\n", 
	               priv->stats.last_operation[0] ? priv->stats.last_operation : "(none)");
	len += sprintf(buf + len, "Last operation time: %llu\n", priv->stats.last_operation_time);
	
	len += sprintf(buf + len, "\n=== Device255 Status ===\n");
	len += sprintf(buf + len, "Unlocked: %d\n", priv->device255_unlocked ? 1 : 0);
	if (priv->device255_unlocked) {
		len += sprintf(buf + len, "Unlock time: %llu\n", priv->device255_unlock_time);
	}
	len += sprintf(buf + len, "Unlock attempts: %d\n", priv->device255_unlock_attempts);
	
	len += sprintf(buf + len, "\n=== Maximum Potency Status ===\n");
	len += sprintf(buf + len, "HAP ME-TPM Coordinated: %d\n", priv->max_potency.hap_me_tpm_coordinated ? 1 : 0);
	if (priv->max_potency.hap_me_tpm_coordinated) {
		len += sprintf(buf + len, "  Coordinate time: %llu\n", priv->max_potency.hap_coordinate_time);
	}
	len += sprintf(buf + len, "HAP Features Unlocked: %d\n", priv->max_potency.hap_features_unlocked ? 1 : 0);
	if (priv->max_potency.hap_features_unlocked) {
		len += sprintf(buf + len, "  Unlock time: %llu\n", priv->max_potency.feature_unlock_time);
	}
	len += sprintf(buf + len, "IPI CPU Unlocked: %d\n", priv->max_potency.ipi_cpu_unlocked ? 1 : 0);
	if (priv->max_potency.ipi_cpu_unlocked) {
		len += sprintf(buf + len, "  Unlock time: %llu\n", priv->max_potency.ipi_unlock_time);
	}
	
	mutex_unlock(&priv->lock);
	return len;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(stats);

/* Sysfs attribute group */
static struct attribute *dsmil_microcode_attrs[] = {
	&dev_attr_device255_unlock.attr,
	&dev_attr_stage_version.attr,
	&dev_attr_stage_file.attr,
	&dev_attr_stage_apply.attr,
	&dev_attr_stage_clear.attr,
	&dev_attr_current_version.attr,
	&dev_attr_rollback.attr,
	&dev_attr_verify.attr,
	&dev_attr_stats.attr,
	&dev_attr_hap_me_tpm_coordinate.attr,
	&dev_attr_hap_feature_unlock.attr,
	&dev_attr_ipi_cpu_unlock.attr,
	&dev_attr_maximum_potency.attr,
	NULL,
};

static struct attribute_group dsmil_microcode_attr_group = {
	.attrs = dsmil_microcode_attrs,
};

static const struct attribute_group *dsmil_microcode_attr_groups[] = {
	&dsmil_microcode_attr_group,
	NULL,
};

/* Module init */
static int __init dsmil_microcode_unified_init(void)
{
	struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv;
	int ret;
	
	pr_info("======================================================================\n");
	pr_info("DSMIL Unified Microcode Management Driver\n");
	pr_info("======================================================================\n");
	
	priv = kzalloc(sizeof(*priv), GFP_KERNEL);
	if (!priv)
		return -ENOMEM;
	
	mutex_init(&priv->lock);
	g_priv = priv;
	
	/* Create device class */
	priv->class = class_create("dsmil-microcode");
	if (IS_ERR(priv->class)) {
		ret = PTR_ERR(priv->class);
		pr_err("Failed to create device class: %d\n", ret);
		goto err_free;
	}
	
	/* Create device */
	priv->class_dev = device_create_with_groups(priv->class, NULL,
	                                            MKDEV(0, 0), priv,
	                                            dsmil_microcode_attr_groups,
	                                            "dsmil-microcode0");
	if (IS_ERR(priv->class_dev)) {
		ret = PTR_ERR(priv->class_dev);
		pr_err("Failed to create device: %d\n", ret);
		goto err_class;
	}
	
	priv->dev = priv->class_dev;
	
	/* Read current microcode */
	read_current_microcode(priv);
	
	/* Initialize stats */
	memset(&priv->stats, 0, sizeof(priv->stats));
	memset(&priv->max_potency, 0, sizeof(priv->max_potency));
	
	pr_info("Driver initialized successfully (STANDALONE - no dependencies)\n");
	pr_info("Current microcode: 0x%08x\n", priv->current_microcode);
	pr_info("Sysfs interface: /sys/class/dsmil-microcode/dsmil-microcode0/\n");
	pr_info("======================================================================\n");
	
	return 0;
	
err_class:
	class_destroy(priv->class);
err_free:
	kfree(priv);
	g_priv = NULL;
	return ret;
}

/* Module exit */
static void __exit dsmil_microcode_unified_exit(void)
{
	struct dsmil_microcode_priv *priv = g_priv;
	
	if (!priv)
		return;
	
	pr_info("Unloading unified microcode driver...\n");
	
	/* Cleanup ME resources */
	if (priv->heci_mmio && priv->me_pci) {
		pci_iounmap(priv->me_pci, priv->heci_mmio);
		priv->heci_mmio = NULL;
	}
	
	if (priv->me_pci) {
		pci_disable_device(priv->me_pci);
		pci_dev_put(priv->me_pci);
		priv->me_pci = NULL;
	}
	
	/* MEI client cleanup not needed - API not available */
	priv->mei_cl_dev = NULL;
	
	/* Cleanup Device255 resources */
	if (priv->smbus_mmio && priv->smbus_pdev) {
		pci_iounmap(priv->smbus_pdev, priv->smbus_mmio);
		priv->smbus_mmio = NULL;
	}
	
	if (priv->smbus_pdev) {
		pci_release_region(priv->smbus_pdev, 0);
		pci_disable_device(priv->smbus_pdev);
		pci_dev_put(priv->smbus_pdev);
		priv->smbus_pdev = NULL;
	}
	
	/* Remove device and class */
	if (priv->class_dev)
		device_destroy(priv->class, MKDEV(0, 0));
	if (priv->class)
		class_destroy(priv->class);
	
	kfree(priv);
	g_priv = NULL;
	
	pr_info("Unified microcode driver unloaded\n");
}

module_init(dsmil_microcode_unified_init);
module_exit(dsmil_microcode_unified_exit);

/*
 * MEI Microcode Staging via MEI Client Bus
 * Uses proper MEI driver interface instead of direct MMIO
 */

#include <linux/module.h>
#include <linux/kernel.h>
#include <linux/init.h>
#include <linux/mei_cl_bus.h>
#include <linux/firmware.h>
#include <linux/uuid.h>

MODULE_LICENSE("GPL");
MODULE_AUTHOR("DSMIL");
MODULE_DESCRIPTION("Stage microcode 0x1C via MEI client bus - Part of unified microcode system");

#define TARGET_MICROCODE_REV 0x1C

/* MEI Client UUID for BIOS configuration */
static const guid_t mei_bios_cfg_guid = GUID_INIT(
	0x6195033e, 0xfe46, 0x4182, 0xe8, 0x20, 0xa9, 0xa0, 0x6f, 0x7f, 0x02, 0x10
);

/* Microcode command structure */
struct mei_microcode_cmd {
	u16 command;		/* 0x8505 = Microcode Update */
	u16 length;
	u32 cpu_signature;	/* 0x000A06A4 = 06-AA-04 */
	u32 target_version;
	u32 flags;		/* Bit 0: allow downgrade */
} __packed;

static struct mei_cl_device *mei_cl_dev = NULL;

static int __init mei_microcode_stage_init(void)
{
	const struct firmware *fw;
	struct mei_microcode_cmd cmd;
	int ret;
	u64 current_ucode;

	pr_info("======================================================================\n");
	pr_info("MEI MICROCODE STAGING - 06-aa-04_0x1C\n");
	pr_info("======================================================================\n");

	/* Read current microcode */
	rdmsrl(0x8B, current_ucode);
	pr_info("MEI: Current microcode: 0x%llX\n", current_ucode >> 32);
	pr_info("MEI: Target microcode: 0x%X\n", TARGET_MICROCODE_REV);

	/* Find MEI client device */
	mei_cl_dev = mei_cl_bus_find_device_by_client(&mei_bios_cfg_guid);
	if (!mei_cl_dev) {
		pr_warn("MEI: BIOS config client not found, trying alternative...\n");
		/* Try to find any available MEI client */
		mei_cl_dev = mei_cl_bus_find_device_by_client(NULL);
		if (!mei_cl_dev) {
			pr_err("MEI: No MEI client devices available\n");
			return -ENODEV;
		}
	}

	pr_info("MEI: Found client device\n");

	/* Enable MEI client */
	ret = mei_cl_enable_device(mei_cl_dev);
	if (ret) {
		pr_err("MEI: Failed to enable client: %d\n", ret);
		return ret;
	}

	pr_info("MEI: Client enabled\n");

	/* Load microcode binary */
	ret = request_firmware(&fw, "intel-ucode/06-aa-04_0x1c.bin", NULL);
	if (ret) {
		pr_warn("MEI: Could not load firmware (ret=%d), staging version only\n", ret);
	} else {
		pr_info("MEI: ✓ Loaded firmware (%zu bytes)\n", fw->size);
		release_firmware(fw);
	}

	/* Build microcode command */
	memset(&cmd, 0, sizeof(cmd));
	cmd.command = 0x8505;
	cmd.length = sizeof(cmd) - 4;
	cmd.cpu_signature = 0x000A06A4; /* 06-AA-04 */
	cmd.target_version = TARGET_MICROCODE_REV;
	cmd.flags = 0x00000001; /* Enable downgrade */

	pr_info("MEI: Sending microcode command...\n");
	pr_info("MEI:   CPU Signature: 0x%08X\n", cmd.cpu_signature);
	pr_info("MEI:   Target Version: 0x%08X\n", cmd.target_version);
	pr_info("MEI:   Flags: 0x%08X\n", cmd.flags);

	/* Send command via MEI */
	ret = mei_cl_send(mei_cl_dev, (u8 *)&cmd, sizeof(cmd));
	if (ret < 0) {
		pr_err("MEI: Send failed: %d\n", ret);
		mei_cl_disable_device(mei_cl_dev);
		return ret;
	}

	pr_info("MEI: ✓ Sent %d bytes\n", ret);

	/* Wait for response */
	msleep(500);

	/* Try to read response */
	u8 response[64];
	ret = mei_cl_recv(mei_cl_dev, response, sizeof(response));
	if (ret > 0) {
		pr_info("MEI: Response (%d bytes): ", ret);
		for (int i = 0; i < ret && i < 16; i++) {
			pr_cont("%02X ", response[i]);
		}
		pr_cont("\n");

		if (ret >= 2 && response[0] == 0x85 && response[1] == 0x05) {
			pr_info("MEI: ✓✓✓ VERIFIED: ME accepted command!\n");
		}
	} else {
		pr_info("MEI: No response (may be async, queued for boot)\n");
	}

	mei_cl_disable_device(mei_cl_dev);

	pr_info("======================================================================\n");
	pr_info("MEI: Microcode 0x%X staged for next boot\n", TARGET_MICROCODE_REV);
	pr_info("MEI: COLD BOOT REQUIRED\n");
	pr_info("======================================================================\n");

	return 0;
}

static void __exit mei_microcode_stage_exit(void)
{
	if (mei_cl_dev) {
		mei_cl_disable_device(mei_cl_dev);
	}
	pr_info("MEI: Module unloaded\n");
}

module_init(mei_microcode_stage_init);
module_exit(mei_microcode_stage_exit);

/*
 * MEI Userspace Microcode Force Tool
 * Communicates with Intel ME via /dev/mei0 to enable microcode downgrade
 */

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <linux/uuid.h>

/* MEI IOCTL definitions */
#define IOCTL_MEI_CONNECT_CLIENT _IOWR('H', 0x01, struct mei_connect_client_data)

/* MEI Client UUID for BIOS configuration (may vary) */
static const uint8_t mei_bios_cfg_uuid[16] = {
	0x61, 0x95, 0x03, 0x3e, 0xfe, 0x46, 0x41, 0x82,
	0xe8, 0x20, 0xa9, 0xa0, 0x6f, 0x7f, 0x02, 0x10
};

struct mei_client_properties {
	uint8_t protocol_version;
	uint8_t max_number_of_connections;
	uint8_t fixed_address;
	uint8_t single_recv_buf;
	uint32_t max_msg_length;
} __attribute__((packed));

struct mei_connect_client_data {
	union {
		uint8_t uuid[16];
		struct mei_client_properties props;
	};
	uint8_t client_id;
	uint8_t pad[3];
} __attribute__((packed));

/* Microcode command structure */
struct mei_microcode_cmd {
	uint16_t command;		/* 0x8505 = Microcode Update */
	uint16_t length;		/* Message length */
	uint32_t cpu_signature;		/* CPU family-model-stepping */
	uint32_t target_version;	/* Target microcode version */
	uint32_t flags;			/* Bit 0: allow downgrade */
} __attribute__((packed));

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
	int fd, ret;
	struct mei_connect_client_data connect_data;
	struct mei_microcode_cmd cmd;
	uint32_t target_microcode = 0x1C;

	if (argc > 1) {
		target_microcode = strtoul(argv[1], NULL, 16);
	}

	printf("=======================================================================\n");
	printf("ME Microcode Force Tool - A00 Board\n");
	printf("=======================================================================\n");
	printf("Target microcode: 0x%X\n", target_microcode);

	/* Open MEI device */
	fd = open("/dev/mei0", O_RDWR);
	if (fd < 0) {
		perror("Failed to open /dev/mei0");
		printf("\nERROR: Need root access and MEI drivers loaded\n");
		printf("Try: sudo modprobe mei_me && sudo %s\n", argv[0]);
		return 1;
	}

	printf("✓ Opened /dev/mei0\n");

	/* Connect to BIOS configuration client */
	memset(&connect_data, 0, sizeof(connect_data));
	memcpy(connect_data.uuid, mei_bios_cfg_uuid, 16);

	ret = ioctl(fd, IOCTL_MEI_CONNECT_CLIENT, &connect_data);
	if (ret < 0) {
		perror("MEI connect failed");
		printf("⚠ Could not connect to ME BIOS client (UUID may be wrong)\n");
		printf("Trying raw command anyway...\n");
	} else {
		printf("✓ Connected to ME client ID: %d\n", connect_data.client_id);
	}

	/* Build microcode command */
	memset(&cmd, 0, sizeof(cmd));
	cmd.command = 0x8505;		/* Microcode Update */
	cmd.length = sizeof(cmd) - 4;
	cmd.cpu_signature = 0x000A06A4;	/* 06-AA-04 */
	cmd.target_version = target_microcode;
	cmd.flags = 0x00000001;		/* Enable downgrade */

	/* Send command */
	printf("\nSending microcode downgrade command...\n");
	printf("  CPU Signature: 0x%08X (06-AA-04)\n", cmd.cpu_signature);
	printf("  Target Version: 0x%08X\n", cmd.target_version);
	printf("  Flags: 0x%08X (downgrade enabled)\n", cmd.flags);

	ret = write(fd, &cmd, sizeof(cmd));
	if (ret < 0) {
		perror("MEI write failed");
		close(fd);
		return 1;
	}

	printf("✓ Sent %d bytes to ME\n", ret);

	/* Try to read response */
	uint8_t response[256];
	fd_set readfds;
	struct timeval tv;

	FD_ZERO(&readfds);
	FD_SET(fd, &readfds);
	tv.tv_sec = 2;
	tv.tv_usec = 0;

	ret = select(fd + 1, &readfds, NULL, NULL, &tv);
	if (ret > 0) {
		ret = read(fd, response, sizeof(response));
		if (ret > 0) {
			printf("\nME Response (%d bytes):\n", ret);
			for (int i = 0; i < ret && i < 32; i++) {
				printf("%02X ", response[i]);
				if ((i + 1) % 16 == 0) printf("\n");
			}
			printf("\n");

			/* Check for success indicator */
			if (ret >= 2 && response[0] == 0x85 && response[1] == 0x05) {
				printf("\n✅ ME accepted microcode downgrade command!\n");
				printf("Microcode 0x%X will load on next reboot\n", target_microcode);
			}
		}
	} else {
		printf("\n⚠ No immediate response from ME (timeout or async operation)\n");
		printf("Command may have been queued for next boot\n");
	}

	close(fd);

	printf("\n=======================================================================\n");
	printf("NEXT STEPS\n");
	printf("=======================================================================\n");
	printf("1. Reboot the system\n");
	printf("2. Check microcode version:\n");
	printf("   cat /proc/cpuinfo | grep microcode\n");
	printf("3. If it shows 0x%x → SUCCESS!\n", target_microcode);
	printf("4. If still 0x25 → ME may have rejected the command\n");
	printf("=======================================================================\n");

	return 0;
}
