    {UUID_LE(0x42b3ce2f, 0xbd9f, 0x485a, 0x96, 0xae, 0x26, 0x40, 0x62, 0x30, 0xb1, 0xff), "Client 4"},
    {UUID_LE(0x309dcde8, 0xccb1, 0x4062, 0x8f, 0x78, 0x60, 0x01, 0x15, 0xa3, 0x43, 0x27), "Client 5"},
    {UUID_LE(0x55213584, 0x9a29, 0x4916, 0xba, 0xdf, 0x0f, 0xb7, 0xed, 0x68, 0x2a, 0xeb), "Client 6"},
    {UUID_LE(0x0f73db04, 0x97ab, 0x4125, 0xb8, 0x93, 0xe9, 0x04, 0xad, 0x0d, 0x54, 0x64), "Client 7 (GSC Proxy)"},
    {UUID_LE(0x8e6a6715, 0x9abc, 0x4043, 0x88, 0xef, 0x9e, 0x39, 0xc6, 0xf6, 0x3e, 0x0f), "Client 8"},
    {UUID_LE(0x8c2f4425, 0x77d6, 0x4755, 0xac, 0xa3, 0x89, 0x1f, 0xdb, 0xc6, 0x6a, 0x58), "Client 9"},
    {UUID_LE(0xcea154ea, 0x8ff5, 0x4f94, 0x92, 0x90, 0x0b, 0xb7, 0x35, 0x5a, 0x34, 0xdb), "Client 10"},
    {{0}, NULL}  // Sentinel
};

int parse_uuid(const char *uuid_str, uuid_le *uuid) {
    unsigned int a, b, c;
    unsigned char d[8];
    
    if (sscanf(uuid_str, "%08x-%04x-%04x-%02x%02x-%02x%02x%02x%02x%02x%02x",
               &a, &b, &c,
               &d[0], &d[1], &d[2], &d[3], &d[4], &d[5], &d[6], &d[7]) != 11) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    *uuid = UUID_LE(a, b, c, d[0], d[1], d[2], d[3], d[4], d[5], d[6], d[7]);
    return 0;
}

int connect_mei_client(int fd, const uuid_le *uuid, struct mei_client *client_info) {
    struct mei_connect_client_data data;
    
    memcpy(&data.in_client_uuid, uuid, sizeof(uuid_le));
    
    if (ioctl(fd, IOCTL_MEI_CONNECT_CLIENT, &data) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    if (client_info) {
        *client_info = data.out_client_properties;
    }
    
    return 0;
}

int send_heci_message(int fd, const unsigned char *payload, size_t len) {
    if (len > 255) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    // HECI message header: [length(1), reserved(1), host_addr(1), me_addr(1)]
    unsigned char header[4] = {len, 0, 0, 0};
    
    if (write(fd, header, 4) != 4) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    if (len > 0 && write(fd, payload, len) != (ssize_t)len) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    return 0;
}

int read_heci_message(int fd, unsigned char *buffer, size_t max_len) {
    unsigned char header[4];
    size_t payload_len;
    
    if (read(fd, header, 4) != 4) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    payload_len = header[0];
    if (payload_len == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    
    if (payload_len > max_len) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    if (read(fd, buffer, payload_len) != (ssize_t)payload_len) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    return payload_len;
}

unsigned long long read_xcr0(void) {
    FILE *f = popen("rdmsr 0x1D 2>/dev/null", "r");
    if (!f) {
        return 0;
    }
    
    char line[32];
    if (fgets(line, sizeof(line), f)) {
        unsigned long long val = strtoull(line, NULL, 16);
        pclose(f);
        return val;
    }
    
    pclose(f);
    return 0;
}

int test_avx512_execution(void) {
    pid_t pid = fork();
    if (pid == 0) {
        // Child: try to run AVX512 test
        execl("/tmp/test_avx512_execution", "/tmp/test_avx512_execution", (char *)NULL);
        _exit(1);
    } else if (pid > 0) {
        int status;
        waitpid(pid, &status, 0);
        return WIFEXITED(status) && WEXITSTATUS(status) == 0;
    }
    return 0;
}

int test_amx_execution(void) {
    pid_t pid = fork();
    if (pid == 0) {
        // Child: try to run AMX test
        execl("/tmp/test_amx_execution", "/tmp/test_amx_execution", (char *)NULL);
        _exit(1);
    } else if (pid > 0) {
        int status;
        waitpid(pid, &status, 0);
        return WIFEXITED(status) && WEXITSTATUS(status) == 0;
    }
    return 0;
}

void print_banner(const char *title) {
    printf("\n");
    printf("======================================================================\n");
    printf("%s\n", title);
    printf("======================================================================\n");
}

void print_cpu_features(unsigned long long xcr0, int avx512, int amx) {
    printf("  XCR0: 0x%016llX\n", xcr0);
    printf("  AVX512: %s\n", avx512 ? "✓" : "✗");
    printf("  AMX: %s\n", amx ? "✓" : "✗");
}

int test_client_unlock(int fd, const mei_client_t *client) {
    printf("\nTesting unlock commands for: %s\n", client->name);
    printf("  Protocol: %d, Max length: %d bytes\n", 
           client->protocol_version, client->max_len);
    
    // Unlock patterns to test
    struct {
        const char *name;
        unsigned int pattern;
    } patterns[] = {
        {"Engineering Mode", 0xA00A00A0},
        {"Bypass", 0xDEADBEEF},
        {"Unlock", 0x55555555},
        {"Enable", 0xFFFFFFFF},
        {NULL, 0}
    };
    
    for (int i = 0; patterns[i].name; i++) {
        printf("  Testing pattern: %s (0x%08X)\n", 
               patterns[i].name, patterns[i].pattern);
        
        unsigned char payload[4];
        memcpy(payload, &patterns[i].pattern, 4);
        
        if (send_heci_message(fd, payload, 4) < 0) {
            printf("    ✗ Send failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
            continue;
        }
        
        printf("    ✓ Sent %d bytes\n", 4);
        
        // Wait for response
        usleep(200000);  // 200ms
        
        unsigned char response[MAX_MSG_SIZE];
        int resp_len = read_heci_message(fd, response, sizeof(response));
        
        if (resp_len > 0) {
            printf("    ✓ Response: %d bytes\n", resp_len);
            if (resp_len <= 32) {
                printf("      Data: ");
                for (int j = 0; j < resp_len; j++) {
                    printf("%02X ", response[j]);
                }
                printf("\n");
            }
        } else if (resp_len == 0) {
            printf("    ⚠ No response\n");
        } else {
            if (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) {
                printf("    ⚠ No response (would block)\n");
            } else {
                printf("    ✗ Read failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
            }
        }
        
        usleep(100000);  // 100ms between patterns
    }
    
    return 0;
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
    int fd;
    mei_client_t clients[MAX_CLIENTS];
    int client_count = 0;
    unsigned long long xcr0_before, xcr0_after;
    int avx512_before, avx512_after;
    int amx_before, amx_after;
    
    print_banner("HECI Unlock Test - Pure C Implementation");
    
    // Check root
    if (geteuid() != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "✗ Must run as root\n");
        return 1;
    }
    
    // Open device
    fd = open(MEI_DEVICE, O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("open");
        return 1;
    }
    printf("✓ Opened %s (fd=%d)\n", MEI_DEVICE, fd);
    
    // Capture baseline
    print_banner("Baseline CPU Features");
    xcr0_before = read_xcr0();
    avx512_before = test_avx512_execution();
    amx_before = test_amx_execution();
    print_cpu_features(xcr0_before, avx512_before, amx_before);
    
    // Discover and connect to clients
    print_banner("MEI Client Discovery and Connection");
    
    for (int i = 0; known_clients[i].name && client_count < MAX_CLIENTS; i++) {
        mei_client_t *client = &clients[client_count];
        client->name = known_clients[i].name;
        client->uuid = known_clients[i].uuid;
        
        // Try to connect (need fresh fd for each connection attempt)
        close(fd);
        fd = open(MEI_DEVICE, O_RDWR);
        if (fd < 0) {
            perror("reopen for client");
            continue;
        }
        
        struct mei_client client_info;
        if (connect_mei_client(fd, &client->uuid, &client_info) == 0) {
            client->connected = 1;
            client->protocol_version = client_info.protocol_version;
            client->max_len = client_info.max_msg_length;
            printf("✓ Connected to %s\n", client->name);
            printf("    Protocol: %d, Max length: %d bytes\n", 
                   client->protocol_version, client->max_len);
            client_count++;
        } else {
            printf("✗ Failed to connect: %s (%s)\n", 
                   client->name, strerror(errno));
        }
    }
    
    printf("\nTotal clients connected: %d\n", client_count);
    
    if (client_count == 0) {
        printf("✗ No clients connected, cannot proceed\n");
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }
    
    // Test unlock commands on each connected client
    print_banner("Unlock Command Testing");
    
    for (int i = 0; i < client_count; i++) {
        if (!clients[i].connected) {
            continue;
        }
        
        // Reconnect (ioctl must be done on fresh connection)
        close(fd);
        fd = open(MEI_DEVICE, O_RDWR);
        if (fd < 0) {
            perror("reopen");
            continue;
        }
        
        struct mei_client client_info;
        if (connect_mei_client(fd, &clients[i].uuid, &client_info) < 0) {
            printf("✗ Failed to reconnect to client %d\n", i);
            continue;
        }
        
        test_client_unlock(fd, &clients[i]);
        
        usleep(500000);  // 500ms between clients
    }
    
    // Check for CPU feature changes
    print_banner("Post-Test CPU Features");
    xcr0_after = read_xcr0();
    avx512_after = test_avx512_execution();
    amx_after = test_amx_execution();
    print_cpu_features(xcr0_after, avx512_after, amx_after);
    
    // Compare
    print_banner("Change Detection");
    int xcr0_changed = (xcr0_after != xcr0_before);
    int avx512_changed = (avx512_before != avx512_after);
    int amx_changed = (amx_before != amx_after);
    
    printf("  XCR0: %s\n", xcr0_changed ? "CHANGED ⚠⚠⚠" : "unchanged");
    printf("  AVX512: %s\n", avx512_changed ? "CHANGED ⚠⚠⚠" : "unchanged");
    printf("  AMX: %s\n", amx_changed ? "CHANGED ⚠⚠⚠" : "unchanged");
    
    if (xcr0_changed || avx512_changed || amx_changed) {
        printf("\n⚠⚠⚠ HECI UNLOCK EFFECTS DETECTED ⚠⚠⚠\n");
    }
    
    close(fd);
    
    print_banner("Test Complete");
    printf("Clients tested: %d\n", client_count);
    printf("Unlock patterns tested: 4 per client\n");
    
    return 0;
}

/*
 * HECI Connect Client - C Helper Program
 * Connects to MEI client and returns connection info
 * Usage: heci_connect_client <uuid>
 */

#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/mei.h>
#include <linux/mei_uuid.h>
#include <errno.h>

int parse_uuid(const char *uuid_str, uuid_le *uuid) {
    unsigned int a, b, c;
    unsigned char d[8];
    
    if (sscanf(uuid_str, "%08x-%04x-%04x-%02x%02x-%02x%02x%02x%02x%02x%02x",
               &a, &b, &c,
               &d[0], &d[1], &d[2], &d[3], &d[4], &d[5], &d[6], &d[7]) != 11) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    *uuid = UUID_LE(a, b, c, d[0], d[1], d[2], d[3], d[4], d[5], d[6], d[7]);
    return 0;
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
    const char *device = "/dev/mei0";
    int fd;
    struct mei_connect_client_data data;
    int ret;
    
    if (argc < 2) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Usage: %s <uuid>\n", argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }
    
    // Parse UUID
    if (parse_uuid(argv[1], &data.in_client_uuid) < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Invalid UUID format\n");
        return 1;
    }
    
    // Open device
    fd = open(device, O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "FAILED:open:%d\n", errno);
        return 1;
    }
    
    // Call ioctl
    ret = ioctl(fd, IOCTL_MEI_CONNECT_CLIENT, &data);
    
    if (ret < 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "FAILED:ioctl:%d\n", errno);
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }
    
    // Success - output protocol version and max message length
    printf("SUCCESS:%u:%u\n", 
           data.out_client_properties.protocol_version,
           data.out_client_properties.max_msg_length);
    
    // Keep fd open briefly for message testing
    // In practice, the calling process would keep this fd
    close(fd);
    return 0;
}

/*
 * HECI IOCTL Test - C Implementation
 * Tests MEI client connection using proper kernel structures
 */

#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/mei.h>
#include <linux/mei_uuid.h>
#include <errno.h>

int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
    const char *device = "/dev/mei0";
    int fd;
    struct mei_connect_client_data data;
    int ret;
    
    printf("======================================================================\n");
    printf("HECI IOCTL Test - C Implementation\n");
    printf("======================================================================\n\n");
    
    // Open device
    fd = open(device, O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("open");
        return 1;
    }
    printf("✓ Opened %s (fd=%d)\n\n", device, fd);
    
    // Test with first client UUID from sysfs
    // UUID: 6861ec7b-d07a-4673-856c-7f22b4d55769
    uuid_le test_uuid = UUID_LE(0x6861ec7b, 0xd07a, 0x4673, 
                                 0x85, 0x6c, 0x7f, 0x22, 0xb4, 0xd5, 0x57, 0x69);
    
    // Set input UUID
    memcpy(&data.in_client_uuid, &test_uuid, sizeof(uuid_le));
    
    printf("Attempting ioctl connect...\n");
    printf("  UUID: 6861ec7b-d07a-4673-856c-7f22b4d55769\n");
    printf("  IOCTL: IOCTL_MEI_CONNECT_CLIENT (0x%08X)\n", IOCTL_MEI_CONNECT_CLIENT);
    printf("  Structure size: %zu bytes\n\n", sizeof(data));
    
    // Call ioctl
    ret = ioctl(fd, IOCTL_MEI_CONNECT_CLIENT, &data);
    
    if (ret < 0) {
        printf("✗ ioctl failed: %s (errno %d)\n", strerror(errno), errno);
        if (errno == 25) {
            printf("  → ENOTTY: Inappropriate ioctl for device\n");
            printf("  → May indicate:\n");
            printf("    - Wrong ioctl number\n");
            printf("    - Structure format mismatch\n");
            printf("    - Device not ready\n");
        } else if (errno == 19) {
            printf("  → ENODEV: No such device\n");
            printf("  → Client may not be available\n");
        }
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }
    
    printf("✓ ioctl succeeded!\n");
    printf("  Protocol version: %u\n", data.out_client_properties.protocol_version);
    printf("  Max message length: %u bytes\n", data.out_client_properties.max_msg_length);
    
    // Try to read/write
    printf("\nTesting read/write...\n");
    unsigned char test_msg[] = {0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00};
    ssize_t written = write(fd, test_msg, sizeof(test_msg));
    if (written < 0) {
        printf("  ✗ Write failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
    } else {
        printf("  ✓ Wrote %zd bytes\n", written);
    }
    
    close(fd);
    return 0;
}

/*
 * HECI Coordinated Unlock - Multi-Device Coordination
 * Coordinates VSEC, GNA, Ethernet, and HECI unlocks in proper sequence
 * Tests CPU feature changes after coordinated unlock
 */

#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <linux/mei.h>
#include <linux/mei_uuid.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <sys/wait.h>

#define MEI_DEVICE "/dev/mei0"
#define VSEC_BASE 0x5019240000ULL
#define VSEC_SIZE 0x40000
#define GNA_BASE 0x5019200000ULL
#define GNA_SIZE 0x10000
#define ETH_BASE 0x7c100000ULL
#define ETH_SIZE 0x20000

// Use clients we successfully connected to earlier
// Client 0, 1, 6, 8 showed good response patterns
#define CLIENT_0_GUID UUID_LE(0x6861ec7b, 0xd07a, 0x4673, 0x85, 0x6c, 0x7f, 0x22, 0xb4, 0xd5, 0x57, 0x69)
#define CLIENT_1_GUID UUID_LE(0xdd17041c, 0x09ea, 0x4b17, 0xa2, 0x71, 0x5b, 0x98, 0x98, 0x67, 0xec, 0x65)
#define CLIENT_6_GUID UUID_LE(0x55213584, 0x9a29, 0x4916, 0xba, 0xdf, 0x0f, 0xb7, 0xed, 0x68, 0x2a, 0xeb)

unsigned long long read_xcr0(void) {
    FILE *f = popen("rdmsr 0x1D 2>/dev/null", "r");
    if (!f) return 0;
    char line[32];
    if (fgets(line, sizeof(line), f)) {
        unsigned long long val = strtoull(line, NULL, 16);
        pclose(f);
        return val;
    }
    pclose(f);
    return 0;
}

int test_avx512_execution(void) {

        _exit(1);

    if (pid == 0) {

        _exit(1);

void print_cpu_features(const char *label, unsigned long long xcr0, int avx512, int amx) {
    printf("\n%s\n", label);
    printf("  XCR0: 0x%016llX\n", xcr0);
    printf("  AVX512: %s\n", avx512 ? "✓" : "✗");
    printf("  AMX: %s\n", amx ? "✓" : "✗");
}

int unlock_vsec(void) {
    printf("\n[1] VSEC/PMT Unlock\n");
    
    int mem_fd = open("/dev/mem", O_RDWR | O_SYNC);
    if (mem_fd < 0) {
        printf("  ✗ Failed to open /dev/mem: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return -1;
    }
    
    void *vsec_mmio = mmap(NULL, VSEC_SIZE, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, mem_fd, VSEC_BASE);
    if (vsec_mmio == MAP_FAILED) {
        printf("  ✗ Failed to mmap VSEC: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        close(mem_fd);
        return -1;
    }
    
    // Read current values
    uint32_t reg0 = *(volatile uint32_t *)(vsec_mmio + 0x0000);
    uint32_t regC = *(volatile uint32_t *)(vsec_mmio + 0x000C);
    
    printf("  Current: 0x0000=0x%08X, 0x000C=0x%08X\n", reg0, regC);
    
    // Write unlock patterns
    *(volatile uint32_t *)(vsec_mmio + 0x0000) = 0xDEADBEEF;
    *(volatile uint32_t *)(vsec_mmio + 0x000C) = 0xDEADBEEF;
    
    usleep(100000);  // 100ms
    
    // Verify
    reg0 = *(volatile uint32_t *)(vsec_mmio + 0x0000);
    regC = *(volatile uint32_t *)(vsec_mmio + 0x000C);
    
    printf("  After: 0x0000=0x%08X, 0x000C=0x%08X\n", reg0, regC);
    
    if (reg0 == 0xDEADBEEF && regC == 0xDEADBEEF) {
        printf("  ✓ VSEC unlock successful\n");
        munmap(vsec_mmio, VSEC_SIZE);
        close(mem_fd);
        return 0;
    } else {
        printf("  ✗ VSEC unlock failed\n");
        munmap(vsec_mmio, VSEC_SIZE);
        close(mem_fd);
        return -1;
    }
}

int unlock_gna(void) {
    printf("\n[2] GNA Unlock\n");
    
    int mem_fd = open("/dev/mem", O_RDWR | O_SYNC);
    if (mem_fd < 0) {
        printf("  ✗ Failed to open /dev/mem: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return -1;
    }
    
    void *gna_mmio = mmap(NULL, GNA_SIZE, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, mem_fd, GNA_BASE);
    if (gna_mmio == MAP_FAILED) {
        printf("  ✗ Failed to mmap GNA: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        close(mem_fd);
        return -1;
    }
    
    // Write unlock to feature control
    *(volatile uint32_t *)(gna_mmio + 0x0100) = 0xFFFFFFFF;
    *(volatile uint32_t *)(gna_mmio + 0x00B0) = 0xA00A00A0;
    
    usleep(100000);
    
    uint32_t status = *(volatile uint32_t *)(gna_mmio + 0x0104);
    printf("  GNA Status: 0x%08X\n", status);
    printf("  ✓ GNA unlock attempted\n");
    
    munmap(gna_mmio, GNA_SIZE);
    close(mem_fd);
    return 0;
}

int unlock_ethernet(void) {
    printf("\n[3] Ethernet Controller Unlock\n");
    
    int mem_fd = open("/dev/mem", O_RDWR | O_SYNC);
    if (mem_fd < 0) {
        printf("  ✗ Failed to open /dev/mem: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        return -1;
    }
    
    void *eth_mmio = mmap(NULL, ETH_SIZE, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED, mem_fd, ETH_BASE);
    if (eth_mmio == MAP_FAILED) {
        printf("  ✗ Failed to mmap Ethernet: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        close(mem_fd);
        return -1;
    }
    
    // Write to key registers
    *(volatile uint32_t *)(eth_mmio + 0x0200) = 0xA00A00A0;  // Engineering mode
    *(volatile uint32_t *)(eth_mmio + 0x0024) = 0xDEADBEEF;  // Bypass
    
    usleep(100000);
    
    printf("  ✓ Ethernet unlock attempted\n");
    
    munmap(eth_mmio, ETH_SIZE);
    close(mem_fd);
    return 0;
}

int unlock_heci_clients(int fd) {
    printf("\n[4] HECI Client Unlock (Multiple Clients)\n");
    
    uuid_le test_clients[] = {CLIENT_0_GUID, CLIENT_1_GUID, CLIENT_6_GUID};
    const char *names[] = {"Client 0", "Client 1", "Client 6"};
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        printf("  Testing %s...\n", names[i]);
        
        // Reconnect for each client
        close(fd);
        fd = open(MEI_DEVICE, O_RDWR);
        if (fd < 0) {
            printf("    ✗ Failed to reopen device\n");
            continue;
        }
        
        struct mei_connect_client_data data;
        memcpy(&data.in_client_uuid, &test_clients[i], sizeof(uuid_le));
        
        if (ioctl(fd, IOCTL_MEI_CONNECT_CLIENT, &data) < 0) {
            printf("    ✗ Failed to connect: %s\n", strerror(errno));
            continue;
        }
        
        printf("    ✓ Connected\n");
        
        // Send unlock patterns
        uint32_t patterns[] = {0xA00A00A0, 0xDEADBEEF, 0x55555555, 0xFFFFFFFF};
        const char *pattern_names[] = {"Engineering", "Bypass", "Unlock", "Enable"};
        
        for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
            unsigned char header[4] = {4, 0, 0, 0};
            write(fd, header, 4);
            write(fd, &patterns[j], 4);
            usleep(100000);
        }
        
        printf("    ✓ Sent unlock patterns\n");
    }
    
    return 0;
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
    int fd;
    unsigned long long xcr0_before, xcr0_after;
    int avx512_before, avx512_after;
    int amx_before, amx_after;
    
    printf("======================================================================\n");
    printf("HECI Coordinated Unlock - Multi-Device Sequence\n");
    printf("======================================================================\n");
    
    if (geteuid() != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "✗ Must run as root\n");
        return 1;
    }
    
    // Baseline
    print_cpu_features("Baseline CPU Features", 
                       xcr0_before = read_xcr0(),
                       avx512_before = test_avx512_execution(),
                       amx_before = test_amx_execution());
    
    // Step 1: Hardware unlocks first
    unlock_vsec();
    usleep(200000);
    
    unlock_gna();
    usleep(200000);
    
    unlock_ethernet();
    usleep(200000);
    
    // Step 2: HECI unlocks
    fd = open(MEI_DEVICE, O_RDWR);
    if (fd >= 0) {
        unlock_heci_clients(fd);
        close(fd);
    }
    
    // Wait for effects
    printf("\nWaiting 2 seconds for unlock effects...\n");
    sleep(2);
    
    // Check results
    print_cpu_features("Post-Unlock CPU Features",
                       xcr0_after = read_xcr0(),
                       avx512_after = test_avx512_execution(),
                       amx_after = test_amx_execution());
    
    // Compare
    printf("\n======================================================================\n");
    printf("Change Detection\n");
    printf("======================================================================\n");
    
    int xcr0_changed = (xcr0_after != xcr0_before);
    int avx512_changed = (avx512_before != avx512_after);
    int amx_changed = (amx_before != amx_after);
    
    printf("  XCR0: %s\n", xcr0_changed ? "CHANGED ⚠⚠⚠" : "unchanged");
    printf("  AVX512: %s\n", avx512_changed ? "CHANGED ⚠⚠⚠" : "unchanged");
    printf("  AMX: %s\n", amx_changed ? "CHANGED ⚠⚠⚠" : "unchanged");
    
    if (xcr0_changed || avx512_changed || amx_changed) {
        printf("\n⚠⚠⚠ COORDINATED UNLOCK EFFECTS DETECTED ⚠⚠⚠\n");
    }
    
    printf("\n======================================================================\n");
    printf("Coordinated Unlock Complete\n");
    printf("======================================================================\n");
    
    return 0;
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
HECI Protocol Initialization via Driver Interface
Uses mei_me driver to properly initialize HECI protocol
"""

import os
import sys
import mmap
import struct
import time
import fcntl

HECI_BASE = 0x50192dd000
HECI_SIZE = 0x1000

# Try to find HECI device file
HECI_DEVICES = [
    "/dev/mei0",
    "/dev/mei1",
    "/dev/mei2",
    "/dev/mei3",
]

def find_heci_device():
    """Find available HECI device file"""
    for dev in HECI_DEVICES:
        if os.path.exists(dev):
            return dev
    return None

def init_heci_via_driver():
    """Initialize HECI via driver interface"""
    print("Attempting HECI initialization via driver interface...")
    
    heci_dev = find_heci_device()
    if not heci_dev:
        print("  ✗ No /dev/mei* device found")
        print("  → Driver may not be loaded or device not available")
        return False
    
    print(f"  Found HECI device: {heci_dev}")
    
    try:
        # Open HECI device
        fd = os.open(heci_dev, os.O_RDWR)
        print(f"  ✓ Opened {heci_dev}")
        
        # Try to read from device (this may initialize it)
        try:
            data = os.read(fd, 64)
            print(f"  ✓ Read {len(data)} bytes from device")
            if len(data) > 0:
                print(f"  Data: {data.hex()}")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  ⚠ Read failed: {e} (may be normal)")
        
        # Try to write initialization command
        # HECI protocol typically requires specific message format
        try:
            # Placeholder for actual HECI protocol message
            # Real implementation would use proper HECI message format
            init_msg = bytes([0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00])
            os.write(fd, init_msg)
            print(f"  ✓ Wrote initialization message")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  ⚠ Write failed: {e}")
        
        os.close(fd)
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  ✗ Failed to access device: {e}")
        return False

def init_heci_via_mmio_with_driver_bound():
    """Initialize HECI via MMIO while driver is bound"""
    print("\nAttempting HECI initialization via MMIO (driver bound)...")
    
    # Map HECI MMIO
    try:
        mem_fd = os.open('/dev/mem', os.O_RDWR | os.O_SYNC)
        mmio = mmap.mmap(mem_fd, HECI_SIZE, mmap.MAP_SHARED, 
                        mmap.PROT_READ | mmap.PROT_WRITE, offset=HECI_BASE)
        os.close(mem_fd)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  ✗ Failed to map MMIO: {e}")
        return False
    
    # Read initial state
    mmio.seek(0x00)
    hcs_before = struct.unpack('<I', mmio.read(4))[0]
    print(f"  HCS before: 0x{hcs_before:08X}")
    
    # With driver bound, try different approach
    # Maybe driver has initialized it differently
    mmio.seek(0x00)
    hcs_after = struct.unpack('<I', mmio.read(4))[0]
    print(f"  HCS after: 0x{hcs_after:08X}")
    
    if (hcs_after & 0x1) != 0:
        print("  ✓ HECI Ready!")
        mmio.close()
        return True
    
    mmio.close()
    return False

def check_heci_status():
    """Check current HECI status"""
    print("\nCurrent HECI Status:")
    print("-" * 70)
    
    # Check if driver is loaded
    try:
        with open('/proc/modules', 'r') as f:
            modules = f.read()
            if 'mei_me' in modules:
                print("  ✓ mei_me driver is loaded")
            else:
                print("  ✗ mei_me driver not loaded")
    except:
        pass
    
    # Check device files
    heci_dev = find_heci_device()
    if heci_dev:
        print(f"  ✓ HECI device found: {heci_dev}")
        try:
            stat = os.stat(heci_dev)
            print(f"    Permissions: {oct(stat.st_mode)[-3:]}")
        except:
            pass
    else:
        print("  ✗ No HECI device files found")
    
    # Check MMIO status
    try:
        mem_fd = os.open('/dev/mem', os.O_RDWR | os.O_SYNC)
        mmio = mmap.mmap(mem_fd, HECI_SIZE, mmap.MAP_SHARED, 
                        mmap.PROT_READ | mmap.PROT_WRITE, offset=HECI_BASE)
        os.close(mem_fd)
        
        mmio.seek(0x00)
        hcs = struct.unpack('<I', mmio.read(4))[0]
        mmio.seek(0x04)
        his = struct.unpack('<I', mmio.read(4))[0]
        
        print(f"  HCS: 0x{hcs:08X} (Ready: {bool(hcs & 0x1)}, ME Ready: {bool(hcs & 0x80000000)})")
        print(f"  HIS: 0x{his:08X} (Interrupt Pending: {bool(his & 0x80000000)})")
        
        mmio.close()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  ✗ Failed to read MMIO: {e}")

def main():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("HECI Protocol Initialization")
    print("=" * 70)
    
    if os.geteuid() != 0:
        print("\n✗ Must run as root")
        return 1
    
    # Check current status
    check_heci_status()
    
    # Try driver interface
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("Method 1: Driver Interface")
    print("=" * 70)
    driver_init = init_heci_via_driver()
    
    # Try MMIO with driver
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("Method 2: MMIO with Driver Bound")
    print("=" * 70)
    mmio_init = init_heci_via_mmio_with_driver_bound()
    
    # Final status check
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("Final Status Check")
    print("=" * 70)
    check_heci_status()
    
    if driver_init or mmio_init:
        print("\n✓ HECI initialization successful!")
        return 0
    else:
        print("\n✗ HECI initialization failed")
        print("  May require:")
        print("    - ME firmware interaction")
        print("    - UEFI shell access")
        print("    - Specific HECI protocol commands")
        return 1

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
HECI List Available ME Clients
Discovers available Management Engine clients via HECI protocol
"""

import os
import sys
import struct
import time

MEI_DEVICE = "/dev/mei0"

# ME Client IDs (known)
ME_CLIENTS = {
    0x00: "PCH",
    0x01: "AMT",
    0x02: "DEBUG",
    0x03: "MKHI",
    0x04: "ICC",
    0x05: "THERMAL",
    0x06: "POWER",
    0x07: "FWU",
    0x08: "IPU",
    0x09: "ISH",
    0x0A: "TBT",
    0x0B: "HDCP",
    0x0C: "PAVP",
    0x0D: "MCA",
    0x0E: "DEBUG_TRACE",
    0x0F: "DEBUG_TRACE_EXT",
}

def read_heci_message(fd):
    """Read HECI message from MEI device"""
    try:
        header = os.read(fd, 4)
        if len(header) < 4:
            return None
        length, reserved, host_addr, me_addr = struct.unpack('BBBB', header)
        if length > 0:
            payload = os.read(fd, length)
            return {'length': length, 'me_addr': me_addr, 'payload': payload}
        return {'length': 0, 'me_addr': me_addr, 'payload': b''}
    except OSError as e:
        if e.errno == 11:  # EAGAIN
            return None
        raise

def write_heci_message(fd, client_id, payload):
    """Write HECI message to MEI device"""
    length = len(payload)
    if length > 255:
        raise ValueError(f"Message too long: {length}")
    header = struct.pack('BBBB', length, 0, 0, client_id)
    os.write(fd, header + payload)
    return length + 4

def test_client_connection(fd, client_id):
    """Test if ME client is available"""
    try:
        # Try to connect (send minimal message)
        connect_payload = b'\x00' * 8
        written = write_heci_message(fd, client_id, connect_payload)
        time.sleep(0.1)
        
        # Try to read response
        response = read_heci_message(fd)
        return response is not None
    except:
        return False

def main():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("HECI ME Client Discovery")
    print("=" * 70)
    
    if os.geteuid() != 0:
        print("\n✗ Must run as root")
        return 1
    
    if not os.path.exists(MEI_DEVICE):
        print(f"\n✗ MEI device not found: {MEI_DEVICE}")
        print("  → Load mei_me driver: modprobe mei_me")
        return 1
    
    print(f"\n✓ Found MEI device: {MEI_DEVICE}")
    
    try:
        fd = os.open(MEI_DEVICE, os.O_RDWR | os.O_NONBLOCK)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"\n✗ Failed to open device: {e}")
        return 1
    
    print("\n[1] Testing known ME clients...")
    print("-" * 70)
    
    available_clients = []
    
    for client_id, name in sorted(ME_CLIENTS.items()):
        print(f"  Testing 0x{client_id:02X} ({name})...", end=' ')
        if test_client_connection(fd, client_id):
            print("✓ Available")
            available_clients.append((client_id, name))
        else:
            print("✗ Not available")
        time.sleep(0.05)
    
    print(f"\n[2] Scanning for additional clients...")
    print("-" * 70)
    
    # Scan all possible client IDs
    found_clients = []
    for client_id in range(0x10, 0x100):
        if test_client_connection(fd, client_id):
            found_clients.append(client_id)
            print(f"  Found unknown client: 0x{client_id:02X}")
        time.sleep(0.01)
    
    print(f"\n{'='*70}")
    print("Results")
    print("=" * 70)
    print(f"\nAvailable known clients: {len(available_clients)}")
    for client_id, name in available_clients:
        print(f"  0x{client_id:02X}: {name}")
    
    if found_clients:
        print(f"\nUnknown clients found: {len(found_clients)}")
        for client_id in found_clients:
            print(f"  0x{client_id:02X}: Unknown")
    
    os.close(fd)
    
    return 0

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
HECI IOCTL Connect - Fixed Implementation
Uses correct union structure from Linux kernel headers
"""

import os
import sys
import glob
import struct
import fcntl
import time
import subprocess
import json
from ctypes import *

MEI_DEVICE = "/dev/mei0"

# IOCTL definition from /usr/include/linux/mei.h
# IOCTL_MEI_CONNECT_CLIENT = _IOWR('H', 0x01, struct mei_connect_client_data)
# _IOWR(type, nr, size) calculation:
# type = 'H' = 0x48
# nr = 0x01
# size = 16 (union size - max of uuid_le (16) and mei_client (8))
# _IOWR = (16 << 16) | (0x48 << 8) | 0x01 | 0x40000000 | 0x80000000
# = 0x00100000 | 0x00004800 | 0x00000001 | 0xC0000000
# = 0xC0104801

IOCTL_MEI_CONNECT_CLIENT = 0xC0104801

def check_msr_xcr0():
    """Check XCR0 MSR"""
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(['rdmsr', '0x1D'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
        if result.returncode == 0:
            return int(result.stdout.strip(), 16)
    except:
        pass
    return None

def run_direct_execution_test(test_binary):
    """Run direct execution test and return results"""
    try:
        result = subprocess.run([test_binary], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
        return {
            'returncode': result.returncode,
            'success': result.returncode == 0 and 'Illegal instruction' not in result.stderr
        }
    except:
        return {'success': False}

def compile_test_binaries():
    """Compile AVX512 and AMX test binaries if needed"""
    avx512_bin = '/tmp/test_avx512_execution'
    amx_bin = '/tmp/test_amx_execution'
    
    script_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
    unlock_dir = os.path.dirname(script_dir)
    common_dir = os.path.join(unlock_dir, 'common')
    
    if not os.path.exists(avx512_bin):
        source = os.path.join(common_dir, 'test_avx512_execution.c')
        if os.path.exists(source):
            subprocess.run(['gcc', '-mavx512f', '-mavx512bw', '-mavx512vl', 
                          '-o', avx512_bin, source], 
                         capture_output=True)
    
    if not os.path.exists(amx_bin):
        source = os.path.join(common_dir, 'test_amx_execution.c')
        if os.path.exists(source):
            subprocess.run(['gcc', '-mamx-tile', '-mamx-int8', 
                          '-o', amx_bin, source], 
                         capture_output=True)
    
    return avx512_bin, amx_bin

def uuid_to_bytes(uuid_str):
    """Convert UUID string to bytes (remove dashes)"""
    return bytes.fromhex(uuid_str.replace('-', ''))

def get_mei_clients():
    """Get list of available MEI clients from sysfs"""
    clients = []
    for path in glob.glob('/sys/bus/mei/devices/*'):
        uuid_file = os.path.join(path, 'uuid')
        max_len_file = os.path.join(path, 'max_len')
        
        if os.path.exists(uuid_file):
            with open(uuid_file, 'r') as f:
                uuid = f.read().strip()
            
            max_len = 0
            if os.path.exists(max_len_file):
                with open(max_len_file, 'r') as f:
                    max_len = int(f.read().strip())
            
            clients.append({
                'uuid': uuid,
                'uuid_bytes': uuid_to_bytes(uuid),
                'max_len': max_len,
                'path': path
            })
    
    return clients

# Structure definitions based on /usr/include/linux/mei.h
# struct mei_client {
#     __u32 max_msg_length;
#     __u8 protocol_version;
#     __u8 reserved[3];
# };
class MeiClient(Structure):
    _pack_ = 1
    _fields_ = [
        ('max_msg_length', c_uint32),
        ('protocol_version', c_ubyte),
        ('reserved', c_ubyte * 3),
    ]

# struct mei_connect_client_data {
#     union {
#         uuid_le in_client_uuid;  // 16 bytes
#         struct mei_client out_client_properties;  // 8 bytes
#     };
# };
# This is a UNION - same memory location for input and output
# Size is 16 bytes (max of the two)
class MeiConnectClientData(Union):
    _pack_ = 1
    _fields_ = [
        ('in_client_uuid', c_ubyte * 16),  # Input: UUID (16 bytes)
        ('out_client_properties', MeiClient),  # Output: Client properties (8 bytes)
    ]

def connect_to_client(fd, client_uuid_bytes):
    """Connect to ME client using ioctl with correct union structure"""
    data = MeiConnectClientData()
    
    # Set input UUID (16 bytes)
    for i in range(16):
        if i < len(client_uuid_bytes):
            data.in_client_uuid[i] = client_uuid_bytes[i]
        else:
            data.in_client_uuid[i] = 0
    
    try:
        # Call ioctl - this will overwrite the union with output
        result = fcntl.ioctl(fd, IOCTL_MEI_CONNECT_CLIENT, data)
        
        # After ioctl, the union contains out_client_properties
        max_msg_length = data.out_client_properties.max_msg_length
        protocol_version = data.out_client_properties.protocol_version
        
        return {
            'success': True,
            'protocol_version': protocol_version,
            'max_msg_length': max_msg_length
        }
    except OSError as e:
        return {
            'success': False,
            'error': str(e),
            'errno': e.errno
        }

def read_heci_message(fd):
    """Read HECI message from connected client"""
    try:
        header = os.read(fd, 4)
        if len(header) < 4:
            return None
        length, reserved, host_addr, me_addr = struct.unpack('BBBB', header)
        if length > 0:
            payload = os.read(fd, length)
            return {'length': length, 'me_addr': me_addr, 'payload': payload}
        return {'length': 0, 'me_addr': me_addr, 'payload': b''}
    except OSError as e:
        if e.errno == 11:  # EAGAIN
            return None
        raise

def write_heci_message(fd, payload):
    """Write HECI message to connected client"""
    length = len(payload)
    if length > 255:
        raise ValueError(f"Message too long: {length}")
    # When connected via ioctl, driver handles header
    os.write(fd, payload)
    return length

def main():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("HECI IOCTL Connect - Fixed Implementation")
    print("=" * 70)
    
    if os.geteuid() != 0:
        print("\n✗ Must run as root")
        return 1
    
    # Compile test binaries
    print("\n[1] Compiling direct execution tests...")
    avx512_bin, amx_bin = compile_test_binaries()
    
    # Baseline
    print("\n[2] Capturing baseline state...")
    xcr0_before = check_msr_xcr0()
    avx512_before = run_direct_execution_test(avx512_bin)
    amx_before = run_direct_execution_test(amx_bin)
    print(f"  XCR0: {f'0x{xcr0_before:016X}' if xcr0_before else 'N/A'}")
    print(f"  AVX512: {'✓' if avx512_before['success'] else '✗'}")
    print(f"  AMX: {'✓' if amx_before['success'] else '✗'}")
    
    # Get available clients
    print("\n[3] Discovering MEI clients from sysfs...")
    clients = get_mei_clients()
    print(f"  Found {len(clients)} MEI clients")
    
    if not clients:
        print("  ✗ No MEI clients found")
        return 1
    
    if not os.path.exists(MEI_DEVICE):
        print(f"\n✗ MEI device not found: {MEI_DEVICE}")
        return 1
    
    results = {
        'baseline': {
            'xcr0': f'0x{xcr0_before:016X}' if xcr0_before else None,
            'avx512_success': avx512_before['success'],
            'amx_success': amx_before['success']
        },
        'connections': []
    }
    
    # Try connecting to each client
    print(f"\n{'='*70}")
    print("[4] Attempting Client Connections (with UNION structure)")
    print('='*70)
    
    for client in clients[:5]:  # Try first 5 clients
        uuid = client['uuid']
        uuid_bytes = client['uuid_bytes']
        max_len = client['max_len']
        
        print(f"\nConnecting to: {uuid}")
        print(f"  Expected max_len: {max_len} bytes")
        
        # Open fresh fd for each client
        try:
            fd = os.open(MEI_DEVICE, os.O_RDWR)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  ✗ Failed to open device: {e}")
            continue
        
        try:
            result = connect_to_client(fd, uuid_bytes)
            
            if result['success']:
                print(f"  ✓ Connected!")
                print(f"    Protocol version: {result.get('protocol_version', 'N/A')}")
                print(f"    Max message length: {result.get('max_msg_length', 'N/A')} bytes")
                
                # Try sending a test message
                print(f"  Testing message send...")
                try:
                    test_payload = b'\x00' * 8
                    written = write_heci_message(fd, test_payload)
                    print(f"    ✓ Sent {written} bytes")
                    
                    time.sleep(0.2)
                    response = read_heci_message(fd)
                    if response:
                        print(f"    ✓ Response: {len(response['payload'])} bytes")
                        if len(response['payload']) > 0:
                            print(f"      Data: {response['payload'].hex()[:64]}")
                    else:
                        print(f"    ⚠ No response")
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"    ⚠ Message send failed: {e}")
                
                results['connections'].append({
                    'uuid': uuid,
                    'connected': True,
                    'protocol_version': result.get('protocol_version'),
                    'max_msg_length': result.get('max_msg_length')
                })
            else:
                print(f"  ✗ Failed: {result.get('error', 'Unknown error')}")
                print(f"    Error code: {result.get('errno', 'N/A')}")
                results['connections'].append({
                    'uuid': uuid,
                    'connected': False,
                    'error': result.get('error'),
                    'errno': result.get('errno')
                })
        finally:
            os.close(fd)
        
        time.sleep(0.1)
    
    # Check for CPU feature changes
    print(f"\n{'='*70}")
    print("[5] Checking for CPU Feature Changes")
    print('='*70)
    
    xcr0_after = check_msr_xcr0()
    avx512_after = run_direct_execution_test(avx512_bin)
    amx_after = run_direct_execution_test(amx_bin)
    
    xcr0_changed = (xcr0_after and xcr0_after != xcr0_before)
    avx512_changed = (avx512_before['success'] != avx512_after['success'])
    amx_changed = (amx_before['success'] != amx_after['success'])
    
    print(f"  XCR0: {f'0x{xcr0_after:016X}' if xcr0_after else 'N/A'} ({'CHANGED' if xcr0_changed else 'unchanged'})")
    print(f"  AVX512: {'✓' if avx512_after['success'] else '✗'} ({'CHANGED' if avx512_changed else 'unchanged'})")
    print(f"  AMX: {'✓' if amx_after['success'] else '✗'} ({'CHANGED' if amx_changed else 'unchanged'})")
    
    results['after'] = {
        'xcr0': f'0x{xcr0_after:016X}' if xcr0_after else None,
        'xcr0_changed': xcr0_changed,
        'avx512_changed': avx512_changed,
        'amx_changed': amx_changed
    }
    
    if xcr0_changed or avx512_changed or amx_changed:
        print(f"\n  ⚠⚠⚠ HECI CLIENT CONNECTION EFFECTS DETECTED ⚠⚠⚠")
    
    # Save results
    output_file = '/tmp/heci_ioctl_fixed_results.json'
    with open(output_file, 'w') as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
    
    print(f"\n{'='*70}")
    print("Test Complete")
    print("=" * 70)
    print(f"Results saved to: {output_file}")
    
    # Summary
    successful = [c for c in results['connections'] if c.get('connected', False)]
    print(f"\nSummary:")
    print(f"  Clients tested: {len(results['connections'])}")
    print(f"  Successful connections: {len(successful)}")
    if successful:
        print(f"  Connected clients:")
        for conn in successful:
            print(f"    - {conn['uuid']}")
    
    return 0

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
HECI Protocol Communication Test
Attempts to communicate with Management Engine via HECI protocol
"""

import os
import sys
import mmap
import struct
import time

HECI_BASE = 0x50192dd000
HECI_SIZE = 0x1000

# HECI Register Offsets
HECI_HCS = 0x00
HECI_HIS = 0x04
HECI_HICR = 0x08
HECI_HIIDR = 0x0C
HECI_HIMR = 0x10

# HECI HCS bits
HCS_READY = 0x1
HCS_START = 0x2
HCS_RESET = 0x4
HCS_IG = 0x8
HCS_IS = 0x10
HCS_BUF_SIZE_MASK = 0x7FF0000
HCS_ME_RDY = 0x80000000

# HECI HIS bits
HIS_IS = 0x1
HIS_IE = 0x2
HIS_D0I3C = 0x4
HIS_FC = 0x8
HIS_DONE = 0x10
HIS_BUSY = 0x20
HIS_RST = 0x40
HIS_RDY = 0x80
HIS_IS_31 = 0x80000000

# Common ME Client IDs
ME_CLIENT_PCH = 0x00
ME_CLIENT_AMT = 0x01
ME_CLIENT_DEBUG = 0x02
ME_CLIENT_MKHI = 0x03
ME_CLIENT_ICC = 0x04
ME_CLIENT_THERMAL = 0x05
ME_CLIENT_POWER = 0x06
ME_CLIENT_FWU = 0x07
ME_CLIENT_IPU = 0x08
ME_CLIENT_ISH = 0x09
ME_CLIENT_TBT = 0x0A
ME_CLIENT_HDCP = 0x0B
ME_CLIENT_PAVP = 0x0C
ME_CLIENT_MCA = 0x0D
ME_CLIENT_DEBUG_TRACE = 0x0E
ME_CLIENT_DEBUG_TRACE_EXT = 0x0F

def read_u32(mmio, offset):
    """Read 32-bit value from MMIO"""
    mmio.seek(offset)
    return struct.unpack('<I', mmio.read(4))[0]

def write_u32(mmio, offset, value):
    """Write 32-bit value to MMIO"""
    mmio.seek(offset)
    mmio.write(struct.pack('<I', value))

def read_heci_status(mmio):
    """Read HECI status registers"""
    hcs = read_u32(mmio, HECI_HCS)
    his = read_u32(mmio, HECI_HIS)
    hicr = read_u32(mmio, HECI_HICR)
    hiidr = read_u32(mmio, HECI_HIIDR)
    himr = read_u32(mmio, HECI_HIMR)
    
    return {
        'hcs': hcs,
        'his': his,
        'hicr': hicr,
        'hiidr': hiidr,
        'himr': himr,
        'ready': bool(hcs & HCS_READY),
        'me_ready': bool(hcs & HCS_ME_RDY),
        'interrupt_pending': bool(his & HIS_IS_31),
        'buffer_size': (hcs & HCS_BUF_SIZE_MASK) >> 16,
    }

def initialize_heci(mmio):
    """Attempt to initialize HECI protocol"""
    print("Initializing HECI protocol...")
    
    status = read_heci_status(mmio)
    print(f"  Initial HCS: 0x{status['hcs']:08X}")
    print(f"  Ready: {status['ready']}")
    print(f"  ME Ready: {status['me_ready']}")
    
    # Try to set ready bit
    hcs_new = status['hcs'] | HCS_READY
    write_u32(mmio, HECI_HCS, hcs_new)
    time.sleep(0.1)
    
    status_after = read_heci_status(mmio)
    print(f"  After set HCS: 0x{status_after['hcs']:08X}")
    print(f"  Ready: {status_after['ready']}")
    
    if status_after['ready']:
        print("  ✓ HECI initialized successfully")
        return True
    
    # Try reset sequence
    print("  Attempting reset sequence...")
    write_u32(mmio, HECI_HCS, status['hcs'] | HCS_RESET)
    time.sleep(0.1)
    write_u32(mmio, HECI_HCS, status['hcs'] | HCS_READY)
    time.sleep(0.1)
    
    status_final = read_heci_status(mmio)
    print(f"  Final HCS: 0x{status_final['hcs']:08X}")
    print(f"  Ready: {status_final['ready']}")
    
    return status_final['ready']

def send_heci_message(mmio, client_id, message_data):
    """Attempt to send HECI message"""
    print(f"\nAttempting to send HECI message to client 0x{client_id:02X}...")
    
    status = read_heci_status(mmio)
    if not status['ready']:
        print("  ✗ HECI not ready")
        return False
    
    if not status['me_ready']:
        print("  ✗ ME not ready")
        return False
    
    # HECI message format:
    # Byte 0: Message length (excluding header)
    # Byte 1: Reserved
    # Byte 2-3: Host address / Client ID
    # Bytes 4+: Message data
    
    buffer_size = status['buffer_size'] * 4
    print(f"  Buffer size: {buffer_size} bytes")
    
    # Check if buffer is available
    if buffer_size < len(message_data) + 4:
        print(f"  ✗ Message too large ({len(message_data) + 4} > {buffer_size})")
        return False
    
    # For now, just report what we would send
    print(f"  Would send {len(message_data)} bytes to client 0x{client_id:02X}")
    print(f"  Message: {message_data.hex()}")
    
    return False  # Don't actually send yet - need more protocol details

def main():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("HECI Protocol Communication Test")
    print("=" * 70)
    
    if os.geteuid() != 0:
        print("\n✗ Must run as root")
        return 1
    
    # Map HECI MMIO
    try:
        mem_fd = os.open('/dev/mem', os.O_RDWR | os.O_SYNC)
        mmio = mmap.mmap(mem_fd, HECI_SIZE, mmap.MAP_SHARED, 
                        mmap.PROT_READ | mmap.PROT_WRITE, offset=HECI_BASE)
        os.close(mem_fd)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"✗ Failed to map HECI MMIO: {e}")
        return 1
    
    # Read initial status
    print("\nInitial HECI Status:")
    status = read_heci_status(mmio)
    for key, value in status.items():
        if isinstance(value, bool):
            print(f"  {key}: {value}")
        else:
            print(f"  {key}: 0x{value:08X}")
    
    # Attempt initialization
    initialized = initialize_heci(mmio)
    
    if initialized:
        # Try to send test message to MKHI client (Management Kernel Host Interface)
        # MKHI is often used for engineering/unlock commands
        test_message = bytes([0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00])  # Placeholder
        send_heci_message(mmio, ME_CLIENT_MKHI, test_message)
    
    mmio.close()
    return 0

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
HECI Full Protocol Implementation
Uses C helper for ioctl, then Python for message handling
Tests unlock commands via MKHI and DEBUG clients
Includes direct execution testing for CPU feature verification
"""

import os
import sys
import glob
import struct
import subprocess
import time
import json

MEI_DEVICE = "/dev/mei0"
HELPER_BIN = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), 'heci_connect_client')

def check_msr_xcr0():
    """Check XCR0 MSR"""
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(['rdmsr', '0x1D'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
        if result.returncode == 0:
            return int(result.stdout.strip(), 16)
    except:
        pass
    return None

def run_direct_execution_test(test_binary):
    """Run direct execution test and return results"""
    try:
        result = subprocess.run([test_binary], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
        return {
            'returncode': result.returncode,
            'success': result.returncode == 0 and 'Illegal instruction' not in result.stderr
        }
    except:
        return {'success': False}

def compile_test_binaries():
    """Compile AVX512 and AMX test binaries if needed"""
    avx512_bin = '/tmp/test_avx512_execution'
    amx_bin = '/tmp/test_amx_execution'
    
    script_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
    unlock_dir = os.path.dirname(script_dir)
    common_dir = os.path.join(unlock_dir, 'common')
    
    if not os.path.exists(avx512_bin):
        source = os.path.join(common_dir, 'test_avx512_execution.c')
        if os.path.exists(source):
            subprocess.run(['gcc', '-mavx512f', '-mavx512bw', '-mavx512vl', 
                          '-o', avx512_bin, source], 
                         capture_output=True)
    
    if not os.path.exists(amx_bin):
        source = os.path.join(common_dir, 'test_amx_execution.c')
        if os.path.exists(source):
            subprocess.run(['gcc', '-mamx-tile', '-mamx-int8', 
                          '-o', amx_bin, source], 
                         capture_output=True)
    
    return avx512_bin, amx_bin

def get_mei_clients():
    """Get list of available MEI clients from sysfs"""
    clients = []
    for path in glob.glob('/sys/bus/mei/devices/*'):
        uuid_file = os.path.join(path, 'uuid')
        max_len_file = os.path.join(path, 'max_len')
        
        if os.path.exists(uuid_file):
            with open(uuid_file, 'r') as f:
                uuid = f.read().strip()
            
            max_len = 0
            if os.path.exists(max_len_file):
                with open(max_len_file, 'r') as f:
                    max_len = int(f.read().strip())
            
            clients.append({
                'uuid': uuid,
                'max_len': max_len,
                'path': path
            })
    
    return clients

def connect_client(uuid):
    """Connect to client using C helper"""
    if not os.path.exists(HELPER_BIN):
        return {'success': False, 'error': 'Helper binary not found'}
    
    result = subprocess.run([HELPER_BIN, uuid], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
    
    if result.returncode == 0 and result.stdout.startswith('SUCCESS:'):
        parts = result.stdout.strip().split(':')
        return {
            'success': True,
            'protocol_version': int(parts[1]),
            'max_msg_length': int(parts[2])
        }
    else:
        if 'FAILED:' in result.stderr:
            parts = result.stderr.strip().split(':')
            return {'success': False, 'error': parts[1], 'errno': int(parts[2])}
        return {'success': False, 'error': 'Unknown error'}

def send_heci_message_direct(fd, payload):
    """Send HECI message directly to connected device"""
    # When connected via ioctl, we can write directly
    # HECI message format: [length(1), reserved(1), host_addr(1), me_addr(1)] + payload
    length = len(payload)
    if length > 255:
        raise ValueError(f"Message too long: {length}")
    
    header = struct.pack('BBBB', length, 0, 0, 0)
    message = header + payload
    
    written = os.write(fd, message)
    return written

def read_heci_message_direct(fd):
    """Read HECI message from connected device"""
    try:
        header = os.read(fd, 4)
        if len(header) < 4:
            return None
        length, reserved, host_addr, me_addr = struct.unpack('BBBB', header)
        if length > 0:
            payload = os.read(fd, length)
            return {'length': length, 'me_addr': me_addr, 'payload': payload}
        return {'length': 0, 'me_addr': me_addr, 'payload': b''}
    except OSError as e:
        if e.errno == 11:  # EAGAIN
            return None
        raise

def main():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("HECI Full Protocol Implementation")
    print("=" * 70)
    
    if os.geteuid() != 0:
        print("\n✗ Must run as root")
        return 1
    
    # Compile test binaries
    print("\n[1] Compiling direct execution tests...")
    avx512_bin, amx_bin = compile_test_binaries()
    
    # Baseline
    print("\n[2] Capturing baseline state...")
    xcr0_before = check_msr_xcr0()
    avx512_before = run_direct_execution_test(avx512_bin)
    amx_before = run_direct_execution_test(amx_bin)
    print(f"  XCR0: {f'0x{xcr0_before:016X}' if xcr0_before else 'N/A'}")
    print(f"  AVX512: {'✓' if avx512_before['success'] else '✗'}")
    print(f"  AMX: {'✓' if amx_before['success'] else '✗'}")
    
    # Get available clients
    print("\n[3] Discovering MEI clients from sysfs...")
    clients = get_mei_clients()
    print(f"  Found {len(clients)} MEI clients")
    
    if not clients:
        print("  ✗ No MEI clients found")
        return 1
    
    results = {
        'baseline': {
            'xcr0': f'0x{xcr0_before:016X}' if xcr0_before else None,
            'avx512_success': avx512_before['success'],
            'amx_success': amx_before['success']
        },
        'connections': []
    }
    
    # Try connecting to clients and sending unlock commands
    print(f"\n{'='*70}")
    print("[4] Connecting to Clients and Testing Unlock Commands")
    print('='*70)
    
    for client in clients[:5]:  # Try first 5
        uuid = client['uuid']
        
        print(f"\nClient: {uuid}")
        result = connect_client(uuid)
        
        if result['success']:
            print(f"  ✓ Connected!")
            print(f"    Protocol version: {result.get('protocol_version', 'N/A')}")
            print(f"    Max message length: {result.get('max_msg_length', 'N/A')} bytes")
            
            # Now open device and send messages
            try:
                fd = os.open(MEI_DEVICE, os.O_RDWR)
                
                # Connect again (ioctl needs to be done on open fd)
                # For now, just document that connection worked
                print(f"  → Device opened for message sending")
                
                # Try sending unlock pattern
                unlock_payload = struct.pack('I', 0xA00A00A0)  # Engineering mode
                try:
                    written = send_heci_message_direct(fd, unlock_payload)
                    print(f"    Sent unlock message: {written} bytes")
                    
                    time.sleep(0.2)
                    response = read_heci_message_direct(fd)
                    if response:
                        print(f"    ✓ Response: {len(response['payload'])} bytes")
                    else:
                        print(f"    ⚠ No response")
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"    ⚠ Message send failed: {e}")
                
                os.close(fd)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"  ⚠ Device access failed: {e}")
            
            results['connections'].append({
                'uuid': uuid,
                'connected': True,
                'protocol_version': result.get('protocol_version'),
                'max_msg_length': result.get('max_msg_length')
            })
        else:
            print(f"  ✗ Failed: {result.get('error', 'Unknown error')}")
            results['connections'].append({
                'uuid': uuid,
                'connected': False,
                'error': result.get('error')
            })
    
    # Check for CPU feature changes
    print(f"\n{'='*70}")
    print("[5] Checking for CPU Feature Changes")
    print('='*70)
    
    xcr0_after = check_msr_xcr0()
    avx512_after = run_direct_execution_test(avx512_bin)
    amx_after = run_direct_execution_test(amx_bin)
    
    xcr0_changed = (xcr0_after and xcr0_after != xcr0_before)
    avx512_changed = (avx512_before['success'] != avx512_after['success'])
    amx_changed = (amx_before['success'] != amx_after['success'])
    
    print(f"  XCR0: {f'0x{xcr0_after:016X}' if xcr0_after else 'N/A'} ({'CHANGED' if xcr0_changed else 'unchanged'})")
    print(f"  AVX512: {'✓' if avx512_after['success'] else '✗'} ({'CHANGED' if avx512_changed else 'unchanged'})")
    print(f"  AMX: {'✓' if amx_after['success'] else '✗'} ({'CHANGED' if amx_changed else 'unchanged'})")
    
    results['after'] = {
        'xcr0': f'0x{xcr0_after:016X}' if xcr0_after else None,
        'xcr0_changed': xcr0_changed,
        'avx512_changed': avx512_changed,
        'amx_changed': amx_changed
    }
    
    if xcr0_changed or avx512_changed or amx_changed:
        print(f"\n  ⚠⚠⚠ HECI PROTOCOL UNLOCK EFFECTS DETECTED ⚠⚠⚠")
    
    # Save results
    output_file = '/tmp/heci_full_protocol_results.json'
    with open(output_file, 'w') as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
    
    print(f"\n{'='*70}")
    print("Test Complete")
    print("=" * 70)
    print(f"Results saved to: {output_file}")
    
    # Summary
    successful = [c for c in results['connections'] if c.get('connected', False)]
    print(f"\nSummary:")
    print(f"  Clients tested: {len(results['connections'])}")
    print(f"  Successful connections: {len(successful)}")
    if successful:
        print(f"  Connected clients:")
        for conn in successful:
            print(f"    - {conn['uuid']}")
    
    return 0

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

/*
 * HECI MKHI Protocol Implementation
 * Implements proper MKHI (Management Kernel Host Interface) commands
 * for unlock and engineering mode operations
 */

#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <linux/mei.h>
#include <linux/mei_uuid.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#define MEI_DEVICE "/dev/mei0"

// MKHI Client UUID (from Intel ME documentation)
#define MKHI_GUID UUID_LE(0x8ba6a053, 0x1ca7, 0x11ea, \
                          0x8b, 0x94, 0x2b, 0x05, 0xb8, 0x9a, 0xf5, 0x2e)

// MKHI Command Groups
#define MKHI_GROUP_GENERAL     0x01
#define MKHI_GROUP_FEATURE    0x02
#define MKHI_GROUP_SECURITY   0x03
#define MKHI_GROUP_MCA        0x04
#define MKHI_GROUP_DEBUG      0x05

// MKHI General Commands
#define MKHI_GEN_GET_FW_VERSION    0x00
#define MKHI_GEN_GET_FW_CAP       0x02

// MKHI Feature Commands
#define MKHI_FEATURE_GET_FEATURES  0x00
#define MKHI_FEATURE_SET_FEATURES  0x01

// MKHI Security Commands
#define MKHI_SEC_GET_SECURITY_STATE    0x00
#define MKHI_SEC_SET_SECURITY_STATE    0x01
#define MKHI_SEC_UNLOCK                0x02
#define MKHI_SEC_ENABLE_ENGINEERING    0x03

// MKHI Debug Commands
#define MKHI_DEBUG_GET_STATUS      0x00
#define MKHI_DEBUG_ENABLE_DEBUG    0x01

// MKHI Message Header
typedef struct {
    uint8_t group_id;
    uint8_t command;
    uint8_t reserved;
    uint8_t result;
} __attribute__((packed)) mkhi_header_t;

// MKHI Get FW Version Response
typedef struct {
    mkhi_header_t header;
    uint16_t major;
    uint16_t minor;
    uint16_t hotfix;
    uint16_t build;
} __attribute__((packed)) mkhi_fw_version_t;

// MKHI Get Security State Response
typedef struct {
    mkhi_header_t header;
    uint32_t security_state;
    uint32_t reserved;
} __attribute__((packed)) mkhi_security_state_t;

// MKHI Set Security State / Unlock Request
typedef struct {
    mkhi_header_t header;
    uint32_t unlock_code;
    uint32_t flags;
} __attribute__((packed)) mkhi_unlock_request_t;

int connect_mkhi_client(int fd) {
    struct mei_connect_client_data data;
    struct mei_client client_info;
    
    memcpy(&data.in_client_uuid, &MKHI_GUID, sizeof(uuid_le));
    
    if (ioctl(fd, IOCTL_MEI_CONNECT_CLIENT, &data) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    client_info = data.out_client_properties;
    printf("  Connected to MKHI client\n");
    printf("    Protocol version: %u\n", client_info.protocol_version);
    printf("    Max message length: %u bytes\n", client_info.max_msg_length);
    
    return 0;
}

int send_mkhi_command(int fd, uint8_t group, uint8_t command, 
                      const void *payload, size_t payload_len,
                      void *response, size_t response_max) {
    mkhi_header_t header = {
        .group_id = group,
        .command = command,
        .reserved = 0,
        .result = 0
    };
    
    // Build message: header + payload
    size_t msg_len = sizeof(header) + payload_len;
    unsigned char message[256];
    
    if (msg_len > sizeof(message)) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    memcpy(message, &header, sizeof(header));
    if (payload && payload_len > 0) {
        memcpy(message + sizeof(header), payload, payload_len);
    }
    
    // Send message
    if (send_heci_message(fd, message, msg_len) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    // Read response
    usleep(200000);  // 200ms
    
    unsigned char resp_buf[256];
    int resp_len = read_heci_message(fd, resp_buf, sizeof(resp_buf));
    
    if (resp_len < (int)sizeof(mkhi_header_t)) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    mkhi_header_t *resp_header = (mkhi_header_t *)resp_buf;
    
    if (resp_header->result != 0) {
        printf("    ⚠ MKHI error: result=0x%02X\n", resp_header->result);
    }
    
    if (response && response_max > 0) {
        size_t copy_len = resp_len - sizeof(mkhi_header_t);
        if (copy_len > response_max) {
            copy_len = response_max;
        }
        memcpy(response, resp_buf + sizeof(mkhi_header_t), copy_len);
    }
    
    return resp_len;
}

// Forward declaration
int send_heci_message(int fd, const unsigned char *payload, size_t len);
int read_heci_message(int fd, unsigned char *buffer, size_t max_len);

int send_heci_message(int fd, const unsigned char *payload, size_t len) {
    if (len > 255) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    unsigned char header[4] = {len, 0, 0, 0};
    
    if (write(fd, header, 4) != 4) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    if (len > 0 && write(fd, payload, len) != (ssize_t)len) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    return 0;
}

static int read_heci_message(int fd, unsigned char *buffer, size_t max_len) {
    unsigned char header[4];
    size_t payload_len;
    
    if (read(fd, header, 4) != 4) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    payload_len = header[0];
    if (payload_len == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    
    if (payload_len > max_len) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    if (read(fd, buffer, payload_len) != (ssize_t)payload_len) {
        return -1;
    }
    
    return payload_len;
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
    int fd;
    
    printf("======================================================================\n");
    printf("HECI MKHI Protocol Implementation\n");
    printf("======================================================================\n\n");
    
    if (geteuid() != 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "✗ Must run as root\n");
        return 1;
    }
    
    fd = open(MEI_DEVICE, O_RDWR);
    if (fd < 0) {
        perror("open");
        return 1;
    }
    
    printf("✓ Opened %s\n\n", MEI_DEVICE);
    
    // Connect to MKHI client
    printf("Connecting to MKHI client...\n");
    if (connect_mkhi_client(fd) < 0) {
        printf("✗ Failed to connect: %s\n", strerror(errno));
        close(fd);
        return 1;
    }
    
    // Test 1: Get FW Version
    printf("\n[1] Get FW Version (General Group)\n");
    mkhi_fw_version_t fw_version;
    int ret = send_mkhi_command(fd, MKHI_GROUP_GENERAL, MKHI_GEN_GET_FW_VERSION,
                                NULL, 0, &fw_version, sizeof(fw_version));
    if (ret > 0) {
        printf("  ✓ Response received: %d bytes\n", ret);
        printf("    Version: %u.%u.%u.%u\n", 
               fw_version.major, fw_version.minor, 
               fw_version.hotfix, fw_version.build);
    } else {
        printf("  ✗ Failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
    }
    
    // Test 2: Get Security State
    printf("\n[2] Get Security State (Security Group)\n");
    mkhi_security_state_t sec_state;
    ret = send_mkhi_command(fd, MKHI_GROUP_SECURITY, MKHI_SEC_GET_SECURITY_STATE,
                           NULL, 0, &sec_state, sizeof(sec_state));
    if (ret > 0) {
        printf("  ✓ Response received: %d bytes\n", ret);
        printf("    Security state: 0x%08X\n", sec_state.security_state);
    } else {
        printf("  ✗ Failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
    }
    
    // Test 3: Unlock Command
    printf("\n[3] Unlock Command (Security Group)\n");
    mkhi_unlock_request_t unlock_req = {
        .header = {
            .group_id = MKHI_GROUP_SECURITY,
            .command = MKHI_SEC_UNLOCK,
            .reserved = 0,
            .result = 0
        },
        .unlock_code = 0xA00A00A0,  // Engineering mode code
        .flags = 0x00000001
    };
    
    mkhi_security_state_t unlock_resp;
    ret = send_mkhi_command(fd, MKHI_GROUP_SECURITY, MKHI_SEC_UNLOCK,
                           &unlock_req.unlock_code, sizeof(unlock_req.unlock_code),
                           &unlock_resp, sizeof(unlock_resp));
    if (ret > 0) {
        printf("  ✓ Response received: %d bytes\n", ret);
        printf("    Security state: 0x%08X\n", unlock_resp.security_state);
    } else {
        printf("  ✗ Failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
    }
    
    // Test 4: Enable Engineering Mode
    printf("\n[4] Enable Engineering Mode (Security Group)\n");
    uint32_t eng_mode_code = 0xDEADBEEF;  // Bypass code
    ret = send_mkhi_command(fd, MKHI_GROUP_SECURITY, MKHI_SEC_ENABLE_ENGINEERING,
                           &eng_mode_code, sizeof(eng_mode_code),
                           &unlock_resp, sizeof(unlock_resp));
    if (ret > 0) {
        printf("  ✓ Response received: %d bytes\n", ret);
        printf("    Security state: 0x%08X\n", unlock_resp.security_state);
    } else {
        printf("  ✗ Failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
    }
    
    // Test 5: Get Features
    printf("\n[5] Get Features (Feature Group)\n");
    unsigned char features_resp[64];
    ret = send_mkhi_command(fd, MKHI_GROUP_FEATURE, MKHI_FEATURE_GET_FEATURES,
                           NULL, 0, features_resp, sizeof(features_resp));
    if (ret > 0) {
        printf("  ✓ Response received: %d bytes\n", ret);
        printf("    Features data: ");
        for (int i = 0; i < ret && i < 16; i++) {
            printf("%02X ", features_resp[i]);
        }
        printf("\n");
    } else {
        printf("  ✗ Failed: %s\n", strerror(errno));
    }
    
    close(fd);
    
    printf("\n======================================================================\n");
    printf("MKHI Protocol Test Complete\n");
    printf("======================================================================\n");
    
    return 0;
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
MEI/HECI Protocol Test via /dev/mei0
Tests Management Engine communication through driver interface
"""

import os
import sys
import struct
import fcntl

# MEI device
MEI_DEVICE = "/dev/mei0"

# HECI Protocol Constants
HECI_HEADER_SIZE = 4
HECI_MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE = 512

# ME Client IDs (common)
ME_CLIENT_PCH = 0x00
ME_CLIENT_AMT = 0x01
ME_CLIENT_DEBUG = 0x02
ME_CLIENT_MKHI = 0x03  # Management Kernel Host Interface
ME_CLIENT_ICC = 0x04
ME_CLIENT_THERMAL = 0x05
ME_CLIENT_POWER = 0x06
ME_CLIENT_FWU = 0x07
ME_CLIENT_IPU = 0x08
ME_CLIENT_ISH = 0x09
ME_CLIENT_TBT = 0x0A
ME_CLIENT_HDCP = 0x0B
ME_CLIENT_PAVP = 0x0C
ME_CLIENT_MCA = 0x0D
ME_CLIENT_DEBUG_TRACE = 0x0E
ME_CLIENT_DEBUG_TRACE_EXT = 0x0F

def read_mei_message(fd):
    """Read HECI message from MEI device"""
    try:
        # HECI message header: [length(1), reserved(1), host_addr(1), me_addr(1)]
        header = os.read(fd, HECI_HEADER_SIZE)
        if len(header) < HECI_HEADER_SIZE:
            return None
        
        length = header[0]
        host_addr = header[2]
        me_addr = header[3]
        
        if length > 0:
            payload = os.read(fd, length)
            return {
                'length': length,
                'host_addr': host_addr,
                'me_addr': me_addr,
                'payload': payload,
            }
        return {
            'length': 0,
            'host_addr': host_addr,
            'me_addr': me_addr,
            'payload': b'',
        }
    except OSError as e:
        if e.errno == 11:  # EAGAIN - no data available
            return None
        raise

def write_mei_message(fd, client_id, payload):
    """Write HECI message to MEI device"""
    length = len(payload)
    if length > 255:
        raise ValueError("Message too long")
    
    # HECI message header
    header = struct.pack('BBBB', length, 0, 0, client_id)
    message = header + payload
    
    os.write(fd, message)
    return len(message)

def connect_to_client(fd, client_id):
    """Attempt to connect to ME client"""
    print(f"Attempting to connect to ME client 0x{client_id:02X}...")
    
    # Connection request payload (simplified)
    # Real protocol may require specific GUID or connection data
    connect_payload = b'\x00' * 16  # Placeholder
    
    try:
        written = write_mei_message(fd, client_id, connect_payload)
        print(f"  ✓ Sent {written} bytes")
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  ✗ Failed: {e}")
        return False

def main():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("MEI/HECI Protocol Test via /dev/mei0")
    print("=" * 70)
    
    if os.geteuid() != 0:
        print("\n✗ Must run as root")
        return 1
    
    if not os.path.exists(MEI_DEVICE):
        print(f"\n✗ MEI device not found: {MEI_DEVICE}")
        print("  Load mei_me driver or check device")
        return 1
    
    print(f"\n✓ Found MEI device: {MEI_DEVICE}")
    
    try:
        # Open MEI device
        fd = os.open(MEI_DEVICE, os.O_RDWR | os.O_NONBLOCK)
        print("✓ Device opened")
        
        # Set non-blocking mode
        flags = fcntl.fcntl(fd, fcntl.F_GETFL)
        fcntl.fcntl(fd, fcntl.F_SETFL, flags | os.O_NONBLOCK)
        
        # Try to read initial state
        print("\nReading initial device state...")
        import time
        time.sleep(0.1)
        
        message = read_mei_message(fd)
        if message:
            print(f"  Received message:")
            print(f"    Length: {message['length']}")
            print(f"    Host Addr: 0x{message['host_addr']:02X}")
            print(f"    ME Addr: 0x{message['me_addr']:02X}")
            print(f"    Payload: {message['payload'].hex()[:64]}...")
        else:
            print("  No messages available")
        
        # Try to connect to MKHI client (often used for unlock commands)
        print("\n" + "=" * 70)
        print("Testing ME Client Connections")
        print("=" * 70)
        
        test_clients = [
            (ME_CLIENT_MKHI, "MKHI (Management Kernel Host Interface)"),
            (ME_CLIENT_DEBUG, "DEBUG"),
            (ME_CLIENT_PCH, "PCH"),
        ]
        
        for client_id, name in test_clients:
            print(f"\nTesting {name} (0x{client_id:02X}):")
            if connect_to_client(fd, client_id):
                time.sleep(0.2)
                response = read_mei_message(fd)
                if response:
                    print(f"  ✓ Received response:")
                    print(f"    ME Addr: 0x{response['me_addr']:02X}")
                    print(f"    Payload: {response['payload'].hex()[:64]}...")
                else:
                    print("  ⚠ No immediate response")
        
        os.close(fd)
        print("\n✓ MEI protocol test complete")
        return 0
        
    except PermissionError:
        print(f"\n✗ Permission denied accessing {MEI_DEVICE}")
        print("  Check device permissions or run with sudo")
        return 1
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"\n✗ Error: {e}")
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()
        return 1

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
