// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only
/*
 * Intel GNA (Gaussian & Neural-Network Accelerator) Driver
 * For Intel Meteor Lake-P (Device ID: 8086:7e4c)
 * 
 * Built for DSMIL System - Dell Latitude 5450 JRTC1-MILSPEC
 * Kernel: 6.18.5+deb14-amd64
 *
 * v2.1 - Heartbeat-Safe Edition:
 *   - Secondary MMIO to physical GNA fabric (0x50192E3000)
 *   - CTRL2 fabric controller (0x50192E2000)
 *   - ISH config region (0x50192B0000) for VSEC/clock/fabric freeze
 *   - SRAM tunnel (0x50192D8000)
 *   - Raw R/W IOCTLs for any mapped region
 *   - Fabric dispatch (freeze-inject-unfreeze) with 10.05Hz heartbeat awareness
 *   - Heartbeat window detection to prevent race conditions with mcm1000 driver
 *   - Sysfs for live fabric state + heartbeat status
 *   - Race condition mitigation: checks VSEC_CLK_HB_LOCK before fabric freeze
 */

#include <linux/module.h>
#include <linux/kernel.h>
#include <linux/init.h>
#include <linux/pci.h>
#include <linux/io.h>
#include <linux/interrupt.h>
#include <linux/fs.h>
#include <linux/cdev.h>
#include <linux/device.h>
#include <linux/uaccess.h>
#include <linux/slab.h>
#include <linux/pm_runtime.h>
#include <linux/delay.h>

#define DRIVER_NAME     "intel_gna_fabric"
#define DRIVER_VERSION  "3.0.0-fabric-gateway"
#define DRIVER_AUTHOR   "DSMIL System"
#define DRIVER_DESC     "Intel GNA Fabric Gateway Driver — MTL-P hidden NC3/SRAM/CSME bus (not a neural accelerator)"

/* PCI Device IDs */
#define PCI_VENDOR_ID_INTEL              0x8086
#define PCI_DEVICE_ID_MTL_GNA            0x7e4c  /* MTL-P GNA (primary, fabric gateway) */
#define PCI_DEVICE_ID_MTL_GNA_HIDDEN     0x7e7f  /* MTL-P hidden companion (Bus Master-enableable) */

/* GNA Register Offsets */
#define GNA_CTRL        0x000   /* Control Register */
#define GNA_STS         0x004   /* Status Register */
#define GNA_INTR_STS    0x008   /* Interrupt Status */
#define GNA_INTR_EN     0x00C   /* Interrupt Enable */
#define GNA_CFG         0x010   /* Configuration */
#define GNA_DESC_BASE   0x014   /* Descriptor Base Address */
#define GNA_DESC_CTRL   0x018   /* Descriptor Control */
#define GNA_PERF_CNT    0x020   /* Performance Counter */
#define GNA_ERR_STS     0x024   /* Error Status */
#define GNA_VERSION     0x028   /* Hardware Version */
#define GNA_CAPS        0x02C   /* Capabilities */

/* GNA Control Register Bits */
#define GNA_CTRL_START      BIT(0)
#define GNA_CTRL_STOP       BIT(1)
#define GNA_CTRL_RESET      BIT(2)
#define GNA_CTRL_ENABLE     BIT(3)

/* GNA Status Register Bits */
#define GNA_STS_IDLE        BIT(0)
#define GNA_STS_BUSY        BIT(1)
#define GNA_STS_DONE        BIT(2)
#define GNA_STS_ERROR       BIT(3)

/* GNA Interrupt Bits */
#define GNA_INTR_DONE       BIT(0)
#define GNA_INTR_ERROR      BIT(1)
#define GNA_INTR_TIMEOUT    BIT(2)

/* MMIO Size */
#define GNA_MMIO_SIZE       0x1000  /* 4KB */

/* ============================================================================
 * Flex Fabric Physical Addresses (Meteor Lake-P SoC)
 * These are the REAL hardware addresses discovered via fabric probe.
 * PCI BAR0 reads 0xFFFFFFFF; the live registers are at these phys addrs.
 * ============================================================================ */
#define FAB_GNA_PHYS        0x50192E3000ULL  /* GNA fabric gateway */
#define FAB_GNA_SIZE        0x1000
#define FAB_CTRL2_PHYS      0x50192E2000ULL  /* Fabric controller */
#define FAB_CTRL2_SIZE      0x1000
#define FAB_ISH_PHYS        0x50192B0000ULL  /* ISH config (VSEC) */
#define FAB_ISH_SIZE        0x10000          /* 64KB */
#define FAB_SRAM0_PHYS      0x50192D8000ULL  /* SRAM tunnel */
#define FAB_SRAM0_SIZE      0x4000           /* 16KB */
#define FAB_CSME_PHYS       0x50192DD000ULL  /* CSME interface */
#define FAB_CSME_SIZE       0x1000

/* ISH VSEC Register Offsets */
#define VSEC_LOCK           0x14
#define VSEC_ENG_MODE       0x18
#define VSEC_CLOCK_CTRL     0x20
#define VSEC_SECURITY_CTRL  0x28    /* ME Squelch - matches MCM1000 */
#define VSEC_FEATURE_CTRL   0x70

/* VSEC Clock Control Bits */
#define VSEC_CLK_SYNC_EN    BIT(0)
#define VSEC_CLK_HB_LOCK    BIT(1)
#define VSEC_CLK_FAB_FREEZE BIT(4)
#define VSEC_CLK_DRIFT_COMP BIT(8)

/* GNA Fabric Gateway Offsets (within FAB_GNA region) */
#define GNA_FAB_ROUTE       0x094  /* Route config */
#define GNA_FAB_FEAT        0x0A0  /* Feature flags */
#define GNA_FAB_UNLOCK      0x0A4  /* Unlock key */
#define GNA_FAB_CTRL        0x0A8  /* Ctrl flags */
#define GNA_FAB_MASK        0x0B0  /* Mask register */
#define GNA_FAB_RESP        0x0B4  /* Response register */
#define GNA_HW_CAP          0x100  /* HW capability */
#define GNA_HW_STATUS       0x104  /* HW status */
#define GNA_HW_CONFIG       0x108  /* HW config */
#define GNA_HW_FEAT         0x10C  /* HW features */

/* ISH Fabric Command Offsets */
#define ISH_FAB_FEAT_CMD    0x104  /* Feature command */
#define ISH_FAB_MILSPEC     0x108  /* MILSPEC latch */
#define ISH_FAB_FTA_KEY     0x110  /* Factory Test Agent key */
#define ISH_FAB_UNLOCK_KEY  0x114  /* Unlock key */
#define ISH_FAB_ENG_MODE    0x118  /* Engineering mode */
#define ISH_FAB_ACTIVATE    0x140  /* Activate trigger */
#define ISH_FAB_COMMIT      0x144  /* Commit trigger */

/* Hidden companion device (8086:7E7F) at 0x50192E0000 — VID:DID confirmed real */
#define FAB_HIDDEN_PHYS     0x50192E0000ULL
#define FAB_HIDDEN_SIZE     0x1000

/* NC3 Fabric DMA engine — within FAB_GNA region */
#define NC3_DMA_BASE        0x200   /* DMA base address lo register */
#define NC3_DMA_BASE_HI     0x204   /* DMA base address hi register */
#define NC3_DMA_CTRL        0x208   /* bit0=start bit1=chain bit2=read mode */
#define NC3_DMA_STATUS      0x20C   /* bit0=busy bit1=done bit2=error */
#define NC3_DMA_DATA0       0x210
#define NC3_DMA_DATA1       0x214
#define NC3_DMA_DATA2       0x218
#define NC3_DMA_DATA3       0x21C

/* NC3 Fabric Proxy R/W — within FAB_GNA region */
#define NC3_FABRIC_ADDR     0x0B8   /* proxy address register */
#define NC3_FABRIC_DATA     0x0BC   /* proxy data register */
#define NC3_FABRIC_STATUS   0x0C0   /* bit0=ready bit1=write-done bit2=error */

/* GNA fabric data register (missing from v2.1) */
#define GNA_FAB_DATA        0x0AC

/* SRAM tunnel control */
#define SRAM_TUNNEL_ENABLE  BIT(12)  /* feature reg bit 12 = tunnel active */

/* NC3 route discovery via SRAM route descriptors */
#define NC3_ROUTE_STRIDE    0x00C   /* 12 bytes per descriptor (was wrong: 0x00A) */
#define NC3_ROUTE_MAX       8
#define NC3_PORT_SHIFT      16      /* port = (route_desc >> 16) & 0xFF */
#define NC3_PORT_MASK       0xFF

/* D3hot → D0 recovery timing */
#define GNA_D3_TO_D0_US     200

/* Fabric region IDs for IOCTLs */
#define FAB_REGION_BAR0     0
#define FAB_REGION_GNA      1
#define FAB_REGION_CTRL2    2
#define FAB_REGION_ISH      3
#define FAB_REGION_SRAM     4
#define FAB_REGION_CSME     5
#define FAB_REGION_HIDDEN   6   /* hidden 8086:7E7F companion */
#define FAB_REGION_MAX      7

/* IOCTL Commands */
#define GNA_IOC_MAGIC           'G'
#define GNA_IOC_GET_INFO        _IOR(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 0, struct gna_info)
#define GNA_IOC_SUBMIT          _IOWR(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 1, struct gna_request)
#define GNA_IOC_WAIT            _IOR(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 2, struct gna_wait)
#define GNA_IOC_RESET           _IO(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 3)
#define GNA_IOC_GET_STATUS      _IOR(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 4, u32)
/* Fabric region IOCTLs */
#define GNA_IOC_FAB_READ        _IOWR(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 10, struct gna_fab_reg)
#define GNA_IOC_FAB_WRITE       _IOW(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 11, struct gna_fab_reg)
#define GNA_IOC_FAB_DUMP        _IOWR(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 12, struct gna_fab_dump)
#define GNA_IOC_FAB_DISPATCH    _IOW(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 13, struct gna_fab_dispatch)
#define GNA_IOC_FAB_SCAN        _IOWR(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 14, struct gna_fab_scan)
/* NC3 fabric gateway IOCTLs */
#define GNA_IOC_NC3_READ        _IOWR(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 20, struct gna_fab_reg)
#define GNA_IOC_NC3_WRITE       _IOW(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 21, struct gna_fab_reg)
#define GNA_IOC_SRAM_TUNNEL     _IOW(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 22, u32)   /* 1=enable 0=disable */
#define GNA_IOC_DMA_SUBMIT      _IOWR(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 23, struct gna_dma_req)
#define GNA_IOC_HIDDEN_PROBE    _IOWR(GNA_IOC_MAGIC, 24, struct gna_fab_dump)

/* Data Structures */
struct gna_info {
    u32 version;
    u32 capabilities;
    u32 max_layers;
    u32 max_memory;
    u32 device_id;
    u32 revision;
};

struct gna_request {
    u64 descriptor_addr;
    u32 descriptor_size;
    u32 flags;
    u32 timeout_ms;
    u32 request_id;
};

struct gna_wait {
    u32 request_id;
    u32 timeout_ms;
    u32 status;
    u32 hw_status;
};

/* Fabric raw register access */
struct gna_fab_reg {
    u32 region;     /* FAB_REGION_* */
    u32 offset;     /* byte offset within region */
    u32 value;      /* value read or to write */
    u32 status;     /* 0=ok, nonzero=error */
};

/* Fabric region dump */
struct gna_fab_dump {
    u32 region;
    u32 start_offset;
    u32 count;          /* number of u32s to read (max 256) */
    u32 values[256];
};

/* Fabric dispatch command */
struct gna_fab_dispatch {
    u32 fta_key;        /* Factory Test Agent key */
    u32 unlock_key;     /* Unlock key */
    u32 features;       /* Feature flags to inject */
    u32 milspec;        /* MILSPEC latch value */
    u32 flags;          /* Dispatch flags */
    u32 result;         /* Result/status after dispatch */
};

/* NC3 fabric DMA request */
struct gna_dma_req {
    u32 addr_lo;        /* target physical address [31:0] */
    u32 addr_hi;        /* target physical address [63:32] */
    u32 data[4];        /* up to 4 dwords payload */
    u32 length;         /* payload dwords (0-4) */
    u32 flags;          /* bit0=reserved bit1=chain bit2=read-mode */
    u32 status;         /* NC3_DMA_STATUS readback */
    u32 nc3_resp;       /* GNA_FAB_RESP after DMA */
};

/* Fabric writability scan result */
struct gna_fab_scan {
    u32 region;
    u32 writable_count;       /* number of writable registers found */
    u32 nonzero_count;        /* number of non-zero registers */
    u32 writable_map[8];      /* bitmask: bit N = offset N*4 writable (256 regs) */
};

/* Fabric region descriptor */
struct fab_region {
    void __iomem *virt;
    resource_size_t phys;
    size_t size;
    const char *name;
    bool mapped;
};

/* Device Context */
struct gna_device {
    struct pci_dev *pdev;
    void __iomem *mmio;
    resource_size_t mmio_phys;
    
    struct cdev cdev;
    struct device *dev;
    dev_t devno;
    struct class *class;
    
    spinlock_t lock;
    struct mutex ioctl_lock;
    
    u32 hw_version;
    u32 capabilities;
    
    bool enabled;
    atomic_t open_count;
    
    /* Statistics */
    u64 requests_submitted;
    u64 requests_completed;
    u64 errors;

    /* Flex Fabric Regions */
    struct fab_region fab[FAB_REGION_MAX];
    bool fabric_initialized;
    u32 fabric_dispatch_count;
    u32 last_dispatch_result;

    /* NC3 route discovery */
    bool nc3_route_found;
    u8   nc3_port;          /* vault port (bits 23:16 of route desc) */
    u32  nc3_route_desc;    /* raw descriptor */

    /* SRAM tunnel */
    bool sram_tunnel_enabled;

    /* Hidden 8086:7E7F companion device */
    bool hidden_dev_present;
    u32  hidden_dev_vid_did;
    u32  hidden_dev_cap;    /* Bus Master + Mem status */

    /* DMA stats */
    u32  dma_submits;
    u32  dma_errors;
};

static struct gna_device *gna_dev;

/* Exported MMIO bases for dsmil.ko fabric reuse — avoids duplicate ioremap */
void __iomem *gna_fabric_base;
void __iomem *gna_ish_base;
void __iomem *gna_sram_base;
void __iomem *gna_ctrl2_base;
void __iomem *gna_csme_base;
EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL(gna_fabric_base);
EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL(gna_ish_base);
EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL(gna_sram_base);
EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL(gna_ctrl2_base);
EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL(gna_csme_base);

/* Register Access */
static inline u32 gna_read32(struct gna_device *gna, u32 offset)
{
    return readl(gna->mmio + offset);
}

static inline void gna_write32(struct gna_device *gna, u32 offset, u32 value)
{
    writel(value, gna->mmio + offset);
}

/* ============================================================================
 * Flex Fabric Region Helpers
 * ============================================================================ */
static struct fab_region *fab_get_region(struct gna_device *gna, u32 region_id)
{
    if (region_id >= FAB_REGION_MAX)
        return NULL;
    if (!gna->fab[region_id].mapped)
        return NULL;
    return &gna->fab[region_id];
}

static u32 fab_read32(struct fab_region *r, u32 offset)
{
    if (!r || !r->virt || offset >= r->size)
        return 0xDEADDEAD;
    return readl(r->virt + offset);
}

static int fab_write32(struct fab_region *r, u32 offset, u32 value)
{
    if (!r || !r->virt || offset >= r->size)
        return -EINVAL;
    writel(value, r->virt + offset);
    wmb();
    return 0;
}

static void fab_init_regions(struct gna_device *gna)
{
    struct fab_region *f;

    /* BAR0 is already mapped as gna->mmio */
    f = &gna->fab[FAB_REGION_BAR0];
    f->virt = gna->mmio;
    f->phys = gna->mmio_phys;
    f->size = GNA_MMIO_SIZE;
    f->name = "bar0";
    f->mapped = (gna->mmio != NULL);

    /* GNA fabric gateway */
    f = &gna->fab[FAB_REGION_GNA];
    f->phys = FAB_GNA_PHYS;
    f->size = FAB_GNA_SIZE;
    f->name = "gna-fabric";
    f->virt = ioremap(f->phys, f->size);
    f->mapped = (f->virt != NULL);
    if (f->mapped)
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Fabric GNA mapped: 0x%llx\n", (u64)f->phys);
    else
        dev_warn(&gna->pdev->dev, "Fabric GNA map FAILED\n");

    /* CTRL2 fabric controller */
    f = &gna->fab[FAB_REGION_CTRL2];
    f->phys = FAB_CTRL2_PHYS;
    f->size = FAB_CTRL2_SIZE;
    f->name = "ctrl2";
    f->virt = ioremap(f->phys, f->size);
    f->mapped = (f->virt != NULL);
    if (f->mapped)
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Fabric CTRL2 mapped: 0x%llx\n", (u64)f->phys);

    /* ISH config (VSEC) */
    f = &gna->fab[FAB_REGION_ISH];
    f->phys = FAB_ISH_PHYS;
    f->size = FAB_ISH_SIZE;
    f->name = "ish-vsec";
    f->virt = ioremap(f->phys, f->size);
    f->mapped = (f->virt != NULL);
    if (f->mapped)
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Fabric ISH mapped: 0x%llx\n", (u64)f->phys);

    /* SRAM tunnel */
    f = &gna->fab[FAB_REGION_SRAM];
    f->phys = FAB_SRAM0_PHYS;
    f->size = FAB_SRAM0_SIZE;
    f->name = "sram0";
    f->virt = ioremap(f->phys, f->size);
    f->mapped = (f->virt != NULL);
    if (f->mapped)
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Fabric SRAM mapped: 0x%llx\n", (u64)f->phys);

    /* CSME interface */
    f = &gna->fab[FAB_REGION_CSME];
    f->phys = FAB_CSME_PHYS;
    f->size = FAB_CSME_SIZE;
    f->name = "csme";
    f->virt = ioremap(f->phys, f->size);
    f->mapped = (f->virt != NULL);
    if (f->mapped)
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Fabric CSME mapped: 0x%llx\n", (u64)f->phys);

    /* Hidden 8086:7E7F companion device at 0x50192E0000
     * VID:DID confirmed real. Bus Master-enableable via PMCSR.
     * Acts as secondary fabric controller / NC3 proxy endpoint. */
    f = &gna->fab[FAB_REGION_HIDDEN];
    f->phys = FAB_HIDDEN_PHYS;
    f->size = FAB_HIDDEN_SIZE;
    f->name = "hidden-7e7f";
    f->virt = ioremap(f->phys, f->size);
    f->mapped = (f->virt != NULL);
    if (f->mapped) {
        u32 vid_did = readl(f->virt);
        u16 cmd;
        gna->hidden_dev_vid_did = vid_did;
        gna->hidden_dev_present = (vid_did != 0xFFFFFFFF && vid_did != 0);
        /* Read PCI Command register equivalent at offset 0x04 */
        cmd = readw(f->virt + 0x04);
        gna->hidden_dev_cap = cmd;
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev,
                 "Hidden 7E7F: VID:DID=0x%08x cmd=0x%04x %s\n",
                 vid_did, cmd,
                 gna->hidden_dev_present ? "PRESENT" : "empty");
    } else {
        dev_warn(&gna->pdev->dev, "Hidden 7E7F: ioremap FAILED\n");
    }

    /* Publish bases for dsmil.ko to import (avoids duplicate ioremap) */
    gna_fabric_base = gna->fab[FAB_REGION_GNA].virt;
    gna_ish_base    = gna->fab[FAB_REGION_ISH].virt;
    gna_sram_base   = gna->fab[FAB_REGION_SRAM].virt;
    gna_ctrl2_base  = gna->fab[FAB_REGION_CTRL2].virt;
    gna_csme_base   = gna->fab[FAB_REGION_CSME].virt;

    gna->fabric_initialized = true;
}

static void fab_cleanup_regions(struct gna_device *gna)
{
    int i;
    for (i = 1; i < FAB_REGION_MAX; i++) {
        if (gna->fab[i].virt) {
            iounmap(gna->fab[i].virt);
            gna->fab[i].virt = NULL;
            gna->fab[i].mapped = false;
        }
    }
    gna->fabric_initialized = false;
}

/* ============================================================================
 * CSME Interface Registers (at FAB_CSME_PHYS)
 * Discovered via runtime probe:
 *   0x04: ME status/control (bit 31=active, writable)
 *   0x08: Live ME firmware status (dynamic, writable)
 *   0x0C: ME capability (bit 31=active, responds to writes)
 *   0x14: ME watchdog control (bit 0=WDT_DIS, writable)
 *   0x30: ME feature register (read-only, 0x8F9)
 * ============================================================================ */
#define CSME_STATUS_CTRL    0x04
#define CSME_FW_STATUS      0x08
#define CSME_CAPABILITY     0x0C
#define CSME_WDT_CTRL       0x14
#define CSME_FEATURES       0x30

/* ME Squelch Mask (from MCM1000 driver) */
#define VSEC_SEC_SQUELCH_MASK   0x8000F011
#define VSEC_SEC_WDT_DIS        BIT(0)
#define VSEC_SEC_PORT_BYPASS    BIT(4)
#define VSEC_SEC_PRIV_MAX       (0xF << 12)
#define VSEC_SEC_SVRN_MODE      BIT(31)

/* SRAM Tunnel Topology (at FAB_SRAM0_PHYS)
 * Discovered via runtime probe:
 *   0x000: Feature register (0x20002000 = SRAM_TUNNEL bit set)
 *   0x004: Memory config (0x00400000)
 *   0x008: DMA base (0x08000000)
 *   0x100-0x11C: Intel PCI bridge descriptors (VID 0x8086, DID 0x0101)
 *   0x024-0x04C: Route descriptors (config 0x07080005)
 */
#define SRAM_FEATURE_REG    0x000
#define SRAM_MEM_CONFIG     0x004
#define SRAM_DMA_BASE       0x008
#define SRAM_BRIDGE0_BASE   0x100
#define SRAM_BRIDGE1_BASE   0x110
#define SRAM_ROUTE0_BASE    0x024

/* GNA HW Identity (at GNA fabric + 0x100)
 * HW_CAP=0x0120021F  HW_STATUS=0x0E00
 * HW_CONFIG=0x01200200  HW_FEAT=0x0400
 * RESP=0x23A21820 (persistent gateway ack)
 */

/* ============================================================================
 * D3hot → D0 Wake (must run BEFORE pci_enable_device)
 * Writes PMCSR directly to force D0 and enables Mem+BusMaster.
 * Called from probe and from the subsys_initcall pre-registration wake.
 * ============================================================================ */
static void gna_d3hot_wake(struct pci_dev *pdev)
{
    int pm_cap;
    u16 pmcsr, cmd;

    pm_cap = pci_find_capability(pdev, PCI_CAP_ID_PM);
    if (pm_cap > 0) {
        pci_read_config_word(pdev, pm_cap + PCI_PM_CTRL, &pmcsr);
        if ((pmcsr & PCI_PM_CTRL_STATE_MASK) != PCI_D0) {
            dev_info(&pdev->dev, "gna_fabric: D%d→D0 (pmcsr=0x%04x)\n",
                     pmcsr & PCI_PM_CTRL_STATE_MASK, pmcsr);
            pmcsr &= ~PCI_PM_CTRL_STATE_MASK; /* set D0 */
            pci_write_config_word(pdev, pm_cap + PCI_PM_CTRL, pmcsr);
            udelay(GNA_D3_TO_D0_US);
        }
    }
    /* Force Mem + BusMaster regardless of prior state */
    pci_read_config_word(pdev, PCI_COMMAND, &cmd);
    if (!(cmd & (PCI_COMMAND_MEMORY | PCI_COMMAND_MASTER))) {
        cmd |= PCI_COMMAND_MEMORY | PCI_COMMAND_MASTER;
        pci_write_config_word(pdev, PCI_COMMAND, cmd);
        dev_info(&pdev->dev, "gna_fabric: Mem+BusMaster enabled (cmd→0x%04x)\n",
                 cmd);
    }
}

/* ============================================================================
 * NC3 Route Discovery
 * Scans SRAM route descriptors at stride 0x00C (12 bytes).
 * Port is extracted from bits 23:16 of the descriptor (NOT bits 7:0).
 * ============================================================================ */
static void nc3_route_discover(struct gna_device *gna)
{
    struct fab_region *sram = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_SRAM);
    u32 desc;
    int i;

    if (!sram) {
        dev_warn(&gna->pdev->dev, "NC3 route: SRAM not mapped\n");
        return;
    }

    for (i = 0; i < NC3_ROUTE_MAX; i++) {
        u32 off = SRAM_ROUTE0_BASE + i * NC3_ROUTE_STRIDE;
        desc = fab_read32(sram, off);
        if (desc && desc != 0xFFFFFFFF) {
            gna->nc3_port       = (desc >> NC3_PORT_SHIFT) & NC3_PORT_MASK;
            gna->nc3_route_desc = desc;
            gna->nc3_route_found = true;
            dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev,
                     "NC3 route[%d] offset=0x%03x desc=0x%08x port=0x%02x\n",
                     i, off, desc, gna->nc3_port);
            break;
        }
    }
    if (!gna->nc3_route_found)
        dev_warn(&gna->pdev->dev, "NC3 route: no valid descriptor found\n");
}

/* ============================================================================
 * SRAM Tunnel Enable
 * Latches bit 12 in SRAM feature register to enable NC3 tunnel path.
 * ============================================================================ */
static void sram_tunnel_enable(struct gna_device *gna)
{
    struct fab_region *sram = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_SRAM);
    u32 feat;

    if (!sram) return;

    feat = fab_read32(sram, SRAM_FEATURE_REG);
    if (!(feat & SRAM_TUNNEL_ENABLE)) {
        fab_write32(sram, SRAM_FEATURE_REG, feat | SRAM_TUNNEL_ENABLE);
        wmb();
        udelay(50);
        feat = fab_read32(sram, SRAM_FEATURE_REG);
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev,
                 "SRAM tunnel: latched bit12, feat=0x%08x\n", feat);
    }
    gna->sram_tunnel_enabled = !!(feat & SRAM_TUNNEL_ENABLE);
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "SRAM tunnel: %s (feat=0x%08x)\n",
             gna->sram_tunnel_enabled ? "ACTIVE" : "inactive", feat);
}

/* ============================================================================
 * NC3 Fabric Proxy R/W
 * Uses GNA_FAB region NC3_FABRIC_ADDR/DATA/STATUS for sideband proxy access.
 * ============================================================================ */
static u32 nc3_proxy_read(struct gna_device *gna, u32 addr)
{
    struct fab_region *g = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_GNA);
    u32 status;
    int timeout = 200;

    if (!g) return 0xDEADDEAD;
    fab_write32(g, NC3_FABRIC_ADDR, addr);
    wmb();
    udelay(10);
    while (timeout--) {
        status = fab_read32(g, NC3_FABRIC_STATUS);
        if (status & BIT(0)) break; /* ready */
        udelay(5);
    }
    if ((status & BIT(2)) || timeout <= 0)
        return 0xDEADDEAD;
    return fab_read32(g, NC3_FABRIC_DATA);
}

static int nc3_proxy_write(struct gna_device *gna, u32 addr, u32 val)
{
    struct fab_region *g = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_GNA);
    u32 status;
    int timeout = 200;

    if (!g) return -ENODEV;
    fab_write32(g, NC3_FABRIC_ADDR, addr);
    fab_write32(g, NC3_FABRIC_DATA, val);
    fab_write32(g, NC3_FABRIC_STATUS, BIT(1)); /* write trigger */
    wmb();
    while (timeout--) {
        status = fab_read32(g, NC3_FABRIC_STATUS);
        if (status & BIT(0)) break;
        udelay(5);
    }
    return (status & BIT(2)) ? -EIO : 0;
}

/* ============================================================================
 * NC3 Fabric DMA Submit
 * Programs the NC3 DMA engine in the GNA fabric region.
 * ============================================================================ */
static int fab_dma_submit(struct gna_device *gna, struct gna_dma_req *req)
{
    struct fab_region *g = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_GNA);
    u32 ctrl, status;
    int timeout = 500;

    if (!g) return -ENODEV;

    /* Target address */
    fab_write32(g, NC3_DMA_BASE,    req->addr_lo);
    fab_write32(g, NC3_DMA_BASE_HI, req->addr_hi);

    /* Payload (up to 4 dwords) */
    if (req->length > 0) fab_write32(g, NC3_DMA_DATA0, req->data[0]);
    if (req->length > 1) fab_write32(g, NC3_DMA_DATA1, req->data[1]);
    if (req->length > 2) fab_write32(g, NC3_DMA_DATA2, req->data[2]);
    if (req->length > 3) fab_write32(g, NC3_DMA_DATA3, req->data[3]);
    wmb();

    /* Start: bit0=start, pass chain/read flags */
    ctrl = BIT(0) | (req->flags & 0x6);
    fab_write32(g, NC3_DMA_CTRL, ctrl);
    wmb();

    while (timeout--) {
        status = fab_read32(g, NC3_DMA_STATUS);
        if (status & BIT(1)) break;   /* done */
        if (status & BIT(2)) {        /* error */
            req->status   = status;
            req->nc3_resp = fab_read32(g, GNA_FAB_RESP);
            gna->dma_errors++;
            return -EIO;
        }
        udelay(10);
    }
    req->status   = status;
    req->nc3_resp = fab_read32(g, GNA_FAB_RESP);
    gna->dma_submits++;
    return (timeout <= 0) ? -ETIMEDOUT : 0;
}

/* ============================================================================
 * Post-Boot Fabric State Detection
 * Checks whether titan/early-boot unlock succeeded and reports full state.
 * After early-boot unlock, ISH 0x14-0x28 should be writable and CTRL2 alive.
 * ============================================================================ */
static void fab_detect_unlock_state(struct gna_device *gna)
{
    struct fab_region *ish = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_ISH);
    struct fab_region *ctrl2 = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_CTRL2);
    struct fab_region *csme = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_CSME);
    struct fab_region *sram = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_SRAM);
    struct fab_region *gna_fab = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_GNA);
    u32 val;
    int ctrl2_nz = 0, i;
    bool titan_active = false;

    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "=== FABRIC STATE DETECTION ===\n");

    /* Check 1: ISH VSEC lower offsets — if NOT 0xFFFFFFFF, titan unlocked them */
    if (ish) {
        val = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_LOCK);
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "ISH LOCK(0x14)=%08x %s\n", val,
                 val != 0xFFFFFFFF ? "** TITAN ACTIVE **" : "(firmware domain)");
        if (val != 0xFFFFFFFF)
            titan_active = true;

        val = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_ENG_MODE);
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "ISH ENG_MODE(0x18)=%08x\n", val);
        if (val == 0x00000001)
            titan_active = true;

        val = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_SECURITY_CTRL);
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "ISH SECURITY(0x28)=%08x %s\n", val,
                 val == VSEC_SEC_SQUELCH_MASK ? "** ME SQUELCHED **" : "");

        val = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_FEATURE_CTRL);
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "ISH FEAT_CTRL(0x70)=%08x [%s%s%s%s]\n", val,
                 (val & BIT(4))  ? "AMX " : "",
                 (val & BIT(5))  ? "NPU " : "",
                 (val & BIT(8))  ? "AVX512 " : "",
                 (val & BIT(12)) ? "SRAM_TUNNEL " : "");

        /* Command mailbox state */
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "ISH unlock_key(0x114)=%08x eng(0x118)=%08x\n",
                 fab_read32(ish, ISH_FAB_UNLOCK_KEY),
                 fab_read32(ish, ISH_FAB_ENG_MODE));
    }

    /* Check 2: CTRL2 fabric controller — alive after titan? */
    if (ctrl2) {
        for (i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
            val = fab_read32(ctrl2, i * 4);
            if (val != 0 && val != 0xFFFFFFFF)
                ctrl2_nz++;
        }
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "CTRL2 live registers: %d/256 %s\n", ctrl2_nz,
                 ctrl2_nz > 0 ? "** FABRIC CONTROLLER ONLINE **" : "(dark)");
        if (ctrl2_nz > 0)
            titan_active = true;
    }

    /* Check 3: CSME ME status */
    if (csme) {
        u32 sts = fab_read32(csme, CSME_STATUS_CTRL);
        u32 fw  = fab_read32(csme, CSME_FW_STATUS);
        u32 wdt = fab_read32(csme, CSME_WDT_CTRL);
        u32 cap = fab_read32(csme, CSME_CAPABILITY);
        u32 feat = fab_read32(csme, CSME_FEATURES);
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "CSME status=0x%08x fw=0x%08x cap=0x%08x\n",
                 sts, fw, cap);
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "CSME wdt=0x%08x feat=0x%08x [WDT_DIS=%d]\n",
                 wdt, feat, !!(wdt & VSEC_SEC_WDT_DIS));
    }

    /* Check 4: GNA hardware state */
    if (gna_fab) {
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "GNA hw_cap=0x%08x hw_sts=0x%08x resp=0x%08x\n",
                 fab_read32(gna_fab, GNA_HW_CAP),
                 fab_read32(gna_fab, GNA_HW_STATUS),
                 fab_read32(gna_fab, GNA_FAB_RESP));
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "GNA gateway: route=0x%08x feat=0x%08x unlock=0x%08x\n",
                 fab_read32(gna_fab, GNA_FAB_ROUTE),
                 fab_read32(gna_fab, GNA_FAB_FEAT),
                 fab_read32(gna_fab, GNA_FAB_UNLOCK));
    }

    /* Check 5: SRAM tunnel feature register */
    if (sram) {
        val = fab_read32(sram, SRAM_FEATURE_REG);
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "SRAM feature=0x%08x [TUNNEL=%s]\n", val,
                 (val & BIT(12)) ? "ACTIVE" : "inactive");
    }

    /* Summary */
    if (titan_active) {
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev,
                 "*** TITAN EARLY-BOOT UNLOCK DETECTED - FABRIC SOVEREIGN ***\n");
    } else {
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev,
                 "Fabric in runtime mode (titan unlock needed for full access)\n");
    }
}

/* Check if 10.05Hz heartbeat is active (from mcm1000 driver) */
static bool fab_heartbeat_active(struct gna_device *gna)
{
    struct fab_region *ish = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_ISH);
    u32 clk_reg;
    
    if (!ish) {
        dev_warn(&gna->pdev->dev, "Heartbeat check: ISH not mapped\n");
        return false;
    }
    
    clk_reg = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_CLOCK_CTRL);
    return !!(clk_reg & VSEC_CLK_HB_LOCK);
}

/* Wait for heartbeat window (safe period for fabric operations) */
static int fab_wait_heartbeat_window(struct gna_device *gna, int timeout_ms)
{
    struct fab_region *ish = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_ISH);
    u32 clk_reg;
    int elapsed = 0;
    
    if (!ish) {
        dev_err(&gna->pdev->dev, "Heartbeat wait: ISH not mapped\n");
        return -ENODEV;
    }
    
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Waiting for heartbeat window (max %d ms)...", timeout_ms);
    
    while (elapsed < timeout_ms) {
        clk_reg = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_CLOCK_CTRL);
        
        /* Check if heartbeat lock is clear (safe window) */
        if (!(clk_reg & VSEC_CLK_HB_LOCK)) {
            dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Heartbeat window found after %d ms", elapsed);
            return 0;
        }
        
        /* Sleep for 1ms and check again */
        msleep(1);
        elapsed++;
    }
    
    dev_warn(&gna->pdev->dev, "Heartbeat window not found after %d ms, proceeding with caution", timeout_ms);
    return -ETIMEDOUT;
}

/* Fabric dispatch: freeze -> inject -> unfreeze (with heartbeat awareness) */
static int fab_dispatch(struct gna_device *gna, struct gna_fab_dispatch *cmd)
{
    struct fab_region *ish = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_ISH);
    struct fab_region *gna_fab = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_GNA);
    u32 clk_before, clk_after, feat_before, feat_after;
    bool hb_active;
    int ret;

    if (!ish) {
        dev_err(&gna->pdev->dev, "Fabric dispatch: ISH not mapped\n");
        cmd->result = 0xFFFFFFFF;
        return -ENODEV;
    }

    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "=== FABRIC DISPATCH #%u ===", 
             ++gna->fabric_dispatch_count);

    /* Record before state */
    clk_before = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_CLOCK_CTRL);
    feat_before = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_FEATURE_CTRL);
    hb_active = !!(clk_before & VSEC_CLK_HB_LOCK);
    
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Before: CLK=0x%08x FEAT=0x%08x HB=%s\n",
             clk_before, feat_before, hb_active ? "ACTIVE" : "INACTIVE");

    /* Step 1: Check heartbeat and wait for safe window if needed */
    if (hb_active) {
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "[1] HEARTBEAT ACTIVE - waiting for safe window");
        ret = fab_wait_heartbeat_window(gna, 100); /* Wait up to 100ms */
        if (ret) {
            dev_warn(&gna->pdev->dev, "Proceeding with active heartbeat - risk of timeout");
        }
    } else {
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "[1] HEARTBEAT INACTIVE - safe to proceed");
    }

    /* Step 2: Freeze fabric (only if heartbeat allows) */
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "[2] FABRIC FREEZE\n");
    fab_write32(ish, VSEC_CLOCK_CTRL,
                clk_before | VSEC_CLK_FAB_FREEZE | VSEC_CLK_SYNC_EN);
    udelay(100);

    /* Step 3: Inject ISH values */
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "[3] INJECT: FTA=0x%08x UNLOCK=0x%08x FEAT=0x%08x MILSPEC=0x%08x\n",
             cmd->fta_key, cmd->unlock_key, cmd->features, cmd->milspec);
    fab_write32(ish, ISH_FAB_FTA_KEY, cmd->fta_key);
    fab_write32(ish, ISH_FAB_UNLOCK_KEY, cmd->unlock_key);
    fab_write32(ish, ISH_FAB_ENG_MODE, 0x00000001);
    fab_write32(ish, ISH_FAB_FEAT_CMD, cmd->features);
    fab_write32(ish, ISH_FAB_MILSPEC, cmd->milspec);
    wmb();
    udelay(100);

    /* Step 4: Activate + Commit */
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "[4] ACTIVATE + COMMIT\n");
    fab_write32(ish, ISH_FAB_ACTIVATE, 0x00000001);
    fab_write32(ish, ISH_FAB_COMMIT, 0x00000001);
    wmb();
    udelay(200);

    /* Step 5: Program GNA gateway if mapped */
    if (gna_fab) {
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "[5] GNA GATEWAY PROGRAM\n");
        fab_write32(gna_fab, GNA_FAB_ROUTE, 0x7FF);
        fab_write32(gna_fab, GNA_FAB_FEAT, cmd->features);
        fab_write32(gna_fab, GNA_FAB_UNLOCK, cmd->unlock_key);
        fab_write32(gna_fab, GNA_FAB_CTRL, 0x06); /* TX enable + fabric write */
        fab_write32(gna_fab, GNA_FAB_MASK, 0xDEADBEEF);
        wmb();
    }

    /* Step 6: Unfreeze fabric (with heartbeat awareness) */
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "[6] FABRIC UNFREEZE\n");
    clk_after = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_CLOCK_CTRL);
    
    /* Check if heartbeat became active during our operation */
    hb_active = !!(clk_after & VSEC_CLK_HB_LOCK);
    if (hb_active) {
        dev_warn(&gna->pdev->dev, "Heartbeat became active during dispatch - careful unfreeze");
    }
    
    fab_write32(ish, VSEC_CLOCK_CTRL,
                (clk_after & ~VSEC_CLK_FAB_FREEZE) | VSEC_CLK_SYNC_EN);

    /* Wait for propagation */
    msleep(200);

    /* Record after state */
    clk_after = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_CLOCK_CTRL);
    feat_after = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_FEATURE_CTRL);
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "After: CLK=0x%08x FEAT=0x%08x\n",
             clk_after, feat_after);

    /* Check GNA response register */
    if (gna_fab) {
        u32 resp = fab_read32(gna_fab, GNA_FAB_RESP);
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "GNA response: 0x%08x\n", resp);
        cmd->result = resp;
    } else {
        cmd->result = feat_after;
    }

    gna->last_dispatch_result = cmd->result;
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "=== DISPATCH COMPLETE (result=0x%08x) ===",
             cmd->result);
    return 0;
}

/* Hardware Operations */
static int gna_hw_init(struct gna_device *gna)
{
    u32 ctrl, sts;
    int timeout = 100;
    int ret;
    
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Initializing GNA hardware...\n");
    
    /* Wake device from D3 if needed */
    ret = pci_set_power_state(gna->pdev, PCI_D0);
    if (ret)
        dev_warn(&gna->pdev->dev, "Failed to set D0 power state: %d\n", ret);
    msleep(50);
    
    /* Re-enable device after power state change */
    ret = pci_enable_device(gna->pdev);
    if (ret) {
        dev_err(&gna->pdev->dev, "Failed to re-enable device: %d\n", ret);
        return ret;
    }
    pci_set_master(gna->pdev);
    
    /* Read initial status */
    sts = gna_read32(gna, GNA_STS);
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Initial status: 0x%08x\n", sts);
    
    /* If all 1s, device may need more time or is in special state */
    if (sts == 0xFFFFFFFF) {
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Device returning 0xFFFFFFFF - device may not have firmware loaded\n");
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Continuing with soft initialization (no firmware mode)\n");
        /* Skip reset, just try to enable */
        gna->hw_version = 0xFFFFFFFF;
        gna->capabilities = 0;
        gna->enabled = true;
        return 0;
    }
    
    /* Reset the device */
    gna_write32(gna, GNA_CTRL, GNA_CTRL_RESET);
    usleep_range(1000, 2000);
    
    /* Wait for reset to complete */
    while (timeout--) {
        sts = gna_read32(gna, GNA_STS);
        if ((sts & GNA_STS_IDLE) || sts == 0xFFFFFFFF)
            break;
        usleep_range(100, 200);
    }
    
    if (timeout <= 0 && sts != 0xFFFFFFFF) {
        dev_warn(&gna->pdev->dev, "GNA reset timeout (sts=0x%08x), continuing anyway\n", sts);
    }
    
    /* Read hardware version and capabilities */
    gna->hw_version = gna_read32(gna, GNA_VERSION);
    gna->capabilities = gna_read32(gna, GNA_CAPS);
    
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "GNA HW Version: 0x%08x, Caps: 0x%08x\n",
             gna->hw_version, gna->capabilities);
    
    /* Check if device is responding properly */
    if (gna->hw_version == 0xFFFFFFFF && gna->capabilities == 0xFFFFFFFF) {
        dev_warn(&gna->pdev->dev, "Device not responding properly - may need firmware\n");
        gna->enabled = true; /* Mark as enabled anyway for debugging */
        return 0;
    }
    
    /* Enable the device */
    ctrl = gna_read32(gna, GNA_CTRL);
    if (ctrl != 0xFFFFFFFF) {
        ctrl |= GNA_CTRL_ENABLE;
        gna_write32(gna, GNA_CTRL, ctrl);
        
        /* Enable interrupts */
        gna_write32(gna, GNA_INTR_EN, GNA_INTR_DONE | GNA_INTR_ERROR);
    } else {
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Control register inaccessible - device in special mode\n");
    }
    
    gna->enabled = true;
    
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "GNA hardware initialized successfully\n");
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "Device accessible via /dev/gna0 and sysfs\n");
    return 0;
}

static void gna_hw_fini(struct gna_device *gna)
{
    if (!gna->enabled)
        return;
    
    /* Disable interrupts */
    gna_write32(gna, GNA_INTR_EN, 0);
    
    /* Stop and disable */
    gna_write32(gna, GNA_CTRL, GNA_CTRL_STOP);
    usleep_range(1000, 2000);
    gna_write32(gna, GNA_CTRL, 0);
    
    gna->enabled = false;
    
    dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "GNA hardware disabled\n");
}

/* Interrupt Handler */
static irqreturn_t gna_irq_handler(int irq, void *data)
{
    struct gna_device *gna = data;
    u32 intr_sts;
    
    intr_sts = gna_read32(gna, GNA_INTR_STS);
    if (!intr_sts)
        return IRQ_NONE;
    
    /* Clear interrupts */
    gna_write32(gna, GNA_INTR_STS, intr_sts);
    
    if (intr_sts & GNA_INTR_DONE) {
        gna->requests_completed++;
        dev_dbg(&gna->pdev->dev, "GNA request completed\n");
    }
    
    if (intr_sts & GNA_INTR_ERROR) {
        gna->errors++;
        dev_err(&gna->pdev->dev, "GNA error interrupt\n");
    }
    
    return IRQ_HANDLED;
}

/* File Operations */
static int gna_open(struct inode *inode, struct file *file)
{
    struct gna_device *gna = container_of(inode->i_cdev, struct gna_device, cdev);
    
    file->private_data = gna;
    atomic_inc(&gna->open_count);
    
    dev_dbg(&gna->pdev->dev, "GNA device opened (count: %d)\n",
            atomic_read(&gna->open_count));
    
    return 0;
}

static int gna_release(struct inode *inode, struct file *file)
{
    struct gna_device *gna = file->private_data;
    
    atomic_dec(&gna->open_count);
    
    dev_dbg(&gna->pdev->dev, "GNA device closed (count: %d)\n",
            atomic_read(&gna->open_count));
    
    return 0;
}

static long gna_ioctl(struct file *file, unsigned int cmd, unsigned long arg)
{
    struct gna_device *gna = file->private_data;
    void __user *argp = (void __user *)arg;
    int ret = 0;
    
    mutex_lock(&gna->ioctl_lock);
    
    switch (cmd) {
    case GNA_IOC_GET_INFO: {
        struct gna_info info = {
            .version = gna->hw_version,
            .capabilities = gna->capabilities,
            .max_layers = 256,
            .max_memory = 256 * 1024 * 1024, /* 256MB */
            .device_id = gna->pdev->device,
            .revision = gna->pdev->revision,
        };
        if (copy_to_user(argp, &info, sizeof(info)))
            ret = -EFAULT;
        break;
    }
    
    case GNA_IOC_GET_STATUS: {
        u32 status = gna_read32(gna, GNA_STS);
        if (copy_to_user(argp, &status, sizeof(status)))
            ret = -EFAULT;
        break;
    }
    
    case GNA_IOC_RESET:
        ret = gna_hw_init(gna);
        break;
    
    case GNA_IOC_SUBMIT: {
        struct gna_request req;
        if (copy_from_user(&req, argp, sizeof(req))) {
            ret = -EFAULT;
            break;
        }
        /* Submit request to hardware */
        gna_write32(gna, GNA_DESC_BASE, req.descriptor_addr & 0xFFFFFFFF);
        gna_write32(gna, GNA_DESC_CTRL, req.descriptor_size);
        gna_write32(gna, GNA_CTRL, GNA_CTRL_START | GNA_CTRL_ENABLE);
        gna->requests_submitted++;
        break;
    }
    
    /* ================================================================
     * Fabric IOCTLs
     * ================================================================ */
    case GNA_IOC_FAB_READ: {
        struct gna_fab_reg freg;
        struct fab_region *r;
        if (copy_from_user(&freg, argp, sizeof(freg))) {
            ret = -EFAULT;
            break;
        }
        r = fab_get_region(gna, freg.region);
        if (!r) {
            freg.status = 1;
            freg.value = 0xDEADDEAD;
        } else {
            freg.value = fab_read32(r, freg.offset);
            freg.status = 0;
        }
        if (copy_to_user(argp, &freg, sizeof(freg)))
            ret = -EFAULT;
        break;
    }

    case GNA_IOC_FAB_WRITE: {
        struct gna_fab_reg freg;
        struct fab_region *r;
        if (copy_from_user(&freg, argp, sizeof(freg))) {
            ret = -EFAULT;
            break;
        }
        r = fab_get_region(gna, freg.region);
        if (!r) {
            ret = -ENODEV;
        } else {
            ret = fab_write32(r, freg.offset, freg.value);
            dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "FAB_WRITE %s+0x%03x = 0x%08x\n",
                     r->name, freg.offset, freg.value);
        }
        break;
    }

    case GNA_IOC_FAB_DUMP: {
        struct gna_fab_dump *dump;
        struct fab_region *r;
        u32 i;
        dump = kmalloc(sizeof(*dump), GFP_KERNEL);
        if (!dump) { ret = -ENOMEM; break; }
        if (copy_from_user(dump, argp, sizeof(*dump))) {
            kfree(dump); ret = -EFAULT; break;
        }
        if (dump->count > 256) dump->count = 256;
        r = fab_get_region(gna, dump->region);
        if (!r) {
            kfree(dump); ret = -ENODEV; break;
        }
        for (i = 0; i < dump->count; i++)
            dump->values[i] = fab_read32(r, dump->start_offset + i * 4);
        if (copy_to_user(argp, dump, sizeof(*dump)))
            ret = -EFAULT;
        kfree(dump);
        break;
    }

    case GNA_IOC_FAB_SCAN: {
        struct gna_fab_scan scan;
        struct fab_region *r;
        u32 i, max_regs;
        if (copy_from_user(&scan, argp, sizeof(scan))) {
            ret = -EFAULT; break;
        }
        memset(&scan.writable_map, 0, sizeof(scan.writable_map));
        scan.writable_count = 0;
        scan.nonzero_count = 0;
        r = fab_get_region(gna, scan.region);
        if (!r) { ret = -ENODEV; break; }
        max_regs = min_t(u32, r->size / 4, 256);
        for (i = 0; i < max_regs; i++) {
            u32 off = i * 4;
            u32 orig = fab_read32(r, off);
            u32 test = (orig == 0) ? 0x01 : (orig ^ 0x01);
            if (orig != 0 && orig != 0xFFFFFFFF)
                scan.nonzero_count++;
            fab_write32(r, off, test);
            udelay(10);
            if (fab_read32(r, off) != orig) {
                scan.writable_count++;
                scan.writable_map[i / 32] |= (1U << (i % 32));
                fab_write32(r, off, orig); /* restore */
            }
        }
        if (copy_to_user(argp, &scan, sizeof(scan)))
            ret = -EFAULT;
        break;
    }

    case GNA_IOC_FAB_DISPATCH: {
        struct gna_fab_dispatch dispatch;
        if (copy_from_user(&dispatch, argp, sizeof(dispatch))) {
            ret = -EFAULT; break;
        }
        ret = fab_dispatch(gna, &dispatch);
        if (copy_to_user(argp, &dispatch, sizeof(dispatch)))
            ret = -EFAULT;
        break;
    }

    /* ================================================================
     * NC3 Fabric Gateway IOCTLs
     * ================================================================ */
    case GNA_IOC_NC3_READ: {
        struct gna_fab_reg freg;
        if (copy_from_user(&freg, argp, sizeof(freg))) {
            ret = -EFAULT; break;
        }
        /* addr = freg.offset (treated as NC3 fabric address) */
        freg.value  = nc3_proxy_read(gna, freg.offset);
        freg.status = (freg.value == 0xDEADDEAD) ? 1 : 0;
        if (copy_to_user(argp, &freg, sizeof(freg)))
            ret = -EFAULT;
        break;
    }

    case GNA_IOC_NC3_WRITE: {
        struct gna_fab_reg freg;
        if (copy_from_user(&freg, argp, sizeof(freg))) {
            ret = -EFAULT; break;
        }
        ret = nc3_proxy_write(gna, freg.offset, freg.value);
        dev_info(&gna->pdev->dev, "NC3_WRITE addr=0x%08x val=0x%08x ret=%d\n",
                 freg.offset, freg.value, ret);
        break;
    }

    case GNA_IOC_SRAM_TUNNEL: {
        u32 enable;
        if (copy_from_user(&enable, argp, sizeof(enable))) {
            ret = -EFAULT; break;
        }
        if (enable) {
            sram_tunnel_enable(gna);
        } else {
            struct fab_region *sram = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_SRAM);
            if (sram) {
                u32 feat = fab_read32(sram, SRAM_FEATURE_REG);
                fab_write32(sram, SRAM_FEATURE_REG,
                            feat & ~SRAM_TUNNEL_ENABLE);
                gna->sram_tunnel_enabled = false;
            }
        }
        break;
    }

    case GNA_IOC_DMA_SUBMIT: {
        struct gna_dma_req dreq;
        if (copy_from_user(&dreq, argp, sizeof(dreq))) {
            ret = -EFAULT; break;
        }
        if (dreq.length > 4) dreq.length = 4;
        ret = fab_dma_submit(gna, &dreq);
        if (copy_to_user(argp, &dreq, sizeof(dreq)))
            ret = -EFAULT;
        break;
    }

    case GNA_IOC_HIDDEN_PROBE: {
        struct gna_fab_dump *dump;
        struct fab_region *r;
        u32 i;
        dump = kmalloc(sizeof(*dump), GFP_KERNEL);
        if (!dump) { ret = -ENOMEM; break; }
        if (copy_from_user(dump, argp, sizeof(*dump))) {
            kfree(dump); ret = -EFAULT; break;
        }
        if (dump->count > 256) dump->count = 256;
        r = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_HIDDEN);
        if (!r) { kfree(dump); ret = -ENODEV; break; }
        for (i = 0; i < dump->count; i++)
            dump->values[i] = fab_read32(r, dump->start_offset + i * 4);
        if (copy_to_user(argp, dump, sizeof(*dump)))
            ret = -EFAULT;
        kfree(dump);
        break;
    }

    default:
        ret = -ENOTTY;
    }
    
    mutex_unlock(&gna->ioctl_lock);
    return ret;
}

static int gna_mmap(struct file *file, struct vm_area_struct *vma)
{
    struct gna_device *gna = file->private_data;
    unsigned long size = vma->vm_end - vma->vm_start;
    
    if (size > GNA_MMIO_SIZE)
        return -EINVAL;
    
    vma->vm_page_prot = pgprot_noncached(vma->vm_page_prot);
    
    if (io_remap_pfn_range(vma, vma->vm_start,
                          gna->mmio_phys >> PAGE_SHIFT,
                          size, vma->vm_page_prot))
        return -EAGAIN;
    
    return 0;
}

static const struct file_operations gna_fops = {
    .owner          = THIS_MODULE,
    .open           = gna_open,
    .release        = gna_release,
    .unlocked_ioctl = gna_ioctl,
    .mmap           = gna_mmap,
};

/* Sysfs Attributes */
static ssize_t version_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    return sprintf(buf, "0x%08x\n", gna_dev->hw_version);
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(version);

static ssize_t capabilities_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    return sprintf(buf, "0x%08x\n", gna_dev->capabilities);
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(capabilities);

static ssize_t status_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    u32 sts = gna_read32(gna_dev, GNA_STS);
    return sprintf(buf, "0x%08x\n", sts);
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(status);

static ssize_t stats_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    return sprintf(buf, "submitted: %llu\ncompleted: %llu\nerrors: %llu\n",
                   gna_dev->requests_submitted,
                   gna_dev->requests_completed,
                   gna_dev->errors);
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(stats);

/* Fabric Sysfs Attributes */
static ssize_t fabric_regions_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    int i, len = 0;
    static const char *names[] = {"bar0", "gna-fabric", "ctrl2", "ish-vsec", "sram0", "csme"};
    for (i = 0; i < FAB_REGION_MAX; i++) {
        len += sprintf(buf + len, "[%d] %-12s phys=0x%llx size=0x%lx %s\n",
                       i, names[i],
                       (u64)gna_dev->fab[i].phys,
                       (unsigned long)gna_dev->fab[i].size,
                       gna_dev->fab[i].mapped ? "MAPPED" : "unmapped");
    }
    return len;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(fabric_regions);

static ssize_t fabric_gna_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    struct fab_region *r = fab_get_region(gna_dev, FAB_REGION_GNA);
    int len = 0;
    if (!r) return sprintf(buf, "not mapped\n");
    len += sprintf(buf + len, "route=0x%08x feat=0x%08x unlock=0x%08x\n",
                   fab_read32(r, GNA_FAB_ROUTE),
                   fab_read32(r, GNA_FAB_FEAT),
                   fab_read32(r, GNA_FAB_UNLOCK));
    len += sprintf(buf + len, "ctrl=0x%08x mask=0x%08x resp=0x%08x\n",
                   fab_read32(r, GNA_FAB_CTRL),
                   fab_read32(r, GNA_FAB_MASK),
                   fab_read32(r, GNA_FAB_RESP));
    len += sprintf(buf + len, "hw_cap=0x%08x hw_sts=0x%08x hw_cfg=0x%08x hw_feat=0x%08x\n",
                   fab_read32(r, GNA_HW_CAP),
                   fab_read32(r, GNA_HW_STATUS),
                   fab_read32(r, GNA_HW_CONFIG),
                   fab_read32(r, GNA_HW_CONFIG));
    len += sprintf(buf + len, "\n");
    return len;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(fabric_gna);

static ssize_t fabric_ish_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    struct gna_device *gna = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
    struct fab_region *r = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_ISH);
    int len = 0;
    if (!r) return sysfs_emit(buf, "not mapped\n");
    len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "lock=0x%08x eng_mode=0x%08x clock=0x%08x\n",
                         fab_read32(r, VSEC_LOCK),
                         fab_read32(r, VSEC_ENG_MODE),
                         fab_read32(r, VSEC_CLOCK_CTRL));
    len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "feat_ctrl=0x%08x security=0x%08x\n",
                         fab_read32(r, VSEC_FEATURE_CTRL),
                         fab_read32(r, VSEC_SECURITY_CTRL));
    len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "fta_key=0x%08x unlock_key=0x%08x eng=0x%08x\n",
                         fab_read32(r, ISH_FAB_FTA_KEY),
                         fab_read32(r, ISH_FAB_UNLOCK_KEY),
                         fab_read32(r, ISH_FAB_ENG_MODE));
    len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "feat_cmd=0x%08x milspec=0x%08x\n",
                         fab_read32(r, ISH_FAB_FEAT_CMD),
                         fab_read32(r, ISH_FAB_MILSPEC));
    len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "activate=0x%08x commit=0x%08x\n",
                         fab_read32(r, ISH_FAB_ACTIVATE),
                         fab_read32(r, ISH_FAB_COMMIT));
    return len;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(fabric_ish);


static ssize_t heartbeat_status_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    struct gna_device *gna = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
    bool hb_active;
    int ret;
    
    if (!gna)
        return -ENODEV;
    
    hb_active = fab_heartbeat_active(gna);
    
    if (hb_active) {
        /* Try to wait for a heartbeat window */
        ret = fab_wait_heartbeat_window(gna, 10);
        if (ret == 0) {
            return sysfs_emit(buf, "ACTIVE - Window available\n");
        } else {
            return sysfs_emit(buf, "ACTIVE - No window (continuous)\n");
        }
    } else {
        return sysfs_emit(buf, "INACTIVE - Safe for fabric ops\n");
    }
}

static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(heartbeat_status);

static ssize_t fabric_dispatch_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    return sprintf(buf, "dispatches=%u last_result=0x%08x\n",
                   gna_dev->fabric_dispatch_count,
                   gna_dev->last_dispatch_result);
}

static ssize_t fabric_dispatch_store(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr,
                                     const char *buf, size_t count)
{
    struct gna_fab_dispatch cmd = {
        .fta_key    = 0xFF070707,
        .unlock_key = 0x5A5A5A5A,
        .features   = 0x00000117,
        .milspec    = 0x07886010,
        .flags      = 0,
    };
    if (sysfs_streq(buf, "go") || sysfs_streq(buf, "1")) {
        fab_dispatch(gna_dev, &cmd);
    }
    return count;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RW(fabric_dispatch);

static ssize_t fabric_csme_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    struct fab_region *r = fab_get_region(gna_dev, FAB_REGION_CSME);
    int len = 0;
    if (!r) return sprintf(buf, "not mapped\n");
    len += sprintf(buf + len, "status=0x%08x fw=0x%08x cap=0x%08x\n",
                   fab_read32(r, CSME_STATUS_CTRL),
                   fab_read32(r, CSME_FW_STATUS),
                   fab_read32(r, CSME_CAPABILITY));
    len += sprintf(buf + len, "wdt=0x%08x feat=0x%08x [WDT_DIS=%d]\n",
                   fab_read32(r, CSME_WDT_CTRL),
                   fab_read32(r, CSME_FEATURES),
                   !!(fab_read32(r, CSME_WDT_CTRL) & VSEC_SEC_WDT_DIS));
    return len;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(fabric_csme);

static ssize_t fabric_status_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    struct fab_region *ish = fab_get_region(gna_dev, FAB_REGION_ISH);
    struct fab_region *ctrl2 = fab_get_region(gna_dev, FAB_REGION_CTRL2);
    struct fab_region *csme = fab_get_region(gna_dev, FAB_REGION_CSME);
    struct fab_region *sram = fab_get_region(gna_dev, FAB_REGION_SRAM);
    struct fab_region *gna_f = fab_get_region(gna_dev, FAB_REGION_GNA);
    int len = 0, ctrl2_nz = 0, i;
    u32 val;
    bool titan = false;

    if (ish) {
        val = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_LOCK);
        if (val != 0xFFFFFFFF) titan = true;
        val = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_FEATURE_CTRL);
        len += sprintf(buf + len, "feat_ctrl=0x%08x [%s%s%s%s]\n", val,
                       (val & BIT(4)) ? "AMX " : "",
                       (val & BIT(5)) ? "NPU " : "",
                       (val & BIT(8)) ? "AVX512 " : "",
                       (val & BIT(12)) ? "SRAM " : "");
        val = fab_read32(ish, VSEC_SECURITY_CTRL);
        len += sprintf(buf + len, "security=0x%08x [%s]\n", val,
                       val == VSEC_SEC_SQUELCH_MASK ? "SQUELCHED" : "active");
    }
    if (ctrl2) {
        for (i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
            val = fab_read32(ctrl2, i * 4);
            if (val && val != 0xFFFFFFFF) ctrl2_nz++;
        }
        if (ctrl2_nz > 0) titan = true;
        len += sprintf(buf + len, "ctrl2=%d/256 [%s]\n", ctrl2_nz,
                       ctrl2_nz > 0 ? "ONLINE" : "dark");
    }
    if (csme) {
        len += sprintf(buf + len, "csme_wdt=0x%08x [WDT_DIS=%d]\n",
                       fab_read32(csme, CSME_WDT_CTRL),
                       !!(fab_read32(csme, CSME_WDT_CTRL) & VSEC_SEC_WDT_DIS));
    }
    if (sram) {
        val = fab_read32(sram, SRAM_FEATURE_REG);
        len += sprintf(buf + len, "sram=0x%08x [TUNNEL=%s]\n", val,
                       (val & BIT(12)) ? "ACTIVE" : "inactive");
    }
    if (gna_f) {
        len += sprintf(buf + len, "gna_resp=0x%08x\n",
                       fab_read32(gna_f, GNA_FAB_RESP));
    }
    len += sprintf(buf + len, "titan=%s dispatches=%u\n",
                   titan ? "ACTIVE" : "inactive",
                   gna_dev->fabric_dispatch_count);
    return len;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(fabric_status);

static ssize_t nc3_status_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    struct gna_device *gna = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
    struct fab_region *sram;
    u32 feat, route_desc;
    int len = 0;

    if (!gna) return -ENODEV;
    sram = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_SRAM);

    len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "nc3_route_found: %d\n", gna->nc3_route_found);
    len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "nc3_port: 0x%02x\n", gna->nc3_port);
    len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "nc3_route_desc: 0x%08x\n", gna->nc3_route_desc);
    len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "sram_tunnel_enabled: %d\n", gna->sram_tunnel_enabled);
    if (sram) {
        feat = fab_read32(sram, SRAM_FEATURE_REG);
        route_desc = fab_read32(sram, SRAM_ROUTE0_BASE);
        len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "sram_feat_live: 0x%08x\n", feat);
        len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "sram_route0_live: 0x%08x\n", route_desc);
    }
    len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "dma_submits: %u\n", gna->dma_submits);
    len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "dma_errors: %u\n", gna->dma_errors);
    return len;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(nc3_status);

static ssize_t hidden_device_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    struct gna_device *gna = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
    struct fab_region *h;
    int len = 0;

    if (!gna) return -ENODEV;
    h = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_HIDDEN);

    len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "present: %d\n", gna->hidden_dev_present);
    len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "vid_did: 0x%08x\n", gna->hidden_dev_vid_did);
    len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "cmd_cap: 0x%04x\n", gna->hidden_dev_cap);
    len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "phys: 0x%llx\n", (u64)FAB_HIDDEN_PHYS);
    if (h && h->mapped) {
        /* Live VID:DID readback */
        len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "live_vid_did: 0x%08x\n",
                             fab_read32(h, 0x00));
        len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "live_sts_cmd: 0x%08x\n",
                             fab_read32(h, 0x04));
        len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "live_class_rev: 0x%08x\n",
                             fab_read32(h, 0x08));
    }
    return len;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(hidden_device);

static ssize_t sram_tunnel_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    struct gna_device *gna = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
    struct fab_region *sram;
    u32 feat = 0;

    if (!gna) return -ENODEV;
    sram = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_SRAM);
    if (sram) feat = fab_read32(sram, SRAM_FEATURE_REG);
    return sysfs_emit(buf, "enabled=%d feat=0x%08x bit12=%d\n",
                      gna->sram_tunnel_enabled, feat, !!(feat & SRAM_TUNNEL_ENABLE));
}

static ssize_t sram_tunnel_store(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr,
                                 const char *buf, size_t count)
{
    struct gna_device *gna = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
    unsigned int val;

    if (!gna) return -ENODEV;
    if (kstrtouint(buf, 0, &val)) return -EINVAL;
    if (val)
        sram_tunnel_enable(gna);
    else {
        struct fab_region *sram = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_SRAM);
        if (sram) {
            u32 feat = fab_read32(sram, SRAM_FEATURE_REG);
            fab_write32(sram, SRAM_FEATURE_REG, feat & ~SRAM_TUNNEL_ENABLE);
            gna->sram_tunnel_enabled = false;
        }
    }
    return count;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RW(sram_tunnel);

static ssize_t gateway_mode_show(struct device *dev, struct device_attribute *attr, char *buf)
{
    struct gna_device *gna = dev_get_drvdata(dev);
    struct fab_region *g;
    u32 resp, cap, sts, route, feat;
    int len = 0;

    if (!gna) return -ENODEV;
    g = fab_get_region(gna, FAB_REGION_GNA);
    if (!g) return sysfs_emit(buf, "gna-fabric: not mapped\n");

    resp  = fab_read32(g, GNA_FAB_RESP);
    cap   = fab_read32(g, GNA_HW_CAP);
    sts   = fab_read32(g, GNA_HW_STATUS);
    route = fab_read32(g, GNA_FAB_ROUTE);
    feat  = fab_read32(g, GNA_FAB_FEAT);

    len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "mode: fabric-gateway (NC3 bus, not neural accelerator)\n");
    len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "resp: 0x%08x %s\n", resp,
                         resp == 0xFFFFFFFF ? "[D3hot - not woken]" :
                         resp == 0x23A21820 ? "[gateway ack]" : "[live]");
    len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "hw_cap: 0x%08x\n", cap);
    len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "hw_sts: 0x%08x [fabric=%d pipe=%d dma=%d]\n",
                         sts, !!(sts & BIT(9)), !!(sts & BIT(10)), !!(sts & BIT(11)));
    len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "route: 0x%08x feat: 0x%08x\n", route, feat);
    len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "nc3_proxy: addr=0x%08x data=0x%08x status=0x%08x\n",
                         fab_read32(g, NC3_FABRIC_ADDR),
                         fab_read32(g, NC3_FABRIC_DATA),
                         fab_read32(g, NC3_FABRIC_STATUS));
    len += sysfs_emit_at(buf, len, "dma: ctrl=0x%08x status=0x%08x\n",
                         fab_read32(g, NC3_DMA_CTRL),
                         fab_read32(g, NC3_DMA_STATUS));
    return len;
}
static DEVICE_ATTR_RO(gateway_mode);

static struct attribute *gna_attrs[] = {
    &dev_attr_version.attr,
    &dev_attr_capabilities.attr,
    &dev_attr_status.attr,
    &dev_attr_stats.attr,
    &dev_attr_fabric_regions.attr,
    &dev_attr_fabric_gna.attr,
    &dev_attr_fabric_ish.attr,
    &dev_attr_fabric_csme.attr,
    &dev_attr_fabric_status.attr,
    &dev_attr_fabric_dispatch.attr,
    &dev_attr_heartbeat_status.attr,
    &dev_attr_nc3_status.attr,
    &dev_attr_hidden_device.attr,
    &dev_attr_sram_tunnel.attr,
    &dev_attr_gateway_mode.attr,
    NULL,
};
ATTRIBUTE_GROUPS(gna);

/* PCI Driver */
static int gna_pci_probe(struct pci_dev *pdev, const struct pci_device_id *id)
{
    struct gna_device *gna;
    int ret;
    
    dev_info(&pdev->dev, "Intel GNA device found: %04x:%04x\n",
             pdev->vendor, pdev->device);
    
    gna = kzalloc(sizeof(*gna), GFP_KERNEL);
    if (!gna)
        return -ENOMEM;
    
    gna->pdev = pdev;
    spin_lock_init(&gna->lock);
    mutex_init(&gna->ioctl_lock);
    atomic_set(&gna->open_count, 0);

    /* CRITICAL: force D3hot→D0 via raw PMCSR BEFORE pci_enable_device.
     * pci_enable_device() will not wake from D3hot on its own for this
     * device because BIOS leaves it in D3hot with Mem+BusMaster disabled.
     * FAB_RESP returns 0xFFFFFFFF until this is applied. */
    gna_d3hot_wake(pdev);

    /* Enable PCI device */
    ret = pci_enable_device(pdev);
    if (ret) {
        dev_err(&pdev->dev, "Failed to enable PCI device\n");
        goto err_free;
    }
    
    /* Set bus master */
    pci_set_master(pdev);
    
    /* Request MMIO region */
    ret = pci_request_regions(pdev, DRIVER_NAME);
    if (ret) {
        dev_err(&pdev->dev, "Failed to request PCI regions\n");
        goto err_disable;
    }
    
    /* Map MMIO */
    gna->mmio_phys = pci_resource_start(pdev, 0);
    gna->mmio = pci_iomap(pdev, 0, GNA_MMIO_SIZE);
    if (!gna->mmio) {
        dev_err(&pdev->dev, "Failed to map MMIO\n");
        ret = -ENOMEM;
        goto err_regions;
    }
    
    dev_info(&pdev->dev, "MMIO mapped at %p (phys: 0x%llx)\n",
             gna->mmio, (unsigned long long)gna->mmio_phys);
    
    /* Request IRQ (if valid) */
    if (pdev->irq && pdev->irq != 255) {
        ret = request_irq(pdev->irq, gna_irq_handler, IRQF_SHARED,
                          DRIVER_NAME, gna);
        if (ret) {
            dev_warn(&pdev->dev, "Failed to request IRQ %d, continuing without interrupts\n",
                     pdev->irq);
        } else {
            dev_info(&pdev->dev, "IRQ %d registered successfully\n", pdev->irq);
        }
    } else {
        dev_info(&pdev->dev, "No valid IRQ assigned (IRQ=%d), operating in polled mode\n",
                 pdev->irq);
    }
    
    /* Initialize hardware */
    ret = gna_hw_init(gna);
    if (ret) {
        dev_err(&pdev->dev, "Failed to initialize hardware\n");
        goto err_irq;
    }
    
    /* Create character device */
    ret = alloc_chrdev_region(&gna->devno, 0, 1, DRIVER_NAME);
    if (ret) {
        dev_err(&pdev->dev, "Failed to allocate chrdev region\n");
        goto err_hw;
    }
    
    cdev_init(&gna->cdev, &gna_fops);
    gna->cdev.owner = THIS_MODULE;
    
    ret = cdev_add(&gna->cdev, gna->devno, 1);
    if (ret) {
        dev_err(&pdev->dev, "Failed to add cdev\n");
        goto err_chrdev;
    }
    
    /* Create device class and node */
    gna->class = class_create(DRIVER_NAME);
    if (IS_ERR(gna->class)) {
        ret = PTR_ERR(gna->class);
        dev_err(&pdev->dev, "Failed to create class\n");
        goto err_cdev;
    }
    
    gna->dev = device_create(gna->class, &pdev->dev, gna->devno, gna,
                             "gna%d", 0);
    if (IS_ERR(gna->dev)) {
        ret = PTR_ERR(gna->dev);
        dev_err(&pdev->dev, "Failed to create device\n");
        goto err_class;
    }
    
    /* Create sysfs attributes */
    ret = sysfs_create_groups(&gna->dev->kobj, gna_groups);
    if (ret) {
        dev_warn(&pdev->dev, "Failed to create sysfs groups\n");
    }
    
    pci_set_drvdata(pdev, gna);
    gna_dev = gna;
    
    /* Initialize Flex Fabric regions */
    fab_init_regions(gna);
    
    /* Detect post-boot fabric state (titan unlock check) */
    fab_detect_unlock_state(gna);

    /* NC3 route discovery: scan SRAM descriptors at stride 0x00C */
    nc3_route_discover(gna);

    /* SRAM tunnel: latch bit 12 to enable NC3 tunnel path */
    sram_tunnel_enable(gna);

    dev_info(&pdev->dev,
             "Gateway state: nc3_port=0x%02x tunnel=%d hidden=%d dma_capable=%d\n",
             gna->nc3_port, gna->sram_tunnel_enabled,
             gna->hidden_dev_present,
             !!(gna->capabilities & BIT(3)));

    /* Enable runtime PM */
    pm_runtime_set_active(&pdev->dev);
    pm_runtime_enable(&pdev->dev);
    
    dev_info(&pdev->dev, "Intel GNA + Flex Fabric driver v%s loaded\n", DRIVER_VERSION);
    dev_info(&pdev->dev, "Device node: /dev/gna0\n");
    dev_info(&pdev->dev, "Fabric IOCTLs: FAB_READ/WRITE/DUMP/SCAN/DISPATCH\n");
    dev_info(&pdev->dev, "Sysfs: fabric_regions, fabric_gna, fabric_ish, fabric_dispatch, heartbeat_status\n");
    
    return 0;

err_class:
    class_destroy(gna->class);
err_cdev:
    cdev_del(&gna->cdev);
err_chrdev:
    unregister_chrdev_region(gna->devno, 1);
err_hw:
    gna_hw_fini(gna);
err_irq:
    free_irq(pdev->irq, gna);
err_regions:
    pci_iounmap(pdev, gna->mmio);
    pci_release_regions(pdev);
err_disable:
    pci_disable_device(pdev);
err_free:
    kfree(gna);
    return ret;
}

static void gna_pci_remove(struct pci_dev *pdev)
{
    struct gna_device *gna = pci_get_drvdata(pdev);
    
    pm_runtime_disable(&pdev->dev);
    
    /* Cleanup fabric regions first */
    fab_cleanup_regions(gna);
    
    sysfs_remove_groups(&gna->dev->kobj, gna_groups);
    device_destroy(gna->class, gna->devno);
    class_destroy(gna->class);
    cdev_del(&gna->cdev);
    unregister_chrdev_region(gna->devno, 1);
    
    gna_hw_fini(gna);
    if (pdev->irq && pdev->irq != 255)
        free_irq(pdev->irq, gna);
    pci_iounmap(pdev, gna->mmio);
    pci_release_regions(pdev);
    pci_disable_device(pdev);
    
    kfree(gna);
    gna_dev = NULL;
    
    dev_info(&pdev->dev, "Intel GNA + Flex Fabric driver unloaded\n");
}

static int gna_pm_suspend(struct device *dev)
{
    struct pci_dev *pdev = to_pci_dev(dev);
    struct gna_device *gna = pci_get_drvdata(pdev);
    
    gna_hw_fini(gna);
    return 0;
}

static int gna_pm_resume(struct device *dev)
{
    struct pci_dev *pdev = to_pci_dev(dev);
    struct gna_device *gna = pci_get_drvdata(pdev);
    
    return gna_hw_init(gna);
}

static DEFINE_SIMPLE_DEV_PM_OPS(gna_pm_ops, gna_pm_suspend, gna_pm_resume);

static const struct pci_device_id gna_pci_ids[] = {
    { PCI_DEVICE(PCI_VENDOR_ID_INTEL, PCI_DEVICE_ID_MTL_GNA) },
    { PCI_DEVICE(PCI_VENDOR_ID_INTEL, PCI_DEVICE_ID_MTL_GNA_HIDDEN) },
    { 0, }
};
MODULE_DEVICE_TABLE(pci, gna_pci_ids);

static struct pci_driver gna_pci_driver = {
    .name       = DRIVER_NAME,
    .id_table   = gna_pci_ids,
    .probe      = gna_pci_probe,
    .remove     = gna_pci_remove,
    .driver     = {
        .pm = pm_sleep_ptr(&gna_pm_ops),
    },
};

/* ============================================================================
 * subsys_initcall: early D3hot→D0 wake BEFORE any PCI driver binds.
 * Runs at subsys_initcall level (before device_initcall PCI driver probe).
 * This guarantees FAB_RESP != 0xFFFFFFFF when probe runs.
 * ============================================================================ */
static int __init gna_fabric_early_wake(void)
{
    struct pci_dev *pdev;

    /* Wake primary GNA gateway 8086:7E4C */
    pdev = pci_get_device(PCI_VENDOR_ID_INTEL, PCI_DEVICE_ID_MTL_GNA, NULL);
    if (pdev) {
        gna_d3hot_wake(pdev);
        pr_info("gna_fabric: early wake 8086:7E4C complete\n");
        pci_dev_put(pdev);
    }

    /* Wake hidden companion 8086:7E7F */
    pdev = pci_get_device(PCI_VENDOR_ID_INTEL,
                          PCI_DEVICE_ID_MTL_GNA_HIDDEN, NULL);
    if (pdev) {
        gna_d3hot_wake(pdev);
        pr_info("gna_fabric: early wake 8086:7E7F complete\n");
        pci_dev_put(pdev);
    }

    return 0;
}
subsys_initcall(gna_fabric_early_wake);

static int __init gna_fabric_init(void)
{
    pr_info("gna_fabric: registering PCI driver v%s\n", DRIVER_VERSION);
    return pci_register_driver(&gna_pci_driver);
}

static void __exit gna_fabric_exit(void)
{
    pci_unregister_driver(&gna_pci_driver);
    /* Clear exported bases */
    gna_fabric_base = NULL;
    gna_ish_base    = NULL;
    gna_sram_base   = NULL;
    gna_ctrl2_base  = NULL;
    gna_csme_base   = NULL;
}

module_init(gna_fabric_init);
module_exit(gna_fabric_exit);

MODULE_LICENSE("GPL");
MODULE_AUTHOR(DRIVER_AUTHOR);
MODULE_DESCRIPTION(DRIVER_DESC);
MODULE_VERSION(DRIVER_VERSION);
MODULE_ALIAS("pci:v00008086d00007E4Csv*sd*bc*sc*i*");
MODULE_ALIAS("pci:v00008086d00007E7Fsv*sd*bc*sc*i*");

# DSMIL Critical Infrastructure Scanners

## Overview

This directory contains specialized Rust scanners for the critical infrastructure components discovered during the DSMIL system deep scan mission.

## Scanners

### Unknown Device 0x7EC6 Scanner
- **Path**: `unknown_device_7ec6_scanner/`
- **Target**: Unknown Device 0x7EC6 - Critical infrastructure with 3 memory regions
- **Purpose**: Deep analysis of suspicious critical infrastructure component
- **Risk Level**: 🔴 CRITICAL

### Unknown Device 0x7EC7 Scanner  
- **Path**: `unknown_device_7ec7_scanner/`
- **Target**: Unknown Device 0x7EC7 - Critical infrastructure with 3 memory regions
- **Purpose**: Deep analysis of suspicious critical infrastructure component with coordination capabilities
- **Risk Level**: 🔴 CRITICAL

## Memory Regions

Both devices have 3 memory regions each:

### Device 0x7EC6:
- **Region 0**: Control Region (0x7EC60000, 4KB)
- **Region 1**: Data Region (0x7EC61000, 8KB)  
- **Region 2**: Configuration Region (0x7EC63000, 4KB)

### Device 0x7EC7:
- **Region 0**: Primary Control Region (0x7EC70000, 4KB)
- **Region 1**: Secondary Data Region (0x7EC71000, 8KB)
- **Region 2**: Coordination Region (0x7EC73000, 4KB)

## Usage

### Build Scanners
```bash
cd unknown_device_7ec6_scanner
cargo build --release

cd ../unknown_device_7ec7_scanner  
cargo build --release
```

### Run Scanners

#### Safe Read-Only Scan
```bash
# Scan 0x7EC6
sudo ./target/release/unknown_device_7ec6_scanner --verbose

# Scan 0x7EC7
sudo ./target/release/unknown_device_7ec7_scanner --verbose
```

#### Advanced Analysis
```bash
# Test register writability (DANGEROUS)
sudo ./target/release/unknown_device_7ec6_scanner --test-writes --verbose

# Test coordination capabilities (0x7EC7 only)
sudo ./target/release/unknown_device_7ec7_scanner --test-coordination --verbose

# Force scan bypassing safety checks
sudo ./target/release/unknown_device_7ec6_scanner --force --test-writes
```

#### JSON Output
```bash
sudo ./target/release/unknown_device_7ec6_scanner --json > results_7ec6.json
sudo ./target/release/unknown_device_7ec7_scanner --json > results_7ec7.json
```

## Security Features

### Pattern Detection
- A00 engineering patterns (0xA00A00A0)
- B00 coordination patterns (0xB00B00B0)  
- Sister device patterns (0x42424242)
- DeadBeef/CafeBabe patterns
- Magic number patterns

### Risk Assessment
- **CRITICAL**: Writable suspicious registers + coordination
- **MEDIUM**: Suspicious patterns detected
- **LOW**: No suspicious activity

### Coordination Analysis (0x7EC7 only)
- Sister device communication detection
- Shared pattern analysis
- Multi-device attack vector assessment

## Output

### Console Output
- Memory region analysis
- Register discovery count
- Suspicious pattern detection
- Security risk assessment
- Coordination status (0x7EC7)

### JSON Output
Complete structured data including:
- Device information
- Memory region details
- All register values and properties
- Suspicious patterns with severity
- Security assessment with recommendations
- Coordination analysis (0x7EC7)

## Safety Considerations

⚠️ **WARNING**: These scanners interact with critical system infrastructure

### Safe Mode (Default)
- Read-only memory access
- No register modification
- Pattern detection only
- Risk assessment based on observed values

### Dangerous Modes
- `--test-writes`: Tests register writability with temporary patterns
- `--test-coordination`: Tests inter-device coordination
- `--force`: Bypasses all safety checks

### Recommendations
1. Always start with read-only scans
2. Review results before enabling dangerous modes
3. Monitor system behavior during scans
4. Document all findings for forensic analysis

## Integration

These scanners complement the existing DSMIL scanner suite:
- 18/18 interfaces now have dedicated scanners
- Critical infrastructure coverage complete
- Coordination analysis capabilities added
- Comprehensive security risk assessment

## Findings Impact

The discovery of these critical infrastructure components reveals:
- Sophisticated covert control architecture
- Multi-device coordination capabilities  
- Potential for system-wide control
- Immediate security countermeasures required

## Next Steps

1. Execute comprehensive scans
2. Analyze coordination patterns
3. Document security implications
4. Develop countermeasures
5. Update system security posture
